# Neuralis implementation

The user authorized implementation of Neuralis Studio, a browser and desktop neural research workbench, with English UI and documentation, real runnable demos, a separate `demos/super-mario` reinforcement-learning project, numbered actual screenshots, and GitHub Pages deployment. The earlier onboarding restriction on changing tracked code does not apply to this authorized coding task.

Agents share this checkout. Do not create worktrees. Respect assigned file ownership; coordinate shared contracts with the root agent. Do not commit or push from a child agent.

Deliver working, substantive code. Never pad line counts, duplicate modules, fabricate training results, fake live backend capabilities, or label generated design images as screenshots. All experiment metrics must derive from actual computation; unavailable integrations need an honest capability message. The production code target is at least 30,000 useful lines excluding dependencies, generated output, comments, blank lines, tests and docs; report actual counts honestly.

Keep UI and documentation in English. Use CPU-first defaults and bounded capture/render budgets. GitHub Pages is static: browser demos must run without a Python server; optional remote backend integrations must be clearly labeled.

Use existing credentials without printing them. Never print environment/credential values. Preserve TLS/checksum verification. Do not download model weights or launch costly jobs without a clear need. Mario training must report achieved performance, not promise a perfect policy.

Add meaningful tests for numerical engines, control/state transitions, persistence, and integrations. Run checks belonging to your part. Preserve command exit status.

# Neuralis Studio

Neuralis Studio is an open neural research workbench for the browser and desktop. It combines a local, reproducible learning engine with an optional PyTorch runtime for experiments that need a real Python process. The interface is English throughout.

The browser build runs without a server and includes inspectable models, training controls, weights, activations, gradients, attention views, interventions, representation analysis, CSV preprocessing, checkpoints, replay and a library of runnable demonstrations. The optional API runs registered PyTorch MLP, CNN and causal Transformer examples on CPU and exposes bounded telemetry, checkpoints, inference, attribution and controlled interventions. The desktop shell is a Tauri host for the same UI and a local or remote runtime.

The project does not claim access to the private weights or internal tools of Anthropic, OpenAI or xAI. A 3D graph is a measured representation of captured model data, not a visualization of private model thoughts. Large-laboratory adapters report their actual availability; PostgreSQL, S3, OIDC, Slurm, Kubernetes, TransformerLens and Circuit Tracer are optional capabilities and are not silently presented as configured in this checkout.

## Try the browser workbench

```bash
npm ci
npm run dev
```

Open `http://localhost:5173`. Browser demos execute on the current device. `npm run build` creates the static site in `apps/web/dist`, packages the self-contained demos and Mario evidence, and is the build used by GitHub Pages.

The repository includes a Pages workflow at `.github/workflows/pages.yml`. After the `main` branch is pushed and Pages is enabled for the repository with **GitHub Actions** as its source, the site is served at:

`https://3scud3r0.github.io/Neuralis/`

The workflow runs TypeScript checks, browser tests and the production build before publishing. A static Pages site cannot run the Python API or train Mario; it provides the CPU browser experiments, source demos, viewer and measured evidence. Use a local API or desktop runtime for larger models.

## Run the Python runtime

The validated runtime targets Python 3.12–3.13 and CPU by default. `uv` keeps dependencies and the CPU PyTorch wheel pinned.

```bash
uv sync --project services/api --extra dev
uv run --project services/api python -m neuralis
```

The API listens on `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. In Neuralis Studio open **Infrastructure**, enter that URL and connect. The frontend calls the versioned `/api/v1` API, receives WebSocket events, and reports gaps instead of pretending that dropped telemetry was captured. The API advertises the validated device and integration limits at `/api/v1/capabilities`.

Useful checks:

```bash
uv run --project services/api pytest services/api/tests
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
```

Runtime data is stored outside the checkout by default in `/tmp/neuralis-data`. Set `NEURALIS_DATA`, `NEURALIS_HOST`, `NEURALIS_PORT` and explicit `NEURALIS_CORS_ORIGINS` when running it elsewhere. Do not use wildcard CORS for a laboratory deployment. Authentication and project controls are configuration-sensitive; the default loopback process is not a production multi-user service.

## Mario research demo

The separate `demos/super-mario` project uses `gym-super-mario-bros`/`nes_py`, PyTorch and a reproducible PPO or Double-DQN pipeline. It includes action wrappers, frame stacking, bounded PPO, a dueling prioritized n-step Double-DQN, checkpoints, replay integrity, evaluation, activation capture, integrated gradients, Grad-CAM, ablation and a static report viewer.

```bash
cd demos/super-mario
python3.11 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python doctor.py
python train.py --config configs/smoke.json
python evaluate.py --checkpoint runs/latest/checkpoint.pt --episodes 3
```

The emulator smoke test and a 2,048-transition PPO run completed in this environment. The held-out short evaluation completed **0/3 flags**; the maximum observed x-position was 314 and mean native return was 250. The Double-DQN smoke test completed 512 transitions and 61 gradient updates; it also did not solve a level. These are measured research baselines, not a claim of perfect Mario play. Longer training requires a user-owned machine, legal game assets and substantially more compute.

The numbered Mario evidence and report are in `demos/super-mario/evidence/`. The browser viewer is `demos/super-mario/index.html`. Large checkpoints and replay buffers are intentionally not included in the static Pages artifact.

## Desktop and laboratory profiles

The Tauri shell is under `apps/desktop`. Its Rust core manages a local Python sidecar with an ephemeral port and token, secure workspace paths, checkpoint dialogs, diagnostics and remote connection metadata. The desktop package needs the platform's native WebView/GTK toolchain; the browser and Python workflows do not.

`deploy/compose.yaml` is the validated local container profile for the API and worker. `deploy/compose.cloud.yaml`, `deploy/oidc.env.example` and `docs/laboratory.md` describe the explicit laboratory extensions. They do not imply that a PostgreSQL/S3/cluster is available in this environment.

## Repository map

```text
apps/web/                 React, TypeScript, Three.js and browser training engine
apps/desktop/             Tauri host, runtime lifecycle and secure file integration
services/api/             FastAPI, PyTorch models, capture, interventions and persistence
services/worker/          Worker leases, bounded execution and distributed diagnostics
demos/                    Browser examples and isolated Super Mario RL project
deploy/                   Local/container laboratory profiles
docs/                     Desktop, laboratory and source-count documentation
screenshots/              Numbered captures of the implemented application
```

Generated dependencies, local runs, checkpoints, recordings, `node_modules`, virtual environments and build output are ignored. The source count is produced with `python3 scripts/count-code.py`; it separates production, tests, configuration and tooling and never counts dependencies or generated bundles.

## Scope and evidence

The current checkout is CPU-first and bounded. The browser and API tests compare gradients, attention masks, checkpoints, interventions and training metrics against real numerical references. The Pages workflow is configured but publication is owned by GitHub repository settings and the Actions run. The final capture manifest distinguishes actual screenshots from design references; generated concept images in the proposal are not presented as product evidence.

/** Browser-safe bridge: use global Tauri IPC only inside the installed app. */
export interface NativePreferences {
  schema_version: number;
  mode: 'browser_only' | 'local' | 'remote';
  python_executable: string;
  repository_root: string | null;
  remote_endpoint: string | null;
  data_directory?: string | null;
  startup_timeout_seconds: number;
  capture_budget_bytes: number;
}
export interface NativeStatus {
  phase: 'browser_only' | 'starting' | 'ready' | 'failed' | 'stopped';
  endpoint: string | null;
  managed: boolean;
  process_id: number | null;
  message: string;
}
export interface NativeArtifact {
  filename: string; kind: 'checkpoint' | 'experiment' | 'metrics' | 'dataset' | 'capture';
  bytes: number; sha256: string; created_at_ms: number;
}
export interface NativeProject {
  schema_version: number; id: string; name: string; description: string;
  created_at_ms: number; updated_at_ms: number; tags: string[]; artifacts: NativeArtifact[];
}
export interface FileReceipt { path: string; bytes: number; sha256: string }
interface TauriGlobal { core: { invoke<T>(command: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T> } }
function host(): TauriGlobal | undefined {
  return (globalThis as typeof globalThis & { __TAURI__?: TauriGlobal }).__TAURI__;
}
export function isDesktop(): boolean { return Boolean(host()); }
async function invoke<T>(command: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T> {
  const native = host();
  if (!native) throw new Error('This operation requires the Neuralis desktop application.');
  return native.core.invoke<T>(command, args);
}
export const desktop = {
  preferences: () => invoke<NativePreferences>('get_preferences'),
  savePreferences: (preferences: NativePreferences) => invoke<void>('save_preferences', { preferences }),
  start: (token?: string) => invoke<NativeStatus>('start_backend', { token: token ?? null }),
  stop: () => invoke<void>('stop_backend'),
  status: () => invoke<NativeStatus>('backend_status'),
  probePython: () => invoke<{ executable: string; ready: boolean; missing: string[]; recommendations: string[]; runtime: { python: string; platform: string; cuda_available: boolean; cuda_device_count: number; packages: Record<string, { available: boolean; version: string | null }> } }>("probe_python_runtime"),
  diagnostics: () => invoke<string[]>('backend_diagnostics'),
  request: <T>(method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE', path: string, body?: unknown) => invoke<T>('backend_request', { method, path, body: body ?? null }),
  selectExportFolder: () => invoke<string | null>('choose_export_directory'),
  selectCheckpoint: () => invoke<string | null>('choose_checkpoint'),
  exportCheckpoint: (directory: string, filename: string, content: string) => invoke<FileReceipt>('export_checkpoint', { directory, filename, content }),
  selectWorkspace: () => invoke<string | null>('choose_workspace'),
  listProjects: () => invoke<NativeProject[]>('list_projects'),
  createProject: (name: string, description: string, tags: string[]) => invoke<NativeProject>('create_project', { name, description, tags }),
  updateProject: (id: string, name: string, description: string, tags: string[]) => invoke<NativeProject>('update_project', { id, name, description, tags }),
  addArtifact: (id: string, filename: string, kind: NativeArtifact['kind'], content: string) => invoke<NativeArtifact>('add_project_artifact', { id, filename, kind, content }),
  readArtifact: (id: string, filename: string) => invoke<string>('read_project_artifact', { id, filename }),
  exportProject: (id: string, directory: string, filename: string) => invoke<FileReceipt>('export_project_bundle', { id, directory, filename }),
  importProject: (path: string) => invoke<NativeProject>('import_project_bundle', { path }),
  workspaceUsage: () => invoke<number>('workspace_usage'),
  importCheckpoint: (path: string) => invoke<[string, FileReceipt]>('import_checkpoint', { path }),
};

BEGIN FILE: apps/desktop/scripts/doctor.py

"""Print desktop build prerequisites without reading credential values."""
from __future__ import annotations
import importlib.util
import json
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


def version(binary: str, argument: str = "--version") -> str | None:
    path = shutil.which(binary)
    if not path:
        return None
    try:
        result = subprocess.run([path, argument], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
        return result.stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] if result.returncode == 0 else "installed; version unavailable"
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, IndexError):
        return "installed; version unavailable"


def main() -> int:
    system = platform.system()
    required = {"node": version("node"), "npm": version("npm"), "rustc": version("rustc"), "cargo": version("cargo")}
    optional = {"python": sys.version.split()[0], "torch": importlib.util.find_spec("torch") is not None}
    missing = [name for name, value in required.items() if value is None]
    linux = {}
    if system == "Linux":
        pkg_config = shutil.which("pkg-config")
        for package in ["gtk+-3.0", "webkit2gtk-4.1", "libsoup-3.0"]:
            found = False
            if pkg_config:
                found = subprocess.run([pkg_config, "--exists", package], capture_output=True).returncode == 0
            linux[package] = found
            if not found:
                missing.append(package)
    print(json.dumps({"platform": system, "architecture": platform.machine(), "required": required,
        "optional": optional, "linux_native_libraries": linux, "missing": missing,
        "python_bundled": False, "code_signing_configured": False}, indent=2))
    return 0 if not missing else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
====================================================================================================
END FILE: apps/desktop/scripts/doctor.py

BEGIN FILE: apps/desktop/src-tauri/examples/runtime_smoke.rs
====================================================================================================
use neuralis_desktop::{
    config::{BackendMode, Preferences},
    runtime::Runtime,
};
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let mut arguments = std::env::args().skip(1);
    let python = PathBuf::from(
        arguments
            .next()
            .ok_or("Usage: runtime_smoke PYTHON REPOSITORY_ROOT")?,
    );
    let root = PathBuf::from(arguments.next().ok_or("Repository path is required")?);
    let directory = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
        "neuralis-desktop-smoke-{}",
        neuralis_desktop::security::session_token()
    ));
    let preferences = Preferences {
        mode: BackendMode::Local,
        python_executable: python,
        repository_root: Some(root),
        data_directory: Some(directory.clone()),
        ..Preferences::default()
    };
    let mut runtime = Runtime::new()?;
    let outcome = (|| -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let status = runtime.start(&preferences, None)?;
        assert!(status.managed);
        assert!(status
            .endpoint
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|value| value.starts_with("http://127.0.0.1:")));
        let capabilities = runtime.request("GET", "/api/v1/capabilities", None)?;
        assert!(capabilities.is_object());
        println!("Local Python startup, authenticated readiness and native API request succeeded");
        runtime.stop()?;
        assert!(!runtime.status().managed);
        println!("Managed Python shutdown succeeded");
        Ok(())
    })();
    let _ = runtime.stop();
    if directory.exists() {
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(directory)?;
    }
    outcome
}
====================================================================================================
END FILE: apps/desktop/src-tauri/examples/runtime_smoke.rs

If a webview or its window is not matching any capability then it has no access to the IPC layer at all.\n\nThis can be done to create groups of windows, based on their required system access, which can reduce impact of frontend vulnerabilities in less privileged windows. Windows can be added to a capability by exact name (e.g. `main-window`) or glob patterns like `*` or `admin-*`. A Window can have none, one, or multiple associated capabilities.\n\n## Example\n\n```json { \"identifier\": \"main-user-files-write\", \"description\": \"This capability allows the `main` window on macOS and Windows access to `filesystem` write related commands and `dialog` commands to enable programmatic access to files selected by the user.\", \"windows\": [ \"main\" ], \"permissions\": [ \"core:default\", \"dialog:open\", { \"identifier\": \"fs:allow-write-text-file\", \"allow\": [{ \"path\": \"$HOME/test.txt\" }] }, ], \"platforms\": [\"macOS\",\"windows\"] } ```",

BEGIN FILE: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/config.rs

use crate::{security::validate_endpoint, Error, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::fs::{self, OpenOptions};
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum BackendMode {
    BrowserOnly,
    Local,
    Remote,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Preferences {
    pub schema_version: u32,
    pub mode: BackendMode,
    pub python_executable: PathBuf,
    pub repository_root: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub remote_endpoint: Option<String>,
    pub data_directory: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub startup_timeout_seconds: u64,
    pub capture_budget_bytes: usize,
}

impl Default for Preferences {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            schema_version: 1,
            mode: BackendMode::BrowserOnly,
            python_executable: PathBuf::from(if cfg!(windows) {
                "python.exe"
            } else {
                "python3"
            }),
            repository_root: None,
            remote_endpoint: None,
            data_directory: None,
            startup_timeout_seconds: 30,
            capture_budget_bytes: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
        }
    }
}

impl Preferences {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        if self.schema_version != 1 {
            return Err(Error::Config("Unsupported preferences schema".into()));
        }
        if !(1..=120).contains(&self.startup_timeout_seconds) {
            return Err(Error::Config(
                "Startup timeout must be between 1 and 120 seconds".into(),
            ));
        }
        if !(1024..=64 * 1024 * 1024).contains(&self.capture_budget_bytes) {
            return Err(Error::Config(
                "Capture budget must be between 1 KiB and 64 MiB".into(),
            ));
        }
        if self.python_executable.as_os_str().is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::Config("Python executable is empty".into()));
        }
        if self
            .data_directory
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|path| !path.is_absolute())
        {
            return Err(Error::Config(
                "Backend data directory must be an absolute path".into(),
            ));
        }
        if self.mode == BackendMode::Local {
            let root = self.repository_root.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
                Error::Config("Select the Neuralis repository before launching Python".into())
            })?;
            if !root.is_absolute() || !root.join("services/api").is_dir() {
                return Err(Error::Config(
                    "Local repository must contain services/api".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        if let Some(endpoint) = &self.remote_endpoint {
            validate_endpoint(endpoint)?;
        }
        if self.mode == BackendMode::Remote && self.remote_endpoint.is_none() {
            return Err(Error::Config("Remote mode needs an endpoint".into()));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn load(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {
        if !path.exists() {
            return Ok(Self::default());
        }
        let bytes = fs::read(path)?;
        if bytes.len() > 64 * 1024 {
            return Err(Error::Config("Preferences file is too large".into()));
        }
        let value: Self = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?;
        value.validate()?;
        Ok(value)
    }

    pub fn save(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
        self.validate()?;
        let parent = path
            .parent()
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Config("Preferences path has no parent".into()))?;
        fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        let temp = parent.join(format!(
            "preferences.{}.tmp",
            crate::security::session_token()
        ));
        let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
        options.write(true).create_new(true);
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
            options.mode(0o600);
        }
        let outcome = (|| -> Result<()> {
            let mut file = options.open(&temp)?;
            file.write_all(&serde_json::to_vec_pretty(self)?)?;
            file.sync_all()?;
            // Windows rename does not replace an existing target. A backup permits rollback.
            let backup = parent.join("preferences.previous.json");
            if cfg!(windows) && path.exists() {
                fs::rename(path, &backup)?;
            }
            if let Err(error) = fs::rename(&temp, path) {
                if cfg!(windows) && backup.exists() {
                    let _ = fs::rename(&backup, path);
                }
                return Err(error.into());
            }
            if backup.exists() {
                fs::remove_file(backup)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        })();
        if temp.exists() {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(temp);
        }
        outcome
    }
}

use crate::{Error, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    io::Read,
    path::Path,
    process::{Command, Stdio},
    sync::{Arc, Mutex},
    thread,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

const PROBE: &str = r#"
import json,sys,platform,importlib.util,importlib.metadata
names=['fastapi','uvicorn','numpy','torch','safetensors','psutil']
modules={}
for name in names:
    available=importlib.util.find_spec(name) is not None
    version=None
    if available:
        try: version=importlib.metadata.version(name)
        except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError: pass
    modules[name]={'available':available,'version':version}
result={'python':platform.python_version(),'major':sys.version_info.major,'minor':sys.version_info.minor,'platform':platform.system(),'architecture':platform.machine(),'packages':modules,'cuda_available':False,'cuda_device_count':0}
if modules['torch']['available']:
    try:
        import torch
        result['cuda_available']=torch.cuda.is_available()
        result['cuda_device_count']=torch.cuda.device_count() if result['cuda_available'] else 0
    except Exception:
        result['packages']['torch']['available']=False
print(json.dumps(result,allow_nan=False))
"#;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct PackageReadiness {
    pub available: bool,
    pub version: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct PythonReadiness {
    pub python: String,
    pub major: u32,
    pub minor: u32,
    pub platform: String,
    pub architecture: String,
    pub packages: HashMap<String, PackageReadiness>,
    pub cuda_available: bool,
    pub cuda_device_count: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct RuntimeReadiness {
    pub executable: String,
    pub runtime: PythonReadiness,
    pub ready: bool,
    pub missing: Vec<String>,
    pub recommendations: Vec<String>,
}

pub fn probe_python(executable: &Path, timeout: Duration) -> Result<RuntimeReadiness> {
    if executable.as_os_str().is_empty() || timeout.is_zero() || timeout > Duration::from_secs(60) {
        return Err(Error::Config(
            "Python probe requires an executable and a deadline of at most 60 seconds".into(),
        ));
    }
    let mut command = Command::new(executable);
    command
        .args(["-I", "-c", PROBE])
        .stdin(Stdio::null())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::null());
    // The probe never needs credentials or injected Python startup hooks.
    for name in [
        "NEURALIS_TOKEN",
        "NEURALIS_WORKER_TOKEN",
        "GH_TOKEN",
        "GITHUB_TOKEN",
        "PYTHONSTARTUP",
        "PYTHONPATH",
    ] {
        command.env_remove(name);
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        command.creation_flags(0x08000000);
    }
    let mut child = command.spawn()?;
    let stdout = child
        .stdout
        .take()
        .ok_or_else(|| Error::Runtime("Python probe output is unavailable".into()))?;
    let output = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
    let copy = output.clone();
    let reader = thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        let result = stdout.take(65537).read_to_end(&mut bytes);
        if let Ok(mut value) = copy.lock() {
            *value = bytes;
        }
        result
    });
    let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
    let status = loop {
        if let Some(status) = child.try_wait()? {
            break status;
        }
        if Instant::now() >= deadline {
            child.kill()?;
            child.wait()?;
            let _ = reader.join();
            return Err(Error::Runtime(
                "Python readiness probe exceeded its deadline".into(),
            ));
        }
        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(25));
    };
    reader
        .join()
        .map_err(|_| Error::Runtime("Python probe reader failed".into()))??;
    if !status.success() {
        return Err(Error::Runtime(format!(
            "Python readiness probe exited with {status}"
        )));
    }
    let bytes = output
        .lock()
        .map_err(|_| Error::Runtime("Probe output lock failed".into()))?;
    if bytes.len() > 65536 {
        return Err(Error::Runtime(
            "Python probe exceeded its output budget".into(),
        ));
    }
    let runtime: PythonReadiness = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?;
    let mut missing: Vec<String> = [
        "fastapi",
        "uvicorn",
        "numpy",
        "torch",
        "safetensors",
        "psutil",
    ]
    .iter()
    .filter(|name| {
        !runtime
            .packages
            .get(**name)
            .is_some_and(|value| value.available)
    })
    .map(|name| (*name).to_string())
    .collect();
    if runtime.major != 3 || !(12..14).contains(&runtime.minor) {
        missing.push("Python 3.12 or 3.13".into());
    }
    let mut recommendations = Vec::new();
    if !missing.is_empty() {
        recommendations.push(
            "Install the API's frozen uv lockfile and select its virtual-environment interpreter"
                .into(),
        );
    }
    if !runtime.cuda_available {
        recommendations.push("CPU mode is available; CUDA acceleration requires compatible hardware and a separate supported runtime".into());
    }
    Ok(RuntimeReadiness {
        executable: executable.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        ready: missing.is_empty(),
        runtime,
        missing,
        recommendations,
    })
}

        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join("neuralis-interpreter-that-does-not-exist");
        assert!(probe_python(&path, Duration::from_secs(1)).is_err());
    }

    }

        let parsed: PythonReadiness = serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap();

        assert_eq!(parsed.cuda_device_count, 0);
    }

use crate::{
    security::{validate_name, MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES},
    Error, Result,
};
use serde::Serialize;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::{
    collections::HashSet,
    fs::{self, OpenOptions},
    io::{Read, Write},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct FileGrants {
    exports: HashSet<PathBuf>,
    imports: HashSet<PathBuf>,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
pub struct FileReceipt {
    pub path: String,
    pub bytes: usize,
    pub sha256: String,
}

impl FileGrants {
    pub fn grant_export_directory(&mut self, selected: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {
        let canonical = selected.canonicalize()?;
        if !canonical.is_dir() {
            return Err(Error::Permission(
                "Export destination must be a directory".into(),
            ));
        }
        self.exports.insert(canonical.clone());
        Ok(canonical)
    }

    pub fn grant_import_file(&mut self, selected: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {
        let canonical = selected.canonicalize()?;
        if !canonical.is_file() {
            return Err(Error::Permission(
                "Checkpoint selection must be a regular file".into(),
            ));
        }
        self.imports.insert(canonical.clone());
        Ok(canonical)
    }

    pub fn export_json(
        &self,
        directory: &Path,
        filename: &str,
        value: &str,
    ) -> Result<FileReceipt> {
        validate_name(filename)?;
        let canonical = directory.canonicalize()?;
        if !self.exports.contains(&canonical) {
            return Err(Error::Permission(
                "Choose the export folder with the native dialog first".into(),
            ));
        }
        if value.len() > MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES {
            return Err(Error::Permission("Export exceeds 64 MiB".into()));
        }
        let parsed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(value)?;
        if !parsed.is_object() {
            return Err(Error::Config("Checkpoint must be a JSON object".into()));
        }
        let destination = canonical.join(filename);
        let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
        // Create-new refuses overwrite, existing symbolic links and accidental clobbering.
        options.write(true).create_new(true);
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
            options.mode(0o600);
        }
        let mut file = options.open(&destination)?;
        if let Err(error) = file
            .write_all(value.as_bytes())
            .and_then(|_| file.sync_all())
        {
            drop(file);
            let _ = fs::remove_file(&destination);
            return Err(error.into());
        }
        Ok(receipt(&destination, value.as_bytes()))
    }

    pub fn import_json(&self, selected: &Path) -> Result<(String, FileReceipt)> {
        let canonical = selected.canonicalize()?;
        if !self.imports.contains(&canonical) {
            return Err(Error::Permission(
                "Choose the checkpoint with the native dialog first".into(),
            ));
        }
        let file = fs::File::open(&canonical)?;
        if !file.metadata()?.is_file() || file.metadata()?.len() > MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES as u64 {
            return Err(Error::Permission(
                "Checkpoint must be a regular JSON file smaller than 64 MiB".into(),
            ));
        }
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        file.take((MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES + 1) as u64)
            .read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
        if bytes.len() > MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES {
            return Err(Error::Permission(
                "Checkpoint exceeded the read budget".into(),
            ));
        }
        let parsed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?;
        if !parsed.is_object() {
            return Err(Error::Config("Checkpoint must be a JSON object".into()));
        }
        let text = String::from_utf8(bytes.clone())
            .map_err(|_| Error::Config("Checkpoint is not UTF-8".into()))?;
        let summary = receipt(&canonical, &bytes);
        Ok((text, summary))
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.exports.clear();
        self.imports.clear();
    }
}

fn receipt(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> FileReceipt {
    let hash = Sha256::digest(bytes);
    FileReceipt {
        path: path.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        bytes: bytes.len(),
        sha256: hash.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect(),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn dialog_grants_are_required_and_overwrite_is_refused() {
        let directory = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "neuralis-files-{}",
            crate::security::session_token()
        ));
        fs::create_dir(&directory).unwrap();
        let mut grants = FileGrants::default();
        assert!(grants
            .export_json(&directory, "checkpoint.json", "{}")
            .is_err());
        grants.grant_export_directory(&directory).unwrap();
        let receipt = grants
            .export_json(&directory, "checkpoint.json", "{}")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(receipt.bytes, 2);
        assert_eq!(receipt.sha256.len(), 64);
        assert!(grants
            .export_json(&directory, "checkpoint.json", "{}")
            .is_err());
        assert!(grants
            .export_json(&directory, "../outside.json", "{}")
            .is_err());
        let path = directory.join("checkpoint.json");
        assert!(grants.import_json(&path).is_err());
        grants.grant_import_file(&path).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(grants.import_json(&path).unwrap().0, "{}");
        grants.clear();
        assert!(grants.import_json(&path).is_err());
        fs::remove_dir_all(directory).unwrap();
    }

    #[cfg(unix)]
    #[test]
    fn cannot_overwrite_through_symbolic_link() {
        let directory = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "neuralis-links-{}",
            crate::security::session_token()
        ));
        fs::create_dir(&directory).unwrap();
        fs::write(directory.join("actual.json"), "{}").unwrap();
        std::os::unix::fs::symlink(directory.join("actual.json"), directory.join("linked.json"))
            .unwrap();
        let mut grants = FileGrants::default();
        grants.grant_export_directory(&directory).unwrap();
        assert!(grants
            .export_json(&directory, "linked.json", "{\"modified\":true}")
            .is_err());
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read_to_string(directory.join("actual.json")).unwrap(),
            "{}"
        );
        fs::remove_dir_all(directory).unwrap();
    }
}

pub mod config;
pub mod diagnostics;
pub mod files;
pub mod runtime;
pub mod security;
pub mod workspace;

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum Error {
    #[error("Invalid configuration: {0}")]
    Config(String),
    #[error("Operation not permitted: {0}")]
    Permission(String),
    #[error("Runtime error: {0}")]
    Runtime(String),
    #[error("I/O error: {0}")]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
    #[error("JSON error: {0}")]
    Json(#[from] serde_json::Error),
    #[error("HTTP error: {0}")]
    Http(#[from] reqwest::Error),
}

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;

#![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")]

use neuralis_desktop::{
    config::Preferences,
    files::{FileGrants, FileReceipt},
    runtime::{Runtime, RuntimeStatus},
    workspace::{ArtifactKind, ArtifactManifest, ProjectManifest, Workspace},
};
use std::{
    path::PathBuf,
    sync::{Arc, Mutex},
};
use tauri::{Manager, State};
use tauri_plugin_dialog::DialogExt;

struct AppState {
    runtime: Arc<Mutex<Runtime>>,
    grants: Mutex<FileGrants>,
    preferences: Mutex<Preferences>,
    preferences_path: PathBuf,
    workspace: Mutex<Option<Workspace>>,
}

fn message<T, E: std::fmt::Display>(value: Result<T, E>) -> Result<T, String> {
    value.map_err(|error| error.to_string())
}

#[tauri::command]
fn get_preferences(state: State<AppState>) -> Result<Preferences, String> {
    Ok(message(state.preferences.lock())?.clone())
}

#[tauri::command]
fn save_preferences(preferences: Preferences, state: State<AppState>) -> Result<(), String> {
    message(preferences.save(&state.preferences_path))?;
    *message(state.preferences.lock())? = preferences;
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn start_backend(
    token: Option<String>,
    state: State<'_, AppState>,
) -> Result<RuntimeStatus, String> {
    // The selected mode and executable come from native preferences, never a server response.
    let mut preferences = message(state.preferences.lock())?.clone();
    if preferences.data_directory.is_none() {
        preferences.data_directory = Some(
            state
                .preferences_path
                .parent()
                .ok_or("Configuration directory is unavailable")?
                .join("data"),
        );
    }
    let runtime = state.runtime.clone();
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
        message(message(runtime.lock())?.start(&preferences, token))
    })
    .await
    .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?
}

#[tauri::command]
fn stop_backend(state: State<AppState>) -> Result<(), String> {
    message(message(state.runtime.lock())?.stop())
}

#[tauri::command]
fn backend_status(state: State<AppState>) -> Result<RuntimeStatus, String> {
    Ok(message(state.runtime.lock())?.status())
}

#[tauri::command]
fn backend_diagnostics(state: State<AppState>) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
    Ok(message(state.runtime.lock())?.diagnostics())
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn backend_request(
    method: String,
    path: String,
    body: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    state: State<'_, AppState>,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
    let runtime = state.runtime.clone();
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
        message(message(runtime.lock())?.request(&method, &path, body))
    })
    .await
    .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn choose_export_directory(
    app: tauri::AppHandle,
    state: State<'_, AppState>,
) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
    let selected = app
        .dialog()
        .file()
        .set_title("Choose a Neuralis export folder")
        .blocking_pick_folder();
    let Some(selected) = selected else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let path = message(selected.into_path())?;
    let canonical = message(message(state.grants.lock())?.grant_export_directory(&path))?;
    Ok(Some(canonical.to_string_lossy().into_owned()))
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn choose_checkpoint(
    app: tauri::AppHandle,
    state: State<'_, AppState>,
) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
    let selected = app
        .dialog()
        .file()
        .set_title("Import a Neuralis JSON checkpoint")
        .add_filter("JSON checkpoint", &["json"])
        .blocking_pick_file();
    let Some(selected) = selected else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let path = message(selected.into_path())?;
    let canonical = message(message(state.grants.lock())?.grant_import_file(&path))?;
    Ok(Some(canonical.to_string_lossy().into_owned()))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn export_checkpoint(
    directory: String,
    filename: String,
    content: String,
    state: State<AppState>,
) -> Result<FileReceipt, String> {
    message(message(state.grants.lock())?.export_json(
        &PathBuf::from(directory),
        &filename,
        &content,
    ))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn import_checkpoint(
    path: String,
    state: State<AppState>,
) -> Result<(String, FileReceipt), String> {
    message(message(state.grants.lock())?.import_json(&PathBuf::from(path)))
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn choose_workspace(
    app: tauri::AppHandle,
    state: State<'_, AppState>,
) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
    let selected = app
        .dialog()
        .file()
        .set_title("Choose a Neuralis project workspace")
        .blocking_pick_folder();
    let Some(selected) = selected else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let path = message(selected.into_path())?;
    let workspace = message(Workspace::open(&path, 10 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))?;
    let root = workspace.root().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    *message(state.workspace.lock())? = Some(workspace);
    Ok(Some(root))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn list_projects(state: State<AppState>) -> Result<Vec<ProjectManifest>, String> {
    let guard = message(state.workspace.lock())?;
    let workspace = guard.as_ref().ok_or("Choose a workspace folder first")?;
    message(workspace.list())
}

#[tauri::command]
fn create_project(
    name: String,
    description: String,
    tags: Vec<String>,
    state: State<AppState>,
) -> Result<ProjectManifest, String> {
    let guard = message(state.workspace.lock())?;
    let workspace = guard.as_ref().ok_or("Choose a workspace folder first")?;
    message(workspace.create(name, description, tags))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn update_project(
    id: String,
    name: String,
    description: String,
    tags: Vec<String>,
    state: State<AppState>,
) -> Result<ProjectManifest, String> {
    let guard = message(state.workspace.lock())?;
    let workspace = guard.as_ref().ok_or("Choose a workspace folder first")?;
    message(workspace.update_metadata(&id, name, description, tags))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn add_project_artifact(
    id: String,
    filename: String,
    kind: ArtifactKind,
    content: String,
    state: State<AppState>,
) -> Result<ArtifactManifest, String> {
    let guard = message(state.workspace.lock())?;
    let workspace = guard.as_ref().ok_or("Choose a workspace folder first")?;
    message(workspace.add_artifact(&id, &filename, kind, &content))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn read_project_artifact(
    id: String,
    filename: String,
    state: State<AppState>,
) -> Result<String, String> {
    let guard = message(state.workspace.lock())?;
    let workspace = guard.as_ref().ok_or("Choose a workspace folder first")?;
    message(workspace.read_artifact(&id, &filename))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn export_project_bundle(
    id: String,
    directory: String,
    filename: String,
    state: State<AppState>,
) -> Result<FileReceipt, String> {
    let guard = message(state.workspace.lock())?;
    let workspace = guard.as_ref().ok_or("Choose a workspace folder first")?;
    let content = message(workspace.bundle(&id))?;
    message(message(state.grants.lock())?.export_json(
        &PathBuf::from(directory),
        &filename,
        &content,
    ))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn import_project_bundle(path: String, state: State<AppState>) -> Result<ProjectManifest, String> {
    let (text, _) = message(message(state.grants.lock())?.import_json(&PathBuf::from(path)))?;
    let guard = message(state.workspace.lock())?;
    let workspace = guard.as_ref().ok_or("Choose a workspace folder first")?;
    message(workspace.import_bundle(&text))
}

#[tauri::command]
fn workspace_usage(state: State<AppState>) -> Result<u64, String> {
    let guard = message(state.workspace.lock())?;
    let workspace = guard.as_ref().ok_or("Choose a workspace folder first")?;
    message(workspace.usage())
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn probe_python_runtime(
    state: State<'_, AppState>,
) -> Result<neuralis_desktop::diagnostics::RuntimeReadiness, String> {
    let executable = message(state.preferences.lock())?.python_executable.clone();
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
        message(neuralis_desktop::diagnostics::probe_python(
            &executable,
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(15),
        ))
    })
    .await
    .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?
}

fn main() {
    tauri::Builder::default()
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_dialog::init())
        .setup(|app| {
            let path = app.path().app_config_dir()?.join("preferences.json");
            let preferences = Preferences::load(&path).unwrap_or_default();
            app.manage(AppState {
                runtime: Arc::new(Mutex::new(Runtime::new()?)),
                grants: Mutex::new(FileGrants::default()),
                preferences: Mutex::new(preferences),
                preferences_path: path,
                workspace: Mutex::new(None),
            });
            Ok(())
        })
        .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
            get_preferences,
            save_preferences,
            start_backend,
            stop_backend,
            backend_status,
            backend_diagnostics,
            backend_request,
            choose_export_directory,
            choose_checkpoint,
            export_checkpoint,
            import_checkpoint,
            choose_workspace,
            list_projects,
            create_project,
            update_project,
            add_project_artifact,
            read_project_artifact,
            export_project_bundle,
            import_project_bundle,
            workspace_usage,
            probe_python_runtime
        ])
        .build(tauri::generate_context!())
        .expect("Could not initialize Neuralis Studio")
        .run(|app, event| {
            if matches!(event, tauri::RunEvent::Exit) {
                if let Some(state) = app.try_state::<AppState>() {
                    if let Ok(mut runtime) = state.runtime.lock() {
                        let _ = runtime.stop();
                    }
                }
            }
        });
}

use crate::{
    config::{BackendMode, Preferences},
    security::{session_token, validate_api_path, validate_endpoint, MAX_HTTP_BYTES},
    Error, Result,
};
use reqwest::blocking::Client;
use serde::Serialize;
use std::{
    collections::VecDeque,
    io::{BufRead, BufReader, Read},
    net::TcpListener,
    process::{Child, Command, Stdio},
    sync::{Arc, Mutex},
    thread,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum RuntimePhase {
    BrowserOnly,
    Starting,
    Ready,
    Failed,
    Stopped,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct RuntimeStatus {
    pub phase: RuntimePhase,
    pub endpoint: Option<String>,
    pub managed: bool,
    pub process_id: Option<u32>,
    pub message: String,
}

pub struct Runtime {
    child: Option<Child>,
    endpoint: Option<String>,
    token: Option<String>,
    phase: RuntimePhase,
    logs: Arc<Mutex<VecDeque<String>>>,
    client: Client,
    message: String,
}

impl Runtime {
    pub fn new() -> Result<Self> {
        Ok(Self {
            child: None,
            endpoint: None,
            token: None,
            phase: RuntimePhase::BrowserOnly,
            logs: Arc::new(Mutex::new(VecDeque::with_capacity(200))),
            client: Client::builder()
                .timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
                .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
                .build()?,
            message: "Browser demos are available without Python".into(),
        })
    }

    pub fn start(
        &mut self,
        preferences: &Preferences,
        remote_token: Option<String>,
    ) -> Result<RuntimeStatus> {
        preferences.validate()?;
        self.stop()?;
        if preferences.mode == BackendMode::BrowserOnly {
            self.phase = RuntimePhase::BrowserOnly;
            self.message = "Browser demos are available without Python".into();
            return Ok(self.status());
        }
        self.phase = RuntimePhase::Starting;
        if preferences.mode == BackendMode::Remote {
            self.endpoint = preferences.remote_endpoint.clone();
            self.token = remote_token.filter(|value| !value.is_empty());
            if let Err(error) = self.check_health() {
                self.phase = RuntimePhase::Failed;
                self.message = format!("Remote readiness failed: {error}");
                self.token = None;
                return Err(error);
            }
            self.phase = RuntimePhase::Ready;
            self.message = "Connected to the selected remote backend".into();
            return Ok(self.status());
        }
        let root = preferences.repository_root.as_ref().unwrap();
        let token = session_token();
        // Reserve an OS-selected loopback port; the Python process binds it immediately.
        // If another process wins the bind race, readiness requires the unique bearer token.
        let reservation = TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))?;
        let port = reservation.local_addr()?.port();
        self.endpoint = Some(format!("http://127.0.0.1:{port}"));
        self.token = Some(token.clone());
        let mut command = Command::new(&preferences.python_executable);
        command
            .args(["-m", "neuralis"])
            .current_dir(root.join("services/api"))
            .env("NEURALIS_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
            .env("NEURALIS_PORT", port.to_string())
            .env("NEURALIS_TOKEN", &token)
            .env("PYTHONUNBUFFERED", "1")
            .env("PYTHONPATH", root.join("services/api/src"))
            .env("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "2")
            .stdin(Stdio::null())
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::piped());
        #[cfg(windows)]
        {
            use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
            command.creation_flags(0x08000000); // CREATE_NO_WINDOW
        }
        if let Some(directory) = &preferences.data_directory {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(directory)?;
            command.env("NEURALIS_DATA", directory);
        }
        drop(reservation);
        let mut child = match command.spawn() {
            Ok(child) => child,
            Err(error) => {
                self.phase = RuntimePhase::Failed;
                self.token = None;
                self.message = "Python could not be started; check the selected interpreter".into();
                return Err(error.into());
            }
        };
        if let Some(stdout) = child.stdout.take() {
            capture_log(stdout, self.logs.clone(), token.clone());
        }
        if let Some(stderr) = child.stderr.take() {
            capture_log(stderr, self.logs.clone(), token);
        }
        self.child = Some(child);
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(preferences.startup_timeout_seconds);
        let mut last_error = String::new();
        while Instant::now() < deadline {
            if let Some(code) = self.child.as_mut().unwrap().try_wait()? {
                self.child.take();
                self.phase = RuntimePhase::Failed;
                self.token = None;
                self.message = format!("Python exited before readiness: {code}");
                return Err(Error::Runtime(self.message.clone()));
            }
            match self.check_health() {
                Ok(()) => {
                    self.phase = RuntimePhase::Ready;
                    self.message = "Authenticated local backend is ready".into();
                    return Ok(self.status());
                }
                Err(error) => last_error = error.to_string(),
            }
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(150));
        }
        self.stop()?;
        self.phase = RuntimePhase::Failed;
        self.message = format!("Backend readiness timed out: {last_error}");
        Err(Error::Runtime(self.message.clone()))
    }

    fn check_health(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let value = self.request("GET", "/health", None)?;
        if value.get("status").and_then(|value| value.as_str()) != Some("ok") {
            return Err(Error::Runtime(
                "Health endpoint did not return status=ok".into(),
            ));
        }
        // A protected endpoint proves the local port is our authenticated backend.
        self.request("GET", "/api/v1/capabilities", None)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn request(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        path: &str,
        body: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    ) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
        validate_api_path(path)?;
        let endpoint = self
            .endpoint
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| Error::Runtime("No backend is selected".into()))?;
        let parsed = validate_endpoint(endpoint)?;
        let base = parsed.as_str().trim_end_matches('/');
        let url = format!("{base}{path}");
        let method = match method {
            "GET" => reqwest::Method::GET,
            "POST" => reqwest::Method::POST,
            "PUT" => reqwest::Method::PUT,
            "DELETE" => reqwest::Method::DELETE,
            _ => {
                return Err(Error::Permission(
                    "Only GET, POST, PUT and DELETE are supported".into(),
                ))
            }
        };
        let mut request = self.client.request(method, url);
        if let Some(token) = &self.token {
            request = request.bearer_auth(token);
        }
        if let Some(value) = body {
            if serde_json::to_vec(&value)?.len() > MAX_HTTP_BYTES {
                return Err(Error::Permission(
                    "Request exceeds the 16 MiB budget".into(),
                ));
            }
            request = request.json(&value);
        }
        let response = request.send()?;
        let status = response.status();
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        response
            .take((MAX_HTTP_BYTES + 1) as u64)
            .read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
        if bytes.len() > MAX_HTTP_BYTES {
            return Err(Error::Runtime("Response exceeded the 16 MiB budget".into()));
        }
        if !status.is_success() {
            // Do not echo arbitrary error bodies; they can contain credentials or user data.
            return Err(Error::Runtime(format!(
                "Backend returned HTTP {}",
                status.as_u16()
            )));
        }
        if bytes.is_empty() {
            return Ok(serde_json::Value::Null);
        }
        Ok(serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?)
    }

    pub fn status(&mut self) -> RuntimeStatus {
        if let Some(child) = self.child.as_mut() {
            if let Ok(Some(code)) = child.try_wait() {
                self.child.take();
                self.token = None;
                self.phase = RuntimePhase::Failed;
                self.message = format!("Managed Python process exited: {code}");
            }
        }
        RuntimeStatus {
            phase: self.phase.clone(),
            endpoint: self.endpoint.clone(),
            managed: self.child.is_some(),
            process_id: self.child.as_ref().map(Child::id),
            message: self.message.clone(),
        }
    }

    pub fn diagnostics(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.logs
            .lock()
            .map(|lines| lines.iter().cloned().collect())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub fn stop(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        if let Some(mut child) = self.child.take() {
            if child.try_wait()?.is_none() {
                child.kill()?;
                child.wait()?;
            }
        }
        self.token = None;
        self.endpoint = None;
        self.phase = RuntimePhase::Stopped;
        self.message = "Backend connection stopped".into();
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Drop for Runtime {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.stop();
    }
}

fn capture_log<R: Read + Send + 'static>(
    reader: R,
    logs: Arc<Mutex<VecDeque<String>>>,
    token: String,
) {
    thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut reader = BufReader::new(reader);
        loop {
            let mut bytes = Vec::new();
            // A malicious or broken subprocess cannot cause unbounded line allocations.
            match reader.by_ref().take(4097).read_until(b'\n', &mut bytes) {
                Ok(0) | Err(_) => break,
                Ok(_) => {
                    let line = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes[..bytes.len().min(4096)])
                        .replace(&token, "[redacted]");
                    if let Ok(mut lines) = logs.lock() {
                        if lines.len() >= 200 {
                            lines.pop_front();
                        }
                        lines.push_back(line.trim().to_string());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn browser_mode_does_not_launch_a_process() {
        let mut runtime = Runtime::new().unwrap();
        let status = runtime.start(&Preferences::default(), None).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(status.phase, RuntimePhase::BrowserOnly));
        assert!(!status.managed);
        assert!(runtime.request("GET", "/health", None).is_err());
        runtime.stop().unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(runtime.status().phase, RuntimePhase::Stopped));
    }

    #[test]
    fn logs_are_bounded_and_token_is_redacted() {
        let logs = Arc::new(Mutex::new(VecDeque::new()));
        capture_log(
            std::io::Cursor::new(b"my secret token\n".to_vec()),
            logs.clone(),
            "secret".into(),
        );
        for _ in 0..20 {
            if !logs.lock().unwrap().is_empty() {
                break;
            }
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
        }
        assert_eq!(logs.lock().unwrap()[0], "my [redacted] token");
    }
}

use crate::{Error, Result};
use rand::RngCore;
use url::Url;

pub const MAX_HTTP_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

pub fn session_token() -> String {
    let mut bytes = [0u8; 32];
    rand::rngs::OsRng.fill_bytes(&mut bytes);
    bytes.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect()
}

pub fn validate_endpoint(value: &str) -> Result<Url> {
    let parsed = Url::parse(value).map_err(|error| Error::Config(error.to_string()))?;
    if !parsed.username().is_empty() || parsed.password().is_some() {
        return Err(Error::Config(
            "Credentials must not be embedded in URLs".into(),
        ));
    }
    if parsed.query().is_some() || parsed.fragment().is_some() {
        return Err(Error::Config(
            "Endpoint cannot have a query or fragment".into(),
        ));
    }
    let host = parsed
        .host_str()
        .ok_or_else(|| Error::Config("Endpoint needs a host".into()))?;
    let loopback = matches!(host, "127.0.0.1" | "localhost" | "[::1]" | "::1");
    if parsed.scheme() != "https" && !(parsed.scheme() == "http" && loopback) {
        return Err(Error::Config(
            "Remote connections require HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only on loopback".into(),
        ));
    }
    Ok(parsed)
}

pub fn validate_api_path(path: &str) -> Result<()> {
    if !path.starts_with('/') || path.starts_with("//") || path.contains('\\') {
        return Err(Error::Permission(
            "API path must be relative to the selected backend".into(),
        ));
    }
    if path.contains('#')
        || path.contains('%')
        || path.split('/').any(|part| part == ".." || part == ".")
    {
        return Err(Error::Permission(
            "Encoded paths and traversal segments are not allowed".into(),
        ));
    }
    if path.len() > 2048 {
        return Err(Error::Permission("API path exceeds 2048 bytes".into()));
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_name(name: &str) -> Result<()> {
    if name.is_empty()
        || name.len() > 120
        || matches!(name, "." | "..")
        || !name
            .chars()
            .all(|char| char.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(char, '-' | '_' | '.'))
    {
        return Err(Error::Permission(
            "Filename must contain only ASCII letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores".into(),
        ));
    }
    let stem = name.split('.').next().unwrap_or("").to_ascii_uppercase();
    if matches!(stem.as_str(), "CON" | "PRN" | "AUX" | "NUL")
        || (stem.len() == 4
            && (stem.starts_with("COM") || stem.starts_with("LPT"))
            && stem
                .chars()
                .last()
                .is_some_and(|char| ('1'..='9').contains(&char)))
    {
        return Err(Error::Permission(
            "Reserved operating-system filename".into(),
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn remote_requires_verified_tls() {
        assert!(validate_endpoint("https://lab.example/api/").is_ok());
        assert!(validate_endpoint("http://127.0.0.1:8000").is_ok());
        assert!(validate_endpoint("http://lab.example").is_err());
        assert!(validate_endpoint("https://secret@lab.example").is_err());
        assert!(validate_endpoint("file:///etc/passwd").is_err());
        assert!(validate_endpoint("https://lab.example?token=x").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn prevents_origin_escape_and_traversal() {
        for value in [
            "//evil.example",
            "/../secret",
            "/%2e%2e/secret",
            "/a\\b",
            "https://evil.example",
        ] {
            assert!(validate_api_path(value).is_err(), "{value}");
        }
        assert!(validate_api_path("/runs?id=42").is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn filenames_are_portable_and_confined() {
        for name in ["../../token", "a/b", "NUL.json", "COM1", "", "hello world"] {
            assert!(validate_name(name).is_err(), "{name}");
        }
        assert!(validate_name("run-42.checkpoint.json").is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn tokens_have_entropy_and_are_ephemeral() {
        let first = session_token();
        assert_eq!(first.len(), 64);
        assert_ne!(first, session_token());
    }
}
