import type { DemoDefinition, InterventionSpec, LayerData, PredictionSample, RunConfig } from '../types';
import { createDataset, type Dataset } from './datasets';
import { Affine, applyDropout, AveragePool2D, Convolution2D } from './layers';
import { argmax, finiteVector, softmax, zeros } from './math';
import type { ResearchModel } from './model';
import type { BatchResult } from './network';
import { ParameterBank, type ParameterBankCheckpoint } from './optimizers';
import { Random } from './random';

interface CNNPass {
  input: number[];
  convolution: number[];
  pooled: number[];
  hidden: number[];
  dropped: number[];
  dropoutMask: number[];
  output: number[];
}

interface CNNCheckpoint {
  bank: ParameterBankCheckpoint;
  random: ReturnType<Random['exportState']>;
  activationGradients: number[][];
}

/** A fully trainable small convolutional classifier for the browser. */
export class CNNModel implements ResearchModel {
  readonly bank = new ParameterBank();
  readonly convolution: Convolution2D;
  readonly pool: AveragePool2D;
  readonly hidden: Affine;
  readonly readout: Affine;
  readonly parameters: number;
  readonly trainingSize: number;
  private readonly data: Dataset;
  private readonly random: Random;
  private readonly config: RunConfig;
  private activationGradients: number[][];

  constructor(demo: DemoDefinition, config: RunConfig) {
    this.config = { ...config };
    this.data = createDataset({ ...demo, id: 'image-patterns' }, config.seed);
    this.random = new Random(config.seed);
    this.convolution = new Convolution2D('conv', { width: 8, height: 8, inputChannels: 1, outputChannels: 2, kernel: 3 }, this.bank, this.random);
    this.pool = new AveragePool2D(6, 6, 2, 2);
    this.hidden = new Affine('hidden', this.pool.outputSize, 12, this.bank, this.random);
    this.readout = new Affine('readout', 12, 4, this.bank, this.random);
    this.parameters = this.bank.size;
    this.trainingSize = this.data.train.length;
    this.activationGradients = [zeros(64), zeros(72), zeros(18), zeros(12), zeros(4)];
  }

  private modify(input: number[], layer: number, intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    if (!intervention || intervention.layer !== layer) return input;
    const result = [...input];
    const neuron = intervention.neuron;
    result[neuron] = intervention.kind === 'ablate' ? 0 : intervention.kind === 'scale' ?
      result[neuron] * intervention.value : result[neuron] + intervention.value;
    return result;
  }

  private forward(input: number[], training = false, intervention?: InterventionSpec): CNNPass {
    if (!finiteVector(input, 64)) throw new Error('CNN expects 64 finite pixels from an 8×8 image.');
    const sizes = [64, 72, 18, 12, 4];
    if (intervention && (!Number.isInteger(intervention.layer) || intervention.layer < 0 || intervention.layer >= sizes.length ||
      !Number.isInteger(intervention.neuron) || intervention.neuron < 0 || intervention.neuron >= sizes[intervention.layer] ||
      !Number.isFinite(intervention.value) || !['ablate', 'scale', 'steer'].includes(intervention.kind))) throw new Error('Invalid CNN activation intervention.');
    const modifiedInput = this.modify([...input], 0, intervention);
    const convolution = this.modify(this.convolution.forward(modifiedInput).map(Math.tanh), 1, intervention);
    const pooled = this.modify(this.pool.forward(convolution), 2, intervention);
    const hidden = this.modify(this.hidden.forward(pooled).map(Math.tanh), 3, intervention);
    const dropout = applyDropout(hidden, training ? this.config.dropout ?? 0 : 0, this.random);
    const output = this.modify(softmax(this.readout.forward(dropout.output)), 4, intervention);
    return { input: modifiedInput, convolution, pooled, hidden, dropped: dropout.output, dropoutMask: dropout.mask, output };
  }

  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    return this.forward(input, false, intervention).output;
  }

  sampleLoss(input: number[], target: number[]): number {
    return this.predict(input).reduce((total, value, i) => total - target[i] * Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, value)), 0);
  }

  /** Exposed for meaningful analytic-gradient tests and research inspection. */
  analyticGradients(inputs: number[][], targets: number[][], training = false): BatchResult {
    if (!inputs.length || inputs.length !== targets.length || targets.some(target => !finiteVector(target, 4))) throw new Error('Invalid CNN training batch.');
    this.bank.zeroGradients();
    let loss = 0;
    let correct = 0;
    for (let sample = 0; sample < inputs.length; sample++) {
      const pass = this.forward(inputs[sample], training);
      const target = targets[sample];
      loss += pass.output.reduce((total, value, i) => total - target[i] * Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, value)), 0);
      correct += Number(argmax(pass.output) === argmax(target));
      const outputGradient = pass.output.map((value, i) => value - target[i]);
      const hiddenGradient = this.readout.backward(pass.dropped, outputGradient)
        .map((value, i) => value * pass.dropoutMask[i] * (1 - pass.hidden[i] ** 2));
      const pooledGradient = this.hidden.backward(pass.pooled, hiddenGradient);
      const convolutionGradient = this.pool.backward(pooledGradient).map((value, i) => value * (1 - pass.convolution[i] ** 2));
      const inputGradient = this.convolution.backward(pass.input, convolutionGradient);
      this.activationGradients = [inputGradient, convolutionGradient, pooledGradient, hiddenGradient, outputGradient];
    }
    this.bank.scaleGradients(1 / inputs.length);
    return { loss: loss / inputs.length, accuracy: correct / inputs.length, gradientNorm: this.bank.gradientNorm };
  }

  train(learningRate: number, batchSize: number): BatchResult {
    const batch = Array.from({ length: batchSize }, () => this.data.train[this.random.integer(this.data.train.length)]);
    const result = this.analyticGradients(batch.map(row => row.input), batch.map(row => row.target), true);
    this.bank.update(learningRate, { kind: this.config.optimizer, weightDecay: this.config.weightDecay, gradientClip: this.config.gradientClip });
    return result;
  }

  evaluate(): BatchResult {
    let loss = 0;
    let correct = 0;
    for (const row of this.data.validation) {
      const prediction = this.predict(row.input);
      loss += prediction.reduce((total, value, i) => total - row.target[i] * Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, value)), 0);
      correct += Number(argmax(prediction) === argmax(row.target));
    }
    return { loss: loss / this.data.validation.length, accuracy: correct / this.data.validation.length, gradientNorm: this.bank.gradientNorm };
  }

  capture(): LayerData[] {
    const pass = this.forward(this.data.validation[0].input);
    const activations = [pass.input, pass.convolution, pass.pooled, pass.hidden, pass.output];
    const names = ['8×8 pixels', '3×3 convolution · 2 channels', '2×2 average pooling', 'Dense tanh readout', 'Orientation softmax'];
    const weights = [[], this.convolution.expandedWeights(), this.pool.expandedWeights(), this.hidden.weight.rows(), this.readout.weight.rows()];
    const biases = [[], Array.from({ length: 72 }, (_, i) => this.convolution.bias.values[Math.floor(i / 36)]),
      zeros(18), [...this.hidden.bias.values], [...this.readout.bias.values]];
    const shapes = [[1, 8, 8], [2, 6, 6], [2, 3, 3], [12, 18], [4, 12]];
    return activations.map((values, i) => ({ id: `cnn-${i}`, name: names[i], size: values.length, shape: shapes[i],
      activations: [...values], weights: weights[i], gradients: [...this.activationGradients[i]], biases: biases[i] }));
  }

  samples(): PredictionSample[] {
    return this.data.validation.slice(0, 8).map(row => ({ input: [...row.input], target: [...row.target], prediction: this.predict(row.input), label: row.label }));
  }

  extras(): Record<string, unknown> {
    const pass = this.forward(this.data.validation[0].input);
    return { ...this.data.extras, architectureNote: 'Trainable 3×3 valid convolution (2 channels), tanh, 2×2 average pooling, dense tanh, softmax.',
      algorithm: 'CNN with exact analytic convolution/pooling backpropagation', scoreLabel: 'Validation accuracy',
      kernels: this.convolution.weight.rows(), kernelShape: [2, 1, 3, 3], featureMaps: pass.convolution,
      featureMapShape: [2, 6, 6], pooledMaps: pass.pooled, pooledShape: [2, 3, 3],
      weightSharing: 'Spatial convolution edges share 18 kernel parameters; expanded visual edges do not add parameters.',
      gradientNote: 'Node gradients are loss derivatives from the final sample of the most recent batch. Parameter gradients are batch means.',
      weightGradients: this.bank.parameters.map(parameter => ({ name: parameter.name, shape: [...parameter.shape], values: [...parameter.gradients] })),
      dropout: this.config.dropout ?? 0, optimizer: this.config.optimizer ?? 'adam',
      customArchitectureNote: 'This demo uses a fixed convolution/pooling architecture. Custom dense hiddenLayers are ignored.',
    };
  }

  checkpoint(): CNNCheckpoint {
    return { bank: this.bank.checkpoint(), random: this.random.exportState(), activationGradients: this.activationGradients.map(row => [...row]) };
  }

  restore(value: unknown): void {
    const saved = value as CNNCheckpoint;
    const sizes = [64, 72, 18, 12, 4];
    if (!saved || !Array.isArray(saved.activationGradients) || saved.activationGradients.length !== sizes.length ||
      saved.activationGradients.some((row, i) => !finiteVector(row, sizes[i]))) throw new Error('Invalid CNN checkpoint.');
    const random = new Random(0);
    random.importState(saved.random);
    this.bank.restore(saved.bank);
    this.random.importState(saved.random);
    this.activationGradients = saved.activationGradients.map(row => [...row]);
  }
}

END FILE: apps/web/src/engine/cnn.ts

====================================================================================================

import type {
  EngineController, InterventionResult, InterventionSpec, MetricPoint,
  RunConfig, RunSnapshot, RunState,
} from '../types';
import { BanditModel } from './bandit';
import { getDemo } from './catalog';
import { DenseModel } from './dense-model';
import { CNNModel } from './cnn';
import { GridworldModel } from './gridworld';
import { KMeansModel } from './kmeans';
import { klDivergence } from './math';
import type { ResearchModel } from './model';
import { PCAModel } from './pca';
import { scheduledLearningRate } from './optimizers';
import { TransformerModel } from './transformer';
import { validateCustomDataset } from './datasets';

const MAX_METRICS = 512;
const CHECKPOINT_SCHEMA = 'neuralis-browser-checkpoint';
const CHECKPOINT_VERSION = 1;
const MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES = 64_000_000;

interface EngineCheckpoint {
  schema: typeof CHECKPOINT_SCHEMA;
  version: number;
  config: RunConfig;
  runId: string;
  step: number;
  elapsedMs: number;
  metrics: MetricPoint[];
  model: unknown;
}

export function validateConfig(value: RunConfig): RunConfig {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') throw new Error('Run configuration is required.');
  getDemo(value.demoId);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value.learningRate) || value.learningRate <= 0 || value.learningRate > 1) {
    throw new Error('Learning rate must be finite and lie in (0, 1].');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(value.maxSteps) || value.maxSteps < 1 || value.maxSteps > 100_000) {
    throw new Error('Training steps must be an integer between 1 and 100,000.');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(value.batchSize) || value.batchSize < 1 || value.batchSize > 256) {
    throw new Error('Batch size must be an integer between 1 and 256.');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(value.seed) || value.seed < 0 || value.seed > 0xffffffff) {
    throw new Error('Seed must be a 32-bit unsigned integer.');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(value.captureEvery) || value.captureEvery < 1 || value.captureEvery > 10_000) {
    throw new Error('Capture interval must be an integer between 1 and 10,000.');
  }
  if (value.hiddenLayers && (!Array.isArray(value.hiddenLayers) || value.hiddenLayers.length > 8 ||
    value.hiddenLayers.some(size => !Number.isInteger(size) || size < 1 || size > 128))) {
    throw new Error('Custom hidden layers allow up to eight layers with 1–128 units each.');
  }
  if (value.optimizer !== undefined && !['adam', 'adamw', 'sgd', 'momentum', 'rmsprop'].includes(value.optimizer)) throw new Error('Unsupported optimizer.');
  if (value.schedule !== undefined && !['constant', 'cosine', 'warmup-cosine'].includes(value.schedule)) throw new Error('Unsupported learning-rate schedule.');
  if (!Number.isFinite(value.weightDecay ?? 0) || (value.weightDecay ?? 0) < 0 || (value.weightDecay ?? 0) > 1) throw new Error('Weight decay must lie in [0, 1].');
  if (!Number.isFinite(value.dropout ?? 0) || (value.dropout ?? 0) < 0 || (value.dropout ?? 0) >= 0.9) throw new Error('Dropout must lie in [0, 0.9).');
  if (!Number.isFinite(value.gradientClip ?? 5) || (value.gradientClip ?? 5) <= 0 || (value.gradientClip ?? 5) > 1000) throw new Error('Gradient clip must lie in (0, 1000].');
  if (value.warmupSteps !== undefined && (!Number.isInteger(value.warmupSteps) || value.warmupSteps < 0 || value.warmupSteps > value.maxSteps)) throw new Error('Warmup steps must lie between zero and maxSteps.');
  if (value.customDataset && value.demoId !== 'custom-data') throw new Error('Uploaded datasets require the custom-data demo.');
  if (value.demoId === 'custom-data' && !value.customDataset) throw new Error('Upload and prepare a dataset in the Data workbench before starting the custom-data demo.');
  return { demoId: value.demoId, learningRate: value.learningRate, maxSteps: value.maxSteps,
    batchSize: value.batchSize, seed: value.seed, captureEvery: value.captureEvery,
    hiddenLayers: value.hiddenLayers ? [...value.hiddenLayers] : undefined,
    optimizer: value.optimizer, weightDecay: value.weightDecay, dropout: value.dropout, gradientClip: value.gradientClip,
    schedule: value.schedule, warmupSteps: value.warmupSteps,
    customDataset: value.customDataset ? validateCustomDataset(value.customDataset) : undefined };
}

function buildModel(config: RunConfig): ResearchModel {
  const demo = getDemo(config.demoId);
  if (demo.id === 'pca') return new PCAModel(demo, config);
  if (demo.id === 'k-means') return new KMeansModel(demo, config);
  if (demo.id === 'gridworld') return new GridworldModel(config);
  if (demo.id === 'bandit') return new BanditModel(config);
  if (demo.id === 'tiny-cnn') return new CNNModel(demo, config);
  if (demo.id === 'tiny-transformer') return new TransformerModel(config);
  if (demo.id === 'super-mario') throw new Error('Super Mario runs in the separate local Python project: demos/super-mario.');
  return new DenseModel(demo, config);
}

/**
 * All work occurs in bounded event-loop slices. A studio step represents one
 * optimizer/minibatch update (or one PCA/Lloyd update), not one example.
 * Snapshots are immutable copies and expose actual validation measurements.
 */
export class BrowserEngine implements EngineController {
  private config: RunConfig;
  private model: ResearchModel;
  private state: RunState = 'idle';
  private currentStep = 0;
  private metrics: MetricPoint[] = [];
  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private disposed = false;
  private runId: string;
  private elapsedMs = 0;
  private activeSince: number | null = null;
  private message: string | undefined;
  private snapshot: RunSnapshot;
  private readonly onSnapshot: (snapshot: RunSnapshot) => void;

  constructor(config: RunConfig, onSnapshot: (snapshot: RunSnapshot) => void) {
    this.config = validateConfig(config);
    this.model = buildModel(this.config);
    this.onSnapshot = onSnapshot;
    this.runId = `run-${this.config.demoId}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${this.config.seed.toString(36)}`;
    this.snapshot = this.capture();
  }

  private assertLive(): void {
    if (this.disposed) throw new Error('This engine has been disposed.');
  }

  private time(): number {
    return this.elapsedMs + (this.activeSince === null ? 0 : Math.max(0, performance.now() - this.activeSince));
  }

  private cancelTimer(): void {
    if (this.timer !== null) clearTimeout(this.timer);
    this.timer = null;
  }

  private endActiveTime(): void {
    this.elapsedMs = this.time();
    this.activeSince = null;
  }

  private capture(): RunSnapshot {
    const result = this.model.evaluate();
    if (![result.loss, result.accuracy, result.gradientNorm].every(Number.isFinite)) {
      throw new Error('The model returned a nonfinite validation measurement.');
    }
    const point: MetricPoint = {
      step: this.currentStep, loss: result.loss, accuracy: result.accuracy,
      gradientNorm: result.gradientNorm, timestamp: Date.now(),
    };
    if (this.metrics.at(-1)?.step === this.currentStep) this.metrics[this.metrics.length - 1] = point;
    else this.metrics.push(point);
    if (this.metrics.length > MAX_METRICS) this.metrics.splice(0, this.metrics.length - MAX_METRICS);
    return {
      runId: this.runId, demoId: this.config.demoId, state: this.state, step: this.currentStep,
      epoch: this.currentStep * this.config.batchSize / this.model.trainingSize,
      loss: result.loss, accuracy: result.accuracy, learningRate: scheduledLearningRate(this.config, Math.max(0, this.currentStep - 1)),
      elapsedMs: this.time(), metrics: this.metrics.map(metric => ({ ...metric })),
      layers: this.model.capture(), samples: this.model.samples(),
      parameters: this.model.parameters, device: 'Browser CPU · JavaScript', message: this.message,
      seed: this.config.seed,
      extras: { ...this.model.extras(), gradientNorm: result.gradientNorm,
        optimizer: this.config.optimizer ?? 'adam', schedule: this.config.schedule ?? 'constant', baseLearningRate: this.config.learningRate,
        captureInterval: this.config.captureEvery, metricCapacity: MAX_METRICS,
        validationNote: 'Metrics are computed from the current model. No simulated training traces are used.',
        epochNote: ['pca', 'k-means'].includes(this.config.demoId) ?
          'Each studio step is a full-data solver iteration; epoch display is only a generic progress estimate.' :
          ['gridworld', 'bandit'].includes(this.config.demoId) ? 'Epoch is a generic transition-equivalent progress estimate, not a dataset epoch.' :
          'Epoch is sampled examples divided by training-set size; minibatches are sampled with replacement.',
      },
    };
  }

  private publish(recapture = true): void {
    if (recapture) this.snapshot = this.capture();
    else this.snapshot = { ...this.snapshot, state: this.state, message: this.message, elapsedMs: this.time() };
    this.onSnapshot(this.getSnapshot());
  }

  private fail(error: unknown): void {
    this.cancelTimer();
    this.endActiveTime();
    this.state = 'failed';
    this.message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'An unknown numerical error occurred.';
    this.publish(false);
  }

  private update(): void {
    this.model.train(scheduledLearningRate(this.config, this.currentStep), this.config.batchSize);
    this.currentStep++;
    if (this.currentStep >= this.config.maxSteps) {
      this.state = 'completed';
      this.endActiveTime();
      this.message = 'Configured training budget completed. Results reflect measured performance.';
    }
  }

  private schedule(): void {
    if (this.timer !== null || this.state !== 'running' || this.disposed) return;
    this.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.timer = null;
      if (this.state !== 'running' || this.disposed) return;
      try {
        const deadline = performance.now() + 8;
        let updates = 0;
        let needsCapture = false;
        do {
          this.update();
          updates++;
          if (this.currentStep % this.config.captureEvery === 0) needsCapture = true;
        } while (this.state === 'running' && updates < 8 && performance.now() < deadline);
        if (needsCapture || this.currentStep >= this.config.maxSteps) this.publish();
        this.schedule();
      } catch (error) {
        this.fail(error);
      }
    }, 0);
  }

  start(): void {
    this.assertLive();
    if (this.state === 'running') return;
    if (this.state === 'paused') { this.resume(); return; }
    if (this.state !== 'idle') throw new Error('Start a new engine to restart a completed, stopped, or failed run.');
    this.state = 'running';
    this.activeSince = performance.now();
    this.message = undefined;
    this.publish(false);
    this.schedule();
  }

  pause(): void {
    this.assertLive();
    if (this.state !== 'running') return;
    this.cancelTimer();
    this.endActiveTime();
    this.state = 'paused';
    this.publish();
  }

  resume(): void {
    this.assertLive();
    if (this.state === 'running') return;
    if (this.state !== 'paused') throw new Error('Only a paused run can be resumed.');
    if (this.currentStep >= this.config.maxSteps) throw new Error('The configured step budget has already been reached.');
    this.state = 'running';
    this.activeSince = performance.now();
    this.message = undefined;
    this.publish(false);
    this.schedule();
  }

  step(): void {
    this.assertLive();
    if (!['idle', 'paused'].includes(this.state)) throw new Error('Single-step requires an idle or paused run.');
    if (this.currentStep >= this.config.maxSteps) throw new Error('The configured step budget has already been reached.');
    this.state = 'paused';
    const before = performance.now();
    try {
      this.update();
      this.elapsedMs += Math.max(0, performance.now() - before);
      this.publish();
    } catch (error) {
      this.fail(error);
    }
  }

  stop(): void {
    this.assertLive();
    if (['completed', 'failed', 'stopped'].includes(this.state)) return;
    this.cancelTimer();
    this.endActiveTime();
    this.state = 'stopped';
    this.message = 'Run stopped. The current parameters remain available for inspection and export.';
    this.publish();
  }

  getSnapshot(): RunSnapshot {
    // structuredClone preserves optional fields and protects model state from consumers.
    return structuredClone(this.snapshot);
  }

  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    this.assertLive();
    return this.model.predict(input, intervention);
  }

  intervene(input: number[], spec: InterventionSpec): InterventionResult {
    this.assertLive();
    const before = this.predict(input);
    const after = this.predict(input, spec);
    return { before, after, delta: after.map((value, i) => value - before[i]),
      input: [...input], spec: { ...spec }, klDivergence: klDivergence(before, after) };
  }

  exportCheckpoint(): string {
    this.assertLive();
    const checkpoint: EngineCheckpoint = {
      schema: CHECKPOINT_SCHEMA, version: CHECKPOINT_VERSION, config: { ...this.config }, runId: this.runId,
      step: this.currentStep, elapsedMs: this.time(), metrics: this.metrics.map(metric => ({ ...metric })),
      model: this.model.checkpoint(),
    };
    return JSON.stringify(checkpoint, null, 2);
  }

  importCheckpoint(serialized: string): void {
    this.assertLive();
    if (typeof serialized !== 'string' || serialized.length > MAX_CHECKPOINT_BYTES) {
      throw new Error('Checkpoint exceeds the 64 MB browser import limit.');
    }
    let saved: EngineCheckpoint;
    try { saved = JSON.parse(serialized) as EngineCheckpoint; }
    catch { throw new Error('Checkpoint is not valid JSON.'); }
    if (!saved || saved.schema !== CHECKPOINT_SCHEMA || saved.version !== CHECKPOINT_VERSION) {
      throw new Error('Unsupported checkpoint schema or version.');
    }
    const nextConfig = validateConfig(saved.config);
    if (!Number.isInteger(saved.step) || saved.step < 0 || saved.step > nextConfig.maxSteps ||
      !Number.isFinite(saved.elapsedMs) || saved.elapsedMs < 0 ||
      typeof saved.runId !== 'string' || saved.runId.length > 200 ||
      !Array.isArray(saved.metrics) || saved.metrics.length > MAX_METRICS ||
      saved.metrics.some((point, i) => !point || !Number.isInteger(point.step) || point.step < 0 || point.step > saved.step ||
        (i > 0 && point.step <= saved.metrics[i - 1].step) ||
        !Number.isFinite(point.loss) || point.loss < 0 || !Number.isFinite(point.accuracy) || point.accuracy < 0 || point.accuracy > 1 ||
        !Number.isFinite(point.timestamp) ||
        (point.gradientNorm !== undefined && (!Number.isFinite(point.gradientNorm) || point.gradientNorm < 0)))) {
      throw new Error('Checkpoint contains invalid run progress or metrics.');
    }
    // Validate and restore a fresh candidate before mutating this running engine.
    const candidate = buildModel(nextConfig);
    candidate.restore(saved.model);
    const result = candidate.evaluate();
    if (![result.loss, result.accuracy, result.gradientNorm].every(Number.isFinite)) {
      throw new Error('Checkpoint restored nonfinite model state.');
    }
    this.cancelTimer();
    this.config = nextConfig;
    this.model = candidate;
    this.currentStep = saved.step;
    this.elapsedMs = saved.elapsedMs;
    this.activeSince = null;
    this.metrics = saved.metrics.map(point => ({ ...point }));
    this.runId = saved.runId;
    this.state = saved.step >= nextConfig.maxSteps ? 'completed' : 'paused';
    this.message = 'Checkpoint loaded with optimizer state and deterministic random-stream position.';
    this.publish();
  }

  dispose(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.cancelTimer();
    this.endActiveTime();
    this.disposed = true;
  }
}

export function createEngine(config: RunConfig, onSnapshot: (snapshot: RunSnapshot) => void): EngineController {
  return new BrowserEngine(config, onSnapshot);
}

import type { DemoDefinition, RunConfig } from '../types';
import { argmax, clamp, finiteVector, mean, softmax } from './math';
import type { Objective } from './network';
import { Random } from './random';

export interface Example {
  input: number[];
  target: number[];
  label: string;
  clean?: number[];
  tokens?: string[];
  attention?: number[][];
}

export interface Dataset {
  train: Example[];
  validation: Example[];
  objective: Objective;
  inputSize: number;
  outputSize: number;
  scoreLabel: string;
  extras: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type CustomDataset = NonNullable<RunConfig['customDataset']>;

/** Validate uploaded numerical arrays before model allocation or checkpoint restore. */
export function validateCustomDataset(value: CustomDataset): CustomDataset {
  if (!value || !['classification', 'regression'].includes(value.task) ||
    !Array.isArray(value.inputs) || !Array.isArray(value.targets) || value.inputs.length < 2 || value.inputs.length > 10_000 ||
    value.targets.length !== value.inputs.length || !finiteVector(value.inputs[0]) || !finiteVector(value.targets[0])) {
    throw new Error('Custom data needs 2–10,000 paired numerical examples and a classification/regression task.');
  }
  const inputSize = value.inputs[0].length;
  const outputSize = value.targets[0].length;
  if (inputSize < 1 || inputSize > 128 || outputSize < 1 || outputSize > 128) throw new Error('Custom data permits 1–128 input features and 1–128 output targets.');
  const validateRows = (inputs: number[][], targets: number[][]) => {
    if (inputs.length !== targets.length || inputs.length > 10_000 ||
      inputs.some(row => !finiteVector(row, inputSize)) || targets.some(row => !finiteVector(row, outputSize))) {
      throw new Error('Custom data contains ragged, mismatched, or nonfinite numerical rows.');
    }
    if (value.task === 'classification' && targets.some(row => row.some(item => item < 0 || item > 1) ||
      (outputSize > 1 && Math.abs(row.reduce((total, item) => total + item, 0) - 1) > 1e-6))) {
      throw new Error('Classification targets must be binary probabilities or normalized one-hot/probability vectors.');
    }
  };
  validateRows(value.inputs, value.targets);
  if ((value.validationInputs === undefined) !== (value.validationTargets === undefined)) throw new Error('Held-out inputs and targets must be supplied together.');
  if (value.validationInputs && value.validationTargets) {
    if (!value.validationInputs.length) throw new Error('The explicit validation split must not be empty.');
    validateRows(value.validationInputs, value.validationTargets);
  }
  const cells = (value.inputs.length + (value.validationInputs?.length ?? 0)) * (inputSize + outputSize);
  if (cells > 1_000_000) throw new Error('Custom data exceeds the one-million numerical value browser memory budget.');
  if (value.name !== undefined && (typeof value.name !== 'string' || value.name.length > 500)) throw new Error('Dataset name is invalid.');
  if (value.labels && (!Array.isArray(value.labels) || value.labels.length > 128 || value.labels.some(label => typeof label !== 'string' || label.length > 500))) throw new Error('Dataset labels are invalid.');
  if (value.featureNames && (!Array.isArray(value.featureNames) || value.featureNames.length !== inputSize || value.featureNames.some(label => typeof label !== 'string' || label.length > 500))) throw new Error('Feature names must match the number of inputs.');
  return { name: value.name, task: value.task, inputs: value.inputs.map(row => [...row]), targets: value.targets.map(row => [...row]),
    validationInputs: value.validationInputs?.map(row => [...row]), validationTargets: value.validationTargets?.map(row => [...row]),
    labels: value.labels ? [...value.labels] : undefined, featureNames: value.featureNames ? [...value.featureNames] : undefined };
}

export function createCustomDataset(value: CustomDataset, seed: number): Dataset {
  const data = validateCustomDataset(value);
  const random = new Random((seed ^ 0x624ac19) >>> 0);
  const objective: Objective = data.task === 'regression' ? 'mse' : data.targets[0].length === 1 ? 'binary' : 'categorical';
  const example = (input: number[], target: number[]): Example => ({ input: [...input], target: [...target],
    label: data.task === 'regression' ? 'Uploaded numerical target' : data.labels?.[objective === 'binary' ? Number(target[0] >= 0.5) : argmax(target)] ?? 'Uploaded class' });
  let train: Example[];
  let validation: Example[];
  if (data.validationInputs && data.validationTargets) {
    train = data.inputs.map((input, i) => example(input, data.targets[i]));
    validation = data.validationInputs.map((input, i) => example(input, data.validationTargets![i]));
  } else {
    const indices = random.shuffle(Array.from({ length: data.inputs.length }, (_, i) => i));
    const validationCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(data.inputs.length * 0.2));
    validation = indices.slice(0, validationCount).map(i => example(data.inputs[i], data.targets[i]));
    train = indices.slice(validationCount).map(i => example(data.inputs[i], data.targets[i]));
  }
  const originalValidationCount = validation.length;
  if (validation.length > 1024) validation = random.shuffle([...validation]).slice(0, 1024);
  return { train, validation, objective, inputSize: train[0].input.length, outputSize: train[0].target.length,
    scoreLabel: data.task === 'regression' ? 'Explained variance (R², clipped at zero)' : 'Held-out accuracy',
    extras: { dataset: data.name ?? 'Uploaded numerical dataset', datasetOrigin: 'User supplied', trainingSamples: train.length,
      validationSamples: validation.length, totalValidationSamples: originalValidationCount,
      scoreLabel: data.task === 'regression' ? 'R² (clipped to [0, 1])' : 'Held-out accuracy',
      featureNames: data.featureNames, outputLabels: data.labels,
      splitNote: data.validationInputs ? 'Explicit training and held-out splits supplied by the dataset workbench.' : 'Seeded random 80/20 holdout; preprocessing must be fitted on the training split to avoid leakage.',
      captureNote: originalValidationCount > 1024 ? 'Validation measurements use a fixed seeded 1,024-row holdout subset to bound browser capture cost.' : undefined,
      inputShape: [train[0].input.length], architectureNote: 'A dense MLP trained on uploaded numerical features; hidden-layer overrides are supported.',
    } };
}

const oneHot = (index: number, size: number) => Array.from({ length: size }, (_, i) => Number(i === index));

function binary(input: number[], label: boolean, names = ['Negative', 'Positive']): Example {
  return { input, target: [Number(label)], label: names[Number(label)] };
}

function multiclass(input: number[], label: number, names: string[]): Example {
  return { input, target: oneHot(label, names.length), label: names[label] };
}

function regression(input: number[], target: number[], label = 'Continuous target'): Example {
  return { input, target, label };
}

const DIGITS = [
  ['01110', '11011', '11011', '11011', '01110'],
  ['00100', '01100', '00100', '00100', '01110'],
  ['01110', '00011', '00110', '01100', '11111'],
  ['11110', '00011', '01110', '00011', '11110'],
  ['11010', '11010', '11111', '00010', '00010'],
  ['11111', '11000', '11110', '00011', '11110'],
  ['01110', '11000', '11110', '11011', '01110'],
  ['11111', '00011', '00110', '01100', '01100'],
  ['01110', '11011', '01110', '11011', '01110'],
  ['01110', '11011', '01111', '00011', '01110'],
].map(rows => rows.join('').split('').map(Number));

export const VOCABULARY = ['the', 'robot', 'cat', 'researcher', 'learns', 'sees', 'builds', 'a', 'model', 'pattern', 'world', '.'];
const PHRASES = [
  ['the', 'robot', 'learns', 'a', 'model', '.'],
  ['the', 'researcher', 'builds', 'a', 'model', '.'],
  ['the', 'cat', 'sees', 'a', 'pattern', '.'],
  ['the', 'robot', 'sees', 'the', 'world', '.'],
  ['the', 'researcher', 'learns', 'a', 'pattern', '.'],
];

const SENTIMENT_WORDS = ['great', 'clear', 'helpful', 'excellent', 'bad', 'confusing', 'broken', 'slow', 'model', 'result', 'very', 'the'];
const SENTIMENT_VECTORS = SENTIMENT_WORDS.map((_, index) => [
  index < 4 ? 1 : index < 8 ? -1 : 0,
  index === 10 ? 1 : 0,
  index >= 8 && index <= 9 ? 1 : 0,
  (index % 3 - 1) * 0.4,
  Math.sin(index * 0.9),
  Math.cos(index * 0.9),
]);

/** Fixed scaled dot-product attention. Dense readout is the trainable component. */
export function attentionPool(tokens: string[]): { feature: number[]; attention: number[][] } {
  const vectors = tokens.map(token => {
    const index = SENTIMENT_WORDS.indexOf(token);
    if (index < 0) throw new Error(`Unknown sentiment token: ${token}`);
    return SENTIMENT_VECTORS[index];
  });
  const queries = vectors.map((vector, position) => vector.map((value, i) => value + Math.sin((position + 1) * (i + 1)) * 0.05));
  const attention = queries.map(query => softmax(vectors.map(key =>
    query.reduce((total, value, i) => total + value * key[i], 0) / Math.sqrt(query.length))));
  const contextual = attention.map(row => Array.from({ length: vectors[0].length }, (_, dimension) =>
    row.reduce((total, weight, i) => total + weight * vectors[i][dimension], 0)));
  return { feature: contextual[0].map((_, dimension) => mean(contextual.map(vector => vector[dimension]))), attention };
}

function sampleDemo(id: string, random: Random, sampleIndex: number): Example {
  const x = random.uniform() * 2 - 1;
  const y = random.uniform() * 2 - 1;
  switch (id) {
    case 'xor': {
      const first = random.integer(2);
      const second = random.integer(2);
      return binary([first, second], first !== second, ['Equal bits', 'Different bits']);
    }
    case 'circles': {
      const inside = sampleIndex % 2 === 0;
      const angle = random.uniform() * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = inside ? 0.22 + random.uniform() * 0.2 : 0.68 + random.uniform() * 0.23;
      return binary([Math.cos(angle) * radius, Math.sin(angle) * radius], !inside, ['Inner ring', 'Outer ring']);
    }
    case 'spirals': {
      const label = sampleIndex % 3;
      const radius = 0.1 + random.uniform() * 0.85;
      const angle = radius * 4.5 + label * Math.PI * 2 / 3 + random.normal(0, 0.1);
      return multiclass([radius * Math.sin(angle), radius * Math.cos(angle)], label, ['Spiral A', 'Spiral B', 'Spiral C']);
    }
    case 'moons': {
      const label = sampleIndex % 2;
      const angle = random.uniform() * Math.PI;
      return binary([label ? 1 - Math.cos(angle) : Math.cos(angle),
        label ? 0.5 - Math.sin(angle) : Math.sin(angle)].map(value => value + random.normal(0, 0.07)),
      Boolean(label), ['Upper moon', 'Lower moon']);
    }
    case 'gaussian-clusters': {
      const label = sampleIndex % 4;
      const centers = [[-0.6, -0.6], [-0.6, 0.6], [0.6, -0.6], [0.6, 0.6]];
      return multiclass(centers[label].map(value => value + random.normal(0, 0.18)), label,
        ['Northwest', 'Southwest', 'Northeast', 'Southeast']);
    }
    case 'parity': {
      const bits = Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => random.integer(2));
      return binary(bits, bits.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) % 2 === 1, ['Even parity', 'Odd parity']);
    }
    case 'sine-regression':
      return regression([x], [Math.sin(x * Math.PI) + random.normal(0, 0.025)], 'Sine signal');
    case 'surface-regression':
      return regression([x, y], [Math.sin(Math.PI * x) * Math.cos(Math.PI * y)], 'Saddle-wave surface');
    case 'linear-regression':
      return regression([x, y, random.normal(0, 0.5)], [0.55 * x - 0.35 * y + 0.12 + random.normal(0, 0.02)], 'Linear response');
    case 'forecasting': {
      const phase = random.uniform() * 2 * Math.PI;
      const frequency = 0.2 + random.uniform() * 0.12;
      const input = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => Math.sin(phase + i * frequency));
      return regression(input, [Math.sin(phase + 8 * frequency)], 'Next signal value');
    }
    case 'image-patterns': {
      const label = sampleIndex % 4;
      const offset = random.integer(3) - 1;
      const input = Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, index) => {
        const row = Math.floor(index / 8);
        const column = index % 8;
        const signal = label === 0 ? Math.abs(column - 3 - offset) <= 1 :
          label === 1 ? Math.abs(row - 3 - offset) <= 1 :
          label === 2 ? Math.abs(row - column - offset) <= 1 : Math.abs(row + column - 7 - offset) <= 1;
        return clamp(Number(signal) + random.normal(0, 0.12), 0, 1);
      });
      return multiclass(input, label, ['Vertical', 'Horizontal', 'Diagonal', 'Anti-diagonal']);
    }
    case 'tiny-digits': {
      const label = sampleIndex % 10;
      const input = DIGITS[label].map(value => clamp(value + random.normal(0, 0.16), 0, 1));
      return multiclass(input, label, DIGITS.map((_, i) => String(i)));
    }
    case 'autoencoder':
    case 'denoising': {
      const label = sampleIndex % DIGITS.length;
      const clean = DIGITS[label].map(value => value * 2 - 1);
      const input = clean.map(value => id === 'denoising' ? clamp(value + random.normal(0, 0.45), -1, 1) : value);
      return { input, target: clean, label: `Synthetic digit ${label}`, clean };
    }
    case 'next-token': {
      const phrase = random.choice(PHRASES);
      const position = random.integer(phrase.length - 2) + 1;
      const context = phrase.slice(position - 1, position + 1);
      const input = context.flatMap(token => oneHot(VOCABULARY.indexOf(token), VOCABULARY.length));
      const next = phrase[position + 1];
      return { input, target: oneHot(VOCABULARY.indexOf(next), VOCABULARY.length),
        label: `${context.join(' ')} → ${next}`, tokens: context };
    }
    case 'attention-sentiment': {
      const positive = sampleIndex % 2 === 0;
      const adjective = random.choice(SENTIMENT_WORDS.slice(positive ? 0 : 4, positive ? 4 : 8));
      const tokens = ['the', random.choice(['model', 'result']), random.choice(['very', 'the']), adjective];
      const pooled = attentionPool(tokens);
      return { input: pooled.feature, target: [Number(positive)], label: tokens.join(' '), tokens, attention: pooled.attention };
    }
    case 'anomaly-detection': {
      const anomaly = sampleIndex % 3 === 0;
      const angle = random.uniform() * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = anomaly ? 0.9 + random.uniform() * 0.5 : 0.3 + random.normal(0, 0.06);
      return binary([Math.cos(angle) * radius, Math.sin(angle) * radius, random.normal(0, anomaly ? 0.65 : 0.1)],
        anomaly, ['Nominal sensor', 'Anomalous sensor']);
    }
    case 'pca': {
      const first = random.normal();
      const second = random.normal(0, 0.4);
      const input = [first + second * 0.1, first * 0.7 + second, first * -0.5 + second * 0.3 + random.normal(0, 0.02)];
      return regression(input, input, 'Correlated observation');
    }
    case 'k-means': {
      const label = sampleIndex % 4;
      const center = [[-0.8, -0.55], [-0.5, 0.65], [0.7, -0.55], [0.6, 0.75]][label];
      return multiclass(center.map(value => value + random.normal(0, 0.14)), label, ['Cluster A', 'Cluster B', 'Cluster C', 'Cluster D']);
    }
    default:
      throw new Error(`No browser dataset is registered for ${id}.`);
  }
}

export function createDataset(demo: DemoDefinition, seed: number): Dataset {
  const random = new Random((seed ^ 0x5a17c9e3) >>> 0);
  const trainCount = demo.id === 'xor' ? 128 : demo.id === 'parity' ? 512 :
    ['tiny-digits', 'autoencoder', 'denoising', 'next-token'].includes(demo.id) ? 480 : 384;
  const train = Array.from({ length: trainCount }, (_, i) => sampleDemo(demo.id, random, i));
  const validation = Array.from({ length: 128 }, (_, i) => sampleDemo(demo.id, random, i + trainCount));
  random.shuffle(train);
  const outputSize = train[0].target.length;
  const regressionDemos = ['sine-regression', 'surface-regression', 'linear-regression', 'forecasting', 'autoencoder', 'denoising', 'pca'];
  const objective: Objective = regressionDemos.includes(demo.id) ? 'mse' : outputSize === 1 ? 'binary' : 'categorical';
  return {
    train, validation, objective,
    inputSize: train[0].input.length, outputSize,
    scoreLabel: objective === 'mse' ? 'Explained variance (R², clipped at zero)' : 'Validation accuracy',
    extras: {
      dataset: 'Deterministic synthetic data; training and validation draws are separate.',
      trainingSamples: train.length,
      validationSamples: validation.length,
      scoreLabel: objective === 'mse' ? 'R² (clipped to [0, 1])' : 'Accuracy',
      inputShape: ['image-patterns'].includes(demo.id) ? [8, 8] :
        ['tiny-digits', 'autoencoder', 'denoising'].includes(demo.id) ? [5, 5] : [train[0].input.length],
      vocabulary: demo.id === 'next-token' ? VOCABULARY : undefined,
      architectureNote: demo.id === 'attention-sentiment' ?
        'Fixed scaled dot-product Q/K/V pooling; only the dense readout is trained. This is not a pretrained Transformer.' :
        ['tiny-digits', 'image-patterns'].includes(demo.id) ?
        'Flattened synthetic pixels with a dense MLP. No convolutional layers or external image dataset.' :
        demo.id === 'next-token' ? 'Two-token one-hot context → dense MLP → vocabulary softmax. No Transformer or pretrained language model.' : undefined,
    },
  };
}

====================================================================================================
BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/engine/dense-model.ts
====================================================================================================
import type { DemoDefinition, InterventionSpec, LayerData, PredictionSample, RunConfig } from '../types';
import { createCustomDataset, createDataset, type Dataset } from './datasets';
import type { ResearchModel } from './model';
import { DenseNetwork, type BatchResult, type NetworkCheckpoint } from './network';
import { Random } from './random';

export class DenseModel implements ResearchModel {
  readonly network: DenseNetwork;
  readonly data: Dataset;
  readonly random: Random;
  readonly parameters: number;
  readonly trainingSize: number;
  private readonly demoId: string;
  private readonly config: RunConfig;
  private readonly previewIndices: number[];
  private recentBatch: BatchResult = { loss: 0, accuracy: 0, gradientNorm: 0 };

  constructor(demo: DemoDefinition, config: RunConfig) {
    this.demoId = demo.id;
    this.config = { ...config };
    this.data = demo.id === 'custom-data' ? createCustomDataset(config.customDataset!, config.seed) : createDataset(demo, config.seed);
    this.random = new Random(config.seed);
    const architecture = config.hiddenLayers ?
      [this.data.inputSize, ...config.hiddenLayers, this.data.outputSize] : demo.id === 'custom-data' ?
      [this.data.inputSize, 24, 16, this.data.outputSize] : demo.architecture;
    if (architecture[0] !== this.data.inputSize || architecture.at(-1) !== this.data.outputSize) {
      throw new Error(`Architecture does not match the ${demo.id} dataset.`);
    }
    this.network = new DenseNetwork(architecture, this.data.objective, this.random);
    this.parameters = this.network.parameters;
    this.trainingSize = this.data.train.length;
    this.previewIndices = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => Math.floor(i * this.data.validation.length / 8));
  }

  train(learningRate: number, batchSize: number): BatchResult {
    const batch = Array.from({ length: batchSize }, () => this.data.train[this.random.integer(this.data.train.length)]);
    this.recentBatch = this.network.trainBatch(batch.map(row => row.input), batch.map(row => row.target), learningRate,
      this.config.gradientClip ?? 5, { kind: this.config.optimizer, weightDecay: this.config.weightDecay,
        dropout: this.config.dropout, gradientClip: this.config.gradientClip, random: this.random });
    return this.recentBatch;
  }

  evaluate(): BatchResult {
    return this.network.evaluate(this.data.validation.map(row => row.input), this.data.validation.map(row => row.target));
  }

  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    return this.network.predict(input, intervention);
  }

  capture(): LayerData[] {
    return this.network.capture(this.data.validation[0].input);
  }

  samples(): PredictionSample[] {
    return this.previewIndices.map(index => {
      const row = this.data.validation[index];
      return { input: [...row.input], target: [...row.target], prediction: this.predict(row.input), label: row.label };
    });
  }

  extras(): Record<string, unknown> {
    const sample = this.data.validation[0];
    const pass = this.network.forward(sample.input);
    const bottleneck = this.network.architecture.indexOf(Math.min(...this.network.architecture.slice(1, -1)), 1);
    return {
      ...this.data.extras,
      objective: this.data.objective,
      optimizer: this.config.optimizer ?? 'adam', dropout: this.config.dropout ?? 0, weightDecay: this.config.weightDecay ?? 0,
      trainingLoss: this.recentBatch.loss,
      batchAccuracy: this.recentBatch.accuracy,
      gradientNorm: this.recentBatch.gradientNorm,
      weightGradients: this.network.layers.map(layer => layer.weightGradient.map(row => [...row])),
      preactivations: pass.preactivations.map(row => [...row]),
      attention: sample.attention?.map(row => [...row]),
      tokens: sample.tokens ? [...sample.tokens] : undefined,
      attentionKind: sample.attention ? 'Fixed scaled dot-product pooling; actual probabilities' : undefined,
      latent: ['autoencoder', 'denoising'].includes(this.demoId) && bottleneck > 0 ?
        this.previewIndices.map(index => this.network.forward(this.data.validation[index].input).activations[bottleneck]) : undefined,
      trainingPreview: this.data.train.slice(0, 64).map(row => ({ input: [...row.input], target: [...row.target] })),
      validationPreview: this.data.validation.slice(0, 128).map(row => ({ input: [...row.input], target: [...row.target], prediction: this.predict(row.input) })),
    };
  }

  checkpoint(): unknown {
    return { network: this.network.exportCheckpoint(), random: this.random.exportState(), recentBatch: { ...this.recentBatch } };
  }

  restore(value: unknown): void {
    const checkpoint = value as { network: NetworkCheckpoint; random: ReturnType<Random['exportState']>; recentBatch: BatchResult };
    if (!checkpoint || !checkpoint.recentBatch ||
      !Number.isFinite(checkpoint.recentBatch.loss) || !Number.isFinite(checkpoint.recentBatch.accuracy) ||
      !Number.isFinite(checkpoint.recentBatch.gradientNorm)) throw new Error('Invalid dense model checkpoint.');
    const random = new Random(0);
    random.importState(checkpoint.random);
    this.network.importCheckpoint(checkpoint.network);
    this.random.importState(checkpoint.random);
    this.recentBatch = { ...checkpoint.recentBatch };
  }
}

BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/engine/gridworld.ts

import type { InterventionSpec, LayerData, PredictionSample, RunConfig } from '../types';
import { argmax, finiteMatrix, finiteVector, matrix, mean, zeros } from './math';
import type { ResearchModel } from './model';
import type { BatchResult } from './network';
import { Random } from './random';

export interface GridTransition { next: number; reward: number; terminal: boolean; }
export const GRID = {
  width: 6, height: 6, goal: 35, hazard: 20,
  walls: [8, 9, 15, 21, 25, 26, 27],
  actions: ['Up', 'Right', 'Down', 'Left'],
} as const;
const WALLS = new Set<number>(GRID.walls);
const OPEN = Array.from({ length: 36 }, (_, i) => i).filter(i => !WALLS.has(i) && i !== GRID.goal && i !== GRID.hazard);
const DISCOUNT = 0.95;

export function gridTransition(state: number, action: number): GridTransition {
  if (!Number.isInteger(state) || state < 0 || state >= 36 || !Number.isInteger(action) || action < 0 || action > 3) {
    throw new Error('Invalid grid state or action.');
  }
  if (state === GRID.goal || state === GRID.hazard) return { next: state, reward: 0, terminal: true };
  const row = Math.floor(state / 6);
  const column = state % 6;
  const dr = [-1, 0, 1, 0][action];
  const dc = [0, 1, 0, -1][action];
  const nextRow = row + dr;
  const nextColumn = column + dc;
  const proposed = nextRow * 6 + nextColumn;
  if (nextRow < 0 || nextRow >= 6 || nextColumn < 0 || nextColumn >= 6 || WALLS.has(proposed)) {
    return { next: state, reward: -0.05, terminal: false };
  }
  return { next: proposed, reward: proposed === GRID.goal ? 1 : proposed === GRID.hazard ? -1 : -0.025,
    terminal: proposed === GRID.goal || proposed === GRID.hazard };
}

function optimalTable(): number[][] {
  let values = zeros(36);
  for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 300; iteration++) {
    const next = values.map((value, state) => OPEN.includes(state) ?
      Math.max(...[0, 1, 2, 3].map(action => {
        const transition = gridTransition(state, action);
        return transition.reward + (transition.terminal ? 0 : DISCOUNT * values[transition.next]);
      })) : value);
    const change = Math.max(...next.map((value, i) => Math.abs(value - values[i])));
    values = next;
    if (change < 1e-12) break;
  }
  return Array.from({ length: 36 }, (_, state) => [0, 1, 2, 3].map(action => {
    if (!OPEN.includes(state)) return 0;
    const transition = gridTransition(state, action);
    return transition.reward + (transition.terminal ? 0 : DISCOUNT * values[transition.next]);
  }));
}

interface GridCheckpoint {
  table: number[][];
  lastTD: number[];
  random: ReturnType<Random['exportState']>;
  current: number;
  episodeSteps: number;
  episodeReward: number;
  episodes: number;
  transitions: number;
  returns: number[];
}

export class GridworldModel implements ResearchModel {
  readonly parameters = 144;
  readonly trainingSize = OPEN.length;
  private readonly random: Random;
  private table = matrix(36, 4);
  private lastTD = zeros(4);
  private current = 0;
  private episodeSteps = 0;
  private episodeReward = 0;
  private episodes = 0;
  private transitions = 0;
  private returns: number[] = [];
  private readonly optimum = optimalTable();

  constructor(config: RunConfig) {
    this.random = new Random(config.seed);
  }

  private epsilon(): number {
    return Math.max(0.05, 0.9 * Math.exp(-this.transitions / 6000));
  }

  train(learningRate: number, batchSize: number): BatchResult {
    let squaredTD = 0;
    this.lastTD.fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < batchSize; i++) {
      const action = this.random.uniform() < this.epsilon() ? this.random.integer(4) : argmax(this.table[this.current]);
      const transition = gridTransition(this.current, action);
      const target = transition.reward + (transition.terminal ? 0 : DISCOUNT * Math.max(...this.table[transition.next]));
      const error = target - this.table[this.current][action];
      this.table[this.current][action] += learningRate * error;
      this.lastTD[action] = -error;
      squaredTD += error * error;
      this.current = transition.next;
      this.episodeSteps++;
      this.episodeReward += transition.reward;
      this.transitions++;
      if (transition.terminal || this.episodeSteps >= 100) {
        this.returns.push(this.episodeReward);
        if (this.returns.length > 128) this.returns.shift();
        this.episodes++;
        this.current = this.random.choice(OPEN);
        this.episodeSteps = 0;
        this.episodeReward = 0;
      }
    }
    return { loss: squaredTD / batchSize, accuracy: this.evaluate().accuracy,
      gradientNorm: Math.sqrt(this.lastTD.reduce((total, value) => total + value * value, 0)) };
  }

  private rollout(start: number): { success: boolean; path: number[]; reward: number } {
    let current = start;
    let reward = 0;
    const path = [current];
    const seen = new Set<number>();
    for (let step = 0; step < 72; step++) {
      if (seen.has(current)) break;
      seen.add(current);
      const transition = gridTransition(current, argmax(this.table[current]));
      reward += transition.reward;
      current = transition.next;
      path.push(current);
      if (transition.terminal) return { success: current === GRID.goal, path, reward };
    }
    return { success: false, path, reward };
  }

  evaluate(): BatchResult {
    let residual = 0;
    for (const state of OPEN) for (let action = 0; action < 4; action++) {
      const transition = gridTransition(state, action);
      const target = transition.reward + (transition.terminal ? 0 : DISCOUNT * Math.max(...this.table[transition.next]));
      residual += (target - this.table[state][action]) ** 2;
    }
    return { loss: residual / (OPEN.length * 4), accuracy: OPEN.filter(state => this.rollout(state).success).length / OPEN.length,
      gradientNorm: Math.sqrt(this.lastTD.reduce((total, value) => total + value * value, 0)) };
  }

  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    if (!finiteVector(input, 36)) throw new Error('Gridworld expects a 36-dimensional one-hot state vector.');
    const result = [...this.table[argmax(input)]];
    if (intervention) {
      if (intervention.layer !== 1 || !Number.isInteger(intervention.neuron) || intervention.neuron < 0 || intervention.neuron > 3 ||
        !['ablate', 'scale', 'steer'].includes(intervention.kind) || !Number.isFinite(intervention.value)) {
        throw new Error('Gridworld interventions target an action value in layer 1.');
      }
      const i = intervention.neuron;
      result[i] = intervention.kind === 'ablate' ? 0 : intervention.kind === 'scale' ? result[i] * intervention.value : result[i] + intervention.value;
    }
    return result;
  }

  capture(): LayerData[] {
    const state = zeros(36);
    state[this.current] = 1;
    return [
      { id: 'grid-state', name: 'One-hot grid state', size: 36, shape: [6, 6], activations: state, weights: [], gradients: zeros(36), biases: [] },
      { id: 'grid-values', name: 'Tabular action values', size: 4, shape: [4, 36], activations: [...this.table[this.current]],
        weights: [0, 1, 2, 3].map(action => this.table.map(row => row[action])), gradients: [...this.lastTD], biases: zeros(4) },
    ];
  }

  samples(): PredictionSample[] {
    return OPEN.slice(0, 8).map(state => {
      const input = zeros(36);
      input[state] = 1;
      return { input, target: [...this.optimum[state]], prediction: this.predict(input), label: `Grid cell ${state}: optimal versus learned Q values` };
    });
  }

  extras(): Record<string, unknown> {
    return { algorithm: 'Tabular Q-learning', scoreLabel: 'Greedy goal reach rate over every nonterminal open start',
      lossLabel: 'Mean squared Bellman residual over all open-state action pairs',
      grid: { ...GRID, current: this.current, table: this.table.map(row => [...row]), path: this.rollout(0).path },
      epsilon: this.epsilon(), episodes: this.episodes, environmentTransitions: this.transitions,
      recentReturns: [...this.returns], meanEpisodeReturn: mean(this.returns), discount: DISCOUNT,
      architectureNote: 'Weights visualize a tabular Q function; no neural network is trained. Gradients are temporal-difference residuals.',
      stepNote: 'One studio step performs batchSize environment transitions.',
    };
  }

  checkpoint(): GridCheckpoint {
    return { table: this.table.map(row => [...row]), lastTD: [...this.lastTD], random: this.random.exportState(), current: this.current,
      episodeSteps: this.episodeSteps, episodeReward: this.episodeReward, episodes: this.episodes, transitions: this.transitions, returns: [...this.returns] };
  }

  restore(value: unknown): void {
    const saved = value as GridCheckpoint;
    if (!saved || !finiteMatrix(saved.table, 36, 4) || !finiteVector(saved.lastTD, 4) ||
      !Number.isInteger(saved.current) || saved.current < 0 || saved.current >= 36 || WALLS.has(saved.current) ||
      !Number.isInteger(saved.episodeSteps) || saved.episodeSteps < 0 || saved.episodeSteps > 100 ||
      !Number.isInteger(saved.episodes) || saved.episodes < 0 || !Number.isInteger(saved.transitions) || saved.transitions < 0 ||
      !Number.isFinite(saved.episodeReward) || !finiteVector(saved.returns) || saved.returns.length > 128) {
      throw new Error('Invalid gridworld checkpoint.');
    }
    const random = new Random(0);
    random.importState(saved.random);
    this.table = saved.table.map(row => [...row]);
    this.lastTD = [...saved.lastTD];
    this.random.importState(saved.random);
    this.current = saved.current;
    this.episodeSteps = saved.episodeSteps;
    this.episodeReward = saved.episodeReward;
    this.episodes = saved.episodes;
    this.transitions = saved.transitions;
    this.returns = [...saved.returns];
  }
}

====================================================================================================
BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/engine/gru.ts

import type { DemoDefinition, InterventionSpec, LayerData, PredictionSample, RunConfig } from '../types';
import { createDataset, type Dataset } from './datasets';
import { Affine, applyDropout } from './layers';
import { clamp, finiteVector, sigmoid, zeros } from './math';
import type { ResearchModel } from './model';
import type { BatchResult } from './network';
import { ParameterBank, type ParameterBankCheckpoint } from './optimizers';
import { Random } from './random';

const HIDDEN = 8;

interface GRUStepCache {
  input: number;
  previous: number[];
  update: number[];
  reset: number[];
  candidate: number[];
  hidden: number[];
}

interface GRUPass {
  steps: GRUStepCache[];
  hiddenDropped: number[];
  dropoutMask: number[];
  output: number[];
}

interface GRUCheckpoint {
  bank: ParameterBankCheckpoint;
  random: ReturnType<Random['exportState']>;
  activationGradients: number[][];
}

/** A genuine recurrent gated cell, unrolled over eight scalar observations. */
export class GRUModel implements ResearchModel {
  readonly bank = new ParameterBank();
  readonly updateGate: Affine;
  readonly resetGate: Affine;
  readonly candidate: Affine;
  readonly readout: Affine;
  readonly parameters: number;
  readonly trainingSize: number;
  private readonly config: RunConfig;
  private readonly data: Dataset;
  private readonly random: Random;
  private activationGradients = [zeros(8), zeros(8), zeros(8), zeros(8), zeros(1)];

  constructor(demo: DemoDefinition, config: RunConfig) {
    this.config = { ...config };
    this.random = new Random(config.seed);
    this.data = createDataset({ ...demo, id: 'forecasting' }, config.seed);
    this.updateGate = new Affine('gru.update', 1 + HIDDEN, HIDDEN, this.bank, this.random);
    this.resetGate = new Affine('gru.reset', 1 + HIDDEN, HIDDEN, this.bank, this.random);
    this.candidate = new Affine('gru.candidate', 1 + HIDDEN, HIDDEN, this.bank, this.random);
    this.readout = new Affine('readout', HIDDEN, 1, this.bank, this.random);
    this.parameters = this.bank.size;
    this.trainingSize = this.data.train.length;
  }

  private modify(input: number[], layer: number, intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    if (!intervention || intervention.layer !== layer) return input;
    const result = [...input];
    const i = intervention.neuron;
    result[i] = intervention.kind === 'ablate' ? 0 : intervention.kind === 'scale' ? result[i] * intervention.value : result[i] + intervention.value;
    return result;
  }

  private forward(input: number[], training = false, intervention?: InterventionSpec): GRUPass {
    if (!finiteVector(input, 8)) throw new Error('GRU expects eight finite scalar time-series values.');
    const sizes = [8, 8, 8, 8, 1];
    if (intervention && (!Number.isInteger(intervention.layer) || intervention.layer < 0 || intervention.layer >= sizes.length ||
      !Number.isInteger(intervention.neuron) || intervention.neuron < 0 || intervention.neuron >= sizes[intervention.layer] ||
      !Number.isFinite(intervention.value) || !['ablate', 'scale', 'steer'].includes(intervention.kind))) throw new Error('Invalid GRU intervention.');
    const sequence = this.modify([...input], 0, intervention);
    let hidden = zeros(HIDDEN);
    const steps: GRUStepCache[] = [];
    for (let time = 0; time < sequence.length; time++) {
      const previous = hidden;
      const joined = [sequence[time], ...previous];
      let update = this.updateGate.forward(joined).map(sigmoid);
      let reset = this.resetGate.forward(joined).map(sigmoid);
      if (time === sequence.length - 1) {
        update = this.modify(update, 1, intervention);
        reset = this.modify(reset, 2, intervention);
      }
      const candidateInput = [sequence[time], ...previous.map((value, i) => value * reset[i])];
      const candidate = this.candidate.forward(candidateInput).map(Math.tanh);
      hidden = candidate.map((value, i) => (1 - update[i]) * value + update[i] * previous[i]);
      if (time === sequence.length - 1) hidden = this.modify(hidden, 3, intervention);
      steps.push({ input: sequence[time], previous, update, reset, candidate, hidden });
    }
    const dropout = applyDropout(hidden, training ? this.config.dropout ?? 0 : 0, this.random);
    const output = this.modify(this.readout.forward(dropout.output), 4, intervention);
    return { steps, hiddenDropped: dropout.output, dropoutMask: dropout.mask, output };
  }

  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    return this.forward(input, false, intervention).output;
  }

  sampleLoss(input: number[], target: number[]): number {
    return (this.predict(input)[0] - target[0]) ** 2;
  }

  analyticGradients(inputs: number[][], targets: number[][], training = false): BatchResult {
    if (!inputs.length || inputs.length !== targets.length || targets.some(row => !finiteVector(row, 1))) throw new Error('Invalid GRU training batch.');
    this.bank.zeroGradients();
    let loss = 0;
    for (let sample = 0; sample < inputs.length; sample++) {
      const pass = this.forward(inputs[sample], training);
      const residual = pass.output[0] - targets[sample][0];
      loss += residual * residual;
      const outputGradient = [2 * residual];
      let hiddenGradient = this.readout.backward(pass.hiddenDropped, outputGradient).map((value, i) => value * pass.dropoutMask[i]);
      const finalHiddenGradient = [...hiddenGradient];
      const inputGradients = zeros(inputs[sample].length);
      let finalUpdateGradient = zeros(HIDDEN);
      let finalResetGradient = zeros(HIDDEN);
      for (let time = pass.steps.length - 1; time >= 0; time--) {
        const cache = pass.steps[time];
        const candidateGradient = hiddenGradient.map((value, i) => value * (1 - cache.update[i]) * (1 - cache.candidate[i] ** 2));
        const updateGradient = hiddenGradient.map((value, i) => value * (cache.previous[i] - cache.candidate[i]) * cache.update[i] * (1 - cache.update[i]));
        const previousGradient = hiddenGradient.map((value, i) => value * cache.update[i]);
        const candidateInput = [cache.input, ...cache.previous.map((value, i) => value * cache.reset[i])];
        const candidateInputGradient = this.candidate.backward(candidateInput, candidateGradient);
        const resetGradient = cache.reset.map((value, i) => candidateInputGradient[i + 1] * cache.previous[i] * value * (1 - value));
        for (let i = 0; i < HIDDEN; i++) previousGradient[i] += candidateInputGradient[i + 1] * cache.reset[i];
        const joined = [cache.input, ...cache.previous];
        const updateInputGradient = this.updateGate.backward(joined, updateGradient);
        const resetInputGradient = this.resetGate.backward(joined, resetGradient);
        inputGradients[time] = candidateInputGradient[0] + updateInputGradient[0] + resetInputGradient[0];
        hiddenGradient = previousGradient.map((value, i) => value + updateInputGradient[i + 1] + resetInputGradient[i + 1]);
        if (time === pass.steps.length - 1) {
          finalUpdateGradient = updateGradient;
          finalResetGradient = resetGradient;
        }
      }
      this.activationGradients = [inputGradients, finalUpdateGradient, finalResetGradient, finalHiddenGradient, outputGradient];
    }
    this.bank.scaleGradients(1 / inputs.length);
    return { loss: loss / inputs.length, accuracy: 0, gradientNorm: this.bank.gradientNorm };
  }

  train(learningRate: number, batchSize: number): BatchResult {
    const batch = Array.from({ length: batchSize }, () => this.data.train[this.random.integer(this.data.train.length)]);
    const result = this.analyticGradients(batch.map(row => row.input), batch.map(row => row.target), true);
    this.bank.update(learningRate, { kind: this.config.optimizer, weightDecay: this.config.weightDecay, gradientClip: this.config.gradientClip });
    return result;
  }

  evaluate(): BatchResult {
    const targetMean = this.data.validation.reduce((total, row) => total + row.target[0], 0) / this.data.validation.length;
    let error = 0;
    let variance = 0;
    for (const row of this.data.validation) {
      error += this.sampleLoss(row.input, row.target);
      variance += (row.target[0] - targetMean) ** 2;
    }
    return { loss: error / this.data.validation.length, accuracy: clamp(1 - error / Math.max(1e-12, variance), 0, 1), gradientNorm: this.bank.gradientNorm };
  }

  capture(): LayerData[] {
    const input = this.data.validation[0].input;
    const pass = this.forward(input);
    const last = pass.steps.at(-1)!;
    const activations = [input, last.update, last.reset, last.hidden, pass.output];
    const names = ['Eight scalar observations', 'Final-time update gate', 'Final-time reset gate', 'Final recurrent state', 'Next signal value'];
    const weights = [[], this.updateGate.weight.rows(), this.resetGate.weight.rows(), this.candidate.weight.rows(), this.readout.weight.rows()];
    const biases = [[], [...this.updateGate.bias.values], [...this.resetGate.bias.values], [...this.candidate.bias.values], [...this.readout.bias.values]];
    return activations.map((values, i) => ({ id: `gru-${i}`, name: names[i], size: values.length,
      shape: i ? [values.length, i === 4 ? HIDDEN : 1 + HIDDEN] : [8, 1],
      activations: [...values], weights: weights[i], gradients: [...this.activationGradients[i]], biases: biases[i] }));
  }

  samples(): PredictionSample[] {
    return this.data.validation.slice(0, 8).map(row => ({ input: [...row.input], target: [...row.target], prediction: this.predict(row.input), label: 'GRU one-step forecast' }));
  }

  extras(): Record<string, unknown> {
    const pass = this.forward(this.data.validation[0].input);
    return { ...this.data.extras, algorithm: 'Eight-step GRU with analytic backpropagation through time',
      architectureNote: 'Actual shared gated recurrence: update, reset, tanh candidate, recurrent state, linear readout. Readout-only dropout.',
      hiddenSize: HIDDEN, sequenceLength: 8, hiddenTrajectory: pass.steps.map(step => [...step.hidden]),
      gateTrajectory: { update: pass.steps.map(step => [...step.update]), reset: pass.steps.map(step => [...step.reset]), candidate: pass.steps.map(step => [...step.candidate]) },
      visualizationNote: 'Layer summaries show the final time step. Gate matrices operate on [scalar observation, previous hidden state], not on the entire input window.',
      weightGradients: this.bank.parameters.map(parameter => ({ name: parameter.name, shape: [...parameter.shape], values: [...parameter.gradients] })),
      customArchitectureNote: 'The recurrent state has eight units. Dense hiddenLayers overrides are ignored.',
      dropout: this.config.dropout ?? 0,
    };
  }

  checkpoint(): GRUCheckpoint {
    return { bank: this.bank.checkpoint(), random: this.random.exportState(), activationGradients: this.activationGradients.map(row => [...row]) };
  }

  restore(value: unknown): void {
    const saved = value as GRUCheckpoint;
    const sizes = [8, 8, 8, 8, 1];
    if (!saved || !Array.isArray(saved.activationGradients) || saved.activationGradients.length !== sizes.length ||
      saved.activationGradients.some((row, i) => !finiteVector(row, sizes[i]))) throw new Error('Invalid GRU checkpoint.');
    const random = new Random(0);
    random.importState(saved.random);
    this.bank.restore(saved.bank);
    this.random.importState(saved.random);
    this.activationGradients = saved.activationGradients.map(row => [...row]);
  }
}

import type { DemoDefinition, InterventionSpec, LayerData, PredictionSample, RunConfig } from '../types';
import { createDataset, type Dataset } from './datasets';
import { argmax, finiteMatrix, matrix, softmax, squaredDistance, zeros } from './math';
import type { ResearchModel } from './model';
import type { BatchResult } from './network';
import { Random } from './random';

interface KMeansCheckpoint { centroids: number[][]; gradients: number[][]; iterations: number; }

function permutations(values: number[]): number[][] {
  if (!values.length) return [[]];
  return values.flatMap((value, i) => permutations(values.filter((_, j) => i !== j)).map(rest => [value, ...rest]));
}

const LABEL_PERMUTATIONS = permutations([0, 1, 2, 3]);

/** Four-centroid Lloyd clustering initialized with the k-means++ distribution. */
export class KMeansModel implements ResearchModel {
  readonly parameters = 8;
  readonly trainingSize: number;
  private readonly data: Dataset;
  private centroids: number[][];
  private gradients: number[][] = matrix(4, 2);
  private iterations = 0;

  constructor(demo: DemoDefinition, config: RunConfig) {
    this.data = createDataset(demo, config.seed);
    this.trainingSize = this.data.train.length;
    const random = new Random(config.seed);
    const points = this.data.train.map(row => row.input);
    this.centroids = [];
    let bestInertia = Infinity;
    // A bounded set of independent k-means++ starts avoids a fragile single seed.
    for (let restart = 0; restart < 8; restart++) {
      const candidate = [[...random.choice(points)]];
      while (candidate.length < 4) {
        const distances = points.map(point => Math.min(...candidate.map(center => squaredDistance(point, center))));
        const total = distances.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
        let threshold = random.uniform() * total;
        let index = points.length - 1;
        for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
          threshold -= distances[i];
          if (threshold <= 0) { index = i; break; }
        }
        candidate.push([...points[index]]);
      }
      const inertia = points.reduce((total, point) => total + Math.min(...candidate.map(center => squaredDistance(point, center))), 0);
      if (inertia < bestInertia) { this.centroids = candidate; bestInertia = inertia; }
    }
  }

  private cluster(input: number[]): number {
    const distances = this.centroids.map(center => squaredDistance(input, center));
    return argmax(distances.map(value => -value));
  }

  train(_learningRate: number, _batchSize: number): BatchResult {
    const counts = zeros(4);
    const sums = matrix(4, 2);
    this.gradients = matrix(4, 2);
    for (const row of this.data.train) {
      const cluster = this.cluster(row.input);
      counts[cluster]++;
      for (let dimension = 0; dimension < 2; dimension++) {
        sums[cluster][dimension] += row.input[dimension];
        this.gradients[cluster][dimension] += 2 * (this.centroids[cluster][dimension] - row.input[dimension]) / this.data.train.length;
      }
    }
    this.centroids = this.centroids.map((center, i) => counts[i] ? sums[i].map(value => value / counts[i]) : center);
    this.iterations++;
    return this.evaluate();
  }

  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    if (input.length !== 2 || input.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value))) throw new Error('K-means expects two finite coordinates.');
    if (intervention) throw new Error('K-means uses centroids rather than intervenable neural activations.');
    return softmax(this.centroids.map(center => -squaredDistance(input, center) / 0.12));
  }

  evaluate(): BatchResult {
    const assignments = this.data.validation.map(row => this.cluster(row.input));
    const inertia = this.data.validation.reduce((total, row, i) => total + squaredDistance(row.input, this.centroids[assignments[i]]), 0);
    const accuracy = Math.max(...LABEL_PERMUTATIONS.map(permutation => this.data.validation.reduce((total, row, i) =>
      total + Number(permutation[assignments[i]] === argmax(row.target)), 0))) / this.data.validation.length;
    return { loss: inertia / this.data.validation.length, accuracy,
      gradientNorm: Math.sqrt(this.gradients.flat().reduce((total, value) => total + value * value, 0)) };
  }

  capture(): LayerData[] {
    const input = this.data.validation[0].input;
    return [
      { id: 'cluster-input', name: 'Point coordinates', size: 2, shape: [2], activations: [...input], weights: [], gradients: zeros(2), biases: [] },
      { id: 'cluster-centroids', name: 'Centroid affinities', size: 4, shape: [4, 2], activations: this.predict(input),
        weights: this.centroids.map(center => [...center]), gradients: this.gradients.map(row => Math.sqrt(row[0] ** 2 + row[1] ** 2)), biases: zeros(4) },
    ];
  }

  samples(): PredictionSample[] {
    const assignments = this.data.validation.map(row => this.cluster(row.input));
    const permutation = LABEL_PERMUTATIONS.reduce((best, candidate) => {
      const score = (mapping: number[]) => this.data.validation.reduce((total, row, i) => total + Number(mapping[assignments[i]] === argmax(row.target)), 0);
      return score(candidate) > score(best) ? candidate : best;
    });
    return this.data.validation.slice(0, 8).map(row => {
      const clusterProbabilities = this.predict(row.input);
      const prediction = zeros(4);
      permutation.forEach((label, cluster) => { prediction[label] = clusterProbabilities[cluster]; });
      return { input: [...row.input], target: [...row.target], prediction, label: row.label };
    });
  }

  extras(): Record<string, unknown> {
    return { algorithm: 'Best of eight k-means++ starts followed by full-batch Lloyd updates', scoreLabel: 'Permutation-matched cluster accuracy',
      lossLabel: 'Validation mean squared distance to nearest centroid', iterations: this.iterations,
      centroids: this.centroids.map(row => [...row]), centroidGradients: this.gradients.map(row => [...row]),
      learningRateNote: 'Lloyd centroid updates ignore learning rate and minibatch size.',
      architectureNote: 'Centroid affinities are a visualization of distances, not neural hidden units or calibrated class probabilities.',
      embedding: this.data.validation.map(row => ({ input: [...row.input], cluster: this.cluster(row.input), label: argmax(row.target) })),
    };
  }

  checkpoint(): KMeansCheckpoint {
    return { centroids: this.centroids.map(row => [...row]), gradients: this.gradients.map(row => [...row]), iterations: this.iterations };
  }

  restore(value: unknown): void {
    const saved = value as KMeansCheckpoint;
    if (!saved || !finiteMatrix(saved.centroids, 4, 2) || !finiteMatrix(saved.gradients, 4, 2) ||
      !Number.isInteger(saved.iterations) || saved.iterations < 0) throw new Error('Invalid k-means checkpoint.');
    this.centroids = saved.centroids.map(row => [...row]);
    this.gradients = saved.gradients.map(row => [...row]);
    this.iterations = saved.iterations;
  }
}
