import { mean, softmax, zeros } from './math';
import { Parameter, ParameterBank } from './optimizers';
import { Random } from './random';

/** Affine parameter orientation is [output, input], matching captured layers. */
export class Affine {
  readonly input: number;
  readonly output: number;
  readonly weight: Parameter;
  readonly bias: Parameter;

  constructor(name: string, input: number, output: number, bank: ParameterBank, random: Random) {
    this.input = input;
    this.output = output;
    this.weight = bank.add(new Parameter(`${name}.weight`, [output, input], random, Math.sqrt(2 / (input + output))));
    this.bias = bank.add(new Parameter(`${name}.bias`, [output], random, 0, false));
  }

  forward(input: number[]): number[] {
    if (input.length !== this.input) throw new Error('Affine input has an incompatible shape.');
    const output = [...this.bias.values];
    for (let unit = 0; unit < this.output; unit++) {
      const offset = unit * this.input;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.input; i++) output[unit] += this.weight.values[offset + i] * input[i];
    }
    return output;
  }

  backward(input: number[], gradient: number[]): number[] {
    if (gradient.length !== this.output) throw new Error('Affine gradient has an incompatible shape.');
    const inputGradient = zeros(this.input);
    for (let unit = 0; unit < this.output; unit++) {
      const g = gradient[unit];
      const offset = unit * this.input;
      this.bias.gradients[unit] += g;
      for (let i = 0; i < this.input; i++) {
        this.weight.gradients[offset + i] += g * input[i];
        inputGradient[i] += g * this.weight.values[offset + i];
      }
    }
    return inputGradient;
  }
}

export interface ConvolutionShape {
  width: number; height: number; inputChannels: number;
  outputChannels: number; kernel: number;
}

/** Valid, unit-stride convolution; channel-major flattened tensors. */
export class Convolution2D {
  readonly shape: ConvolutionShape;
  readonly outputWidth: number;
  readonly outputHeight: number;
  readonly weight: Parameter;
  readonly bias: Parameter;

  constructor(name: string, shape: ConvolutionShape, bank: ParameterBank, random: Random) {
    if ([shape.width, shape.height, shape.inputChannels, shape.outputChannels, shape.kernel].some(value => !Number.isInteger(value) || value < 1) ||
      shape.kernel > shape.width || shape.kernel > shape.height) throw new Error('Invalid convolution dimensions.');
    this.shape = { ...shape };
    this.outputWidth = shape.width - shape.kernel + 1;
    this.outputHeight = shape.height - shape.kernel + 1;
    this.weight = bank.add(new Parameter(`${name}.weight`, [shape.outputChannels, shape.inputChannels, shape.kernel, shape.kernel],
      random, Math.sqrt(1 / (shape.inputChannels * shape.kernel * shape.kernel))));
    this.bias = bank.add(new Parameter(`${name}.bias`, [shape.outputChannels], random, 0, false));
  }

  get outputSize(): number {
    return this.outputWidth * this.outputHeight * this.shape.outputChannels;
  }

  forward(input: number[]): number[] {
    const { width, height, inputChannels, outputChannels, kernel } = this.shape;
    if (input.length !== width * height * inputChannels) throw new Error('Convolution input has an incompatible shape.');
    const result = zeros(this.outputSize);
    for (let channel = 0; channel < outputChannels; channel++) {
      for (let row = 0; row < this.outputHeight; row++) {
        for (let column = 0; column < this.outputWidth; column++) {
          let value = this.bias.values[channel];
          for (let inputChannel = 0; inputChannel < inputChannels; inputChannel++) {
            for (let kr = 0; kr < kernel; kr++) {
              for (let kc = 0; kc < kernel; kc++) {
                const weightIndex = ((channel * inputChannels + inputChannel) * kernel + kr) * kernel + kc;
                const inputIndex = (inputChannel * height + row + kr) * width + column + kc;
                value += input[inputIndex] * this.weight.values[weightIndex];
              }
            }
          }
          result[(channel * this.outputHeight + row) * this.outputWidth + column] = value;
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  backward(input: number[], gradient: number[]): number[] {
    if (gradient.length !== this.outputSize) throw new Error('Convolution gradient has an incompatible shape.');
    const { width, height, inputChannels, outputChannels, kernel } = this.shape;
    const result = zeros(input.length);
    for (let channel = 0; channel < outputChannels; channel++) {
      for (let row = 0; row < this.outputHeight; row++) {
        for (let column = 0; column < this.outputWidth; column++) {
          const g = gradient[(channel * this.outputHeight + row) * this.outputWidth + column];
          this.bias.gradients[channel] += g;
          for (let inputChannel = 0; inputChannel < inputChannels; inputChannel++) {
            for (let kr = 0; kr < kernel; kr++) {
              for (let kc = 0; kc < kernel; kc++) {
                const weightIndex = ((channel * inputChannels + inputChannel) * kernel + kr) * kernel + kc;
                const inputIndex = (inputChannel * height + row + kr) * width + column + kc;
                this.weight.gradients[weightIndex] += input[inputIndex] * g;
                result[inputIndex] += this.weight.values[weightIndex] * g;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  /** The sparse spatial operator exposes real weight sharing for rendering. */
  expandedWeights(): number[][] {
    const { width, height, inputChannels, outputChannels, kernel } = this.shape;
    const inputSize = width * height * inputChannels;
    const rows: number[][] = [];
    for (let channel = 0; channel < outputChannels; channel++) {
      for (let row = 0; row < this.outputHeight; row++) {
        for (let column = 0; column < this.outputWidth; column++) {
          const weights = zeros(inputSize);
          for (let inputChannel = 0; inputChannel < inputChannels; inputChannel++) {
            for (let kr = 0; kr < kernel; kr++) {
              for (let kc = 0; kc < kernel; kc++) {
                const weightIndex = ((channel * inputChannels + inputChannel) * kernel + kr) * kernel + kc;
                weights[(inputChannel * height + row + kr) * width + column + kc] = this.weight.values[weightIndex];
              }
            }
          }
          rows.push(weights);
        }
      }
    }
    return rows;
  }
}

/** Nonoverlapping spatial average pooling, with its exact transpose backward. */
export class AveragePool2D {
  readonly width: number;
  readonly height: number;
  readonly channels: number;
  readonly window: number;
  readonly outputWidth: number;
  readonly outputHeight: number;

  constructor(width: number, height: number, channels: number, window = 2) {
    if ([width, height, channels, window].some(value => !Number.isInteger(value) || value < 1) ||
      width % window !== 0 || height % window !== 0) throw new Error('Pooling requires divisible positive spatial dimensions.');
    this.width = width; this.height = height; this.channels = channels; this.window = window;
    this.outputWidth = width / window; this.outputHeight = height / window;
  }

  get outputSize(): number { return this.outputWidth * this.outputHeight * this.channels; }

  forward(input: number[]): number[] {
    if (input.length !== this.width * this.height * this.channels) throw new Error('Pooling input shape mismatch.');
    const result = zeros(this.outputSize);
    const scale = 1 / (this.window * this.window);
    for (let channel = 0; channel < this.channels; channel++) {
      for (let row = 0; row < this.outputHeight; row++) {
        for (let column = 0; column < this.outputWidth; column++) {
          const index = (channel * this.outputHeight + row) * this.outputWidth + column;
          for (let dr = 0; dr < this.window; dr++) {
            for (let dc = 0; dc < this.window; dc++) {
              result[index] += input[(channel * this.height + row * this.window + dr) * this.width + column * this.window + dc] * scale;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  backward(gradient: number[]): number[] {
    if (gradient.length !== this.outputSize) throw new Error('Pooling gradient shape mismatch.');
    const result = zeros(this.width * this.height * this.channels);
    const scale = 1 / (this.window * this.window);
    for (let channel = 0; channel < this.channels; channel++) {
      for (let row = 0; row < this.outputHeight; row++) {
        for (let column = 0; column < this.outputWidth; column++) {
          const index = (channel * this.outputHeight + row) * this.outputWidth + column;
          for (let dr = 0; dr < this.window; dr++) {
            for (let dc = 0; dc < this.window; dc++) {
              result[(channel * this.height + row * this.window + dr) * this.width + column * this.window + dc] += gradient[index] * scale;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  expandedWeights(): number[][] {
    return Array.from({ length: this.outputSize }, (_, i) => {
      const gradient = zeros(this.outputSize);
      gradient[i] = 1;
      return this.backward(gradient);
    });
  }
}

export interface LayerNormCache {
  normalized: number[];
  inverseDeviation: number;
}

export class LayerNorm {
  readonly scale: Parameter;
  readonly shift: Parameter;
  readonly dimension: number;

  constructor(name: string, dimension: number, bank: ParameterBank, random: Random) {
    this.dimension = dimension;
    this.scale = bank.add(new Parameter(`${name}.scale`, [dimension], random, 0, false, 1));
    this.shift = bank.add(new Parameter(`${name}.shift`, [dimension], random, 0, false));
  }

  forward(input: number[]): { output: number[]; cache: LayerNormCache } {
    if (input.length !== this.dimension) throw new Error('Layer norm shape mismatch.');
    const center = mean(input);
    const variance = mean(input.map(value => (value - center) ** 2));
    const inverseDeviation = 1 / Math.sqrt(variance + 1e-5);
    const normalized = input.map(value => (value - center) * inverseDeviation);
    return { output: normalized.map((value, i) => value * this.scale.values[i] + this.shift.values[i]),
      cache: { normalized, inverseDeviation } };
  }

  backward(cache: LayerNormCache, gradient: number[]): number[] {
    const scaled = gradient.map((value, i) => value * this.scale.values[i]);
    const average = mean(scaled);
    const correlation = mean(scaled.map((value, i) => value * cache.normalized[i]));
    for (let i = 0; i < this.dimension; i++) {
      this.scale.gradients[i] += gradient[i] * cache.normalized[i];
      this.shift.gradients[i] += gradient[i];
    }
    return scaled.map((value, i) => cache.inverseDeviation * (value - average - cache.normalized[i] * correlation));
  }
}

export interface AttentionCache {
  queries: number[][];
  keys: number[][];
  values: number[][];
  probabilities: number[][][];
  context: number[][];
}

export interface AttentionGradients {
  queries: number[][];
  keys: number[][];
  values: number[][];
}

/** Causal scaled dot-product attention with independent contiguous heads. */
export function causalAttention(
  queries: number[][], keys: number[][], values: number[][], heads: number,
): AttentionCache {
  const length = queries.length;
  const dimension = queries[0]?.length ?? 0;
  if (!length || keys.length !== length || values.length !== length || !heads || dimension % heads !== 0 ||
    [...queries, ...keys, ...values].some(row => row.length !== dimension)) throw new Error('Attention tensors have incompatible shapes.');
  const headSize = dimension / heads;
  const scale = 1 / Math.sqrt(headSize);
  const probabilities: number[][][] = [];
  const context = Array.from({ length }, () => zeros(dimension));
  for (let head = 0; head < heads; head++) {
    const offset = head * headSize;
    const attention: number[][] = [];
    for (let query = 0; query < length; query++) {
      const scores = Array.from({ length: query + 1 }, (_, key) => {
        let score = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < headSize; i++) score += queries[query][offset + i] * keys[key][offset + i];
        return score * scale;
      });
      const row = [...softmax(scores), ...zeros(length - query - 1)];
      attention.push(row);
      for (let key = 0; key <= query; key++) {
        for (let i = 0; i < headSize; i++) context[query][offset + i] += row[key] * values[key][offset + i];
      }
    }
    probabilities.push(attention);
  }
  return { queries, keys, values, probabilities, context };
}

/** Exact softmax Jacobian-vector product, including the causal mask. */
export function causalAttentionBackward(cache: AttentionCache, gradient: number[][]): AttentionGradients {
  const length = cache.queries.length;
  const dimension = cache.queries[0].length;
  const heads = cache.probabilities.length;
  const headSize = dimension / heads;
  const scale = 1 / Math.sqrt(headSize);
  const result: AttentionGradients = {
    queries: Array.from({ length }, () => zeros(dimension)),
    keys: Array.from({ length }, () => zeros(dimension)),
    values: Array.from({ length }, () => zeros(dimension)),
  };
  for (let head = 0; head < heads; head++) {
    const offset = head * headSize;
    for (let query = 0; query < length; query++) {
      const probabilities = cache.probabilities[head][query];
      const probabilityGradient = zeros(length);
      for (let key = 0; key <= query; key++) {
        for (let i = 0; i < headSize; i++) {
          probabilityGradient[key] += gradient[query][offset + i] * cache.values[key][offset + i];
          result.values[key][offset + i] += probabilities[key] * gradient[query][offset + i];
        }
      }
      const meanGradient = probabilities.reduce((total, value, key) => total + value * probabilityGradient[key], 0);
      for (let key = 0; key <= query; key++) {
        const scoreGradient = probabilities[key] * (probabilityGradient[key] - meanGradient) * scale;
        for (let i = 0; i < headSize; i++) {
          result.queries[query][offset + i] += scoreGradient * cache.keys[key][offset + i];
          result.keys[key][offset + i] += scoreGradient * cache.queries[query][offset + i];
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return result;
}

export function applyDropout(input: number[], probability: number, random?: Random): { output: number[]; mask: number[] } {
  if (!probability) return { output: [...input], mask: input.map(() => 1) };
  if (!random || probability < 0 || probability >= 1) throw new Error('Dropout requires a seeded stream and probability in [0, 1).');
  const mask = input.map(() => random.uniform() < probability ? 0 : 1 / (1 - probability));
  return { output: input.map((value, i) => value * mask[i]), mask };
}

export const EPSILON = 1e-12;

export function zeros(size: number): number[] {
  return Array.from({ length: size }, () => 0);
}

export function matrix(rows: number, columns: number, initial = 0): number[][] {
  return Array.from({ length: rows }, () => Array.from({ length: columns }, () => initial));
}

export function sum(values: number[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const value of values) total += value;
  return total;
}

export function mean(values: number[]): number {
  return values.length ? sum(values) / values.length : 0;
}

export function dot(a: number[], b: number[]): number {
  if (a.length !== b.length) throw new Error('Dot product dimensions do not match.');
  let result = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) result += a[i] * b[i];
  return result;
}

export function norm(values: number[]): number {
  return Math.sqrt(dot(values, values));
}

export function normalize(values: number[]): number[] {
  const denominator = norm(values);
  return denominator > EPSILON ? values.map(value => value / denominator) : zeros(values.length);
}

export function argmax(values: number[]): number {
  if (!values.length) throw new Error('Cannot select a maximum from an empty vector.');
  let best = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) if (values[i] > values[best]) best = i;
  return best;
}

export function softmax(values: number[]): number[] {
  const maximum = Math.max(...values);
  const exponentials = values.map(value => Math.exp(value - maximum));
  const denominator = sum(exponentials);
  return exponentials.map(value => value / denominator);
}

export function sigmoid(value: number): number {
  if (value >= 0) return 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-value));
  const exponential = Math.exp(value);
  return exponential / (1 + exponential);
}

export function clamp(value: number, low: number, high: number): number {
  return Math.max(low, Math.min(high, value));
}

export function squaredDistance(a: number[], b: number[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) total += (a[i] - b[i]) ** 2;
  return total;
}

export function transpose(values: number[][]): number[][] {
  if (!values.length) return [];
  return Array.from({ length: values[0].length }, (_, column) => values.map(row => row[column]));
}

export function multiplyVector(values: number[][], vector: number[]): number[] {
  return values.map(row => dot(row, vector));
}

export function finiteVector(value: unknown, expected?: number): value is number[] {
  return Array.isArray(value) && (expected === undefined || value.length === expected) &&
    value.every(item => typeof item === 'number' && Number.isFinite(item));
}

export function finiteMatrix(value: unknown, rows: number, columns: number): value is number[][] {
  return Array.isArray(value) && value.length === rows && value.every(row => finiteVector(row, columns));
}

/** KL divergence only for normalized probability vectors. */
export function klDivergence(before: number[], after: number[]): number | undefined {
  const isProbability = (values: number[]) => values.every(value => value >= 0 && value <= 1) &&
    Math.abs(sum(values) - 1) < 1e-6;
  if (!isProbability(before) || !isProbability(after)) return undefined;
  return before.reduce((total, value, i) => total +
    (value > 0 ? value * Math.log(value / Math.max(EPSILON, after[i])) : 0), 0);
}

export function covariance(samples: number[][]): { center: number[]; covariance: number[][] } {
  if (samples.length < 2) throw new Error('Covariance needs at least two samples.');
  const dimension = samples[0].length;
  const center = Array.from({ length: dimension }, (_, i) => mean(samples.map(row => row[i])));
  const result = matrix(dimension, dimension);
  for (const sample of samples) {
    for (let i = 0; i < dimension; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
        result[i][j] += (sample[i] - center[i]) * (sample[j] - center[j]) / (samples.length - 1);
      }
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < dimension; i++) for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) result[j][i] = result[i][j];
  return { center, covariance: result };
}

import type { InterventionSpec, LayerData } from '../types';
import { argmax, clamp, finiteMatrix, finiteVector, matrix, sigmoid, softmax, zeros } from './math';
import { Random } from './random';
import { updateScalar, type OptimizerOptions } from './optimizers';

export type Activation = 'tanh' | 'relu' | 'sigmoid' | 'linear' | 'softmax';
export type Objective = 'categorical' | 'binary' | 'mse';

export interface DenseLayer {
  input: number;
  output: number;
  activation: Activation;
  weights: number[][];
  biases: number[];
  weightGradient: number[][];
  biasGradient: number[];
  firstWeights: number[][];
  secondWeights: number[][];
  firstBiases: number[];
  secondBiases: number[];
}

export interface ForwardPass {
  activations: number[][];
  preactivations: number[][];
  dropoutMasks: number[][];
}

export interface DenseTrainOptions extends OptimizerOptions { dropout?: number; random?: Random; }

export interface BatchResult {
  loss: number;
  accuracy: number;
  gradientNorm: number;
}

export interface NetworkCheckpoint {
  architecture: number[];
  objective: Objective;
  updates: number;
  layers: DenseLayer[];
}

function activate(values: number[], activation: Activation): number[] {
  if (activation === 'softmax') return softmax(values);
  return values.map(value => activation === 'tanh' ? Math.tanh(value) :
    activation === 'relu' ? Math.max(0, value) : activation === 'sigmoid' ? sigmoid(value) : value);
}

function derivative(value: number, preactivation: number, activation: Activation): number {
  if (activation === 'tanh') return 1 - value * value;
  if (activation === 'relu') return preactivation > 0 ? 1 : 0;
  if (activation === 'sigmoid') return value * (1 - value);
  return 1;
}

/** Dense feed-forward network with exact minibatch gradients and Adam updates. */
export class DenseNetwork {
  readonly architecture: number[];
  readonly objective: Objective;
  readonly layers: DenseLayer[];
  updates = 0;

  constructor(architecture: number[], objective: Objective, random: Random, hiddenActivation: Activation = 'tanh') {
    if (architecture.length < 2 || architecture.length > 10 ||
      architecture.some(size => !Number.isInteger(size) || size < 1 || size > 256)) {
      throw new Error('Architecture needs 2–10 layers with 1–256 units each.');
    }
    if (!['tanh', 'relu', 'sigmoid', 'linear'].includes(hiddenActivation)) {
      throw new Error('Unsupported hidden-layer activation.');
    }
    this.architecture = [...architecture];
    this.objective = objective;
    this.layers = architecture.slice(1).map((output, index) => {
      const input = architecture[index];
      const activation = index === architecture.length - 2 ?
        objective === 'categorical' ? 'softmax' : objective === 'binary' ? 'sigmoid' : 'linear' : hiddenActivation;
      const deviation = hiddenActivation === 'relu' ? Math.sqrt(2 / input) : Math.sqrt(2 / (input + output));
      return {
        input, output, activation,
        weights: Array.from({ length: output }, () => Array.from({ length: input }, () => random.normal(0, deviation))),
        biases: zeros(output),
        weightGradient: matrix(output, input),
        biasGradient: zeros(output),
        firstWeights: matrix(output, input),
        secondWeights: matrix(output, input),
        firstBiases: zeros(output),
        secondBiases: zeros(output),
      };
    });
  }

  forward(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec, training?: DenseTrainOptions): ForwardPass {
    if (!finiteVector(input, this.architecture[0])) throw new Error(`Expected ${this.architecture[0]} finite inputs.`);
    if (intervention && (!Number.isInteger(intervention.layer) || intervention.layer < 0 ||
      intervention.layer >= this.architecture.length || !Number.isInteger(intervention.neuron) ||
      intervention.neuron < 0 || intervention.neuron >= this.architecture[intervention.layer] ||
      !['ablate', 'scale', 'steer'].includes(intervention.kind) || !Number.isFinite(intervention.value))) {
      throw new Error('Invalid intervention location, kind, or value.');
    }
    const change = (values: number[], layer: number) => {
      if (!intervention || intervention.layer !== layer) return values;
      const result = [...values];
      const neuron = intervention.neuron;
      result[neuron] = intervention.kind === 'ablate' ? 0 : intervention.kind === 'scale' ?
        result[neuron] * intervention.value : result[neuron] + intervention.value;
      return result;
    };
    const activations: number[][] = [change([...input], 0)];
    const preactivations: number[][] = [];
    const dropoutMasks: number[][] = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < this.layers.length; index++) {
      const layer = this.layers[index];
      const previous = activations[index];
      const values = layer.weights.map((row, unit) => {
        let value = layer.biases[unit];
        for (let i = 0; i < layer.input; i++) value += row[i] * previous[i];
        return value;
      });
      preactivations.push(values);
      let output = activate(values, layer.activation);
      const dropout = training?.dropout ?? 0;
      const mask = output.map(() => dropout && index < this.layers.length - 1 ?
        (training!.random!.uniform() < dropout ? 0 : 1 / (1 - dropout)) : 1);
      dropoutMasks.push(mask);
      if (dropout) output = output.map((value, i) => value * mask[i]);
      activations.push(change(output, index + 1));
    }
    return { activations, preactivations, dropoutMasks };
  }

  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    return this.forward(input, intervention).activations.at(-1)!;
  }

  loss(input: number[], target: number[]): number {
    return this.outputLoss(this.predict(input), target);
  }

  private outputLoss(output: number[], target: number[]): number {
    if (!finiteVector(target, output.length)) throw new Error('Target dimensions do not match the network.');
    if (this.objective === 'categorical') return output.reduce((total, value, i) =>
      total - target[i] * Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, value)), 0);
    if (this.objective === 'binary') return output.reduce((total, value, i) => total -
      (target[i] * Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, value)) +
      (1 - target[i]) * Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, 1 - value))), 0) / output.length;
    return output.reduce((total, value, i) => total + (value - target[i]) ** 2, 0) / output.length;
  }

  gradients(inputs: number[][], targets: number[][], training?: DenseTrainOptions): BatchResult {
    if (!inputs.length || inputs.length !== targets.length) throw new Error('A batch needs matching nonempty inputs and targets.');
    for (const layer of this.layers) {
      layer.weightGradient.forEach(row => row.fill(0));
      layer.biasGradient.fill(0);
    }
    let loss = 0;
    let correct = 0;
    for (let sample = 0; sample < inputs.length; sample++) {
      const pass = this.forward(inputs[sample], undefined, training);
      const output = pass.activations.at(-1)!;
      const target = targets[sample];
      loss += this.outputLoss(output, target);
      if (this.objective === 'categorical') correct += Number(argmax(output) === argmax(target));
      else if (this.objective === 'binary') correct += Number(output.every((value, i) => (value >= 0.5) === (target[i] >= 0.5)));
      let delta = output.map((value, i) => this.objective === 'mse' ?
        2 * (value - target[i]) / output.length :
        (value - target[i]) / (this.objective === 'binary' ? output.length : 1));
      for (let index = this.layers.length - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
        const layer = this.layers[index];
        const previous = pass.activations[index];
        for (let unit = 0; unit < layer.output; unit++) {
          layer.biasGradient[unit] += delta[unit] / inputs.length;
          for (let i = 0; i < layer.input; i++) {
            layer.weightGradient[unit][i] += delta[unit] * previous[i] / inputs.length;
          }
        }
        if (index > 0) {
          const hiddenLayer = this.layers[index - 1];
          const nextDelta = zeros(layer.input);
          for (let i = 0; i < layer.input; i++) {
            for (let unit = 0; unit < layer.output; unit++) nextDelta[i] += layer.weights[unit][i] * delta[unit];
            const preactivation = pass.preactivations[index - 1][i];
            const unmasked = hiddenLayer.activation === 'tanh' ? Math.tanh(preactivation) :
              hiddenLayer.activation === 'sigmoid' ? sigmoid(preactivation) : previous[i];
            nextDelta[i] *= derivative(unmasked, preactivation, hiddenLayer.activation) * pass.dropoutMasks[index - 1][i];
          }
          delta = nextDelta;
        }
      }
    }
    let normSquared = 0;
    for (const layer of this.layers) {
      for (const row of layer.weightGradient) for (const value of row) normSquared += value * value;
      for (const value of layer.biasGradient) normSquared += value * value;
    }
    return { loss: loss / inputs.length, accuracy: correct / inputs.length, gradientNorm: Math.sqrt(normSquared) };
  }

  trainBatch(inputs: number[][], targets: number[][], learningRate: number, gradientClip = 5, options: DenseTrainOptions = {}): BatchResult {
    if (!Number.isFinite(learningRate) || learningRate <= 0 || learningRate > 1) throw new Error('Learning rate must lie in (0, 1].');
    if (!Number.isFinite(options.dropout ?? 0) || (options.dropout ?? 0) < 0 || (options.dropout ?? 0) >= 1 ||
      ((options.dropout ?? 0) > 0 && !options.random)) throw new Error('Dropout needs a probability in [0, 1) and a seeded random stream.');
    const result = this.gradients(inputs, targets, options);
    if (!Number.isFinite(result.loss) || !Number.isFinite(result.gradientNorm)) throw new Error('Training diverged; lower the learning rate.');
    const threshold = options.gradientClip ?? gradientClip;
    const scale = result.gradientNorm > threshold ? threshold / result.gradientNorm : 1;
    this.updates++;
    const update = (parameter: number, gradient: number, first: number, second: number, decay: boolean): [number, number, number] => {
      const next = updateScalar(parameter, gradient * scale, first, second, this.updates, learningRate, options, decay);
      return [next.value, next.first, next.second];
    };
    for (const layer of this.layers) {
      for (let unit = 0; unit < layer.output; unit++) {
        [layer.biases[unit], layer.firstBiases[unit], layer.secondBiases[unit]] = update(
          layer.biases[unit], layer.biasGradient[unit], layer.firstBiases[unit], layer.secondBiases[unit], false);
        for (let i = 0; i < layer.input; i++) {
          [layer.weights[unit][i], layer.firstWeights[unit][i], layer.secondWeights[unit][i]] = update(
            layer.weights[unit][i], layer.weightGradient[unit][i], layer.firstWeights[unit][i], layer.secondWeights[unit][i], true);
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  evaluate(inputs: number[][], targets: number[][]): BatchResult {
    let loss = 0;
    let correct = 0;
    let squaredError = 0;
    const targetMeans = targets[0].map((_, i) => targets.reduce((total, row) => total + row[i], 0) / targets.length);
    let variance = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < inputs.length; i++) {
      const output = this.predict(inputs[i]);
      loss += this.outputLoss(output, targets[i]);
      if (this.objective === 'categorical') correct += Number(argmax(output) === argmax(targets[i]));
      else if (this.objective === 'binary') correct += Number(output.every((value, j) => (value >= 0.5) === (targets[i][j] >= 0.5)));
      else for (let j = 0; j < output.length; j++) {
        squaredError += (output[j] - targets[i][j]) ** 2;
        variance += (targets[i][j] - targetMeans[j]) ** 2;
      }
    }
    return { loss: loss / inputs.length,
      accuracy: this.objective === 'mse' ? clamp(1 - squaredError / Math.max(1e-12, variance), 0, 1) : correct / inputs.length,
      gradientNorm: Math.sqrt(this.layers.reduce((total, layer) => total +
        layer.weightGradient.flat().reduce((subtotal, value) => subtotal + value * value, 0) +
        layer.biasGradient.reduce((subtotal, value) => subtotal + value * value, 0), 0)),
    };
  }

  capture(input: number[]): LayerData[] {
    const pass = this.forward(input);
    return this.architecture.map((size, index) => ({
      id: `layer-${index}`,
      name: index === 0 ? 'Input' : index === this.architecture.length - 1 ? 'Readout' : `Dense ${index}`,
      size,
      shape: index ? [size, this.architecture[index - 1]] : [size],
      activations: [...pass.activations[index]],
      weights: index ? this.layers[index - 1].weights.map(row => [...row]) : [],
      gradients: index ? [...this.layers[index - 1].biasGradient] : zeros(size),
      biases: index ? [...this.layers[index - 1].biases] : [],
    }));
  }

  get parameters(): number {
    return this.layers.reduce((total, layer) => total + layer.output * (layer.input + 1), 0);
  }

  exportCheckpoint(): NetworkCheckpoint {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ architecture: this.architecture, objective: this.objective,
      updates: this.updates, layers: this.layers })) as NetworkCheckpoint;
  }

  importCheckpoint(checkpoint: NetworkCheckpoint): void {
    if (!checkpoint || JSON.stringify(checkpoint.architecture) !== JSON.stringify(this.architecture) ||
      checkpoint.objective !== this.objective || !Number.isInteger(checkpoint.updates) || checkpoint.updates < 0 ||
      !Array.isArray(checkpoint.layers) || checkpoint.layers.length !== this.layers.length) {
      throw new Error('Checkpoint architecture or objective does not match this demo.');
    }
    checkpoint.layers.forEach((saved, index) => {
      const layer = this.layers[index];
      if (saved.input !== layer.input || saved.output !== layer.output || saved.activation !== layer.activation ||
        !finiteMatrix(saved.weights, layer.output, layer.input) ||
        !finiteMatrix(saved.weightGradient, layer.output, layer.input) ||
        !finiteMatrix(saved.firstWeights, layer.output, layer.input) ||
        !finiteMatrix(saved.secondWeights, layer.output, layer.input) ||
        saved.secondWeights.some(row => row.some(value => value < 0)) ||
        !finiteVector(saved.biases, layer.output) || !finiteVector(saved.biasGradient, layer.output) ||
        !finiteVector(saved.firstBiases, layer.output) || !finiteVector(saved.secondBiases, layer.output) ||
        saved.secondBiases.some(value => value < 0)) throw new Error(`Checkpoint contains invalid dense layer ${index}.`);
    });
    this.updates = checkpoint.updates;
    checkpoint.layers.forEach((saved, index) => Object.assign(this.layers[index], JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(saved))));
  }
}

import type { RunConfig } from '../types';
import { finiteVector, zeros } from './math';
import { Random } from './random';

export type OptimizerKind = NonNullable<RunConfig['optimizer']>;

export interface OptimizerOptions {
  kind?: OptimizerKind;
  weightDecay?: number;
  gradientClip?: number;
}

export interface ScalarUpdate {
  value: number;
  first: number;
  second: number;
}

/** Optimizer state has one first and one second moment for every parameter. */
export function updateScalar(
  value: number, gradient: number, first: number, second: number,
  step: number, learningRate: number, options: OptimizerOptions = {}, decay = true,
): ScalarUpdate {
  const kind = options.kind ?? 'adam';
  const weightDecay = decay ? options.weightDecay ?? 0 : 0;
  const g = gradient + (kind === 'adamw' ? 0 : weightDecay * value);
  let direction: number;
  let nextFirst = first;
  let nextSecond = second;
  if (kind === 'sgd') direction = g;
  else if (kind === 'momentum') {
    nextFirst = 0.9 * first + g;
    direction = nextFirst;
  } else if (kind === 'rmsprop') {
    nextSecond = 0.99 * second + 0.01 * g * g;
    direction = g / (Math.sqrt(nextSecond) + 1e-8);
  } else {
    nextFirst = 0.9 * first + 0.1 * g;
    nextSecond = 0.999 * second + 0.001 * g * g;
    direction = (nextFirst / (1 - 0.9 ** step)) / (Math.sqrt(nextSecond / (1 - 0.999 ** step)) + 1e-8);
  }
  const nextValue = value - learningRate * direction - (kind === 'adamw' ? learningRate * weightDecay * value : 0);
  if (![nextValue, nextFirst, nextSecond].every(Number.isFinite)) throw new Error('Optimizer produced a nonfinite parameter or moment.');
  return { value: nextValue, first: nextFirst, second: nextSecond };
}

export function scheduledLearningRate(config: RunConfig, step: number): number {
  const schedule = config.schedule ?? 'constant';
  if (schedule === 'constant') return config.learningRate;
  const warmup = schedule === 'warmup-cosine' ? Math.min(config.maxSteps, config.warmupSteps ?? Math.max(1, Math.floor(config.maxSteps * 0.1))) : 0;
  if (step < warmup) return config.learningRate * (step + 1) / Math.max(1, warmup);
  const progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (step - warmup) / Math.max(1, config.maxSteps - warmup)));
  return config.learningRate * (0.05 + 0.95 * (1 + Math.cos(Math.PI * progress)) / 2);
}

export interface ParameterCheckpoint {
  name: string;
  shape: number[];
  values: number[];
  gradients: number[];
  first: number[];
  second: number[];
}

export class Parameter {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly shape: number[];
  readonly decay: boolean;
  values: number[];
  gradients: number[];
  first: number[];
  second: number[];

  constructor(name: string, shape: number[], random: Random, deviation = 0, decay = true, initial = 0) {
    if (!shape.length || shape.some(size => !Number.isInteger(size) || size < 1)) throw new Error('Invalid parameter shape.');
    const size = shape.reduce((total, value) => total * value, 1);
    this.name = name;
    this.shape = [...shape];
    this.decay = decay;
    this.values = Array.from({ length: size }, () => deviation ? random.normal(initial, deviation) : initial);
    this.gradients = zeros(size);
    this.first = zeros(size);
    this.second = zeros(size);
  }

  rows(): number[][] {
    const columns = this.shape.length > 1 ? this.shape.slice(1).reduce((total, value) => total * value, 1) : 1;
    return Array.from({ length: this.shape[0] }, (_, i) => this.values.slice(i * columns, (i + 1) * columns));
  }

  gradientRows(): number[][] {
    const columns = this.shape.length > 1 ? this.shape.slice(1).reduce((total, value) => total * value, 1) : 1;
    return Array.from({ length: this.shape[0] }, (_, i) => this.gradients.slice(i * columns, (i + 1) * columns));
  }

  checkpoint(): ParameterCheckpoint {
    return { name: this.name, shape: [...this.shape], values: [...this.values], gradients: [...this.gradients], first: [...this.first], second: [...this.second] };
  }

  validate(saved: ParameterCheckpoint): void {
    if (!saved || saved.name !== this.name || JSON.stringify(saved.shape) !== JSON.stringify(this.shape) ||
      !finiteVector(saved.values, this.values.length) || !finiteVector(saved.gradients, this.values.length) ||
      !finiteVector(saved.first, this.values.length) || !finiteVector(saved.second, this.values.length) ||
      saved.second.some(value => value < 0)) throw new Error(`Invalid checkpoint tensor: ${this.name}.`);
  }

  restore(saved: ParameterCheckpoint): void {
    this.validate(saved);
    this.values = [...saved.values];
    this.gradients = [...saved.gradients];
    this.first = [...saved.first];
    this.second = [...saved.second];
  }
}

export interface ParameterBankCheckpoint { updates: number; parameters: ParameterCheckpoint[]; }

export class ParameterBank {
  readonly parameters: Parameter[] = [];
  updates = 0;

  add(parameter: Parameter): Parameter {
    if (this.parameters.some(item => item.name === parameter.name)) throw new Error('Parameter names must be unique.');
    this.parameters.push(parameter);
    return parameter;
  }

  zeroGradients(): void {
    this.parameters.forEach(parameter => parameter.gradients.fill(0));
  }

  scaleGradients(scale: number): void {
    for (const parameter of this.parameters) {
      for (let i = 0; i < parameter.gradients.length; i++) parameter.gradients[i] *= scale;
    }
  }

  get gradientNorm(): number {
    return Math.sqrt(this.parameters.reduce((total, parameter) => total +
      parameter.gradients.reduce((subtotal, value) => subtotal + value * value, 0), 0));
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.parameters.reduce((total, parameter) => total + parameter.values.length, 0);
  }

  update(learningRate: number, options: OptimizerOptions = {}): number {
    if (!Number.isFinite(learningRate) || learningRate <= 0 || learningRate > 1) throw new Error('Invalid optimizer learning rate.');
    const gradientNorm = this.gradientNorm;
    if (!Number.isFinite(gradientNorm)) throw new Error('Nonfinite analytic gradient.');
    const threshold = options.gradientClip ?? 5;
    const scale = gradientNorm > threshold ? threshold / gradientNorm : 1;
    this.updates++;
    for (const parameter of this.parameters) {
      for (let i = 0; i < parameter.values.length; i++) {
        const next = updateScalar(parameter.values[i], parameter.gradients[i] * scale, parameter.first[i], parameter.second[i],
          this.updates, learningRate, options, parameter.decay);
        parameter.values[i] = next.value;
        parameter.first[i] = next.first;
        parameter.second[i] = next.second;
      }
    }
    return gradientNorm;
  }

  checkpoint(): ParameterBankCheckpoint {
    return { updates: this.updates, parameters: this.parameters.map(parameter => parameter.checkpoint()) };
  }

  restore(value: ParameterBankCheckpoint): void {
    if (!value || !Number.isInteger(value.updates) || value.updates < 0 || !Array.isArray(value.parameters) ||
      value.parameters.length !== this.parameters.length) throw new Error('Invalid parameter-bank checkpoint.');
    this.parameters.forEach((parameter, i) => parameter.validate(value.parameters[i]));
    this.parameters.forEach((parameter, i) => parameter.restore(value.parameters[i]));
    this.updates = value.updates;
  }
}

import type { DemoDefinition, InterventionSpec, LayerData, PredictionSample, RunConfig } from '../types';
import { createDataset, type Dataset } from './datasets';
import { clamp, covariance, dot, finiteMatrix, matrix, multiplyVector, norm, normalize, squaredDistance, zeros } from './math';
import type { ResearchModel } from './model';
import type { BatchResult } from './network';
import { Random } from './random';

interface PCACheckpoint {
  axes: number[][];
  displacement: number[][];
  iterations: number;
}

/** Orthogonal block power iteration on the centered sample covariance. */
export class PCAModel implements ResearchModel {
  readonly parameters = 6;
  readonly trainingSize: number;
  private readonly data: Dataset;
  private readonly center: number[];
  private readonly covariance: number[][];
  private axes: number[][];
  private displacement: number[][] = matrix(2, 3);
  private iterations = 0;

  constructor(demo: DemoDefinition, config: RunConfig) {
    this.data = createDataset(demo, config.seed);
    this.trainingSize = this.data.train.length;
    const result = covariance(this.data.train.map(row => row.input));
    this.center = result.center;
    this.covariance = result.covariance;
    const random = new Random(config.seed);
    const first = normalize(Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => random.normal()));
    const second = Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => random.normal());
    const projection = dot(first, second);
    this.axes = [first, normalize(second.map((value, i) => value - projection * first[i]))];
  }

  train(_learningRate: number, _batchSize: number): BatchResult {
    const first = normalize(multiplyVector(this.covariance, this.axes[0]));
    const secondCandidate = multiplyVector(this.covariance, this.axes[1]);
    const projection = dot(first, secondCandidate);
    const second = normalize(secondCandidate.map((value, i) => value - projection * first[i]));
    const next = [first, second];
    this.displacement = next.map((axis, i) => axis.map((value, j) => value - this.axes[i][j]));
    this.axes = next;
    this.iterations++;
    return this.evaluate();
  }

  private project(input: number[]): number[] {
    const centered = input.map((value, i) => value - this.center[i]);
    return this.axes.map(axis => dot(axis, centered));
  }

  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    if (input.length !== 3 || input.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value))) throw new Error('PCA expects three finite coordinates.');
    const latent = this.project(input);
    if (intervention) {
      if (intervention.layer !== 1 || ![0, 1].includes(intervention.neuron) ||
        !['ablate', 'scale', 'steer'].includes(intervention.kind) || !Number.isFinite(intervention.value)) {
        throw new Error('PCA interventions target one of the two principal components in layer 1.');
      }
      const i = intervention.neuron;
      latent[i] = intervention.kind === 'ablate' ? 0 : intervention.kind === 'scale' ? latent[i] * intervention.value : latent[i] + intervention.value;
    }
    return this.center.map((value, i) => value + latent.reduce((total, coefficient, j) => total + coefficient * this.axes[j][i], 0));
  }

  evaluate(): BatchResult {
    const residual = this.data.validation.reduce((total, row) => total + squaredDistance(row.input, this.predict(row.input)), 0);
    const variance = this.data.validation.reduce((total, row) => total + squaredDistance(row.input, this.center), 0);
    return { loss: residual / (this.data.validation.length * 3), accuracy: clamp(1 - residual / variance, 0, 1),
      gradientNorm: norm(this.displacement.flat()) };
  }

  capture(): LayerData[] {
    const input = this.data.validation[0].input;
    const encoded = this.project(input);
    return [
      { id: 'pca-input', name: 'Centered coordinates', size: 3, shape: [3], activations: input.map((value, i) => value - this.center[i]),
        weights: [], gradients: zeros(3), biases: this.center.map(value => -value) },
      { id: 'pca-projection', name: 'Principal axes', size: 2, shape: [2, 3], activations: encoded,
        weights: this.axes.map(axis => [...axis]), gradients: zeros(2), biases: zeros(2) },
      { id: 'pca-reconstruction', name: 'Linear reconstruction', size: 3, shape: [3, 2], activations: this.predict(input),
        weights: Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => this.axes.map(axis => axis[i])), gradients: zeros(3), biases: [...this.center] },
    ];
  }

  samples(): PredictionSample[] {
    return this.data.validation.slice(0, 8).map(row => ({ input: [...row.input], target: [...row.target], prediction: this.predict(row.input), label: row.label }));
  }

  extras(): Record<string, unknown> {
    const eigenvalues = this.axes.map(axis => dot(axis, multiplyVector(this.covariance, axis)));
    const totalVariance = this.covariance.reduce((total, row, i) => total + row[i], 0);
    return { algorithm: 'Orthogonal power iteration', scoreLabel: 'Explained variance',
      gradientNote: 'This eigensolver has no backpropagated gradient. Node gradients are zero; axis displacements are shown separately.',
      axes: this.axes.map(axis => [...axis]), axisDisplacement: this.displacement.map(row => [...row]),
      covariance: this.covariance.map(row => [...row]), eigenvalues,
      explainedVarianceRatio: eigenvalues.map(value => value / totalVariance),
      orthogonalityError: Math.abs(dot(this.axes[0], this.axes[1])), iterations: this.iterations,
      learningRateNote: 'Power iteration ignores learning rate and minibatch size.',
      embedding: this.data.validation.map(row => ({ original: [...row.input], projected: this.project(row.input) })),
    };
  }

  checkpoint(): PCACheckpoint {
    return { axes: this.axes.map(axis => [...axis]), displacement: this.displacement.map(row => [...row]), iterations: this.iterations };
  }

  restore(value: unknown): void {
    const saved = value as PCACheckpoint;
    if (!saved || !finiteMatrix(saved.axes, 2, 3) || !finiteMatrix(saved.displacement, 2, 3) ||
      !Number.isInteger(saved.iterations) || saved.iterations < 0 ||
      saved.axes.some(axis => Math.abs(norm(axis) - 1) > 1e-5) ||
      Math.abs(dot(saved.axes[0], saved.axes[1])) > 1e-5) throw new Error('Invalid PCA checkpoint.');
    this.axes = saved.axes.map(axis => [...axis]);
    this.displacement = saved.displacement.map(row => [...row]);
    this.iterations = saved.iterations;
  }
}

/** Portable deterministic random stream, including a serializable normal cache. */
export class Random {
  private state: number;
  private spare: number | null = null;

  constructor(seed = 42) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(seed)) throw new Error('Seed must be finite.');
    this.state = seed >>> 0;
  }

  uniform(): number {
    this.state = (this.state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let value = this.state;
    value = Math.imul(value ^ (value >>> 15), value | 1);
    value ^= value + Math.imul(value ^ (value >>> 7), value | 61);
    return ((value ^ (value >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  }

  normal(mean = 0, deviation = 1): number {
    if (this.spare !== null) {
      const value = this.spare;
      this.spare = null;
      return mean + deviation * value;
    }
    const radius = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(Math.max(Number.MIN_VALUE, this.uniform())));
    const angle = 2 * Math.PI * this.uniform();
    this.spare = radius * Math.sin(angle);
    return mean + deviation * radius * Math.cos(angle);
  }

  integer(limit: number): number {
    if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1) throw new Error('Random limit must be a positive integer.');
    return Math.floor(this.uniform() * limit);
  }

  choice<T>(values: readonly T[]): T {
    return values[this.integer(values.length)];
  }

  shuffle<T>(values: T[]): T[] {
    for (let i = values.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = this.integer(i + 1);
      [values[i], values[j]] = [values[j], values[i]];
    }
    return values;
  }

  exportState(): { state: number; spare: number | null } {
    return { state: this.state, spare: this.spare };
  }

  importState(value: { state: number; spare: number | null }): void {
    if (!Number.isInteger(value.state) || value.state < 0 || value.state > 0xffffffff ||
      (value.spare !== null && !Number.isFinite(value.spare))) {
      throw new Error('Invalid random-stream checkpoint.');
    }
    this.state = value.state;
    this.spare = value.spare;
  }
}

import type { InterventionSpec, LayerData, PredictionSample, RunConfig } from '../types';
import { VOCABULARY } from './datasets';
import {
  Affine, applyDropout, causalAttention, causalAttentionBackward, LayerNorm,
  type AttentionCache, type LayerNormCache,
} from './layers';
import { argmax, finiteVector, softmax, transpose, zeros } from './math';
import type { ResearchModel } from './model';
import type { BatchResult } from './network';
import { Parameter, ParameterBank, type ParameterBankCheckpoint } from './optimizers';
import { Random } from './random';

export const TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY = [...VOCABULARY, '<bos>'];
const SEQUENCE_LENGTH = 4;
const DIMENSION = 8;
const HEADS = 2;
const FEED_FORWARD = 16;
const PHRASES = [
  'the robot learns a model .',
  'the researcher builds a model .',
  'the cat sees a pattern .',
  'the robot sees the world .',
  'the researcher learns a pattern .',
  'the cat sees the world .',
  'the researcher sees a model .',
  'the robot builds a model .',
].map(sentence => sentence.split(' ').map(token => TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.indexOf(token)));

interface LanguageExample { input: number[]; target: number[]; label: string; }

function languageExample(random: Random): LanguageExample {
  const phrase = random.choice(PHRASES);
  const position = 1 + random.integer(phrase.length - 1);
  const input = phrase.slice(Math.max(0, position - SEQUENCE_LENGTH), position);
  while (input.length < SEQUENCE_LENGTH) input.unshift(TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.length - 1);
  const target = Array.from({ length: TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.length }, (_, i) => Number(i === phrase[position]));
  return { input, target, label: `${input.map(index => TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY[index]).join(' ')} → ${TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY[phrase[position]]}` };
}

interface TransformerPass {
  tokens: number[];
  embedded: number[][];
  normalized1: number[][];
  norm1Cache: LayerNormCache[];
  attention: AttentionCache;
  attentionDropped: number[][];
  attentionMasks: number[][];
  residual1: number[][];
  normalized2: number[][];
  norm2Cache: LayerNormCache[];
  hidden: number[][];
  hiddenDropped: number[][];
  hiddenMasks: number[][];
  residual2: number[][];
  final: number[];
  finalCache: LayerNormCache;
  output: number[];
}

interface TransformerCheckpoint {
  bank: ParameterBankCheckpoint;
  random: ReturnType<Random['exportState']>;
  activationGradients: number[][];
}

/**
 * One complete causal pre-norm Transformer block with two trainable heads.
 * All token/position embeddings, Q/K/V/O projections, FFN, normalization and
 * vocabulary readout parameters receive exact analytic gradients.
 */
export class TransformerModel implements ResearchModel {
  readonly bank = new ParameterBank();
  readonly tokenEmbedding: Parameter;
  readonly positionEmbedding: Parameter;
  readonly norm1: LayerNorm;
  readonly query: Affine;
  readonly key: Affine;
  readonly value: Affine;
  readonly attentionOutput: Affine;
  readonly norm2: LayerNorm;
  readonly ff1: Affine;
  readonly ff2: Affine;
  readonly finalNorm: LayerNorm;
  readonly readout: Affine;
  readonly parameters: number;
  readonly trainingSize: number;
  private readonly random: Random;
  private readonly config: RunConfig;
  private readonly trainSet: LanguageExample[];
  private readonly validation: LanguageExample[];
  private activationGradients = [zeros(4), zeros(8), zeros(8), zeros(16), zeros(8), zeros(13)];

  constructor(config: RunConfig) {
    this.config = { ...config };
    this.random = new Random(config.seed);
    this.tokenEmbedding = this.bank.add(new Parameter('embedding.token', [TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.length, DIMENSION], this.random, 0.2));
    this.positionEmbedding = this.bank.add(new Parameter('embedding.position', [SEQUENCE_LENGTH, DIMENSION], this.random, 0.05));
    this.norm1 = new LayerNorm('norm.attention', DIMENSION, this.bank, this.random);
    this.query = new Affine('attention.query', DIMENSION, DIMENSION, this.bank, this.random);
    this.key = new Affine('attention.key', DIMENSION, DIMENSION, this.bank, this.random);
    this.value = new Affine('attention.value', DIMENSION, DIMENSION, this.bank, this.random);
    this.attentionOutput = new Affine('attention.output', DIMENSION, DIMENSION, this.bank, this.random);
    this.norm2 = new LayerNorm('norm.feedforward', DIMENSION, this.bank, this.random);
    this.ff1 = new Affine('ffn.up', DIMENSION, FEED_FORWARD, this.bank, this.random);
    this.ff2 = new Affine('ffn.down', FEED_FORWARD, DIMENSION, this.bank, this.random);
    this.finalNorm = new LayerNorm('norm.final', DIMENSION, this.bank, this.random);
    this.readout = new Affine('readout', DIMENSION, TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.length, this.bank, this.random);
    this.parameters = this.bank.size;
    const dataRandom = new Random((config.seed ^ 0x930ce71) >>> 0);
    this.trainSet = Array.from({ length: 256 }, () => languageExample(dataRandom));
    this.validation = Array.from({ length: 96 }, () => languageExample(dataRandom));
    this.trainingSize = this.trainSet.length;
  }

  private modify(input: number[], layer: number, intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    if (!intervention || intervention.layer !== layer) return input;
    const result = [...input];
    const i = intervention.neuron;
    result[i] = intervention.kind === 'ablate' ? 0 : intervention.kind === 'scale' ?
      result[i] * intervention.value : result[i] + intervention.value;
    return result;
  }

  private forward(tokens: number[], training = false, intervention?: InterventionSpec): TransformerPass {
    if (!finiteVector(tokens, SEQUENCE_LENGTH) || tokens.some(token => !Number.isInteger(token) || token < 0 || token >= TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.length)) {
      throw new Error(`Tiny Transformer expects four integer token IDs in [0, ${TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.length - 1}].`);
    }
    const sizes = [4, 8, 8, 16, 8, 13];
    if (intervention && (!Number.isInteger(intervention.layer) || intervention.layer < 1 || intervention.layer >= sizes.length ||
      !Number.isInteger(intervention.neuron) || intervention.neuron < 0 || intervention.neuron >= sizes[intervention.layer] ||
      !Number.isFinite(intervention.value) || !['ablate', 'scale', 'steer'].includes(intervention.kind))) {
      throw new Error('Transformer interventions target the final context token in embedding/attention/FFN/readout layers 1–5.');
    }
    const last = SEQUENCE_LENGTH - 1;
    const dropout = training ? this.config.dropout ?? 0 : 0;
    const embedded = tokens.map((token, position) => {
      const vector = Array.from({ length: DIMENSION }, (_, i) => this.tokenEmbedding.values[token * DIMENSION + i] +
        this.positionEmbedding.values[position * DIMENSION + i]);
      return position === last ? this.modify(vector, 1, intervention) : vector;
    });
    const firstNorm = embedded.map(vector => this.norm1.forward(vector));
    const normalized1 = firstNorm.map(result => result.output);
    const attention = causalAttention(normalized1.map(vector => this.query.forward(vector)),
      normalized1.map(vector => this.key.forward(vector)), normalized1.map(vector => this.value.forward(vector)), HEADS);
    const contextDropout = attention.context.map(vector => applyDropout(vector, dropout, this.random));
    const attentionDropped = contextDropout.map(result => result.output);
    const residual1 = embedded.map((vector, token) => {
      const attentionContribution = this.attentionOutput.forward(attentionDropped[token]);
      const result = vector.map((value, i) => value + attentionContribution[i]);
      return token === last ? this.modify(result, 2, intervention) : result;
    });
    const secondNorm = residual1.map(vector => this.norm2.forward(vector));
    const normalized2 = secondNorm.map(result => result.output);
    const hidden = normalized2.map((vector, token) => {
      const result = this.ff1.forward(vector).map(Math.tanh);
      return token === last ? this.modify(result, 3, intervention) : result;
    });
    const hiddenDropout = hidden.map(vector => applyDropout(vector, dropout, this.random));
    const hiddenDropped = hiddenDropout.map(result => result.output);
    const residual2 = residual1.map((vector, token) => {
      const contribution = this.ff2.forward(hiddenDropped[token]);
      const result = vector.map((value, i) => value + contribution[i]);
      return token === last ? this.modify(result, 4, intervention) : result;
    });
    const final = this.finalNorm.forward(residual2[last]);
    const output = this.modify(softmax(this.readout.forward(final.output)), 5, intervention);
    return { tokens: [...tokens], embedded, normalized1, norm1Cache: firstNorm.map(result => result.cache), attention,
      attentionDropped, attentionMasks: contextDropout.map(result => result.mask), residual1,
      normalized2, norm2Cache: secondNorm.map(result => result.cache), hidden, hiddenDropped,
      hiddenMasks: hiddenDropout.map(result => result.mask), residual2,
      final: final.output, finalCache: final.cache, output };
  }

  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[] {
    return this.forward(input, false, intervention).output;
  }

  sampleLoss(input: number[], target: number[]): number {
    return this.predict(input).reduce((total, value, i) => total - target[i] * Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, value)), 0);
  }

  private backward(pass: TransformerPass, target: number[]): void {
    const last = SEQUENCE_LENGTH - 1;
    const outputGradient = pass.output.map((value, i) => value - target[i]);
    const finalGradient = this.readout.backward(pass.final, outputGradient);
    const residual2Gradient = this.finalNorm.backward(pass.finalCache, finalGradient);
    const residual1Gradients = Array.from({ length: SEQUENCE_LENGTH }, () => zeros(DIMENSION));
    const hiddenGradient = this.ff2.backward(pass.hiddenDropped[last], residual2Gradient)
      .map((value, i) => value * pass.hiddenMasks[last][i] * (1 - pass.hidden[last][i] ** 2));
    const secondNormGradient = this.ff1.backward(pass.normalized2[last], hiddenGradient);
    const secondResidualGradient = this.norm2.backward(pass.norm2Cache[last], secondNormGradient);
    residual1Gradients[last] = residual2Gradient.map((value, i) => value + secondResidualGradient[i]);
    const contextGradients = residual1Gradients.map((gradient, token) =>
      this.attentionOutput.backward(pass.attentionDropped[token], gradient).map((value, i) => value * pass.attentionMasks[token][i]));
    const attentionGradients = causalAttentionBackward(pass.attention, contextGradients);
    const embeddedGradients = pass.embedded.map((_, token) => {
      const queryGradient = this.query.backward(pass.normalized1[token], attentionGradients.queries[token]);
      const keyGradient = this.key.backward(pass.normalized1[token], attentionGradients.keys[token]);
      const valueGradient = this.value.backward(pass.normalized1[token], attentionGradients.values[token]);
      const normalizedGradient = queryGradient.map((value, i) => value + keyGradient[i] + valueGradient[i]);
      const directGradient = this.norm1.backward(pass.norm1Cache[token], normalizedGradient);
      return directGradient.map((value, i) => value + residual1Gradients[token][i]);
    });
    for (let token = 0; token < SEQUENCE_LENGTH; token++) {
      for (let i = 0; i < DIMENSION; i++) {
        this.tokenEmbedding.gradients[pass.tokens[token] * DIMENSION + i] += embeddedGradients[token][i];
        this.positionEmbedding.gradients[token * DIMENSION + i] += embeddedGradients[token][i];
      }
    }
    this.activationGradients = [zeros(4), embeddedGradients[last], residual1Gradients[last], hiddenGradient, residual2Gradient, outputGradient];
  }

  /** Full-network analytic derivatives; training=false makes finite differences deterministic. */
  analyticGradients(inputs: number[][], targets: number[][], training = false): BatchResult {
    if (!inputs.length || inputs.length !== targets.length || targets.some(target => !finiteVector(target, TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.length))) {
      throw new Error('Invalid Transformer training batch.');
    }
    this.bank.zeroGradients();
    let loss = 0;
    let correct = 0;
    for (let sample = 0; sample < inputs.length; sample++) {
      const pass = this.forward(inputs[sample], training);
      const target = targets[sample];
      loss += pass.output.reduce((total, value, i) => total - target[i] * Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, value)), 0);
      correct += Number(argmax(pass.output) === argmax(target));
      this.backward(pass, target);
    }
    this.bank.scaleGradients(1 / inputs.length);
    return { loss: loss / inputs.length, accuracy: correct / inputs.length, gradientNorm: this.bank.gradientNorm };
  }

  train(learningRate: number, batchSize: number): BatchResult {
    const batch = Array.from({ length: batchSize }, () => this.trainSet[this.random.integer(this.trainSet.length)]);
    const result = this.analyticGradients(batch.map(row => row.input), batch.map(row => row.target), true);
    this.bank.update(learningRate, { kind: this.config.optimizer, weightDecay: this.config.weightDecay, gradientClip: this.config.gradientClip });
    return result;
  }

  evaluate(): BatchResult {
    let loss = 0;
    let correct = 0;
    for (const row of this.validation) {
      const prediction = this.predict(row.input);
      loss += prediction.reduce((total, value, i) => total - row.target[i] * Math.log(Math.max(1e-12, value)), 0);
      correct += Number(argmax(prediction) === argmax(row.target));
    }
    return { loss: loss / this.validation.length, accuracy: correct / this.validation.length, gradientNorm: this.bank.gradientNorm };
  }

  capture(): LayerData[] {
    const pass = this.forward(this.validation[0].input);
    const last = SEQUENCE_LENGTH - 1;
    const activations = [pass.tokens, pass.embedded[last], pass.residual1[last], pass.hidden[last], pass.residual2[last], pass.output];
    const weights = [[], transpose(this.tokenEmbedding.rows()), this.attentionOutput.weight.rows(), this.ff1.weight.rows(), this.ff2.weight.rows(), this.readout.weight.rows()];
    const biases = [[], this.positionEmbedding.values.slice(last * DIMENSION, (last + 1) * DIMENSION),
      [...this.attentionOutput.bias.values], [...this.ff1.bias.values], [...this.ff2.bias.values], [...this.readout.bias.values]];
    const names = ['Four context token IDs', 'Learned token + position embedding', 'Causal attention + residual',
      'Tanh feed-forward expansion', 'Feed-forward + residual', 'Next-token vocabulary'];
    const shapes = [[4], [TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.length, DIMENSION], [HEADS, 4, 4], [FEED_FORWARD, DIMENSION], [DIMENSION, FEED_FORWARD], [TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY.length, DIMENSION]];
    return activations.map((values, i) => ({ id: `transformer-${i}`, name: names[i], size: values.length, shape: shapes[i],
      activations: [...values], weights: weights[i], gradients: [...this.activationGradients[i]], biases: biases[i] }));
  }

  samples(): PredictionSample[] {
    return this.validation.slice(0, 8).map(row => ({ input: [...row.input], target: [...row.target], prediction: this.predict(row.input), label: row.label }));
  }

  extras(): Record<string, unknown> {
    const pass = this.forward(this.validation[0].input);
    return { algorithm: 'Trainable one-block causal pre-norm Transformer', scoreLabel: 'Held-out next-token accuracy',
      architectureNote: 'All embeddings, Q/K/V/O, FFN, layer norms and readout are trained. This tiny synthetic grammar model is not a pretrained LLM.',
      attention: pass.attention.probabilities[0].map(row => [...row]),
      attentionHeads: pass.attention.probabilities.map(head => head.map(row => [...row])),
      attentionKind: 'Actual learned causal scaled dot-product attention · head 0',
      tokens: pass.tokens.map(index => TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY[index]), vocabulary: [...TRANSFORMER_VOCABULARY],
      headCount: HEADS, headDimension: DIMENSION / HEADS, sequenceLength: SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
      tokenEmbeddings: this.tokenEmbedding.rows(), positionEmbeddings: this.positionEmbedding.rows(),
      residualStream: { embedding: pass.embedded.map(row => [...row]), attention: pass.residual1.map(row => [...row]), feedforward: pass.residual2.map(row => [...row]) },
      q: pass.attention.queries.map(row => [...row]), k: pass.attention.keys.map(row => [...row]), v: pass.attention.values.map(row => [...row]),
      weightGradients: this.bank.parameters.map(parameter => ({ name: parameter.name, shape: [...parameter.shape], values: [...parameter.gradients] })),
      trainingSamples: this.trainSet.length, validationSamples: this.validation.length,
      dataset: 'Small explicit synthetic grammar; draws separated by seeded stream. Grammar contexts can repeat between splits.',
      gradientNote: 'Node gradients show final-context-token loss derivatives from the last training sample. Parameter gradients are minibatch means.',
      visualizationNote: 'Layer summaries show final-context-token vectors; attention mixes all four tokens. Embedding weights are vocabulary lookup values, not dense token-ID connections.',
      dropout: this.config.dropout ?? 0, optimizer: this.config.optimizer ?? 'adam',
      customArchitectureNote: 'This demo fixes dimension=8, heads=2, feed-forward=16, context=4. Dense hiddenLayers overrides are ignored.',
    };
  }

  checkpoint(): TransformerCheckpoint {
    return { bank: this.bank.checkpoint(), random: this.random.exportState(), activationGradients: this.activationGradients.map(row => [...row]) };
  }

  restore(value: unknown): void {
    const saved = value as TransformerCheckpoint;
    const sizes = [4, 8, 8, 16, 8, 13];
    if (!saved || !Array.isArray(saved.activationGradients) || saved.activationGradients.length !== sizes.length ||
      saved.activationGradients.some((row, i) => !finiteVector(row, sizes[i]))) throw new Error('Invalid Transformer checkpoint.');
    const random = new Random(0);
    random.importState(saved.random);
    this.bank.restore(saved.bank);
    this.random.importState(saved.random);
    this.activationGradients = saved.activationGradients.map(row => [...row]);
  }
}

import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Save, Upload, Download, Search, FolderArchive, Trash2, RotateCcw, FileJson, GitCompareArrows, Copy, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { useStudio } from '../app/StudioContext';
import { DEMOS } from '../engine';
import type { RunConfig } from '../types';
import type { SavedCheckpoint } from '../app/storage';
import { downloadText } from '../app/storage';
import { Panel, PageHeader, Select, Button, Badge, EmptyState, KeyValue, Field, Callout } from '../components/ui';

interface CheckpointMetadata {
  schema: string;
  version: number;
  runId: string;
  step: number;
  config: RunConfig;
}
function metadata(checkpoint: SavedCheckpoint): CheckpointMetadata | null {
  try {
    const value = JSON.parse(checkpoint.data) as CheckpointMetadata;
    if (!value.config || typeof value.config.demoId !== 'string') return null;
    return value;
  } catch { return null; }
}
export function Artifacts() {
  const { checkpoints, saveCheckpoint, loadCheckpoint, deleteCheckpoint, importCheckpoint, snapshot, notify } = useStudio();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState('newest');
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(checkpoints[0]?.id ?? '');
  const [compareId, setCompareId] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const file = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const filtered = useMemo(() => checkpoints.filter(item => (filter === 'all' || item.demoId === filter) && `${item.name} ${item.demoId}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())).sort((a, b) => sort === 'step' ? b.step - a.step : sort === 'size' ? b.data.length - a.data.length : Date.parse(b.createdAt) - Date.parse(a.createdAt)), [checkpoints, query, filter, sort]);
  const selected = checkpoints.find(item => item.id === selectedId) ?? filtered[0];
  const comparison = checkpoints.find(item => item.id === compareId);
  const selectedMeta = selected ? metadata(selected) : null;
  const comparisonMeta = comparison ? metadata(comparison) : null;
  const totalBytes = checkpoints.reduce((sum, item) => sum + new Blob([item.data]).size, 0);
  const importFile = async (input: File) => {
    if (input.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) { notify('Checkpoint exceeds the 10 MB browser import limit. Use the backend for larger models.', 'error'); return; }
    importCheckpoint(await input.text());
  };
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="CHECKPOINTS & ARTIFACTS" title="Keep every meaningful model state." description="Name, inspect, compare, and export your saved browser checkpoints." actions={<><Button onClick={() => file.current?.click()} disabled={snapshot.state === 'running'}><Upload size={14} />Import checkpoint</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={() => saveCheckpoint()}><Save size={14} />Save current state</Button></>} />
    <input type="file" ref={file} hidden accept="application/json,.json" onChange={async event => { const selectedFile = event.target.files?.[0]; if (selectedFile) await importFile(selectedFile); event.target.value = ''; }} />
    <div className="artifact-summary"><div><FolderArchive size={22} /><span><strong>{checkpoints.length}</strong><small>Saved checkpoints</small></span></div><div><FileJson size={22} /><span><strong>{(totalBytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB</strong><small>Local artifact data</small></span></div><div><Save size={22} /><span><strong>Step {snapshot.step.toLocaleString()}</strong><small>Current save point</small></span></div></div>
    <div className="artifact-toolbar"><div className="library-search"><Search size={15} /><input value={query} aria-label="Search checkpoints" onChange={event => setQuery(event.target.value)} placeholder="Search checkpoint name…" /></div><Select label="Filter artifact model" value={filter} onChange={setFilter} options={[{ value: 'all', label: 'All models' }, ...Array.from(new Set(checkpoints.map(item => item.demoId))).map(id => ({ value: id, label: DEMOS.find(demo => demo.id === id)?.title ?? id }))]} /><Select label="Sort artifacts" value={sort} onChange={setSort} options={[{ value: 'newest', label: 'Newest first' }, { value: 'step', label: 'Highest step' }, { value: 'size', label: 'Largest file' }]} /></div>
    <div className="artifacts-layout"><Panel title="Saved model states" subtitle="Stored in this browser; export important artifacts">{filtered.length ? <div className="artifact-list">{filtered.map(item => <button key={item.id} className={`artifact-list-item ${selected?.id === item.id ? 'selected' : ''}`} onClick={() => setSelectedId(item.id)}><span className="artifact-file-icon"><FileJson size={20} /></span><span><strong>{item.name}</strong><small>{DEMOS.find(demo => demo.id === item.demoId)?.title ?? item.demoId}</small><span className="artifact-item-meta">Step {item.step.toLocaleString()} · {new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</span></span><Badge tone="cyan">{(new Blob([item.data]).size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB</Badge></button>)}</div> : <EmptyState title="No checkpoints match this view" description="Save a model state or adjust the search and model filter." icon={<FolderArchive size={27} />} />}</Panel><div className="artifact-detail-stack"><Panel title="Checkpoint details" action={selected && <Badge tone="green"><Check size={10} />Local artifact</Badge>}>{selected ? <><div className="artifact-detail"><h3>{selected.name}</h3><KeyValue label="Demo" value={selected.demoId} /><KeyValue label="Step" value={selected.step.toLocaleString()} /><KeyValue label="Created" value={new Date(selected.createdAt).toLocaleString()} /><KeyValue label="File size" value={`${new Blob([selected.data]).size.toLocaleString()} bytes`} /><KeyValue label="Schema" value={selectedMeta?.schema ?? 'Unknown'} /><KeyValue label="Version" value={selectedMeta?.version ?? 'Unknown'} /><KeyValue label="Seed" value={selectedMeta?.config.seed ?? 'Unknown'} /><KeyValue label="Optimizer" value={selectedMeta?.config.optimizer ?? 'adam'} /><KeyValue label="Architecture override" value={selectedMeta?.config.hiddenLayers?.join(' → ') ?? 'Demo default'} /></div><div className="panel-bottom"><Button variant="primary" disabled={snapshot.state === 'running'} onClick={() => loadCheckpoint(selected)}><RotateCcw size={14} />Restore model</Button><Button onClick={() => downloadText(`neuralis-${selected.demoId}-${selected.step}.json`, selected.data)}><Download size={14} />Export</Button><button className="icon-button" aria-label="Delete selected checkpoint" onClick={() => { deleteCheckpoint(selected.id); setSelectedId(''); }}><Trash2 size={15} /></button></div></> : <EmptyState title="Select an artifact" description="Checkpoint metadata and actions appear here." />}</Panel><Panel title="Save a named checkpoint" subtitle="Capture the exact current model and optimizer"><div className="control-stack"><Field label="Checkpoint name"><input value={name} onChange={event => setName(event.target.value)} placeholder="Before activation experiment" maxLength={80} /></Field><Button onClick={() => { saveCheckpoint(name); setName(''); }}><Save size={14} />Save current state</Button></div></Panel><Panel title="Compare checkpoint configuration" action={<GitCompareArrows size={16} />}><div className="control-stack"><Select label="Comparison checkpoint" value={compareId} onChange={setCompareId} options={[{ value: '', label: 'Choose another checkpoint' }, ...checkpoints.filter(item => item.id !== selected?.id).map(item => ({ value: item.id, label: `${item.name} · step ${item.step}` }))]} />{selectedMeta && comparisonMeta && <table className="data-table metadata-comparison"><thead><tr><th>Setting</th><th>Selected</th><th>Comparison</th></tr></thead><tbody>{(['seed', 'learningRate', 'batchSize', 'maxSteps', 'optimizer', 'captureEvery'] as const).map(key => <tr key={key} className={selectedMeta.config[key] !== comparisonMeta.config[key] ? 'changed' : ''}><td>{key}</td><td>{String(selectedMeta.config[key] ?? 'default')}</td><td>{String(comparisonMeta.config[key] ?? 'default')}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>}<Button disabled={!selectedMeta} variant="ghost" onClick={async () => { if (!selectedMeta) return; try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(selectedMeta.config, null, 2)); notify('Checkpoint configuration copied.', 'success'); } catch { notify('Clipboard is unavailable. Export the checkpoint instead.'); } }}><Copy size={14} />Copy selected configuration</Button></div></Panel></div></div>
    <Callout>Browser storage is limited and can be cleared by your browser. This workspace keeps up to 15 local checkpoints. Export files for durable storage, or use native filesystem export in the desktop application.</Callout>
  </>;
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

function DemoArt({ architecture, accent, id }: { architecture: number[]; accent: string; id: string }) {
  const sizes = architecture.slice(0, 6).map(value => Math.min(7, value));
  const width = 320;
  const height = 120;
  const x = (layer: number) => 35 + layer / Math.max(1, sizes.length - 1) * 250;
  const y = (layer: number, node: number) => height / 2 + (node - (sizes[layer] - 1) / 2) * 15;
  return <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} role="img" aria-label={`${architecture.join(' to ')} network architecture`}><defs><radialGradient id={`glow-${id}`}><stop offset="0%" stopColor={accent} stopOpacity=".22" /><stop offset="100%" stopColor={accent} stopOpacity="0" /></radialGradient></defs><ellipse cx="160" cy="60" rx="150" ry="70" fill={`url(#glow-${id})`} />{sizes.slice(1).flatMap((count, layer) => Array.from({ length: sizes[layer] }, (_, a) => Array.from({ length: count }, (_, b) => <line key={`${layer}-${a}-${b}`} x1={x(layer)} y1={y(layer, a)} x2={x(layer + 1)} y2={y(layer + 1, b)} stroke={accent} strokeWidth=".6" opacity=".2" />))).flat()}{sizes.flatMap((count, layer) => Array.from({ length: count }, (_, node) => <g key={`${layer}-${node}`}><circle cx={x(layer)} cy={y(layer, node)} r="5" fill={accent} opacity=".12" /><circle cx={x(layer)} cy={y(layer, node)} r="2.7" fill={accent} opacity={layer === 0 || layer === sizes.length - 1 ? 1 : .7} /></g>))}</svg>;
}
