import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { desktop, isDesktop, type NativePreferences, type NativeStatus } from '../../../desktop/bridge';
import { Laptop, Play, Square, RefreshCw, Save, FolderOpen, Upload, Download } from 'lucide-react';
import { useStudio } from '../app/StudioContext';
import { Panel, Field, Select, Button, Badge, KeyValue, Callout } from '../components/ui';

export function DesktopRuntime() {
  const { engine, snapshot, importCheckpoint, notify } = useStudio();
  const [preferences, setPreferences] = useState<NativePreferences | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<NativeStatus | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [diagnostics, setDiagnostics] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const available = isDesktop();
  const run = async (operation: () => Promise<void>) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try { await operation(); }
    catch (error) { notify(String(error), 'error'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!available) return;
    void Promise.all([desktop.preferences(), desktop.status()]).then(([prefs, current]) => {
      setPreferences(prefs); setStatus(current);
    }).catch(error => notify(`Native runtime: ${String(error)}`, 'error'));
  }, [available, notify]);
  if (!available) return <Panel title="Desktop runtime" action={<Badge>Browser session</Badge>}><div className="settings-section"><Laptop size={27} className="cyan-text" /><p className="muted">Native process supervision and local filesystem operations are available in the installed Neuralis desktop application. Browser model training and JSON exports remain available here.</p></div></Panel>;
  return <Panel title="Native desktop runtime" action={<Badge tone={status?.phase === 'ready' ? 'green' : 'neutral'} dot>{status?.phase ?? 'Loading'}</Badge>}><div className="control-stack">
    {preferences && <><Field label="Runtime mode"><Select label="Native runtime mode" value={preferences.mode} onChange={mode => setPreferences(current => current ? { ...current, mode: mode as NativePreferences['mode'] } : current)} options={[{ value: 'browser_only', label: 'Browser demos only' }, { value: 'local', label: 'Supervised local Python backend' }, { value: 'remote', label: 'Connect to a remote backend' }]} /></Field>{preferences.mode === 'local' && <><Field label="Python executable" hint="Select the Python executable from your prepared backend environment"><input value={preferences.python_executable} onChange={event => setPreferences({ ...preferences, python_executable: event.target.value })} /></Field><Field label="Repository root"><input value={preferences.repository_root ?? ''} onChange={event => setPreferences({ ...preferences, repository_root: event.target.value || null })} placeholder="/path/to/Neuralis" /></Field></>}{preferences.mode === 'remote' && <Field label="Remote backend endpoint"><input type="url" value={preferences.remote_endpoint ?? ''} onChange={event => setPreferences({ ...preferences, remote_endpoint: event.target.value || null })} placeholder="https://your-backend.example" /></Field>}<Button disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run(async () => { await desktop.savePreferences(preferences); notify('Native preferences saved.', 'success'); })}><Save size={14} />Save native preferences</Button></>}
    {status && <><KeyValue label="Managed process" value={status.managed ? 'Yes' : 'No'} /><KeyValue label="Endpoint" value={status.endpoint ?? 'Disconnected'} /><KeyValue label="Process ID" value={status.process_id ?? '—'} /><p className="muted">{status.message}</p></>}
    <div className="inline-actions"><Button disabled={busy} variant="primary" onClick={() => void run(async () => { setStatus(await desktop.start()); })}><Play size={13} />Start backend</Button><Button disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run(async () => { await desktop.stop(); setStatus(await desktop.status()); })}><Square size={13} />Stop</Button><Button disabled={busy} variant="ghost" onClick={() => void run(async () => setStatus(await desktop.status()))} title="Refresh native status"><RefreshCw size={14} /></Button></div>
    <div className="inline-actions"><Button disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run(async () => { const directory = await desktop.selectExportFolder(); if (!directory) return; const receipt = await desktop.exportCheckpoint(directory, `neuralis-${snapshot.demoId}-${snapshot.step}.json`, engine.exportCheckpoint()); notify(`Exported ${receipt.bytes} bytes to ${receipt.path}`, 'success'); })}><Download size={13} />Native export</Button><Button disabled={busy} onClick={() => void run(async () => { const path = await desktop.selectCheckpoint(); if (!path) return; const [text] = await desktop.importCheckpoint(path); importCheckpoint(text); })}><Upload size={13} />Native import</Button></div>
    <Button disabled={busy} variant="ghost" onClick={() => void run(async () => setDiagnostics(await desktop.diagnostics()))}><FolderOpen size={14} />Read runtime diagnostics</Button>
    {diagnostics.length > 0 && <pre className="native-diagnostics">{diagnostics.join('\n')}</pre>}
    <Callout>The desktop supervisor launches only the Python process you configure. Review your executable and repository path before starting.</Callout>
  </div></Panel>;
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Check, Plus, Trash2, Play, Cpu, Layers, Database, Settings2, Radio, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { useStudio } from '../app/StudioContext';
import { DEMOS, validateConfig } from '../engine';
import type { RunConfig } from '../types';
import { PageHeader, Panel, Field, Select, Button, Badge, Callout, KeyValue } from '../components/ui';

const stages = [
  { title: 'Model', description: 'Choose your learning architecture', icon: Layers },
  { title: 'Data', description: 'Review the dataset and task', icon: Database },
  { title: 'Training', description: 'Configure your optimizer', icon: Settings2 },
  { title: 'Capture', description: 'Set your inspection budget', icon: Radio },
  { title: 'Resources', description: 'Understand the execution limits', icon: Cpu },
  { title: 'Review', description: 'Review and initialize the run', icon: ShieldCheck },
];
const fixedArchitectures = new Set(['pca', 'k-means', 'gridworld', 'tiny-cnn', 'tiny-transformer', 'cnn-patterns', 'transformer-copy']);

export function ExperimentWizard() {
  const { config, setConfig, notify } = useStudio();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [stage, setStage] = useState(0);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<RunConfig>({ optimizer: 'adam', weightDecay: 0, dropout: 0, gradientClip: 5, schedule: 'constant', warmupSteps: Math.min(20, config.maxSteps), ...config });
  const [customArchitecture, setCustomArchitecture] = useState(Boolean(config.hiddenLayers));
  const [layers, setLayers] = useState<number[]>(config.hiddenLayers ?? [16, 8]);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const demo = DEMOS.find(item => item.id === draft.demoId)!;
  const browserDemos = DEMOS.filter(item => item.id !== 'super-mario' && (item.id !== 'custom-data' || Boolean(config.customDataset)));
  const supportsCustom = !fixedArchitectures.has(demo.id) && !demo.tags.some(tag => /convolution|transformer/i.test(tag));
  const effectiveArchitecture = supportsCustom && customArchitecture ? [demo.architecture[0], ...layers, demo.architecture.at(-1)!] : demo.architecture;
  const parameters = useMemo(() => effectiveArchitecture.slice(1).reduce((sum, width, index) => sum + width * (effectiveArchitecture[index] + 1), 0), [effectiveArchitecture]);
  const resolved = (): RunConfig => ({ ...draft, hiddenLayers: supportsCustom && customArchitecture ? layers : undefined });
  const next = () => {
    try {
      validateConfig(resolved());
      setError('');
      setStage(current => Math.min(5, current + 1));
    } catch (failure) { setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Invalid configuration'); }
  };
  const create = () => {
    try {
      const result = validateConfig(resolved());
      setConfig(result);
      notify('Experiment initialized. Start training when you are ready.', 'success');
      navigate('/training');
    } catch (failure) { setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Invalid configuration'); }
  };
  const numberField = (key: keyof RunConfig, label: string, min: number, max: number, step = 1, hint?: string) => <Field key={key} label={label} hint={hint}><input type="number" min={min} max={max} step={step} value={draft[key] as number ?? ''} onChange={event => setDraft(current => ({ ...current, [key]: Number(event.target.value) }))} /></Field>;
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="NEW EXPERIMENT" title="Set up your next discovery." description="A reproducible plan with an explicit model, dataset, optimizer, and capture budget." />
    <div className="wizard-layout"><nav className="wizard-stages" aria-label="Experiment setup steps">{stages.map((item, index) => <button key={item.title} className={`${stage === index ? 'active' : ''} ${index < stage ? 'complete' : ''}`} disabled={index > stage} onClick={() => setStage(index)}><span className="wizard-stage-icon">{index < stage ? <Check size={16} /> : <item.icon size={16} />}</span><span><strong>{item.title}</strong><small>{item.description}</small></span><span className="wizard-stage-number">{index + 1}</span></button>)}<div className="wizard-local-note"><Cpu size={18} /><p>This wizard configures the real browser engine. Remote experiments are created from Infrastructure.</p></div></nav><Panel title={stages[stage].title} subtitle={`Step ${stage + 1} of ${stages.length} · ${stages[stage].description}`} className="wizard-panel"><div className="wizard-body">
      {stage === 0 && <><Field label="Learning experiment"><Select label="Wizard demo" value={draft.demoId} onChange={demoId => { setDraft(current => ({ ...current, demoId, hiddenLayers: undefined })); setCustomArchitecture(false); }} options={browserDemos.map(item => ({ value: item.id, label: `${item.title} · ${item.category}` }))} /></Field><div className="wizard-demo-description"><Badge tone="violet">{demo.difficulty}</Badge><h3>{demo.title}</h3><p>{demo.description}</p></div><Field label="Architecture mode"><Select label="Architecture mode" value={customArchitecture && supportsCustom ? 'custom' : 'default'} onChange={value => setCustomArchitecture(value === 'custom')} options={[{ value: 'default', label: 'Demo architecture' }, ...(supportsCustom ? [{ value: 'custom', label: 'Custom hidden layers' }] : [])]} /></Field>{customArchitecture && supportsCustom && <div className="architecture-builder"><div className="architecture-builder-labels"><span>INPUT · {demo.architecture[0]} features</span><span>OUTPUT · {demo.architecture.at(-1)}</span></div>{layers.map((width, index) => <div className="builder-layer" key={index}><Layers size={16} /><strong>Hidden layer {index + 1}</strong><input type="number" aria-label={`Hidden layer ${index + 1} width`} min={1} max={128} value={width} onChange={event => setLayers(current => current.map((size, i) => i === index ? Number(event.target.value) : size))} /><span>units</span><button className="icon-button" aria-label={`Remove hidden layer ${index + 1}`} onClick={() => setLayers(current => current.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}><Trash2 size={14} /></button></div>)}<Button disabled={layers.length >= 8} onClick={() => setLayers(current => [...current, 8])}><Plus size={14} />Add hidden layer</Button><p className="muted">Up to 8 hidden layers, each containing 1–128 units. An empty hidden list produces a linear readout.</p></div>}<div className="wizard-architecture-preview">{effectiveArchitecture.map((size, index) => <span key={index}>{index > 0 && <ArrowRight size={13} />}<strong>{size}</strong></span>)}</div><KeyValue label={supportsCustom ? 'Dense parameter estimate' : 'Architecture shape'} value={supportsCustom ? parameters.toLocaleString() : 'Specialist model · see captured tensors'} /></>}
      {stage === 1 && <><div className="wizard-demo-description"><Badge tone="cyan">{demo.category}</Badge><h3>{demo.task}</h3><p>The selected demo generates deterministic data using the configured random seed. Dataset sizes and evaluation semantics are provided by the engine capture.</p></div>{numberField('seed', 'Dataset and initialization seed', 0, 4294967295, 1, 'A 32-bit unsigned integer; repeat the seed and configuration to reproduce the run.')}<div className="wizard-data-facts"><KeyValue label="Input dimensions" value={demo.architecture[0]} /><KeyValue label="Output dimensions" value={demo.architecture.at(-1)} /><KeyValue label="Data source" value="Deterministic demo generator" /><KeyValue label="Privacy" value="Generated on this device" /></div><Callout>For imported CSV datasets, use Dataset preparation to inspect and export data for your own Python workflow. This browser wizard uses supported generated demo datasets.</Callout></>}
      {stage === 2 && <><div className="wizard-form-grid"><Field label="Optimizer"><Select label="Optimizer" value={draft.optimizer ?? 'adam'} onChange={optimizer => setDraft(current => ({ ...current, optimizer: optimizer as RunConfig['optimizer'] }))} options={[{ value: 'adam', label: 'Adam' }, { value: 'adamw', label: 'AdamW' }, { value: 'sgd', label: 'Stochastic gradient descent' }, { value: 'momentum', label: 'Momentum SGD' }, { value: 'rmsprop', label: 'RMSprop' }]} /></Field>{numberField('learningRate', 'Learning rate', .000001, 1, .001)}{numberField('maxSteps', 'Maximum optimizer steps', 1, 100000)}{numberField('batchSize', 'Batch size', 1, 256)}{numberField('weightDecay', 'Weight decay', 0, 1, .0001)}{numberField('dropout', 'Hidden dropout probability', 0, .89, .05)}{numberField('gradientClip', 'Gradient L2 clip', .01, 1000, .1)}<Field label="Learning-rate schedule"><Select label="Learning-rate schedule" value={draft.schedule ?? 'constant'} onChange={schedule => setDraft(current => ({ ...current, schedule: schedule as RunConfig['schedule'] }))} options={[{ value: 'constant', label: 'Constant' }, { value: 'cosine', label: 'Cosine decay' }, { value: 'warmup-cosine', label: 'Warmup + cosine decay' }]} /></Field>{draft.schedule === 'warmup-cosine' && numberField('warmupSteps', 'Warmup steps', 0, draft.maxSteps)}</div><Callout>Optimizer options apply to trainable neural models. PCA, k-means, and tabular Q-learning follow their own solver updates; inspect the demo protocol rather than assuming a neural optimizer.</Callout></>}
      {stage === 3 && <>{numberField('captureEvery', 'Capture every N optimizer steps', 1, 10000, 1, 'Smaller intervals improve temporal resolution and increase evaluation overhead.')}<div className="capture-budget-card"><Radio size={27} /><h3>Bounded inspection by default</h3><p>Metrics and example captures are bounded by the browser engine. Full model parameters can be saved through checkpoints; 3D edge rendering uses a separate visual budget.</p><KeyValue label="Requested captures" value={Math.ceil(draft.maxSteps / draft.captureEvery) + 1} /><KeyValue label="Captured components" value="Weights, activations, gradients, examples" /><KeyValue label="Uncaptured state" value="No invented or inferred tensors" /></div></>}
      {stage === 4 && <><div className="wizard-resource-card"><Cpu size={36} /><Badge tone="green" dot>Available now</Badge><h3>Local browser CPU</h3><p>Run this experiment in a bounded event-loop scheduler. Model optimization is real JavaScript computation and does not require a GPU, API key, or remote server.</p></div><KeyValue label="Model parameter estimate" value={supportsCustom ? parameters.toLocaleString() : 'Specialist architecture'} /><KeyValue label="Training budget" value={`${draft.maxSteps.toLocaleString()} updates`} /><KeyValue label="Batch budget" value={`${draft.batchSize} samples`} /><KeyValue label="Remote backend" value="Not required" /><Callout>For a model too large for this browser, create an instrumented run through Infrastructure. import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { FlaskConical, Trash2, Download, Play, GitCompareArrows, Clock3, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { LineChart, Line, ResponsiveContainer, CartesianGrid, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip } from 'recharts';
import { useStudio } from '../app/StudioContext';
import { DEMOS } from '../engine';
import { downloadText, type RunRecord } from '../app/storage';
import { Panel, PageHeader, Button, Badge, EmptyState, MetricsChart, KeyValue, Select, Callout, number, percentage } from '../components/ui';

export function Experiments() {
  const { history, clearHistory, selectDemo } = useStudio();
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [replayIndex, setReplayIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const selected = history.find(run => run.id === selectedId) ?? history[0];
  const replay = selected && replayIndex !== null ? selected.metrics[Math.min(replayIndex, selected.metrics.length - 1)] : undefined;
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="EXPERIMENT TRACKER" title="A record of your discoveries." description="Inspect real run histories, replay captured metrics, and reproduce a configuration." actions={<><Button disabled={!history.length} onClick={() => downloadText('neuralis-experiments.json', JSON.stringify(history, null, 2))}><Download size={14} />Export history</Button><Link to="/new-experiment" className="button button-primary"><FlaskConical size={14} />New experiment</Link></>} />
    {history.length ? <div className="experiments-layout"><Panel title="Local run history" subtitle={`${history.length} recorded runs · most recent first`} action={<Button variant="ghost" onClick={clearHistory} title="Clear local run history"><Trash2 size={14} /></Button>}><div className="experiment-list">{history.map(run => <button className={`experiment-item ${selected?.id === run.id ? 'selected' : ''}`} key={run.id} onClick={() => { setSelectedId(run.id); setReplayIndex(null); }}><span className="experiment-icon"><FlaskConical size={19} /></span><span><strong>{DEMOS.find(item => item.id === run.demoId)?.title ?? run.demoId}</strong><small>{new Date(run.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</small><span className="experiment-meta">{run.step.toLocaleString()} steps · seed {run.seed} · loss {number(run.loss, 4)}</span></span><Badge tone={run.state === 'completed' ? 'green' : run.state === 'failed' ? 'red' : 'neutral'}>{run.state}</Badge><ChevronRight size={13} /></button>)}</div></Panel>{selected && <div className="experiment-detail"><Panel title={DEMOS.find(item => item.id === selected.demoId)?.title ?? selected.demoId} subtitle={`Run ${selected.id}`} action={<Badge tone="violet">Seed {selected.seed}</Badge>}><div className="experiment-summary"><KeyValue label="Final loss" value={number(selected.loss, 6)} /><KeyValue label="Final task score" value={percentage(selected.accuracy)} /><KeyValue label="Optimizer steps" value={selected.step.toLocaleString()} /></div><MetricsChart metrics={selected.metrics} height={260} /><div className="panel-bottom"><Link to="/training" className="button button-primary" onClick={() => selectDemo(selected.demoId)}><Play size={14} />Open this demo</Link><Button onClick={() => downloadText(`run-${selected.id}.json`, JSON.stringify(selected, null, 2))}><Download size={14} />Export</Button></div></Panel><Panel title="Metric replay" subtitle="Scrub through the measurements recorded during this run" action={<Clock3 size={15} />}><div className="replay-controls"><input type="range" aria-label="Captured metric replay" min={0} max={Math.max(0, selected.metrics.length - 1)} value={replayIndex ?? selected.metrics.length - 1} onChange={event => setReplayIndex(Number(event.target.value))} /><span className="mono">Capture {(replayIndex ?? selected.metrics.length - 1) + 1} / {selected.metrics.length}</span></div><div className="replay-values"><KeyValue label="Step" value={replay?.step ?? selected.metrics.at(-1)?.step ?? 0} /><KeyValue label="Loss" value={number(replay?.loss ?? selected.loss, 6)} /><KeyValue label="Task score" value={percentage(replay?.accuracy ?? selected.accuracy)} /></div><Callout>This replay contains recorded metrics. Restore a saved checkpoint from the Training page to inspect model parameters at an earlier step.</Callout></Panel></div>}</div> : <Panel><EmptyState title="Your experiment history starts with a real run" description="Train a demo and complete or stop the run to archive its actual metrics here." icon={<FlaskConical size={34} />} action={<Link to="/training" className="button button-primary"><Play size={14} />Start an experiment</Link>} /></Panel>}
  </>;
}

export function CompareRuns() {
  const { history } = useStudio();
  const [leftId, setLeftId] = useState(history[0]?.id ?? '');
  const [rightId, setRightId] = useState(history[1]?.id ?? '');
  const [metric, setMetric] = useState('loss');
  const left = history.find(run => run.id === leftId);
  const right = history.find(run => run.id === rightId);
  const options = history.map(run => ({ value: run.id, label: `${DEMOS.find(item => item.id === run.demoId)?.title ?? run.demoId} · seed ${run.seed} · ${run.step} steps` }));
  const data = comparisonData(left, right, metric as 'loss' | 'accuracy');
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="RUN COMPARISON" title="What changed between experiments?" description="Compare recorded learning curves and final measurements from two runs." />
    {history.length < 2 ? <Panel><EmptyState title="Two runs unlock comparison" description="Complete two experiments, then return to compare their loss and task score." icon={<GitCompareArrows size={34} />} action={<Link to="/training" className="button button-primary">Train another model</Link>} /></Panel> : <>
      <div className="comparison-selectors"><Panel title="Run A" action={<span className="color-dot cyan" />}><Select label="First comparison run" value={leftId} onChange={setLeftId} options={options} /></Panel><Panel title="Run B" action={<span className="color-dot violet" />}><Select label="Second comparison run" value={rightId} onChange={setRightId} options={options} /></Panel></div>
      <Panel title="Learning curve comparison" subtitle="Measurements aligned by optimizer step" action={<Select label="Comparison metric" value={metric} onChange={setMetric} options={[{ value: 'loss', label: 'Training loss' }, { value: 'accuracy', label: 'Task score' }]} />}><div className="comparison-chart"><ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={330}><LineChart data={data} margin={{ left: -10, right: 25, top: 20 }}><CartesianGrid stroke="#223147" strokeDasharray="3 5" /><XAxis dataKey="step" tick={{ fill: '#8192ac', fontSize: 11 }} /><YAxis tick={{ fill: '#8192ac', fontSize: 11 }} /><Tooltip contentStyle={{ background: '#101c2d', border: '1px solid #2b3e56', borderRadius: 8 }} /><Line name="Run A" dataKey="left" connectNulls={false} stroke="#51c8ff" dot={false} strokeWidth={2} isAnimationActive={false} /><Line name="Run B" dataKey="right" connectNulls={false} stroke="#a68bff" dot={false} strokeWidth={2} isAnimationActive={false} /></LineChart></ResponsiveContainer></div><table className="data-table comparison-table"><thead><tr><th>Measurement</th><th>Run A</th><th>Run B</th><th>Difference (B − A)</th></tr></thead><tbody>{[{ label: 'Final loss', a: left?.loss, b: right?.loss }, { label: 'Task score', a: left?.accuracy, b: right?.accuracy }, { label: 'Optimizer steps', a: left?.step, b: right?.step }, { label: 'Seed', a: left?.seed, b: right?.seed }].map(row => <tr key={row.label}><td>{row.label}</td><td className="mono cyan-text">{row.a === undefined ? '—' : number(row.a, 4)}</td><td className="mono violet-text">{row.b === undefined ? '—' : number(row.b, 4)}</td><td className="mono">{row.a === undefined || row.b === undefined ? '—' : number(row.b - row.a, 4)}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></Panel>
      <Callout>Compare runs on the same task and evaluation protocol for a meaningful interpretation. A lower loss across different datasets does not by itself indicate a better model.</Callout>
    </>}
  </>;
}
function comparisonData(left: RunRecord | undefined, right: RunRecord | undefined, metric: 'loss' | 'accuracy') {
  const rows = new Map<number, { step: number; left?: number; right?: number }>();
  left?.metrics.forEach(point => rows.set(point.step, { ...rows.get(point.step), step: point.step, left: point[metric] }));
  right?.metrics.forEach(point => rows.set(point.step, { ...rows.get(point.step), step: point.step, right: point[metric] }));
  return Array.from(rows.values()).sort((a, b) => a.step - b.step);
}

BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/features/Inspectors.tsx

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Table2, ScanEye, Download, Search, Database, ArrowUpRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useStudio } from '../app/StudioContext';
import { TensorInspector, AttentionView } from '../visualization';
import { downloadText } from '../app/storage';
import { Panel, PageHeader, Badge, Button, EmptyState, Callout, Select, number, MetricCard } from '../components/ui';

export function Tensors() {
  const { snapshot } = useStudio();
  const values = snapshot.layers.flatMap(layer => layer.weights.flat());
  const mean = values.length ? values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length : 0;
  const variance = values.length ? values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + (value - mean) ** 2, 0) / values.length : 0;
  const sparsity = values.length ? values.filter(value => Math.abs(value) < 1e-8).length / values.length : 0;
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="TENSOR INSPECTOR" title="Every weight tells a story." description="Inspect captured matrices, activation distributions, and gradients at full precision." actions={<Button onClick={() => downloadText('neuralis-tensors.json', JSON.stringify(snapshot.layers, null, 2))}><Download size={15} />Export tensors</Button>} />
    <div className="metric-grid"><MetricCard label="Captured weights" value={values.length.toLocaleString()} detail="Across all captured matrices" color="cyan" /><MetricCard label="Mean weight" value={number(mean, 6)} detail="Arithmetic mean of captured weights" color="violet" /><MetricCard label="Standard deviation" value={number(Math.sqrt(variance), 6)} detail="Population standard deviation" color="green" /><MetricCard label="Near-zero sparsity" value={`${(sparsity * 100).toFixed(2)}%`} detail="Absolute value below 1e−8" color="amber" /></div>
    <Panel title="Model tensors" subtitle={`Step ${snapshot.step} · ${snapshot.layers.length} layers captured`} action={<Badge tone="cyan"><Table2 size={12} />Measured values</Badge>}><TensorInspector layers={snapshot.layers} /></Panel>
    <Callout>Tensor values are the captured state of your active model. Initial weights are visible before training; gradients become informative after optimizer steps. Export the exact values for further analysis.</Callout>
  </>;
}

function actualAttention(extras?: Record<string, unknown>): { matrix: number[][]; labels: string[] } | null {
  if (!extras) return null;
  const candidate = extras.attention ?? extras.attentionMatrix;
  if (!Array.isArray(candidate) || !candidate.every(row => Array.isArray(row) && row.every(item => typeof item === 'number' && Number.isFinite(item)))) return null;
  const labels = Array.isArray(extras.tokens) && extras.tokens.every(item => typeof item === 'string') ? extras.tokens as string[] : candidate.map((_, index) => `Token ${index}`);
  return { matrix: candidate as number[][], labels };
}
export function Attention() {
  const { snapshot } = useStudio();
  const attention = actualAttention(snapshot.extras);
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="ATTENTION ANALYSIS" title="Discover the relationships between tokens." description="Inspect attention computed by the active model, with no invented token connections." actions={attention && <Button onClick={() => downloadText('attention.json', JSON.stringify(attention, null, 2))}><Download size={14} />Export attention</Button>} />
    {attention ? <Panel title="Computed attention" subtitle="Query-to-key attention probabilities" action={<Badge tone="violet"><ScanEye size={12} />{attention.labels.length} tokens</Badge>}><AttentionView matrix={attention.matrix} labels={attention.labels} /></Panel> : <Panel><EmptyState title="This model has no captured attention matrix" description="Dense neural networks do not use token attention. Choose a language attention demo to inspect a real computed matrix." icon={<ScanEye size={32} />} action={<Link to="/demos" className="button button-primary">Explore language demos<ArrowUpRight size={14} /></Link>} /></Panel>}
    <Callout>Attention is an internal weighting mechanism, and attention scores alone do not establish a causal explanation. Use controlled interventions and paired outputs to test a hypothesis.</Callout>
  </>;
}

export function DataExplorer() {
  const { snapshot } = useStudio();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0);
  const [format, setFormat] = useState('decimal');
  const samples = useMemo(() => snapshot.samples.map((sample, index) => ({ ...sample, index })).filter(sample => `${sample.label ?? ''} ${sample.input.join(' ')} ${sample.target.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())), [snapshot.samples, query]);
  const active = snapshot.samples[selected];
  const display = (value: number) => format === 'scientific' ? value.toExponential(4) : number(value, 4);
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="DATA EXPLORER" title="Know what your model sees." description="Browse real captured examples, their targets, and the model’s predictions." actions={<Button onClick={() => downloadText('captured-samples.json', JSON.stringify(snapshot.samples, null, 2))}><Download size={14} />Export samples</Button>} />
    <div className="data-toolbar"><div className="library-search"><Search size={15} /><input value={query} aria-label="Search captured examples" placeholder="Search sample values or labels…" onChange={event => setQuery(event.target.value)} /></div><Badge tone="cyan">{samples.length} captured samples</Badge><Select label="Numeric display format" value={format} onChange={setFormat} options={[{ value: 'decimal', label: 'Decimal values' }, { value: 'scientific', label: 'Scientific notation' }]} /></div>
    <div className="data-layout"><Panel title="Captured examples" subtitle="A bounded view of the active dataset"><div className="sample-grid">{samples.map(sample => <button key={sample.index} className={`sample-card ${selected === sample.index ? 'selected' : ''}`} onClick={() => setSelected(sample.index)}><div className="sample-values">{sample.input.slice(0, 24).map((value, index) => <span key={index} style={{ background: `rgba(${value >= 0 ? '83, 195, 249' : '168, 126, 255'}, ${Math.min(1, Math.abs(value)) * .65 + .1})` }} title={String(value)} />)}</div><strong>{sample.label ?? `Sample ${sample.index + 1}`}</strong><small>{sample.input.length} features · {sample.target.length} targets</small></button>)}</div>{samples.length === 0 && <EmptyState title="No matching examples" description="Change your search or choose another demo." icon={<Database size={23} />} />}</Panel><Panel title="Selected example" subtitle={active?.label ?? `Sample ${selected + 1}`}>{active ? <div className="sample-detail"><span className="section-label">MODEL INPUT</span><div className="numeric-grid">{active.input.map((value, index) => <div key={index}><span>x{index}</span><code>{display(value)}</code></div>)}</div><span className="section-label">TARGET VS. PREDICTION</span><table className="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Output</th><th>Target</th><th>Prediction</th><th>Absolute error</th></tr></thead><tbody>{active.target.map((target, index) => <tr key={index}><td>{index}</td><td className="mono">{display(target)}</td><td className="mono cyan-text">{display(active.prediction[index] ?? 0)}</td><td className="mono">{display(Math.abs(target - (active.prediction[index] ?? 0)))}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div> : <EmptyState title="No sample selected" description="Select an example to inspect its values." />}</Panel></div>
    <Callout>These examples are captured from the engine, rather than a complete dataset browser. Generated demo data is reproducible from the run seed. Predictions update as training progresses.</Callout>
  </>;
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { FlaskConical, Play, RotateCcw, Download, ArrowRight, Target } from 'lucide-react';
import { useStudio } from '../app/StudioContext';
import type { InterventionResult, InterventionSpec } from '../types';
import NetworkScene from '../visualization/NetworkScene';
import { downloadText } from '../app/storage';
import { Panel, PageHeader, Select, Field, Button, Callout, KeyValue, Badge, number, EmptyState } from '../components/ui';

export function Interventions() {
  const { snapshot, engine, notify } = useStudio();
  const [layerIndex, setLayerIndex] = useState(1);
  const [neuron, setNeuron] = useState(0);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<InterventionSpec['kind']>('ablate');
  const [value, setValue] = useState(0);
  const [sampleIndex, setSampleIndex] = useState(0);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<InterventionResult | null>(null);
  const [customInput, setCustomInput] = useState('');
  const layers = snapshot.layers;
  const layer = layers[layerIndex];
  const sample = snapshot.samples[sampleIndex];
  useEffect(() => { setResult(null); setSampleIndex(0); setLayerIndex(Math.min(1, layers.length - 1)); }, [snapshot.demoId, layers.length]);
  const maxDelta = useMemo(() => result ? Math.max(...result.delta.map(Math.abs), 0.00001) : 1, [result]);
  const run = () => {
    try {
      const input = customInput.trim() ? customInput.split(',').map(text => Number(text.trim())) : sample?.input;
      if (!input || input.some(item => !Number.isFinite(item))) throw new Error('Supply a valid comma-separated numeric input or select a captured sample.');
      if (!layer || neuron < 0 || neuron >= layer.size) throw new Error('Select a neuron within the current layer.');
      setResult(engine.intervene(input, { layer: layerIndex, neuron, kind, value }));
      notify('Intervention evaluated against the same input and model weights.', 'success');
    } catch (error) { notify(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'This model does not support activation interventions.', 'error'); }
  };
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="CAUSAL EXPERIMENTS" title="Observe. Intervene. Understand." description="Change a single activation and measure how the prediction responds." actions={<Button disabled={!result} onClick={() => result && downloadText('intervention-result.json', JSON.stringify(result, null, 2))}><Download size={14} />Export result</Button>} />
    <div className="intervention-layout"><Panel title="Intervention setup" subtitle="Inference-only changes; model weights remain fixed"><div className="control-stack"><Field label="Intervention type"><Select label="Intervention type" value={kind} onChange={next => { setKind(next as InterventionSpec['kind']); setValue(next === 'ablate' ? 0 : 1); }} options={[{ value: 'ablate', label: 'Ablate · set activation to zero' }, { value: 'scale', label: 'Scale · multiply activation' }, { value: 'steer', label: 'Steer · add activation offset' }]} /></Field><Field label="Target layer"><Select label="Target layer" value={String(layerIndex)} onChange={next => { setLayerIndex(Number(next)); setNeuron(0); }} options={layers.map((item, index) => ({ value: String(index), label: `${index} · ${item.name} (${item.size} neurons)` }))} /></Field><Field label="Neuron index"><input type="number" min={0} max={(layer?.size ?? 1) - 1} step={1} value={neuron} onChange={event => setNeuron(Number(event.target.value))} /></Field>{kind !== 'ablate' && <Field label={kind === 'scale' ? 'Scale factor' : 'Activation offset'}><div className="range-with-value"><input type="range" min={-5} max={5} step={0.1} value={value} onChange={event => setValue(Number(event.target.value))} /><output>{value.toFixed(1)}</output></div></Field>}<Field label="Captured input"><Select label="Captured input" value={String(sampleIndex)} onChange={next => setSampleIndex(Number(next))} options={snapshot.samples.map((item, index) => ({ value: String(index), label: item.label ?? `Sample ${index + 1} · [${item.input.map(x => number(x, 2)).join(', ')}]` }))} /></Field><Field label="Or provide a custom input" hint="Comma-separated values matching the model input dimension"><input value={customInput} onChange={event => setCustomInput(event.target.value)} placeholder={sample?.input.join(', ') ?? '0, 1'} /></Field><Button variant="primary" onClick={run}><FlaskConical size={15} />Run intervention</Button><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => { setResult(null); setCustomInput(''); }}><RotateCcw size={14} />Reset experiment</Button></div></Panel><div className="intervention-main"><Panel title="Target circuit" subtitle="Select a neuron directly from the model view" action={<Badge tone="violet">Layer {layerIndex} · Neuron {neuron}</Badge>}><NetworkScene layers={layers} height={280} selected={{ layer: layerIndex, neuron }} onSelect={(l, n) => { setLayerIndex(l); setNeuron(n); }} mode="activations" /></Panel><Panel title="Prediction response" subtitle="A paired evaluation with a controlled activation change" action={result ? <Badge tone="green" dot>Measured</Badge> : undefined}>{result ? <div className="intervention-results"><div className="intervention-input"><Target size={15} /><span>Input</span><code>[{result.input.map(x => number(x, 3)).join(', ')}]</code></div><div className="prediction-comparison"><div><span className="section-label">BASELINE</span>{result.before.map((item, index) => <div className="prediction-value" key={index}><span>Output {index}</span><strong>{number(item, 6)}</strong></div>)}</div><ArrowRight size={24} /><div><span className="section-label">AFTER INTERVENTION</span>{result.after.map((item, index) => <div className="prediction-value" key={index}><span>Output {index}</span><strong className="violet-text">{number(item, 6)}</strong></div>)}</div></div><div className="delta-chart">{result.delta.map((item, index) => <div className="delta-row" key={index}><span>Δ output {index}</span><div><span style={{ width: `${Math.abs(item) / maxDelta * 100}%`, background: item >= 0 ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--rose)' }} /></div><code>{item > 0 ? '+' : ''}{number(item, 6)}</code></div>)}</div>{result.klDivergence !== undefined && <KeyValue label="KL divergence" value={number(result.klDivergence, 6)} mono />}</div> : <EmptyState title="What happens if this neuron changes?" description="Choose a captured input, set an intervention, and run a paired prediction to find out." icon={<FlaskConical size={24} />} action={<Button onClick={run}><Play size={13} />Evaluate hypothesis</Button>} />}</Panel></div></div>
    <Callout>Single-neuron changes measure sensitivity for this input. They do not establish a universal semantic role or prove an entire causal explanation. Interventions are evaluated through the active engine’s supported forward pass.</Callout>
  </>;
}

'var(--green)' : 'var(--violet)' }} /><strong>{layer.name}</strong><small>{layer.size} neurons</small></button>)}</div><div className="panel-bottom"><div className="network-legend"><span><i className="cyan" />Negative</span><span><i className="violet" />Neutral</span><span><i className="green" />Positive</span></div><RunControls compact /></div></Panel><Callout>The scene renders captured values from the active browser engine. BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/features/Readiness.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertCircle, Cpu, Play, Clock3, ShieldCheck, Download, Activity, Monitor } from 'lucide-react';
import { createEngine } from '../engine';
import type { RunSnapshot } from '../types';
import { useStudio } from '../app/StudioContext';
import { downloadText } from '../app/storage';
import { Panel, PageHeader, Button, Badge, KeyValue, Callout, Progress, number } from '../components/ui';

interface ReadinessCheck {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  supported: boolean;
  required: boolean;
  detail: string;
}
interface BenchmarkResult {
  startedAt: string;
  durationMs: number;
  steps: number;
  stepsPerSecond: number;
  finalLoss: number;
  finalScore: number;
  seed: number;
  device: string;
}
function probe(): ReadinessCheck[] {
  let storage = false;
  try { const key = 'neuralis.readiness'; localStorage.setItem(key, 'probe'); storage = localStorage.getItem(key) === 'probe'; localStorage.removeItem(key); } catch { /* Optional persistence may be unavailable. */ }
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  let webgl = false;
  try {
    const context = canvas.getContext('webgl2') || canvas.getContext('webgl');
    webgl = Boolean(context);
    context?.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context')?.loseContext();
  } catch { /* Renderer can use its fallback. */ }
  return [
    { id: 'js', label: 'Local numerical engine', supported: typeof Float64Array !== 'undefined', required: true, detail: 'Typed arrays are available for model parameters and numerical operations.' },
    { id: 'timing', label: 'High-resolution timing', supported: typeof performance?.now === 'function', required: true, detail: 'Used to bound optimizer scheduling and measure actual elapsed work.' },
    { id: 'storage', label: 'Local artifact storage', supported: storage, required: false, detail: storage ? 'Browser localStorage accepted a write/read/delete probe.' : 'Persistence is blocked. Use downloadable checkpoints.' },
    { id: 'webgl', label: 'WebGL scene acceleration', supported: webgl, required: false, detail: webgl ? 'A WebGL context was created successfully.' : 'WebGL is unavailable; scene rendering may use a fallback.' },
    { id: 'download', label: 'Artifact download', supported: typeof Blob !== 'undefined' && typeof URL.createObjectURL === 'function', required: true, detail: 'Browser file downloads can export model JSON and captured data.' },
    { id: 'uuid', label: 'Secure identifier generation', supported: Boolean(crypto?.randomUUID), required: false, detail: 'Secure-context UUID support is used for local artifact identifiers.' },
    { id: 'clipboard', label: 'Clipboard access', supported: Boolean(navigator.clipboard), required: false, detail: 'Availability does not guarantee permission. File export is always preferred for durable data.' },
  ];
}
export function Readiness() {
  const { notify } = useStudio();
  const [checks, setChecks] = useState<ReadinessCheck[]>([]);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<BenchmarkResult | null>(null);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => { setChecks(probe()); }, []);
  const benchmark = async () => {
    setRunning(true); setProgress(0); setResult(null);
    let engine: ReturnType<typeof createEngine> | null = null;
    try {
      engine = createEngine({ demoId: 'xor', learningRate: .03, maxSteps: 100, batchSize: 16, seed: 42, captureEvery: 10 }, () => {});
      const start = performance.now();
      let snapshot: RunSnapshot = engine.getSnapshot();
      for (let batch = 0; batch < 10; batch++) {
        for (let index = 0; index < 10; index++) engine.step();
        snapshot = engine.getSnapshot();
        setProgress(snapshot.step);
        await new Promise<void>(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve()));
      }
      const durationMs = performance.now() - start;
      setResult({ startedAt: new Date().toISOString(), durationMs, steps: snapshot.step, stepsPerSecond: snapshot.step / Math.max(durationMs / 1000, 1e-9), finalLoss: snapshot.loss, finalScore: snapshot.accuracy, seed: 42, device: snapshot.device });
      notify('Bounded XOR benchmark completed using real model updates.', 'success');
    } catch (error) { notify(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Benchmark failed.', 'error'); }
    finally { engine?.dispose(); setRunning(false); }
  };
  const allRequired = checks.filter(check => check.required).every(check => check.supported);
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="ENVIRONMENT READINESS" title="Know the limits of your workspace." description="Runtime capability checks and a bounded benchmark with measured results." actions={<Button onClick={() => setChecks(probe())}><Activity size={14} />Run checks again</Button>} />
    <div className="readiness-banner"><ShieldCheck size={29} /><div><h2>{allRequired ? 'Core browser capabilities are available.' : 'A required browser capability is missing.'}</h2><p>Optional capabilities can improve your workflow; availability is checked on this device.</p></div><Badge tone={allRequired ? 'green' : 'red'}>{allRequired ? 'Core ready' : 'Review required'}</Badge></div>
    <div className="readiness-layout"><Panel title="Capability report" subtitle="Actual feature detection and a storage round trip"><div className="readiness-checks">{checks.map(check => <div className="readiness-check" key={check.id}><span className={check.supported ? 'check-pass' : check.required ? 'check-fail' : 'check-optional'}>{check.supported ? <CheckCircle2 size={19} /> : check.required ? <XCircle size={19} /> : <AlertCircle size={19} />}</span><div><strong>{check.label}</strong><p>{check.detail}</p></div><Badge tone={check.supported ? 'green' : check.required ? 'red' : 'amber'}>{check.supported ? 'Available' : 'Unavailable'}</Badge></div>)}</div></Panel><div className="readiness-detail"><Panel title="Bounded numerical benchmark" action={<Cpu size={17} />}><div className="control-stack"><div className="benchmark-icon"><Clock3 size={28} /></div><p className="muted">Run 100 actual XOR optimizer steps in an isolated model. This does not change your active experiment or save a run to history.</p><KeyValue label="Model" value="2 → 8 → 8 → 1" /><KeyValue label="Seed" value="42" /><KeyValue label="Batch size" value="16" /><KeyValue label="Step budget" value="100" /><Button variant="primary" disabled={running} onClick={() => void benchmark()}><Play size={14} />{running ? 'Benchmarking…' : 'Run benchmark'}</Button>{running && <Progress value={progress} />}{result && <div className="benchmark-result"><Badge tone="green" dot>Measured</Badge><KeyValue label="Elapsed wall time" value={`${number(result.durationMs, 1)} ms`} /><KeyValue label="Throughput" value={`${number(result.stepsPerSecond, 1)} steps/s`} /><KeyValue label="Final loss" value={number(result.finalLoss, 6)} /><KeyValue label="Final task score" value={`${(result.finalScore * 100).toFixed(1)}%`} /><Button onClick={() => downloadText('neuralis-browser-benchmark.json', JSON.stringify({ benchmark: result, checks, userAgent: navigator.userAgent, hardwareConcurrency: navigator.hardwareConcurrency }, null, 2))}><Download size={14} />Export measured report</Button></div>}</div></Panel><Panel title="Device observations" action={<Monitor size={17} />}><div className="info-stack"><KeyValue label="Reported logical processors" value={navigator.hardwareConcurrency ?? 'Unavailable'} /><KeyValue label="Viewport" value={`${window.innerWidth} × ${window.innerHeight}`} /><KeyValue label="Device pixel ratio" value={window.devicePixelRatio} /><KeyValue label="Online hint" value={navigator.onLine ? 'Online' : 'Offline'} /></div></Panel></div></div>
    <Callout>Benchmark throughput includes UI scheduling and snapshot evaluation overhead. It is useful for this small model and browser session, rather than a GPU benchmark or a prediction of large-model performance.</Callout>
  </>;
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Layers, Orbit, Workflow, GitBranch, Table2, Download } from 'lucide-react';
import { useStudio } from '../app/StudioContext';
import { ArchitectureEditor, sequentialArchitecture, EmbeddingView, CircuitView, TensorSliceInspector, denseTensor } from '../visualization';
import { Panel, PageHeader, Select, Badge, Button, Callout, EmptyState } from '../components/ui';
import { downloadText } from '../app/storage';

export function RepresentationExplorer() {
  const { snapshot } = useStudio();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'architecture' | 'projection' | 'circuits' | 'slices'>('architecture');
  const [vectorSource, setVectorSource] = useState('input');
  const [layerIndex, setLayerIndex] = useState('1');
  const graph = useMemo(() => sequentialArchitecture(snapshot.layers.map(layer => layer.size), snapshot.layers.map(layer => layer.name)), [snapshot.layers]);
  const vectors = snapshot.samples.map(sample => vectorSource === 'prediction' ? sample.prediction : vectorSource === 'target' ? sample.target : sample.input);
  const labels = snapshot.samples.map((sample, index) => sample.label ?? `Sample ${index + 1}`);
  const groups = snapshot.samples.map(sample => sample.target.length > 1 ? `Target ${sample.target.indexOf(Math.max(...sample.target))}` : sample.target[0] > .5 ? 'Target > 0.5' : 'Target ≤ 0.5');
  const layer = snapshot.layers[Number(layerIndex)] ?? snapshot.layers[0];
  const tensor = useMemo(() => {
    if (!layer?.weights.length || !layer.weights[0]?.length) return null;
    return denseTensor(layer.weights.flat(), [layer.weights.length, layer.weights[0].length]);
  }, [layer]);
  return <>
    <PageHeader eyebrow="REPRESENTATION EXPLORER" title="Explore the structure behind the prediction." description="Architecture diagrams, sample projections, captured circuits, and exact tensor slices." actions={<Button onClick={() => downloadText('representation-capture.json', JSON.stringify({ layers: snapshot.layers, samples: snapshot.samples }, null, 2))}><Download size={14} />Export capture</Button>} />
    <Panel title="Research views" action={<Badge tone="violet">Step {snapshot.step}</Badge>}><div className="tabs representation-tabs">{[{ id: 'architecture', title: 'Architecture', icon: Workflow }, { id: 'projection', title: 'Sample projection', icon: Orbit }, { id: 'circuits', title: 'Weight circuits', icon: GitBranch }, { id: 'slices', title: 'Tensor slices', icon: Table2 }].map(item => <button key={item.id} className={tab === item.id ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => setTab(item.id as typeof tab)}><item.icon size={13} />{item.title}</button>)}</div>
      {tab === 'architecture' && <><ArchitectureEditor key={snapshot.demoId} graph={graph} readOnly /><div className="representation-note"><Layers size={14} /><p>This diagram describes the captured sequential layer widths. Use New experiment to change supported trainable dense architectures; specialist captured structures are inspected rather than compiled from this diagram.</p></div></>}
      {tab === 'projection' && <><div className="representation-toolbar"><Select label="Projection vector source" value={vectorSource} onChange={setVectorSource} options={[{ value: 'input', label: 'Captured input vectors' }, { value: 'prediction', label: 'Captured prediction vectors' }, { value: 'target', label: 'Captured target vectors' }]} /><span className="muted">{vectors.length} captured vectors · centered PCA</span></div><EmbeddingView vectors={vectors} labels={labels} groups={groups} title={`PCA of captured ${vectorSource} vectors`} /><div className="representation-note"><Orbit size={14} /><p>These are captured {vectorSource} vectors, projected by actual centered PCA. They are not inferred hidden embeddings. Capturing per-example hidden states requires explicit model instrumentation.</p></div></>}
      {tab === 'circuits' && <><CircuitView layers={snapshot.layers} maxEdges={400} /><div className="representation-note"><GitBranch size={14} /><p>This circuit view ranks captured connections by weight magnitude. Weight magnitude measures a parameter, rather than causal feature importance or integrated gradients.</p></div></>}
      {tab === 'slices' && <><div className="representation-toolbar"><Select label="Slice layer" value={layerIndex} onChange={setLayerIndex} options={snapshot.layers.map((item, index) => ({ value: String(index), label: `${item.name} · ${item.weights.length} × ${item.weights[0]?.length ?? 0}` }))} /></div>{tensor ? <TensorSliceInspector key={layer.id} tensor={tensor} axisNames={['Output neuron', 'Input neuron']} title={`${layer.name} weight matrix`} /> : <EmptyState title="No matrix captured for this layer" description="Choose a layer that contains a weight matrix." icon={<Table2 size={27} />} />}</>}
    </Panel>
    <Callout>Each research view states exactly what data it uses and how it is transformed. Interpretability claims should be tested against paired predictions and held-out examples.</Callout>
  </>;
}

export function Settings() {
  const { settings, updateSettings, config, setConfig, history, checkpoints, importCheckpoint, notify } = useStudio();

BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/integrations/BackendWorkbench.tsx

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, Cloud, Download, FlaskConical, LoaderCircle, Pause, Play, RefreshCw, Square, Unplug, Wifi, XCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { CartesianGrid, Line, LineChart, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from 'recharts';
import { BackendClient, BackendError, type BackendCapabilities, type BackendCommand, type BackendConnection, type BackendEvent, type BackendModel, type BackendRun } from './backendClient';
import './remote.css';

interface Props {
  initialUrl?: string;
  onUrlChange?: (url: string) => void;
}
interface Metric { step: number; loss: number; accuracy?: number; }

function identifier(run: BackendRun): string {
  return String(run.run_id || run.id || '');
}
function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value as Record<string, unknown> : {};
}
function metricsFrom(value: unknown): Metric[] {
  const data = Array.isArray(value) ? value : asRecord(value).metrics;
  if (!Array.isArray(data)) return [];
  return data.map(item => {
    const metric = asRecord(item);
    return { step: Number(metric.step), loss: Number(metric.loss ?? metric.train_loss), accuracy: Number(metric.accuracy ?? metric.validation_accuracy) };
  }).filter(item => Number.isFinite(item.step) && Number.isFinite(item.loss));
}
function printable(value: unknown): string {
  return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) ?? 'No response';
}
function saveJson(name: string, content: string): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([content], { type: 'application/json' }));
  const anchor = document.createElement('a');
  anchor.href = url;
  anchor.download = name;
  anchor.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

export { BackendWorkbench };

export default function BackendWorkbench({ initialUrl = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000', onUrlChange }: Props) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState(initialUrl);
  const [sessionToken, setSessionToken] = useState('');
  const [connection, setConnection] = useState<BackendConnection | null>(null);
  const [capabilities, setCapabilities] = useState<BackendCapabilities | null>(null);
  const [models, setModels] = useState<BackendModel[]>([]);
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<BackendRun[]>([]);
  const [modelId, setModelId] = useState('mlp-xor');
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState(300);
  const [learningRate, setLearningRate] = useState(0.02);
  const [seed, setSeed] = useState(42);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<BackendRun | null>(null);
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<Metric[]>([]);
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<BackendEvent[]>([]);
  const [streamState, setStreamState] = useState('disconnected');
  const [captureGaps, setCaptureGaps] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [response, setResponse] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [responseTitle, setResponseTitle] = useState('Server response');
  const [module, setModule] = useState('hidden');
  const [strength, setStrength] = useState(0);
  const client = useRef<BackendClient | null>(null);
  const closeStream = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const active = useRef<string>('');
  const mounted = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    mounted.current = false;
    closeStream.current?.();
    client.current?.dispose();
  }, []);

  const perform = useCallback(async <T,>(name: string, action: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T | undefined> => {
    setBusy(name);
    setError(null);
    try {
      return await action();
    } catch (failure) {
      if (mounted.current) {
        const message = failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'The operation failed.';
        const hint = failure instanceof BackendError && failure.action ? ` ${failure.action}` : '';
        setError(`${message}${hint}`);
      }
      return undefined;
    } finally {
      if (mounted.current) setBusy(null);
    }
  }, []);

  const connect = async () => {
    await perform('connect', async () => {
      closeStream.current?.();
      client.current?.dispose();
      const next = new BackendClient(url, sessionToken || undefined);
      client.current = next;
      next.subscribe(value => { if (mounted.current) setConnection(value); });
      const found = await next.connect();
      setCapabilities(found);
      onUrlChange?.(next.baseUrl);
      const [available, previous] = await Promise.all([next.models(), next.runs()]);
      setModels(available);
      setRuns(previous);
      if (available.length) setModelId(available[0].id);
      return found;
    });
  };

  const disconnect = () => {
    closeStream.current?.();
    closeStream.current = null;
    client.current?.dispose();
    client.current = null;
    setCapabilities(null);
    setSelected(null);
    setMetrics([]);
    setEvents([]);
    setResponse(null);
    setStreamState('disconnected');
  };

  const selectRun = useCallback(async (run: BackendRun) => {
    const current = client.current;
    if (!current) return;
    const id = identifier(run);
    if (!id) return;
    closeStream.current?.();
    active.current = id;
    setSelected(run);
    setEvents([]);
    setMetrics([]);
    setCaptureGaps(0);
    closeStream.current = current.stream(id, event => {
      if (!mounted.current || active.current !== event.run_id) return;
      setEvents(previous => [event, ...previous].slice(0, 80));
      if (event.type === 'metrics') {
        const loss = Number(event.payload.loss ?? event.payload.train_loss);
        if (Number.isFinite(loss)) {
          const accuracy = Number(event.payload.accuracy ?? event.payload.validation_accuracy);
          setMetrics(previous => [...previous.filter(item => item.step !== event.step), { step: event.step, loss, accuracy }].slice(-2000));
        }
      }
      if (event.type === 'state') {
        setSelected(previous => previous ? { ...previous, state: String(event.payload.state || event.payload.status) as BackendRun['state'] } : previous);
      }
    }, {
      onState: setStreamState,
      onGap: (previous, next) => setCaptureGaps(count => count + next - previous - 1),
      onError: failure => { if (mounted.current) setError(failure.message); },
    });
    try {
      const existing = await current.metrics(id);
      if (mounted.current && active.current === id) setMetrics(metricsFrom(existing));
    } catch (failure) {
      if (mounted.current) setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Cannot load metrics.');
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selected || !client.current) return;
    const id = identifier(selected);
    let inFlight = false;
    const timer = setInterval(async () => {
      if (inFlight || !client.current) return;
      inFlight = true;
      try {
        const value = await client.current.run(id);
        if (mounted.current && active.current === id) setSelected(value);
      } catch {
        // A WebSocket disconnection is displayed independently. Polling failures
        // do not fabricate a new run state or reset the existing evidence.
      } finally {
        inFlight = false;
      }
    }, 1500);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [selected?.id, selected?.run_id]);

  const create = async () => {
    const current = client.current;
    if (!current) return;
    const run = await perform('create', () => current.createRun({
      model_id: modelId,
      name: `${modelId} · browser session`,
      seed, steps, batch_size: 32, learning_rate: learningRate,
      capture_every: 5, device: 'cpu', step_delay_ms: 5,
    }));
    if (run) {
      setRuns(previous => [run, ...previous]);
      await selectRun(run);
    }
  };

  const command = async (value: BackendCommand) => {
    if (!client.current || !selected) return;
    const current = client.current;
    const id = identifier(selected);
    await perform(value, async () => {
      const result = await current.command(id, value);
      const run = await current.run(id);
      setSelected(run);
      if (value === 'checkpoint') {
        setResponseTitle('Checkpoint acknowledgment');
        setResponse(result);
      }
      return result;
    });
  };

  const inspect = async (kind: 'inference' | 'tensors' | 'attribution' | 'export') => {
    if (!client.current || !selected) return;
    const current = client.current;
    const id = identifier(selected);
    await perform(kind, async () => {
      if (kind === 'export') {
        const result = await current.exportRun(id);
        saveJson(`neuralis-backend-${id}.json`, result);
        return result;
      }
      const result = kind === 'inference' ? await current.inference(id) :
        kind === 'tensors' ? await current.tensors(id) : await current.attribution(id, 'integrated-gradients', 16);
      setResponseTitle(kind === 'inference' ? 'Actual inference result' : kind === 'tensors' ? 'Captured tensors' : 'Integrated gradients result');
      setResponse(result);
      return result;
    });
  };

  const intervene = async () => {
    if (!client.current || !selected) return;
    const current = client.current;
    await perform('intervention', async () => {
      const result = await current.experiment({
        run_id: identifier(selected),
        input: { sample_indices: [0, 1, 2, 3], split: 'validation' },
        interventions: [{ module, operation: 'scale', strength }],
      });
      setResponseTitle('Baseline versus scaled activation');
      setResponse(result);
      return result;
    });
  };

  const connected = connection?.state === 'connected' && capabilities !== null;
  const state = selected?.state || selected?.status || 'created';
  const latest = metrics[metrics.length - 1];
  return <section className="remote-workbench" aria-label="Python research backend">
    <header className="remote-header">
      <div className="remote-icon"><Cloud size={22}/></div>
      <div><h2>Python research runtime</h2><p>Real PyTorch jobs, captured tensors and reproducible interventions.</p></div>
      <span className={`remote-status ${connected ? 'is-connected' : ''}`}>
        {connected ? <CheckCircle2 size={14}/> : <Unplug size={14}/>}
        {connection?.state || 'disconnected'}
      </span>
    </header>
    <form className="remote-connection" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); void connect(); }}>
      <label>Backend URL<input aria-label="Backend URL" value={url} onChange={event => setUrl(event.target.value)} placeholder="http://127.0.0.1:8000"/></label>
      <label>Session token (optional)<input aria-label="Backend session token" type="password" autoComplete="off" value={sessionToken} onChange={event => setSessionToken(event.target.value)} placeholder="Kept in memory only"/></label>
      <button type="submit" disabled={busy !== null}>{busy === 'connect' ? <LoaderCircle size={16} className="spin"/> : <Wifi size={16}/>}Connect</button>
      {connected && <button type="button" onClick={disconnect}><Unplug size={16}/>Disconnect</button>}
    </form>
    {error && <div className="remote-error" role="alert"><XCircle size={18}/><span>{error}</span><button onClick={() => setError(null)} aria-label="Dismiss backend error">×</button></div>}
    {!connected && <div className="remote-empty"><Cloud size={32}/><h3>Connect when you need more compute</h3><p>The demo library already trains in your browser. This panel connects to an actual local or remote Python runtime; no server or GPU is simulated.</p><code>uv run --project services/api python -m neuralis</code><p>For a hosted workbench, add its origin to the backend CORS configuration. Remote production access requires HTTPS and an authenticated server.</p></div>}
    {connected && <>
      <div className="remote-evidence"><span>HTTP handshake: <strong>{connection?.latencyMs} ms</strong></span><span>Protocol: <strong>{capabilities.protocol_version || 'reported below'}</strong></span><span>Source: <strong>server-reported capabilities</strong></span></div>
      <details className="remote-details"><summary>Inspect capabilities and limits</summary><pre>{printable(capabilities)}</pre></details>
      <div className="remote-grid">
        <div className="remote-card"><h3>Create a CPU experiment</h3>
          <label>Model<select aria-label="Backend model" value={modelId} onChange={event => setModelId(event.target.value)}>{models.map(model => <option key={model.id} value={model.id}>{model.name || model.title || model.id}</option>)}</select></label>
          <div className="remote-fields"><label>Steps<input type="number" min={1} max={100000} value={steps} onChange={event => setSteps(Number(event.target.value))}/></label><label>Seed<input type="number" min={0} value={seed} onChange={event => setSeed(Number(event.target.value))}/></label></div>
          <label>Learning rate<input type="number" step={0.001} min={0.00001} max={1} value={learningRate} onChange={event => setLearningRate(Number(event.target.value))}/></label>
          <button disabled={busy !== null || !models.length} onClick={() => void create()}><FlaskConical size={16}/>Create experiment</button>
        </div>
        <div className="remote-card"><div className="remote-title"><h3>Server runs</h3><button disabled={busy !== null} aria-label="Refresh server runs" onClick={() => void perform('refresh', async () => { const value = await client.current!.runs(); setRuns(value); })}><RefreshCw size={15}/></button></div>
          <div className="remote-run-list">{runs.length === 0 ? <p>No server runs yet.</p> : runs.map(run => <button key={identifier(run)} className={selected && identifier(selected) === identifier(run) ? 'selected' : ''} onClick={() => void selectRun(run)}><span>{run.config?.name || String(run.name || identifier(run).slice(0, 12))}</span><small>{run.state || run.status || 'created'}</small></button>)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {selected && <div className="remote-card remote-active">
        <div className="remote-title"><div><h3>{selected.config?.name || 'Selected server experiment'}</h3><small>{identifier(selected)}</small></div><span className="remote-status">{state}</span></div>
        <div className="remote-evidence"><span>Step: <strong>{Number(selected.step || latest?.step || 0).toLocaleString()}</strong></span><span>Loss: <strong>{latest ? latest.loss.toFixed(5) : 'not captured'}</strong></span><span>Telemetry: <strong>{streamState}</strong></span><span>Missing sequences: <strong>{captureGaps}</strong></span></div>
        <div className="remote-actions">
          <button disabled={busy !== null || state !== 'created'} onClick={() => void command('start')}><Play size={15}/>Start</button>
          <button disabled={busy !== null || state !== 'running'} onClick={() => void command('pause')}><Pause size={15}/>Pause</button>
          <button disabled={busy !== null || state !== 'paused'} onClick={() => void command('resume')}><Play size={15}/>Resume</button>
          <button disabled={busy !== null || !['created', 'paused'].includes(state)} onClick={() => void command('step')}>One step</button>
          <button disabled={busy !== null || ['completed', 'stopped', 'failed'].includes(state)} onClick={() => void command('stop')}><Square size={15}/>Stop</button>
          <button disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void command('checkpoint')}>Checkpoint</button>
        </div>
        <div className="remote-chart" aria-label="Actual backend loss history">{metrics.length > 1 ? <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={200}><LineChart data={metrics}><CartesianGrid stroke="#1b2b40" strokeDasharray="3 3"/><XAxis dataKey="step" stroke="#8494a9"/><YAxis stroke="#8494a9"/><Tooltip contentStyle={{ background: '#0d1727', border: '1px solid #223550' }}/><Line type="monotone" dataKey="loss" dot={false} stroke="#43d9e3" strokeWidth={2} isAnimationActive={false}/></LineChart></ResponsiveContainer> : <p>Loss curves appear after actual training steps are captured.</p>}</div>
        <div className="remote-actions"><button disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void inspect('inference')}>Run inference</button><button disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void inspect('tensors')}>Inspect tensors</button><button disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void inspect('attribution')}>Integrated gradients</button><button disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void inspect('export')}><Download size={15}/>Export run</button></div>
        <details className="remote-details"><summary>Controlled activation intervention</summary><p>Run a baseline and a scaled-activation comparison on an isolated inference copy. A score change is evidence about this experiment, not a complete explanation of the model.</p><div className="remote-fields"><label>Module<input value={module} onChange={event => setModule(event.target.value)}/></label><label>Scale<input type="number" min={-100} max={100} step={0.1} value={strength} onChange={event => setStrength(Number(event.target.value))}/></label></div><button disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void intervene()}>Compare against baseline</button></details>
      </div>}
      {response !== null && <div className="remote-card"><div className="remote-title"><h3>{responseTitle}</h3><button onClick={() => saveJson('neuralis-server-result.json', printable(response))}><Download size={15}/>Save JSON</button></div><pre className="remote-result">{printable(response)}</pre></div>}
      {events.length > 0 && <div className="remote-card"><h3>Measured event stream</h3><div className="remote-event-list">{events.slice(0, 20).map(event => <div key={event.sequence}><code>#{event.sequence}</code><span>{event.type}</span><span>step {event.step}</span><small>rank {event.rank ?? 0}</small></div>)}</div></div>}
    </>}
  </section>;
}

import { describe, expect, it, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { BackendClient, BackendError, decodeEvent, validateBackendUrl } from './backendClient';

afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

describe('remote backend contracts', () => {
  it('normalizes API roots without accepting embedded credentials', () => {
    expect(validateBackendUrl('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/')).toBe('http://127.0.0.1:8000');
    expect(() => validateBackendUrl('https://user:secret@example.com')).toThrow(BackendError);
    expect(() => validateBackendUrl('file:///tmp/backend')).toThrow(BackendError);
    expect(() => validateBackendUrl('https://example.com?token=x')).toThrow(BackendError);
  });
  it('rejects malformed, negative and future-protocol telemetry', () => {
    const event = { protocol_version: '1.0', run_id: 'run-1', sequence: 1, timestamp: 1, step: 2, type: 'metrics', payload: { loss: 0.3 } };
    expect(decodeEvent(event).payload.loss).toBe(0.3);
    expect(() => decodeEvent({ ...event, sequence: -1 })).toThrow();
    expect(() => decodeEvent({ ...event, protocol_version: '2.0' })).toThrow();
    expect(() => decodeEvent({ ...event, payload: [] })).toThrow();
  });
  it('reports real capabilities and latency after a successful handshake', async () => {
    const fetch = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(new Response(JSON.stringify({ protocol_version: '1.0', device: 'cpu' }), { status: 200 }));
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetch);
    const client = new BackendClient('http://localhost:8000');
    const capabilities = await client.connect();
    expect(capabilities.device).toBe('cpu');
    expect(client.getConnection().state).toBe('connected');
    expect(fetch.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe('http://localhost:8000/api/v1/capabilities');
    client.dispose();
    expect(client.getConnection().state).toBe('disconnected');
  });
  it('does not advertise a successful connection when the server refuses access', async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(new Response(JSON.stringify({ detail: { category: 'authorization', message: 'No project access', action: 'Request project access' } }), { status: 403 })));
    const client = new BackendClient('https://lab.example');
    await expect(client.connect()).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 403, category: 'authorization' });
    expect(client.getConnection().state).toBe('failed');
    expect(client.getConnection().capabilities).toBeNull();
  });
  it('uses command identifiers and keeps credentials out of request paths', async () => {
    const fetch = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(new Response('{}', { status: 200 }));
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetch);
    const client = new BackendClient('https://lab.example', 'session-token');
    await client.command('a/b', 'pause');
    const [url, options] = fetch.mock.calls[0];
    expect(url).toBe('https://lab.example/api/v1/runs/a%2Fb/commands');
    const body = JSON.parse(options.body);
    expect(body.command).toBe('pause');
    expect(body.command_id.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
    expect(options.headers.Authorization).toBe('Bearer session-token');
    expect(url).not.toContain('session-token');
  });
});
