export type BackendConnectionState = 'disconnected' | 'connecting' | 'connected' | 'reconnecting' | 'failed';
export type BackendRunState = 'created' | 'running' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'stopped' | 'failed' | 'interrupted';
export type BackendCommand = 'start' | 'pause' | 'step' | 'resume' | 'stop' | 'checkpoint';

export interface BackendModel {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  parameters?: number;
  task?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}
export interface BackendRunConfig {
  model_id: string;
  name: string;
  seed: number;
  steps: number;
  batch_size: number;
  learning_rate: number;
  capture_every: number;
  device: 'cpu';
  step_delay_ms?: number;
}
export interface BackendRun {
  id?: string;
  run_id?: string;
  state?: BackendRunState;
  status?: BackendRunState;
  step?: number;
  config?: BackendRunConfig;
  metrics?: unknown;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}
export interface BackendEvent {
  protocol_version: string;
  run_id: string;
  sequence: number;
  timestamp: number;
  step: number;
  type: string;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
  rank?: number;
  world_size?: number;
}
export interface BackendCapabilities {
  protocol_version?: string;
  version?: string;
  models?: unknown;
  device?: string;
  devices?: unknown;
  capabilities?: Record<string, unknown> | string[];
  [key: string]: unknown;
}
export interface BackendConnection {
  state: BackendConnectionState;
  baseUrl: string;
  capabilities: BackendCapabilities | null;
  lastError: string | null;
  latencyMs: number | null;
  connectedAt: number | null;
}
export interface StreamOptions {
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  afterSequence?: number;
  maxReconnects?: number;
  onState?: (state: BackendConnectionState) => void;
  onGap?: (previous: number, next: number) => void;
  onError?: (error: BackendError) => void;
}

export class BackendError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly category: string;
  readonly action: string;
  constructor(message: string, status = 0, category = 'connection', action = '') {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'BackendError';
    this.status = status;
    this.category = category;
    this.action = action;
  }
}

const MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 15000;

export function validateBackendUrl(input: string): string {
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(input.trim());
  } catch {
    throw new BackendError('Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS backend URL.', 0, 'configuration');
  }
  if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol)) {
    throw new BackendError('The backend must use HTTP or HTTPS.', 0, 'configuration');
  }
  if (url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash) {
    throw new BackendError('Credentials, queries and fragments do not belong in the backend URL.', 0, 'configuration');
  }
  if (typeof location !== 'undefined' && location.protocol === 'https:' && url.protocol === 'http:' &&
      !['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '[::1]'].includes(url.hostname)) {
    throw new BackendError('An HTTPS workbench requires HTTPS for a remote backend.', 0, 'configuration');
  }
  return url.toString().replace(/\/+$/, '').replace(/\/api\/v1$/, '');
}

function isObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
}

export function decodeEvent(value: unknown): BackendEvent {
  if (!isObject(value)) throw new BackendError('The server sent a malformed event.', 0, 'protocol');
  const sequence = Number(value.sequence);
  const step = Number(value.step);
  const timestamp = Number(value.timestamp);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(sequence) || sequence < 0 || !Number.isSafeInteger(step) || step < 0 ||
      !Number.isFinite(timestamp) || typeof value.run_id !== 'string' || typeof value.type !== 'string' ||
      !isObject(value.payload)) {
    throw new BackendError('The server event violates the telemetry contract.', 0, 'protocol');
  }
  const protocol = typeof value.protocol_version === 'string' ? value.protocol_version : '1.0';
  if (protocol.split('.')[0] !== '1') {
    throw new BackendError(`Unsupported telemetry protocol ${protocol}.`, 0, 'protocol', 'Update the client and backend together.');
  }
  return {
    protocol_version: protocol,
    run_id: value.run_id,
    sequence,
    timestamp,
    step,
    type: value.type,
    payload: value.payload,
    rank: Number.isSafeInteger(value.rank) ? Number(value.rank) : 0,
    world_size: Number.isSafeInteger(value.world_size) ? Number(value.world_size) : 1,
  };
}

async function parseResponse(response: Response): Promise<unknown> {
  const length = Number(response.headers.get('content-length'));
  if (Number.isFinite(length) && length > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
    throw new BackendError('The backend response exceeds the capture budget.', response.status, 'budget');
  }
  const text = await response.text();
  if (text.length > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
    throw new BackendError('The backend response exceeds the capture budget.', response.status, 'budget');
  }
  if (!text) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    throw new BackendError('The backend returned an invalid JSON response.', response.status, 'protocol');
  }
}

function errorFromPayload(payload: unknown, status: number): BackendError {
  const object = isObject(payload) ? payload : {};
  const detail = isObject(object.detail) ? object.detail : object;
  const validation = Array.isArray(object.detail) ? object.detail : null;
  const message = typeof detail.message === 'string' ? detail.message :
    typeof object.detail === 'string' ? object.detail :
    validation ? `Invalid request: ${validation.map(item => isObject(item) ? String(item.msg || 'invalid field') : 'invalid field').join('; ')}` :
    `Backend request failed (${status}).`;
  return new BackendError(message, status,
    typeof detail.category === 'string' ? detail.category : 'request',
    typeof detail.action === 'string' ? detail.action : '');
}

export class BackendClient {
  readonly baseUrl: string;
  private token: string | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<(connection: BackendConnection) => void>();
  private connection: BackendConnection;
  private controllers = new Set<AbortController>();
  private streams = new Set<() => void>();
  private disposed = false;

  constructor(baseUrl: string, token?: string) {
    this.baseUrl = validateBackendUrl(baseUrl);
    this.token = token || null;
    this.connection = {
      state: 'disconnected', baseUrl: this.baseUrl, capabilities: null,
      lastError: null, latencyMs: null, connectedAt: null,
    };
  }

  setSessionToken(token: string | null): void {
    this.token = token || null;
  }

  getConnection(): BackendConnection {
    return { ...this.connection };
  }

  subscribe(listener: (connection: BackendConnection) => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    listener(this.getConnection());
    return () => { this.listeners.delete(listener); };
  }

  private publish(changes: Partial<BackendConnection>): void {
    this.connection = { ...this.connection, ...changes };
    this.listeners.forEach(listener => listener(this.getConnection()));
  }

  async connect(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<BackendCapabilities> {
    this.publish({ state: 'connecting', lastError: null });
    const start = performance.now();
    try {
      const capabilities = await this.request<BackendCapabilities>('GET', '/capabilities', undefined, signal);
      const protocol = capabilities.protocol_version;
      if (protocol && protocol.split('.')[0] !== '1') {
        throw new BackendError(`Backend protocol ${protocol} is not supported.`, 0, 'protocol');
      }
      this.publish({
        state: 'connected', capabilities, connectedAt: Date.now(),
        latencyMs: Math.round(performance.now() - start), lastError: null,
      });
      return capabilities;
    } catch (error) {
      const normalized = error instanceof BackendError ? error : new BackendError(String(error));
      this.publish({ state: 'failed', lastError: normalized.message, capabilities: null });
      throw normalized;
    }
  }

  async request<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal, timeout = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT): Promise<T> {
    if (this.disposed) throw new BackendError('The backend client has been disposed.', 0, 'lifecycle');
    if (!path.startsWith('/') || path.startsWith('//')) throw new BackendError('Invalid API path.', 0, 'configuration');
    const controller = new AbortController();
    this.controllers.add(controller);
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort('timeout'), timeout);
    const abort = () => controller.abort(signal?.reason);
    signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
    if (signal?.aborted) abort();
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/api/v1${path}`, {
        method,
        headers: {
          Accept: 'application/json',
          ...(body === undefined ? {} : { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
          ...(this.token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${this.token}` } : {}),
        },
        body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
        signal: controller.signal,
        credentials: 'omit',
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
      const payload = await parseResponse(response);
      if (!response.ok) throw errorFromPayload(payload, response.status);
      return payload as T;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof BackendError) throw error;
      if (controller.signal.aborted) {
        throw new BackendError(signal?.aborted ? 'Request cancelled.' : 'The backend did not respond before the timeout.', 0, 'timeout');
      }
      throw new BackendError('Cannot reach the backend. Check its URL, CORS settings and whether it is running.', 0, 'connection');
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
      this.controllers.delete(controller);
    }
  }

  async models(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<BackendModel[]> {
    const result = await this.request<BackendModel[] | { models: BackendModel[] }>('GET', '/models', undefined, signal);
    return Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.models;
  }

  async runs(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<BackendRun[]> {
    const result = await this.request<BackendRun[] | { runs: BackendRun[] }>('GET', '/runs', undefined, signal);
    return Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.runs;
  }

  createRun(config: BackendRunConfig, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<BackendRun> {
    return this.request('POST', '/runs', config, signal);
  }

  run(id: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<BackendRun> {
    return this.request('GET', `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, undefined, signal);
  }

  command(id: string, command: BackendCommand, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.request('POST', `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/commands`, {
      command, command_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    }, signal);
  }

  inference(id: string, sampleIndices: number[] = [0, 1, 2, 3], signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.request('POST', `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/inference`, {
      sample_indices: sampleIndices, split: 'validation',
    }, signal);
  }

  tensors(id: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.request('GET', `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/tensors`, undefined, signal);
  }

  metrics(id: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.request('GET', `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/metrics`, undefined, signal);
  }

  checkpoints(id: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.request('GET', `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/checkpoints`, undefined, signal);
  }

  experiment(body: {
    run_id: string;
    input: { sample_indices: number[]; split: string };
    interventions: { module: string; operation: 'ablate' | 'scale' | 'steer' | 'patch'; strength: number; indices?: number[] }[];
  }, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.request('POST', '/experiments', body, signal);
  }

  attribution(id: string, method: string, integrationSteps = 32, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.request('POST', `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/attribution`, {
      input: { sample_indices: [0], split: 'validation' },
      method, integration_steps: integrationSteps,
    }, signal, 60000);
  }

  async exportRun(id: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<string> {
    const value = await this.request('GET', `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/export`, undefined, signal);
    return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
  }

  stream(id: string, onEvent: (event: BackendEvent) => void, options: StreamOptions = {}): () => void {
    let socket: WebSocket | null = null;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    let closed = false;
    let reconnects = 0;
    let lastSequence = options.afterSequence ?? -1;
    const maxReconnects = options.maxReconnects ?? 6;
    const connect = () => {
      if (closed || this.disposed || options.signal?.aborted) return;
      options.onState?.(reconnects ? 'reconnecting' : 'connecting');
      const url = new URL(`${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/ws/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
      url.protocol = url.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
      if (lastSequence >= 0) url.searchParams.set('after', String(lastSequence));
      // The backend accepts an ephemeral bearer credential as a negotiated
      // subprotocol. It is never copied into URLs, persistence or diagnostics.
      socket = this.token ? new WebSocket(url, [`neuralis-token.${this.token}`]) : new WebSocket(url);
      socket.onopen = () => {
        options.onState?.('connected');
      };
      socket.onmessage = message => {
        if (typeof message.data !== 'string' || message.data.length > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
          options.onError?.(new BackendError('Unsupported or oversized telemetry frame.', 0, 'protocol'));
          return;
        }
        try {
          const event = decodeEvent(JSON.parse(message.data));
          if (event.run_id !== id) throw new BackendError('A telemetry event belongs to another run.', 0, 'protocol');
          if (event.sequence <= lastSequence) return;
          if (lastSequence >= 0 && event.sequence > lastSequence + 1) options.onGap?.(lastSequence, event.sequence);
          lastSequence = event.sequence;
          reconnects = 0;
          onEvent(event);
        } catch (error) {
          options.onError?.(error instanceof BackendError ? error : new BackendError('Invalid telemetry JSON.', 0, 'protocol'));
        }
      };
      socket.onclose = event => {
        socket = null;
        if (closed || this.disposed) return;
        if (event.code === 1008 || event.code === 4001 || event.code === 4003) {
          options.onState?.('failed');
          options.onError?.(new BackendError('The server rejected the telemetry session.', 403, 'authentication'));
          return;
        }
        if (++reconnects > maxReconnects) {
          options.onState?.('failed');
          options.onError?.(new BackendError('Telemetry reconnection attempts exhausted. Refresh the run state.', 0, 'connection'));
          return;
        }
        options.onState?.('reconnecting');
        timer = setTimeout(connect, Math.min(15000, 500 * 2 ** (reconnects - 1)));
      };
      socket.onerror = () => {
        options.onError?.(new BackendError('Telemetry connection failed; checking the HTTP run state is still available.', 0, 'connection'));
      };
    };
    const close = () => {
      if (closed) return;
      closed = true;
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      if (socket) {
        socket.onclose = null;
        socket.close(1000, 'Client closed the stream');
      }
      this.streams.delete(close);
      options.signal?.removeEventListener('abort', close);
      options.onState?.('disconnected');
    };
    this.streams.add(close);
    options.signal?.addEventListener('abort', close, { once: true });
    connect();
    return close;
  }

  dispose(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.streams.forEach(close => close());
    this.controllers.forEach(controller => controller.abort('disposed'));
    this.controllers.clear();
    this.token = null;
    this.publish({ state: 'disconnected', capabilities: null });
    this.listeners.clear();
  }
}

import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, Database, Download, FileSpreadsheet, Play, Upload } from 'lucide-react';
import { useStudio } from '../app/StudioContext';
import { Random } from '../engine/random';
import { downloadText } from '../app/storage';
import { duplicateRows, parseCsv, prepareDataset, profileColumns, type ColumnProfile, type CsvTable, type EncodedDataset, type FeatureSpec } from './datasetTools';
import './research.css';

function exampleCsv(): string {
  const random = new Random(42);
  const rows = ['horizontal,vertical,quadrant'];
  for (let index = 0; index < 240; index++) {
    const x = random.uniform() * 2 - 1;
    const y = random.uniform() * 2 - 1;
    rows.push(`${x.toFixed(6)},${y.toFixed(6)},${x * y > 0 ? 'matching' : 'opposite'}`);
  }
  return rows.join('\n');
}

export function DatasetWorkbench() {
  const { config, setConfig, notify } = useStudio();
  const [source, setSource] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('My CSV experiment');
  const [delimiter, setDelimiter] = useState(',');
  const [table, setTable] = useState<CsvTable | null>(null);
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<ColumnProfile[]>([]);
  const [target, setTarget] = useState('');
  const [task, setTask] = useState<'classification' | 'regression'>('classification');
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [scaling, setScaling] = useState<NonNullable<FeatureSpec['scaling']>>('standard');
  const [validation, setValidation] = useState(0.2);
  const [prepared, setPrepared] = useState<EncodedDataset | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const duplicates = useMemo(() => table ? duplicateRows(table).duplicates : 0, [table]);

  const parse = (text = source) => {
    try {
      const parsed = parseCsv(text, { delimiter, maxRows: 10000 });
      const info = profileColumns(parsed);
      setTable(parsed);
      setProfiles(info);
      setTarget(parsed.columns[parsed.columns.length - 1]);
      setSelected(parsed.columns.slice(0, -1));
      setPrepared(null);
      setError(null);
      setLoaded(false);
    } catch (failure) {
      setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'The dataset could not be parsed.');
      setTable(null);
      setPrepared(null);
    }
  };

  const build = (): EncodedDataset | null => {
    if (!table) return null;
    try {
      const features: FeatureSpec[] = selected.filter(column => column !== target).map(column => ({
        column,
        kind: profiles.find(profile => profile.name === column)?.type === 'numeric' ? 'numeric' : 'categorical',
        scaling,
        imputation: 'median',
      }));
      const dataset = prepareDataset(table, { features, target, task, validationFraction: validation, seed: config.seed });
      setPrepared(dataset);
      setError(null);
      return dataset;
    } catch (failure) {
      setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'The dataset could not be prepared.');
      setPrepared(null);
      return null;
    }
  };

  const load = () => {
    const dataset = build();
    if (!dataset) return;
    const take = (rows: number[][], indices: number[]) => indices.map(index => rows[index]);
    setConfig({
      demoId: 'custom-data',
      hiddenLayers: [24, 16],
      learningRate: 0.01,
      customDataset: {
        name,
        inputs: take(dataset.inputs, dataset.split.train),
        targets: take(dataset.targets, dataset.split.train),
        validationInputs: take(dataset.inputs, dataset.split.validation),
        validationTargets: take(dataset.targets, dataset.split.validation),
        task,
        labels: dataset.labels,
        featureNames: dataset.featureNames,
      },
    });
    setLoaded(true);
    notify('Custom dataset loaded. Only training rows were used to fit preprocessing; validation remains held out.', 'success');
  };

  return <section className="research-panel" aria-label="Custom CSV dataset preparation">
    <div className="research-heading"><FileSpreadsheet size={22}/><div><h2>Bring your own question</h2><p>Import a CSV, fit preprocessing on training rows and train a real dense model locally.</p></div><span className="research-chip">No upload to a server</span></div>
    <div className="research-actions"><button onClick={() => input.current?.click()}><Upload size={15}/>Choose CSV</button><button onClick={() => { const text = exampleCsv(); setSource(text); setName('Quadrant classification'); parse(text); }}>Use a reproducible example</button><input type="file" accept=".csv,.tsv,text/csv,text/tab-separated-values" hidden ref={input} onChange={async event => {
      const file = event.target.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      try {
        if (file.size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error('Import is limited to 8 MiB.');
        const text = await file.text();
        setSource(text);
        setName(file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ''));
        parse(text);
      } catch (failure) {
        setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'The file could not be read.');
      }
      event.target.value = '';
    }}/></div>
    <details className="research-details" open={!table}><summary>CSV source and parsing</summary><textarea aria-label="CSV source" rows={7} value={source} onChange={event => { setSource(event.target.value); setLoaded(false); }} placeholder={'feature_one,feature_two,label\n0.1,0.2,positive\n-0.4,0.7,negative'}/><div className="research-actions"><label>Delimiter<select value={delimiter} onChange={event => setDelimiter(event.target.value)}><option value=",">Comma</option><option value=";">Semicolon</option><option value={'\t'}>Tab</option></select></label><button disabled={!source.trim()} onClick={() => parse()}><Database size={15}/>Inspect dataset</button></div></details>
    {error && <div className="research-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
    {table && <>
      <div className="research-stat-row"><span><strong>{table.rows.length.toLocaleString()}</strong> observations</span><span><strong>{table.columns.length}</strong> columns</span><span><strong>{duplicates}</strong> duplicate observations</span></div>
      {duplicates > 0 && <p className="research-warning">Duplicate observations can inflate validation performance if identical rows occur in both splits. Remove duplicates or use group-aware splitting before claiming generalization.</p>}
      <div className="research-grid"><div className="research-controls">
        <label>Experiment name<input value={name} onChange={event => setName(event.target.value)}/></label>
        <label>Target column<select aria-label="CSV target column" value={target} onChange={event => { setTarget(event.target.value); setPrepared(null); setLoaded(false); }}>{table.columns.map(column => <option key={column}>{column}</option>)}</select></label>
        <label>Task<select value={task} onChange={event => { setTask(event.target.value as typeof task); setPrepared(null); setLoaded(false); }}><option value="classification">Classification</option><option value="regression">Regression</option></select></label>
        <label>Numeric scaling<select value={scaling} onChange={event => { setScaling(event.target.value as typeof scaling); setPrepared(null); }}><option value="standard">Standard score (training mean/std)</option><option value="minmax">Min/max (training extrema)</option><option value="robust">Robust (training median/IQR)</option><option value="none">None</option></select></label>
        <label>Validation fraction<input type="number" step={0.05} min={0.05} max={0.45} value={validation} onChange={event => { setValidation(Number(event.target.value)); setPrepared(null); }}/></label>
        <p>Numeric missing values use the training median. Categorical features use training-only one-hot vocabularies; unseen validation categories are identified.</p>
      </div><div className="research-table-wrap"><table className="research-table"><thead><tr><th>Input</th><th>Column</th><th>Type</th><th>Missing</th><th>Unique</th></tr></thead><tbody>{profiles.map(profile => <tr key={profile.name}><td><input aria-label={`Use ${profile.name} as an input`} type="checkbox" disabled={profile.name === target} checked={selected.includes(profile.name) && profile.name !== target} onChange={event => { setSelected(current => event.target.checked ? [...current, profile.name] : current.filter(column => column !== profile.name)); setPrepared(null); }}/></td><td>{profile.name}{profile.name === target && <span className="research-chip">target</span>}</td><td>{profile.type}</td><td>{profile.missing}</td><td>{profile.unique}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div></div>
      <div className="research-actions"><button onClick={() => build()}>Validate and preview encoding</button><button className="research-primary" onClick={load}><Play size={15}/>Load into training workspace</button>{loaded && <span className="research-success"><CheckCircle2 size={15}/>Ready to train from Training</span>}</div>
    </>}
    {prepared && <div className="research-result"><h3>Preprocessing provenance</h3><p>{prepared.split.train.length} training rows · {prepared.split.validation.length} held-out rows · {prepared.featureNames.length} encoded features · seed {prepared.split.seed}</p><p>{prepared.split.method}. All imputation values, scaling parameters and category vocabularies were fitted exclusively on training rows.</p>{prepared.warnings.map(warning => <p key={warning} className="research-warning">{warning}</p>)}<div className="research-actions"><button onClick={() => downloadText('neuralis-preprocessing.json', JSON.stringify({ schema: 'neuralis.preprocessing/v1', encoder: prepared.encoder, split: prepared.split, labels: prepared.labels, task: prepared.task }, null, 2))}><Download size={15}/>Export encoder and split</button></div><pre>{JSON.stringify({ featureNames: prepared.featureNames, firstTrainingInput: prepared.inputs[prepared.split.train[0]], firstTrainingTarget: prepared.targets[prepared.split.train[0]] }, null, 2)}</pre></div>}
  </section>;
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { exportCsv, fitEncoder, parseCsv, prepareDataset, splitRows, transformRows } from './datasetTools';

describe('CSV and leakage-safe preprocessing', () => {
  it('handles quotes, escaped quotes, delimiters and embedded newlines', () => {
    const table = parseCsv('name,value\r\n"a,b",1\r\n"say ""hi""\nnext",2\r\n');
    expect(table.rows).toEqual([['a,b', '1'], ['say "hi"\nnext', '2']]);
    expect(parseCsv(exportCsv(table.columns, table.rows))).toEqual(table);
  });
  it('rejects malformed headers, quotes and ragged rows', () => {
    expect(() => parseCsv('x,x\n1,2')).toThrow(/unique/);
    expect(() => parseCsv('x,y\n1')).toThrow(/fields/);
    expect(() => parseCsv('x\n"open')).toThrow(/closed/);
  });
  it('fits numeric transforms only to selected training rows', () => {
    const table = parseCsv('x,label\n0,a\n2,a\n10000,b');
    const encoder = fitEncoder(table, [{ column: 'x', kind: 'numeric', scaling: 'standard' }], [0, 1]);
    expect(encoder.transforms[0]).toMatchObject({ offset: 1 });
    expect(transformRows(table, encoder).inputs[2][0]).toBeGreaterThan(1000);
  });
  it('stratifies deterministic splits while preserving disjoint coverage', () => {
    const split = splitRows(10, 0.2, 42, ['a', 'a', 'a', 'a', 'a', 'b', 'b', 'b', 'b', 'b']);
    expect(split.validation).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(new Set([...split.train, ...split.validation]).size).toBe(10);
    expect(splitRows(10, 0.2, 42, ['a', 'a', 'a', 'a', 'a', 'b', 'b', 'b', 'b', 'b'])).toEqual(split);
  });
  it('prevents target leakage and prepares one-hot class targets', () => {
    const table = parseCsv('x,label\n0,a\n1,a\n2,b\n3,b\n4,b');
    expect(() => prepareDataset(table, { features: [{ column: 'label', kind: 'categorical' }], target: 'label', task: 'classification' })).toThrow(/target/);
    const result = prepareDataset(table, { features: [{ column: 'x', kind: 'numeric' }], target: 'label', task: 'classification' });
    expect(result.labels).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
    expect(result.targets[0]).toEqual([1, 0]);
  });
  it('reports unseen categories without fitting them from validation', () => {
    const table = parseCsv('x\nred\nred\nblue');
    const encoder = fitEncoder(table, [{ column: 'x', kind: 'categorical' }], [0, 1]);
    const result = transformRows(table, encoder);
    expect(result.inputs[2]).toEqual([0]);
    expect(result.warnings).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

import { Random } from '../engine/random';
import { quantile, summarize } from './statistics';

export interface CsvTable { columns: string[]; rows: string[][]; delimiter: string; }
export interface ColumnProfile {
  name: string; type: 'numeric' | 'categorical'; missing: number; unique: number;
  minimum?: number; maximum?: number; mean?: number; standardDeviation?: number;
  categories?: { value: string; count: number }[];
}
export interface FeatureSpec {
  column: string; kind: 'numeric' | 'categorical';
  scaling?: 'none' | 'standard' | 'minmax' | 'robust';
  imputation?: 'mean' | 'median' | 'zero' | 'reject';
}
export interface NumericTransform {
  column: string; kind: 'numeric'; offset: number; divisor: number; imputed: number;
  scaling: NonNullable<FeatureSpec['scaling']>; rejectMissing: boolean;
}
export interface CategoryTransform {
  column: string; kind: 'categorical'; categories: string[]; unknownPolicy: 'zero' | 'reject';
}
export interface FittedEncoder {
  version: 1; transforms: (NumericTransform | CategoryTransform)[];
  featureNames: string[]; fittedRows: number;
}
export interface SplitIndices { train: number[]; validation: number[]; seed: number; method: string; }
export interface EncodedDataset {
  inputs: number[][]; targets: number[][]; labels?: string[];
  task: 'classification' | 'regression'; featureNames: string[];
  encoder: FittedEncoder; split: SplitIndices; warnings: string[];
}

const MISSING = new Set(['', 'na', 'n/a', 'null', 'nan', '?']);
const MAX_TEXT = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_ROWS = 20000;
const MAX_COLUMNS = 256;

export function isMissing(value: string): boolean {
  return MISSING.has(value.trim().toLowerCase());
}

function numberOrNull(value: string): number | null {
  if (isMissing(value)) return null;
  const parsed = Number(value.trim());
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

export function parseCsv(text: string, options: { delimiter?: string; header?: boolean; strict?: boolean; maxRows?: number } = {}): CsvTable {
  if (text.length > MAX_TEXT) throw new Error('The CSV exceeds the 8 MiB browser import budget.');
  const delimiter = options.delimiter ?? ',';
  if (delimiter.length !== 1 || ['"', '\r', '\n'].includes(delimiter)) throw new Error('The delimiter must be one non-quote, non-newline character.');
  const source = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
  const records: string[][] = [];
  let row: string[] = [];
  let field = '';
  let quoted = false;
  let closedQuote = false;
  const pushField = () => {
    row.push(field);
    field = '';
    closedQuote = false;
    if (row.length > MAX_COLUMNS) throw new Error('The CSV exceeds the 256-column budget.');
  };
  const pushRow = () => {
    pushField();
    if (row.some(value => value.trim() !== '') || row.length > 1) records.push(row);
    row = [];
    if (records.length > (options.maxRows ?? MAX_ROWS) + 1) throw new Error('The CSV exceeds the configured row budget.');
  };
  for (let index = 0; index < source.length; index++) {
    const character = source[index];
    if (quoted) {
      if (character === '"' && source[index + 1] === '"') {
        field += '"';
        index++;
      } else if (character === '"') {
        quoted = false;
        closedQuote = true;
      } else field += character;
      continue;
    }
    if (character === delimiter) pushField();
    else if (character === '\n' || character === '\r') {
      if (character === '\r' && source[index + 1] === '\n') index++;
      pushRow();
    } else if (character === '"') {
      if (field.length || closedQuote) throw new Error(`Unexpected quote near character ${index}.`);
      quoted = true;
    } else if (closedQuote && !/\s/.test(character)) {
      throw new Error(`Unexpected text after a closing quote near character ${index}.`);
    } else if (!closedQuote) field += character;
  }
  if (quoted) throw new Error('A quoted CSV field was not closed.');
  if (field || row.length || closedQuote) pushRow();
  if (!records.length) throw new Error('The CSV contains no data.');
  const hasHeader = options.header ?? true;
  const width = records[0].length;
  const columns = hasHeader ? records.shift()!.map(value => value.trim()) : Array.from({ length: width }, (_, index) => `feature_${index + 1}`);
  if (columns.some(value => !value) || new Set(columns).size !== columns.length) throw new Error('CSV headers must be nonempty and unique.');
  const rows = records.map((record, index) => {
    if (record.length !== width && (options.strict ?? true)) throw new Error(`CSV row ${index + (hasHeader ? 2 : 1)} has ${record.length} fields; expected ${width}.`);
    return Array.from({ length: width }, (_, column) => record[column] ?? '');
  });
  if (!rows.length) throw new Error('The CSV has a header but no observations.');
  return { columns, rows, delimiter };
}

export function exportCsv(columns: string[], rows: (string | number | boolean | null)[][]): string {
  const escape = (value: string | number | boolean | null) => {
    const text = value === null ? '' : String(value);
    return /[",\r\n]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : text;
  };
  if (rows.some(row => row.length !== columns.length)) throw new Error('CSV rows must align with the output headers.');
  return [columns.map(escape).join(','), ...rows.map(row => row.map(escape).join(','))].join('\r\n') + '\r\n';
}

export function profileColumns(table: CsvTable): ColumnProfile[] {
  return table.columns.map((name, column) => {
    const values = table.rows.map(row => row[column]);
    const present = values.filter(value => !isMissing(value));
    const numeric = present.map(numberOrNull);
    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    present.forEach(value => counts.set(value, (counts.get(value) ?? 0) + 1));
    const base = { name, missing: values.length - present.length, unique: counts.size };
    if (present.length && numeric.every(value => value !== null)) {
      const stats = summarize(numeric as number[]);
      return { ...base, type: 'numeric', minimum: stats.minimum, maximum: stats.maximum, mean: stats.mean, standardDeviation: stats.standardDeviation };
    }
    return { ...base, type: 'categorical', categories: [...counts].map(([value, count]) => ({ value, count })).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || a.value.localeCompare(b.value)).slice(0, 100) };
  });
}

export function splitRows(count: number, validationFraction = 0.2, seed = 42, labels?: string[]): SplitIndices {
  if (!Number.isInteger(count) || count < 3 || count > MAX_ROWS || !(validationFraction > 0 && validationFraction < 0.5)) {
    throw new Error('A split requires 3–20000 rows and a validation fraction between zero and 0.5.');
  }
  if (labels && labels.length !== count) throw new Error('Stratification labels must align with rows.');
  const random = new Random(seed);
  let train: number[] = [];
  let validation: number[] = [];
  if (labels) {
    const groups = new Map<string, number[]>();
    labels.forEach((label, index) => { if (!groups.has(label)) groups.set(label, []); groups.get(label)!.push(index); });
    for (const indices of groups.values()) {
      random.shuffle(indices);
      const size = indices.length > 1 ? Math.max(1, Math.min(indices.length - 1, Math.round(indices.length * validationFraction))) : 0;
      validation.push(...indices.slice(0, size));
      train.push(...indices.slice(size));
    }
    if (!validation.length) throw new Error('Every class occurs only once; a stratified validation split is unavailable.');
    random.shuffle(train);
    random.shuffle(validation);
  } else {
    const indices = random.shuffle(Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => index));
    const size = Math.max(1, Math.round(count * validationFraction));
    validation = indices.slice(0, size);
    train = indices.slice(size);
  }
  return { train, validation, seed, method: labels ? 'Seeded stratified holdout (rare singleton classes stay in training)' : 'Seeded random holdout' };
}

export function fitEncoder(table: CsvTable, features: FeatureSpec[], trainingIndices: number[], unknownPolicy: 'zero' | 'reject' = 'zero'): FittedEncoder {
  if (!features.length || features.length > 128 || !trainingIndices.length || new Set(trainingIndices).size !== trainingIndices.length) {
    throw new Error('Feature encoding requires selected features and unique training-row indices.');
  }
  if (trainingIndices.some(index => !Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0 || index >= table.rows.length)) throw new Error('A training index is outside the dataset.');
  if (new Set(features.map(feature => feature.column)).size !== features.length) throw new Error('A feature column may be selected only once.');
  const featureNames: string[] = [];
  const transforms = features.map(feature => {
    const column = table.columns.indexOf(feature.column);
    if (column < 0) throw new Error(`Feature column ${feature.column} does not exist.`);
    const values = trainingIndices.map(index => table.rows[index][column]);
    if (feature.kind === 'categorical') {
      const categories = [...new Set(values.map(value => isMissing(value) ? '<missing>' : value))].sort();
      if (categories.length > 64) throw new Error(`Column ${feature.column} has too many categories for one-hot browser encoding.`);
      categories.forEach(value => featureNames.push(`${feature.column}=${value}`));
      return { column: feature.column, kind: 'categorical', categories, unknownPolicy } as CategoryTransform;
    }
    const parsed = values.map(numberOrNull);
    const present = parsed.filter((value): value is number => value !== null);
    if (!present.length) throw new Error(`Column ${feature.column} has no numeric training values.`);
    if (values.some((value, index) => !isMissing(value) && parsed[index] === null)) throw new Error(`Column ${feature.column} contains nonnumeric text.`);
    const rejectMissing = feature.imputation === 'reject';
    if (rejectMissing && parsed.some(value => value === null)) throw new Error(`Column ${feature.column} has missing training values.`);
    const stats = summarize(present);
    const imputed = feature.imputation === 'zero' ? 0 : feature.imputation === 'median' ? stats.median : stats.mean;
    const complete = parsed.map(value => value ?? imputed);
    const fitted = summarize(complete);
    const scaling = feature.scaling ?? 'standard';
    let offset = 0;
    let divisor = 1;
    if (scaling === 'standard') {
      offset = fitted.mean;
      divisor = fitted.standardDeviation || 1;
    } else if (scaling === 'minmax') {
      offset = fitted.minimum;
      divisor = fitted.maximum - fitted.minimum || 1;
    } else if (scaling === 'robust') {
      const sorted = complete.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      offset = quantile(sorted, 0.5);
      divisor = quantile(sorted, 0.75) - quantile(sorted, 0.25) || 1;
    }
    featureNames.push(feature.column);
    return { column: feature.column, kind: 'numeric', offset, divisor, imputed, scaling, rejectMissing } as NumericTransform;
  });
  if (featureNames.length > 128) throw new Error('Expanded one-hot encoding exceeds the 128-feature browser budget.');
  return { version: 1, transforms, featureNames, fittedRows: trainingIndices.length };
}

export function transformRows(table: CsvTable, encoder: FittedEncoder, indices?: number[]): { inputs: number[][]; warnings: string[] } {
  if (encoder.version !== 1) throw new Error('Unsupported feature-encoder version.');
  const warnings = new Set<string>();
  const selected = indices ?? Array.from({ length: table.rows.length }, (_, index) => index);
  const inputs = selected.map(index => {
    const row = table.rows[index];
    if (!row) throw new Error('A selected row is outside the dataset.');
    return encoder.transforms.flatMap(transform => {
      const column = table.columns.indexOf(transform.column);
      if (column < 0) throw new Error(`Required column ${transform.column} is missing from this table.`);
      const raw = row[column];
      if (transform.kind === 'categorical') {
        const value = isMissing(raw) ? '<missing>' : raw;
        if (!transform.categories.includes(value)) {
          if (transform.unknownPolicy === 'reject') throw new Error(`Unknown category in ${transform.column}.`);
          warnings.add(`Unseen categories in ${transform.column} were encoded as an all-zero vector.`);
        }
        return transform.categories.map(category => Number(category === value));
      }
      const value = numberOrNull(raw);
      if (value === null && (!isMissing(raw) || transform.rejectMissing)) throw new Error(`Invalid numeric value in ${transform.column}, row ${index + 1}.`);
      return [((value ?? transform.imputed) - transform.offset) / transform.divisor];
    });
  });
  return { inputs, warnings: [...warnings] };
}

export function prepareDataset(table: CsvTable, options: {
  features: FeatureSpec[]; target: string; task: 'classification' | 'regression';
  validationFraction?: number; seed?: number;
}): EncodedDataset {
  const targetColumn = table.columns.indexOf(options.target);
  if (targetColumn < 0) throw new Error('Select a target column present in the dataset.');
  if (options.features.some(feature => feature.column === options.target)) throw new Error('The target column must not be included among input features.');
  const rawTargets = table.rows.map(row => row[targetColumn]);
  if (rawTargets.some(isMissing)) throw new Error('Target values cannot be missing. Remove or label those rows before importing.');
  const split = splitRows(table.rows.length, options.validationFraction ?? 0.2, options.seed ?? 42, options.task === 'classification' ? rawTargets : undefined);
  const encoder = fitEncoder(table, options.features, split.train);
  const transformed = transformRows(table, encoder);
  let labels: string[] | undefined;
  let targets: number[][];
  if (options.task === 'classification') {
    labels = [...new Set(split.train.map(index => rawTargets[index]))].sort();
    if (labels.length < 2 || labels.length > 64) throw new Error('Classification requires 2–64 training classes.');
    targets = rawTargets.map(value => {
      if (!labels!.includes(value)) throw new Error('A validation class is absent from training.');
      return labels!.map(label => Number(label === value));
    });
  } else {
    targets = rawTargets.map(value => {
      const number = numberOrNull(value);
      if (number === null) throw new Error('Regression targets must be finite numbers.');
      return [number];
    });
  }
  return { inputs: transformed.inputs, targets, labels, task: options.task, featureNames: encoder.featureNames, encoder, split, warnings: transformed.warnings };
}

export function gaussianAugmentation(inputs: number[][], options: { copies?: number; deviation?: number; seed?: number } = {}): number[][] {
  const copies = options.copies ?? 1;
  const deviation = options.deviation ?? 0.01;
  if (!Number.isInteger(copies) || copies < 1 || copies > 20 || !Number.isFinite(deviation) || deviation < 0 || inputs.length * copies > MAX_ROWS) {
    throw new Error('The requested augmentation exceeds its row or noise budget.');
  }
  const random = new Random(options.seed ?? 42);
  return Array.from({ length: copies }, () => inputs.map(row => row.map(value => {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new Error('Augmentation requires finite numeric features.');
    return value + random.normal(0, deviation);
  }))).flat();
}

export function duplicateRows(table: CsvTable): { groups: number[][]; duplicates: number } {
  const groups = new Map<string, number[]>();
  table.rows.forEach((row, index) => {
    const key = JSON.stringify(row);
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
    groups.get(key)!.push(index);
  });
  const repeated = [...groups.values()].filter(group => group.length > 1);
  return { groups: repeated, duplicates: repeated.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.length - 1, 0) };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { adversarialSearch, calibration, integratedGradients, linearCKA, nearestRepresentations, numericalGradient } from './modelAnalysis';

describe('controlled model analysis', () => {
  it('recovers analytical gradients and integrated-gradient completeness', () => {
    const model = (input: number[]) => [2 * input[0] + 3 * input[1] + 1];
    expect(numericalGradient(model, [4, 5])[0]).toBeCloseTo(2, 8);
    const result = integratedGradients(model, [4, 5], { steps: 8 });
    expect(result.values[0]).toBeCloseTo(8, 8);
    expect(result.values[1]).toBeCloseTo(15, 8);
    expect(result.completenessError).toBeCloseTo(0, 8);
  });
  it('bounds attribution work before evaluating an expensive model', () => {
    expect(() => integratedGradients(() => [1], [1, 2, 3], { maxEvaluations: 5 })).toThrow(/budget/);
  });
  it('keeps projected adversarial perturbations inside the requested norm ball', () => {
    const result = adversarialSearch(input => [input[0] + input[1]], [0, 0], { target: 0, direction: 'increase', radius: 0.1, steps: 4 });
    expect(result.input).toEqual([0.1, 0.1]);
    expect(result.after[0]).toBeCloseTo(0.2);
    expect(result.trajectory.every(point => point.distance <= 0.1 + 1e-12)).toBe(true);
  });
  it('makes linear CKA invariant to translation and isotropic scale', () => {
    const data = [[1, 2], [2, 0], [0, 1], [4, 3]];
    const transformed = data.map(row => row.map(value => value * 7 + 100));
    expect(linearCKA(data, transformed)).toBeCloseTo(1, 8);
    expect(linearCKA(data, data)).toBeCloseTo(1, 10);
  });
  it('computes zero calibration error for a perfectly confident correct classifier', () => {
    const result = calibration([[1, 0], [0, 1]], [0, 1]);
    expect(result.expectedCalibrationError).toBe(0);
    expect(result.brierScore).toBe(0);
    expect(() => calibration([[0.8, 0.8]], [0])).toThrow();
  });
  it('finds nearest representations with deterministic tie resolution', () => {
    const result = nearestRepresentations([1, 0], [[0, 1], [1, 0], [2, 0]], 2);
    expect(result.map(item => item.index)).toEqual([1, 2]);
  });
});

import type { EngineController, InterventionResult, InterventionSpec } from '../types';
import { pearsonCorrelation, summarize } from './statistics';

export interface Attribution {
  values: number[]; prediction: number[]; baselinePrediction: number[];
  target: number; completenessError: number; evaluations: number;
  method: string; baseline: number[];
}
export interface AblationObservation {
  layer: number; neuron: number; averageDelta: number; meanAbsoluteDelta: number;
  perSample: number[]; samples: number;
}
export interface CalibrationBin {
  lower: number; upper: number; count: number; confidence: number; accuracy: number; gap: number;
}
export interface CalibrationResult {
  bins: CalibrationBin[]; expectedCalibrationError: number;
  maximumCalibrationError: number; brierScore: number; negativeLogLikelihood: number;
  samples: number; classes: number;
}
type Predictor = (input: number[]) => number[];

function checkedInput(input: readonly number[]): number[] {
  if (!input.length || input.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value))) throw new Error('The model input must be a nonempty finite vector.');
  if (input.length > 512) throw new Error('Black-box analysis is limited to 512 input dimensions.');
  return [...input];
}

function checkedPrediction(predict: Predictor, input: number[], target: number): number[] {
  const result = predict(input);
  if (!Number.isInteger(target) || target < 0 || target >= result.length || result.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value))) {
    throw new Error('The target output is unavailable or the model returned nonfinite values.');
  }
  return result;
}

export function numericalGradient(predict: Predictor, input: readonly number[], target = 0, epsilon = 1e-4): number[] {
  const vector = checkedInput(input);
  if (!(epsilon > 0 && epsilon <= 0.1)) throw new Error('Finite-difference epsilon must be in (0, 0.1].');
  const gradient = new Array<number>(vector.length);
  for (let dimension = 0; dimension < vector.length; dimension++) {
    const value = vector[dimension];
    const displacement = epsilon * Math.max(1, Math.abs(value));
    vector[dimension] = value + displacement;
    const plus = checkedPrediction(predict, vector, target)[target];
    vector[dimension] = value - displacement;
    const minus = checkedPrediction(predict, vector, target)[target];
    vector[dimension] = value;
    gradient[dimension] = (plus - minus) / (2 * displacement);
  }
  return gradient;
}

export function integratedGradients(predict: Predictor, input: readonly number[], options: {
  baseline?: number[]; target?: number; steps?: number; epsilon?: number; maxEvaluations?: number;
} = {}): Attribution {
  const vector = checkedInput(input);
  const baseline = checkedInput(options.baseline ?? vector.map(() => 0));
  if (baseline.length !== vector.length) throw new Error('The baseline and input must have identical dimensions.');
  const target = options.target ?? 0;
  const steps = options.steps ?? 32;
  if (!Number.isInteger(steps) || steps < 2 || steps > 256) throw new Error('Integration steps must be between 2 and 256.');
  const evaluations = 2 * vector.length * (steps + 1) + 2;
  if (evaluations > (options.maxEvaluations ?? 50000)) throw new Error('The attribution exceeds the evaluation budget. Reduce dimensions or integration steps.');
  const accumulated = vector.map(() => 0);
  for (let index = 0; index <= steps; index++) {
    const alpha = index / steps;
    const point = vector.map((value, dimension) => baseline[dimension] + alpha * (value - baseline[dimension]));
    const gradient = numericalGradient(predict, point, target, options.epsilon ?? 1e-4);
    const weight = index === 0 || index === steps ? 0.5 : 1;
    gradient.forEach((value, dimension) => { accumulated[dimension] += weight * value; });
  }
  const values = accumulated.map((value, dimension) => value * (vector[dimension] - baseline[dimension]) / steps);
  const prediction = checkedPrediction(predict, vector, target);
  const baselinePrediction = checkedPrediction(predict, baseline, target);
  const completenessError = values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) - (prediction[target] - baselinePrediction[target]);
  return { values, prediction, baselinePrediction, target, completenessError, evaluations, baseline,
    method: 'Integrated gradients using central finite differences and trapezoidal integration' };
}

export function requireStableEngine(engine: EngineController): void {
  if (engine.getSnapshot().state === 'running') throw new Error('Pause training before analysis so every comparison uses the same parameters.');
}

export function interventionSweep(engine: EngineController, input: number[], spec: Omit<InterventionSpec, 'value'>, values: number[]): InterventionResult[] {
  requireStableEngine(engine);
  if (values.length < 1 || values.length > 100 || values.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value) || Math.abs(value) > 100)) {
    throw new Error('Use 1–100 finite intervention strengths between -100 and 100.');
  }
  const baseline = engine.predict(input);
  const results = values.map(value => engine.intervene(input, { ...spec, value }));
  const after = engine.predict(input);
  if (baseline.length !== after.length || baseline.some((value, index) => Math.abs(value - after[index]) > 1e-10)) {
    throw new Error('The model changed during intervention analysis. Results are not a controlled comparison.');
  }
  return results;
}

export function ablationMap(engine: EngineController, inputs: number[][], target: number, options: {
  maxNeurons?: number; layers?: number[]; maxEvaluations?: number;
} = {}): AblationObservation[] {
  requireStableEngine(engine);
  if (!inputs.length || inputs.length > 128) throw new Error('Ablation analysis requires 1–128 input examples.');
  const snapshot = engine.getSnapshot();
  const selected = options.layers ?? snapshot.layers.map((_, index) => index).slice(1, -1);
  const targets = selected.flatMap(layer => {
    if (layer < 0 || layer >= snapshot.layers.length) throw new Error('An ablation target layer is invalid.');
    return Array.from({ length: Math.min(options.maxNeurons ?? 32, snapshot.layers[layer].size) }, (_, neuron) => ({ layer, neuron }));
  });
  if ((targets.length + 1) * inputs.length > (options.maxEvaluations ?? 5000)) throw new Error('The ablation map exceeds the evaluation budget.');
  const before = inputs.map(input => checkedPrediction(value => engine.predict(value), checkedInput(input), target)[target]);
  return targets.map(({ layer, neuron }) => {
    const perSample = inputs.map((input, index) => engine.intervene(input, { layer, neuron, kind: 'ablate', value: 0 }).after[target] - before[index]);
    return { layer, neuron, perSample, averageDelta: summarize(perSample).mean,
      meanAbsoluteDelta: summarize(perSample.map(Math.abs)).mean, samples: inputs.length };
  });
}

export function featureOcclusion(predict: Predictor, input: number[], baseline: number[], target = 0): number[] {
  const vector = checkedInput(input);
  if (baseline.length !== vector.length) throw new Error('Occlusion requires an aligned baseline.');
  const before = checkedPrediction(predict, vector, target)[target];
  return vector.map((_, dimension) => {
    const masked = [...vector];
    masked[dimension] = baseline[dimension];
    return checkedPrediction(predict, masked, target)[target] - before;
  });
}

export function adversarialSearch(predict: Predictor, input: number[], options: {
  target: number; direction: 'increase' | 'decrease'; radius?: number; stepSize?: number;
  steps?: number; bounds?: { minimum: number; maximum: number }; maxEvaluations?: number;
}): { input: number[]; before: number[]; after: number[]; trajectory: { iteration: number; score: number; distance: number }[]; evaluations: number } {
  const original = checkedInput(input);
  const radius = options.radius ?? 0.15;
  const steps = options.steps ?? 10;
  const stepSize = options.stepSize ?? radius / Math.max(1, steps / 2);
  if (!(radius > 0) || !(stepSize > 0) || !Number.isInteger(steps) || steps < 1 || steps > 100) throw new Error('Invalid perturbation budget.');
  const evaluations = steps * (2 * original.length + 1) + 2;
  if (evaluations > (options.maxEvaluations ?? 20000)) throw new Error('The robustness search exceeds its evaluation budget.');
  const before = checkedPrediction(predict, original, options.target);
  let current = [...original];
  const trajectory = [];
  for (let iteration = 1; iteration <= steps; iteration++) {
    const gradient = numericalGradient(predict, current, options.target);
    current = current.map((value, dimension) => {
      const moved = value + (options.direction === 'increase' ? 1 : -1) * stepSize * Math.sign(gradient[dimension]);
      const projected = Math.max(original[dimension] - radius, Math.min(original[dimension] + radius, moved));
      return options.bounds ? Math.max(options.bounds.minimum, Math.min(options.bounds.maximum, projected)) : projected;
    });
    const score = checkedPrediction(predict, current, options.target)[options.target];
    trajectory.push({ iteration, score, distance: Math.max(...current.map((value, dimension) => Math.abs(value - original[dimension]))) });
  }
  return { input: current, before, after: checkedPrediction(predict, current, options.target), trajectory, evaluations };
}

function validateMatrix(matrix: number[][], maximum = 512): void {
  if (matrix.length < 2 || matrix.length > maximum || !matrix[0]?.length || matrix[0].length > 1024 ||
      matrix.some(row => row.length !== matrix[0].length || row.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value)))) {
    throw new Error('Representations must be rectangular finite matrices with 2–512 aligned observations.');
  }
}

function centeredGram(matrix: number[][]): number[][] {
  const count = matrix.length;
  const gram = Array.from({ length: count }, () => new Array<number>(count).fill(0));
  const means = new Array<number>(count).fill(0);
  for (let first = 0; first < count; first++) {
    for (let second = 0; second <= first; second++) {
      let dot = 0;
      for (let dimension = 0; dimension < matrix[0].length; dimension++) dot += matrix[first][dimension] * matrix[second][dimension];
      gram[first][second] = dot;
      gram[second][first] = dot;
    }
  }
  for (let first = 0; first < count; first++) means[first] = gram[first].reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / count;
  const grand = means.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / count;
  return gram.map((row, first) => row.map((value, second) => value - means[first] - means[second] + grand));
}

export function linearCKA(first: number[][], second: number[][]): number {
  validateMatrix(first);
  validateMatrix(second);
  if (first.length !== second.length) throw new Error('CKA requires the same observations in the same order.');
  const a = centeredGram(first);
  const b = centeredGram(second);
  let dot = 0;
  let normA = 0;
  let normB = 0;
  for (let row = 0; row < a.length; row++) for (let column = 0; column < a.length; column++) {
    dot += a[row][column] * b[row][column];
    normA += a[row][column] ** 2;
    normB += b[row][column] ** 2;
  }
  return normA > 1e-20 && normB > 1e-20 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, dot / Math.sqrt(normA * normB))) : 0;
}

export function representationSimilarity(first: number[][], second: number[][]): number {
  validateMatrix(first);
  validateMatrix(second);
  if (first.length !== second.length) throw new Error('RSA requires aligned observations.');
  const a: number[] = [];
  const b: number[] = [];
  for (let row = 1; row < first.length; row++) for (let column = 0; column < row; column++) {
    a.push(Math.sqrt(first[row].reduce((sum, value, dimension) => sum + (value - first[column][dimension]) ** 2, 0)));
    b.push(Math.sqrt(second[row].reduce((sum, value, dimension) => sum + (value - second[column][dimension]) ** 2, 0)));
  }
  return a.length > 1 ? pearsonCorrelation(a, b) : 0;
}

export function calibration(probabilities: number[][], labels: number[], binCount = 10): CalibrationResult {
  if (!probabilities.length || probabilities.length !== labels.length || !Number.isInteger(binCount) || binCount < 2 || binCount > 100) {
    throw new Error('Calibration needs aligned probabilities/labels and 2–100 bins.');
  }
  const classes = probabilities[0].length;
  if (classes < 2) throw new Error('Calibration is defined here for multi-class probabilities.');
  const bins: CalibrationBin[] = Array.from({ length: binCount }, (_, index) => ({ lower: index / binCount, upper: (index + 1) / binCount, count: 0, confidence: 0, accuracy: 0, gap: 0 }));
  let brierScore = 0;
  let negativeLogLikelihood = 0;
  probabilities.forEach((row, index) => {
    if (row.length !== classes || row.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 1) || Math.abs(row.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) - 1) > 1e-5 ||
        !Number.isInteger(labels[index]) || labels[index] < 0 || labels[index] >= classes) throw new Error('Invalid probability distribution or class label.');
    let predicted = 0;
    row.forEach((value, classIndex) => { if (value > row[predicted]) predicted = classIndex; });
    const confidence = row[predicted];
    const bin = bins[Math.min(binCount - 1, Math.floor(confidence * binCount))];
    bin.count++;
    bin.confidence += confidence;
    bin.accuracy += Number(predicted === labels[index]);
    negativeLogLikelihood -= Math.log(Math.max(1e-15, row[labels[index]]));
    brierScore += row.reduce((sum, value, classIndex) => sum + (value - Number(classIndex === labels[index])) ** 2, 0);
  });
  let expectedCalibrationError = 0;
  let maximumCalibrationError = 0;
  bins.forEach(bin => {
    if (!bin.count) return;
    bin.confidence /= bin.count;
    bin.accuracy /= bin.count;
    bin.gap = Math.abs(bin.accuracy - bin.confidence);
    expectedCalibrationError += bin.gap * bin.count / labels.length;
    maximumCalibrationError = Math.max(maximumCalibrationError, bin.gap);
  });
  return { bins, expectedCalibrationError, maximumCalibrationError, brierScore: brierScore / labels.length,
    negativeLogLikelihood: negativeLogLikelihood / labels.length, samples: labels.length, classes };
}

export function nearestRepresentations(query: number[], representations: number[][], count = 10, metric: 'cosine' | 'euclidean' = 'cosine'): { index: number; score: number }[] {
  const vector = checkedInput(query);
  if (!Number.isInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 100) throw new Error('Neighbor count must be 1–100.');
  const queryNorm = Math.sqrt(vector.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value * value, 0));
  return representations.map((row, index) => {
    if (row.length !== vector.length || row.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value))) throw new Error('Neighbor representations must align with the query.');
    let dot = 0;
    let norm = 0;
    let distance = 0;
    row.forEach((value, dimension) => { dot += value * vector[dimension]; norm += value * value; distance += (value - vector[dimension]) ** 2; });
    const score = metric === 'cosine' ? (norm && queryNorm ? dot / (Math.sqrt(norm) * queryNorm) : 0) : -Math.sqrt(distance);
    return { index, score };
  }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.index - b.index).slice(0, count);
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { adjustPValues, bootstrapInterval, meanInterval, pairedTTest, pearsonCorrelation, regularizedBeta, studentTCdf, studentTQuantile, summarize, wilsonInterval } from './statistics';

describe('research statistics', () => {
  it('uses stable sample variance even around a large offset', () => {
    const result = summarize([1e9 + 1, 1e9 + 2, 1e9 + 3]);
    expect(result.mean).toBe(1e9 + 2);
    expect(result.variance).toBeCloseTo(1, 8);
  });
  it('matches reference Student t values and beta endpoints', () => {
    expect(studentTCdf(0, 10)).toBeCloseTo(0.5, 12);
    expect(studentTQuantile(0.975, 10)).toBeCloseTo(2.22813885196, 8);
    expect(regularizedBeta(0.5, 1, 1)).toBeCloseTo(0.5, 12);
  });
  it('reports no difference for identical paired observations', () => {
    const result = pairedTTest([1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 2, 3, 4]);
    expect(result.difference).toBe(0);
    expect(result.pValue).toBe(1);
  });
  it('rejects silently misaligned or nonfinite data', () => {
    expect(() => pairedTTest([1, 2], [1, 2, 3])).toThrow();
    expect(() => summarize([1, NaN])).toThrow();
    expect(summarize([1, NaN, 3], true).missingCount).toBe(1);
  });
  it('produces deterministic bootstrap intervals and sensible mean confidence', () => {
    const sample = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    expect(bootstrapInterval(sample, { iterations: 200, seed: 7 })).toEqual(bootstrapInterval(sample, { iterations: 200, seed: 7 }));
    const interval = meanInterval(sample);
    expect(interval.lower).toBeLessThan(3);
    expect(interval.upper).toBeGreaterThan(3);
  });
  it('keeps Wilson bounds inside probabilities even for zero or complete successes', () => {
    expect(wilsonInterval(0, 10).lower).toBe(0);
    expect(wilsonInterval(10, 10).upper).toBeCloseTo(1, 14);
    expect(wilsonInterval(10, 10).lower).toBeCloseTo(0.7224672, 6);
  });
  it('corrects multiple comparisons in original order', () => {
    expect(adjustPValues([0.04, 0.01, 0.03], 'holm')).toEqual([0.06, 0.03, 0.06]);
    expect(adjustPValues([0.04, 0.01, 0.03], 'bonferroni')).toEqual([0.12, 0.03, 0.09]);
  });
  it('computes positive and negative reference correlations', () => {
    expect(pearsonCorrelation([1, 2, 3], [2, 4, 6])).toBeCloseTo(1);
    expect(pearsonCorrelation([1, 2, 3], [6, 4, 2])).toBeCloseTo(-1);
  });
});

import { Random } from '../engine/random';

export interface SummaryStatistics {
  count: number; mean: number; variance: number; standardDeviation: number;
  minimum: number; maximum: number; median: number; q1: number; q3: number;
  standardError: number; finiteCount: number; missingCount: number;
}
export interface ConfidenceInterval {
  estimate: number; lower: number; upper: number; confidence: number;
  method: string; samples: number; seed?: number;
}
export interface ComparisonResult {
  difference: number; statistic: number; pValue: number; degreesOfFreedom?: number;
  effectSize: number; sampleSize: number; method: string;
}

function finite(values: readonly number[], minimum = 1): number[] {
  if (values.length < minimum) throw new Error(`At least ${minimum} observations are required.`);
  if (values.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value))) throw new Error('Statistical inputs must all be finite; missing observations must be handled explicitly.');
  return [...values];
}

export function quantile(sorted: readonly number[], probability: number): number {
  if (!sorted.length || probability < 0 || probability > 1 || !Number.isFinite(probability)) {
    throw new Error('A nonempty sorted sample and a quantile between zero and one are required.');
  }
  const position = probability * (sorted.length - 1);
  const left = Math.floor(position);
  const right = Math.ceil(position);
  return sorted[left] * (right - position || 1) + (left === right ? 0 : sorted[right] * (position - left));
}

export function summarize(values: readonly number[], allowMissing = false): SummaryStatistics {
  const data = allowMissing ? values.filter(Number.isFinite) : finite(values);
  if (!data.length) throw new Error('There are no finite observations to summarize.');
  let mean = 0;
  let m2 = 0;
  let count = 0;
  let minimum = Infinity;
  let maximum = -Infinity;
  for (const value of data) {
    count++;
    const delta = value - mean;
    mean += delta / count;
    m2 += delta * (value - mean);
    minimum = Math.min(minimum, value);
    maximum = Math.max(maximum, value);
  }
  const variance = count > 1 ? m2 / (count - 1) : 0;
  const sorted = [...data].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return {
    count, mean, variance, standardDeviation: Math.sqrt(variance), minimum, maximum,
    median: quantile(sorted, 0.5), q1: quantile(sorted, 0.25), q3: quantile(sorted, 0.75),
    standardError: Math.sqrt(variance / count), finiteCount: count, missingCount: values.length - count,
  };
}

const LANCZOS = [676.5203681218851, -1259.1392167224028, 771.3234287776531,
  -176.6150291621406, 12.507343278686905, -0.13857109526572012,
  9.984369578019572e-6, 1.5056327351493116e-7];

export function logGamma(value: number): number {
  if (!(value > 0)) throw new Error('Gamma requires a positive argument.');
  if (value < 0.5) return Math.log(Math.PI) - Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI * value)) - logGamma(1 - value);
  let coefficient = 0.99999999999980993;
  const shifted = value - 1;
  for (let index = 0; index < LANCZOS.length; index++) coefficient += LANCZOS[index] / (shifted + index + 1);
  const t = shifted + LANCZOS.length - 0.5;
  return 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI) + (shifted + 0.5) * Math.log(t) - t + Math.log(coefficient);
}

function betaFraction(a: number, b: number, x: number): number {
  const epsilon = 3e-14;
  const tiny = 1e-300;
  const qab = a + b;
  const qap = a + 1;
  const qam = a - 1;
  let c = 1;
  let d = 1 - qab * x / qap;
  if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
  d = 1 / d;
  let h = d;
  for (let m = 1; m <= 300; m++) {
    const m2 = 2 * m;
    let aa = m * (b - m) * x / ((qam + m2) * (a + m2));
    d = 1 + aa * d;
    if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
    c = 1 + aa / c;
    if (Math.abs(c) < tiny) c = tiny;
    d = 1 / d;
    h *= d * c;
    aa = -(a + m) * (qab + m) * x / ((a + m2) * (qap + m2));
    d = 1 + aa * d;
    if (Math.abs(d) < tiny) d = tiny;
    c = 1 + aa / c;
    if (Math.abs(c) < tiny) c = tiny;
    d = 1 / d;
    const delta = d * c;
    h *= delta;
    if (Math.abs(delta - 1) < epsilon) return h;
  }
  throw new Error('Incomplete beta calculation did not converge.');
}

export function regularizedBeta(x: number, a: number, b: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(x) || x < 0 || x > 1 || a <= 0 || b <= 0) throw new Error('Invalid beta distribution parameters.');
  if (x === 0 || x === 1) return x;
  const front = Math.exp(logGamma(a + b) - logGamma(a) - logGamma(b) + a * Math.log(x) + b * Math.log1p(-x));
  return x < (a + 1) / (a + b + 2) ? front * betaFraction(a, b, x) / a :
    1 - front * betaFraction(b, a, 1 - x) / b;
}

export function studentTCdf(t: number, degreesOfFreedom: number): number {
  if (!(degreesOfFreedom > 0) || Number.isNaN(t)) throw new Error('Invalid Student t parameters.');
  if (t === Infinity) return 1;
  if (t === -Infinity) return 0;
  const beta = regularizedBeta(degreesOfFreedom / (degreesOfFreedom + t * t), degreesOfFreedom / 2, 0.5);
  return t >= 0 ? 1 - beta / 2 : beta / 2;
}

export function studentTQuantile(probability: number, degreesOfFreedom: number): number {
  if (!(probability > 0 && probability < 1)) throw new Error('A finite quantile requires probability strictly between zero and one.');
  if (probability === 0.5) return 0;
  if (probability < 0.5) return -studentTQuantile(1 - probability, degreesOfFreedom);
  let low = 0;
  let high = 1;
  while (studentTCdf(high, degreesOfFreedom) < probability && high < 1e12) high *= 2;
  for (let index = 0; index < 100; index++) {
    const midpoint = (low + high) / 2;
    if (studentTCdf(midpoint, degreesOfFreedom) < probability) low = midpoint;
    else high = midpoint;
  }
  return (low + high) / 2;
}

export function meanInterval(values: readonly number[], confidence = 0.95): ConfidenceInterval {
  finite(values, 2);
  if (!(confidence > 0 && confidence < 1)) throw new Error('Confidence must be between zero and one.');
  const summary = summarize(values);
  const margin = studentTQuantile((1 + confidence) / 2, summary.count - 1) * summary.standardError;
  return { estimate: summary.mean, lower: summary.mean - margin, upper: summary.mean + margin,
    confidence, samples: summary.count, method: 'Student t mean interval (independent observations)' };
}

export function bootstrapInterval(values: readonly number[], options: {
  iterations?: number; confidence?: number; seed?: number; statistic?: (sample: number[]) => number;
} = {}): ConfidenceInterval {
  const data = finite(values, 2);
  const iterations = options.iterations ?? 2000;
  const confidence = options.confidence ?? 0.95;
  const seed = options.seed ?? 42;
  if (!Number.isInteger(iterations) || iterations < 100 || iterations > 100000 || !(confidence > 0 && confidence < 1)) {
    throw new Error('Bootstrap iterations must be 100–100000 and confidence must be between zero and one.');
  }
  const statistic = options.statistic ?? (sample => summarize(sample).mean);
  const random = new Random(seed);
  const draws = new Array<number>(iterations);
  const sample = new Array<number>(data.length);
  for (let draw = 0; draw < iterations; draw++) {
    for (let index = 0; index < data.length; index++) sample[index] = data[random.integer(data.length)];
    draws[draw] = statistic(sample);
    if (!Number.isFinite(draws[draw])) throw new Error('The bootstrap statistic returned a nonfinite value.');
  }
  draws.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const alpha = (1 - confidence) / 2;
  return { estimate: statistic(data), lower: quantile(draws, alpha), upper: quantile(draws, 1 - alpha),
    confidence, samples: data.length, seed, method: `Percentile bootstrap (${iterations} resamples)` };
}

export function pairedTTest(before: readonly number[], after: readonly number[]): ComparisonResult {
  finite(before, 2);
  finite(after, 2);
  if (before.length !== after.length) throw new Error('Paired observations must have the same length and alignment.');
  const differences = after.map((value, index) => value - before[index]);
  const summary = summarize(differences);
  const statistic = summary.standardError > 0 ? summary.mean / summary.standardError : summary.mean === 0 ? 0 : Math.sign(summary.mean) * Infinity;
  const pValue = statistic === 0 ? 1 : 2 * (1 - studentTCdf(Math.abs(statistic), before.length - 1));
  return { difference: summary.mean, statistic, pValue: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, pValue)),
    degreesOfFreedom: before.length - 1, effectSize: summary.standardDeviation ? summary.mean / summary.standardDeviation : 0,
    sampleSize: before.length, method: 'Two-sided paired Student t test; effect size is Cohen dz' };
}

export function welchTTest(first: readonly number[], second: readonly number[]): ComparisonResult {
  finite(first, 2);
  finite(second, 2);
  const a = summarize(first);
  const b = summarize(second);
  const va = a.variance / a.count;
  const vb = b.variance / b.count;
  const error = Math.sqrt(va + vb);
  const difference = b.mean - a.mean;
  const statistic = error ? difference / error : difference === 0 ? 0 : Math.sign(difference) * Infinity;
  const denominator = va * va / (a.count - 1) + vb * vb / (b.count - 1);
  const degreesOfFreedom = denominator ? (va + vb) ** 2 / denominator : a.count + b.count - 2;
  const pooled = Math.sqrt(((a.count - 1) * a.variance + (b.count - 1) * b.variance) / (a.count + b.count - 2));
  return { difference, statistic, degreesOfFreedom, pValue: Math.max(0, 2 * (1 - studentTCdf(Math.abs(statistic), degreesOfFreedom))),
    effectSize: pooled ? difference / pooled : 0, sampleSize: a.count + b.count,
    method: 'Two-sided Welch t test; effect size uses pooled descriptive standard deviation' };
}

export function pairedPermutationTest(before: readonly number[], after: readonly number[], iterations = 10000, seed = 42): ComparisonResult {
  finite(before, 2);
  finite(after, 2);
  if (before.length !== after.length || !Number.isInteger(iterations) || iterations < 100 || iterations > 100000) throw new Error('Invalid paired permutation configuration.');
  const differences = after.map((value, index) => value - before[index]);
  const observed = summarize(differences);
  const random = new Random(seed);
  let extreme = 0;
  for (let trial = 0; trial < iterations; trial++) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (const value of differences) sum += (random.uniform() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * value;
    if (Math.abs(sum / differences.length) >= Math.abs(observed.mean) - 1e-14) extreme++;
  }
  return { difference: observed.mean, statistic: observed.mean, pValue: (extreme + 1) / (iterations + 1),
    effectSize: observed.standardDeviation ? observed.mean / observed.standardDeviation : 0,
    sampleSize: differences.length, method: `Paired sign-flip permutation test (${iterations} samples, seed ${seed})` };
}

export function adjustPValues(values: readonly number[], method: 'holm' | 'bonferroni' | 'benjamini-hochberg' = 'holm'): number[] {
  if (values.some(value => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 1)) throw new Error('P-values must be finite probabilities.');
  const ordered = values.map((value, index) => ({ value, index })).sort((a, b) => a.value - b.value);
  const result = new Array<number>(values.length);
  if (method === 'bonferroni') return values.map(value => Math.min(1, value * values.length));
  if (method === 'holm') {
    let previous = 0;
    ordered.forEach((entry, position) => {
      previous = Math.max(previous, Math.min(1, entry.value * (values.length - position)));
      result[entry.index] = previous;
    });
  } else {
    let previous = 1;
    for (let position = ordered.length - 1; position >= 0; position--) {
      const entry = ordered[position];
      previous = Math.min(previous, entry.value * values.length / (position + 1));
      result[entry.index] = Math.min(1, previous);
    }
  }
  return result;
}

export function wilsonInterval(successes: number, trials: number, z = 1.959963984540054): ConfidenceInterval {
  if (!Number.isInteger(trials) || trials < 1 || !Number.isInteger(successes) || successes < 0 || successes > trials || !(z > 0)) {
    throw new Error('Wilson intervals require a valid success count and positive trial count.');
  }
  const proportion = successes / trials;
  const denominator = 1 + z * z / trials;
  const center = (proportion + z * z / (2 * trials)) / denominator;
  const margin = z * Math.sqrt(proportion * (1 - proportion) / trials + z * z / (4 * trials * trials)) / denominator;
  return { estimate: proportion, lower: Math.max(0, center - margin), upper: Math.min(1, center + margin),
    confidence: 2 * normalCdf(z) - 1, samples: trials, method: `Wilson score interval (z=${z})` };
}

export function normalCdf(value: number): number {
  if (value === Infinity) return 1;
  if (value === -Infinity) return 0;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new Error('The normal CDF requires a numeric argument.');
  const x = Math.abs(value);
  const t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * x);
  const polynomial = t * (0.319381530 + t * (-0.356563782 + t * (1.781477937 + t * (-1.821255978 + t * 1.330274429))));
  const upperTail = Math.exp(-x * x / 2) / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI) * polynomial;
  return value >= 0 ? 1 - upperTail : upperTail;
}

export function pearsonCorrelation(first: readonly number[], second: readonly number[]): number {
  finite(first, 2);
  finite(second, 2);
  if (first.length !== second.length) throw new Error('Correlation vectors must be aligned.');
  const a = summarize(first);
  const b = summarize(second);
  let covariance = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < first.length; index++) covariance += (first[index] - a.mean) * (second[index] - b.mean);
  const denominator = (first.length - 1) * a.standardDeviation * b.standardDeviation;
  return denominator ? Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, covariance / denominator)) : 0;
}

export function effectiveSampleSize(values: readonly number[], maxLag = Math.min(100, Math.floor(values.length / 4))): number {
  const data = finite(values, 4);
  const summary = summarize(data);
  if (!summary.variance) return data.length;
  let correlationSum = 0;
  for (let lag = 1; lag <= maxLag; lag++) {
    let covariance = 0;
    for (let index = lag; index < data.length; index++) covariance += (data[index] - summary.mean) * (data[index - lag] - summary.mean);
    const correlation = covariance / ((data.length - lag) * summary.variance);
    if (correlation <= 0) break;
    correlationSum += correlation;
  }
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(data.length, data.length / (1 + 2 * correlationSum)));
}
