export type RunState = 'idle' | 'running' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'stopped' | 'failed';
export type DemoCategory = 'Classification' | 'Regression' | 'Representation' | 'Reinforcement' | 'Language' | 'Vision';
export interface DemoDefinition {
  id: string; title: string; description: string; category: DemoCategory;
  architecture: number[]; tags: string[]; difficulty: 'Introductory' | 'Intermediate' | 'Advanced';
  accent: string; task: string; inputLabels?: string[]; outputLabels?: string[];
}
export interface RunConfig {
  demoId: string; learningRate: number; maxSteps: number; batchSize: number;
  seed: number; captureEvery: number; hiddenLayers?: number[];
  optimizer?: 'adam' | 'adamw' | 'sgd' | 'momentum' | 'rmsprop';
  weightDecay?: number; dropout?: number; gradientClip?: number;
  schedule?: 'constant' | 'cosine' | 'warmup-cosine'; warmupSteps?: number;
  customDataset?: {
    name?: string; inputs: number[][]; targets: number[][];
    validationInputs?: number[][]; validationTargets?: number[][];
    task: 'classification' | 'regression'; labels?: string[]; featureNames?: string[];
  };
}
export interface MetricPoint { step: number; loss: number; accuracy: number; gradientNorm?: number; timestamp: number; }
export interface LayerData {
  id: string; name: string; size: number; shape: number[];
  activations: number[]; weights: number[][]; gradients: number[]; biases: number[];
}
export interface PredictionSample {
  input: number[]; target: number[]; prediction: number[]; label?: string;
}
export interface RunSnapshot {
  runId: string; demoId: string; state: RunState; step: number; epoch: number;
  loss: number; accuracy: number; learningRate: number; elapsedMs: number;
  metrics: MetricPoint[]; layers: LayerData[]; samples: PredictionSample[];
  parameters: number; device: string; message?: string; seed: number;
  extras?: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface InterventionSpec {
  layer: number; neuron: number; kind: 'ablate' | 'scale' | 'steer'; value: number;
}
export interface InterventionResult {
  before: number[]; after: number[]; delta: number[]; input: number[];
  spec: InterventionSpec; klDivergence?: number;
}
export interface EngineController {
  start(): void; pause(): void; resume(): void; step(): void; stop(): void;
  getSnapshot(): RunSnapshot;
  predict(input: number[], intervention?: InterventionSpec): number[];
  intervene(input: number[], spec: InterventionSpec): InterventionResult;
  exportCheckpoint(): string; importCheckpoint(checkpoint: string): void;
  dispose(): void;
}
export interface SceneProps {
  layers: LayerData[]; mode?: 'activations' | 'weights' | 'gradients';
  onSelect?: (layer: number, neuron: number) => void;
  selected?: { layer: number; neuron: number } | null;
  paused?: boolean; height?: number | string; className?: string;
}

BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/visualization/ArchitectureEditor.tsx

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  analyzeArchitecture,
  connectArchitecture,
  layoutArchitecture,
  parseArchitecture,
  removeArchitectureNode,
  renameArchitectureNode,
  type ArchitectureGraph,
  type ArchitectureOperation,
} from "./architecture";
import { downloadBlob } from "./exports";
import "./visualization.css";

export interface ArchitectureEditorProps {
  graph: ArchitectureGraph;
  onChange?: (graph: ArchitectureGraph) => void;
  readOnly?: boolean;
}
const OPERATION_COLORS: Record<ArchitectureOperation, string> = {
  input: "#22d3ee",
  dense: "#818cf8",
  relu: "#a78bfa",
  tanh: "#a78bfa",
  sigmoid: "#a78bfa",
  softmax: "#fb7185",
  layernorm: "#2dd4bf",
  add: "#fbbf24",
  concat: "#f97316",
  output: "#fb7185",
};

export function ArchitectureEditor({
  graph: initialGraph,
  onChange,
  readOnly = false,
}: ArchitectureEditorProps) {
  const [edited, setEdited] = useState<ArchitectureGraph | null>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [source, setSource] = useState("");
  const [target, setTarget] = useState("");
  const [operation, setOperation] = useState<ArchitectureOperation>("dense");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const graph = edited || initialGraph;
  const analysis = useMemo(() => analyzeArchitecture(graph), [graph]);
  const positions = useMemo(() => layoutArchitecture(graph), [graph]);
  const positionMap = new Map(
    positions.map((position) => [position.id, position]),
  );
  const width = Math.max(740, ...positions.map((position) => position.x + 190));
  const height = Math.max(
    240,
    ...positions.map((position) => position.y + 115),
  );
  const chosen = graph.nodes.find((node) => node.id === selected);
  const save = (next: ArchitectureGraph) => {
    setEdited(next);
    onChange?.(next);
    setError("");
  };
  const connect = () => {
    try {
      save(connectArchitecture(graph, source, target));
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Connection failed.");
    }
  };
  const add = () => {
    if (graph.nodes.length >= 256) {
      setError("Architecture node budget reached.");
      return;
    }
    let counter = graph.nodes.length + 1;
    let id = `${operation}-${counter}`;
    while (graph.nodes.some((node) => node.id === id))
      id = `${operation}-${++counter}`;
    const node = {
      id,
      name: `${operation[0].toUpperCase()}${operation.slice(1)} ${counter}`,
      operation,
      ...(operation === "dense" ? { units: 16 } : {}),
      ...(operation === "input" ? { shape: [4] } : {}),
    };
    save({ ...graph, nodes: [...graph.nodes, node] });
    setSelected(id);
  };
  const load = async (file: File) => {
    try {
      if (file.size > 2000000)
        throw new Error("Architecture file is too large.");
      save(parseArchitecture(await file.text()));
      setSelected(null);
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Import failed.");
    }
  };
  return (
    <section
      className="viz-architecture"
      aria-label="Architecture graph editor"
    >
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <h3>Architecture graph</h3>
        <span className="viz-axis-description">
          {graph.nodes.length} operations ·{" "}
          {analysis.totalParameters.toLocaleString()} inferred parameters
        </span>
        <button
          onClick={() =>
            downloadBlob(
              new Blob([JSON.stringify(graph, null, 2)], {
                type: "application/json",
              }),
              "neuralis-architecture.json",
            )
          }
        >
          Export graph
        </button>
        {!readOnly && (
          <label>
            Import{" "}
            <input
              type="file"
              accept=".json,application/json"
              onChange={(event) => {
                const file = event.target.files?.[0];
                if (file) void load(file);
                event.target.value = "";
              }}
            />
          </label>
        )}
      </div>
      {!readOnly && (
        <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
          <label>
            Operation{" "}
            <select
              value={operation}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setOperation(event.target.value as ArchitectureOperation)
              }
            >
              {Object.keys(OPERATION_COLORS).map((value) => (
                <option key={value}>{value}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <button onClick={add}>Add operation</button>
          <label>
            From{" "}
            <select
              value={source}
              onChange={(event) => setSource(event.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">Select node</option>
              {graph.nodes.map((node) => (
                <option key={node.id} value={node.id}>
                  {node.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            To{" "}
            <select
              value={target}
              onChange={(event) => setTarget(event.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">Select node</option>
              {graph.nodes.map((node) => (
                <option key={node.id} value={node.id}>
                  {node.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <button onClick={connect} disabled={!source || !target}>
            Connect
          </button>
          {edited && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setEdited(null);
                setSelected(null);
              }}
            >
              Restore captured architecture
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p className="viz-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="viz-architecture-layout">
        <div className="viz-architecture-scroll">
          <svg
            viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}
            width={width}
            height={height}
            role="img"
            aria-label="Directed model architecture"
          >
            <defs>
              <marker
                id="architecture-arrow"
                markerWidth="8"
                markerHeight="8"
                refX="7"
                refY="4"
                orient="auto"
              >
                <path d="M0,1 L7,4 L0,7" fill="none" stroke="#6588ae" />
              </marker>
            </defs>
            {graph.edges.map((edge, index) => {
              const a = positionMap.get(edge.source);
              const b = positionMap.get(edge.target);
              if (!a || !b) return null;
              return (
                <path
                  key={`${edge.source}-${edge.target}-${index}`}
                  d={`M${a.x + 132},${a.y + 31} C${(a.x + b.x + 132) / 2},${a.y + 31} ${(a.x + b.x + 132) / 2},${b.y + 31} ${b.x - 5},${b.y + 31}`}
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="#406187"
                  strokeWidth="1.4"
                  markerEnd="url(#architecture-arrow)"
                >
                  <title>
                    {edge.source} → {edge.target}
                  </title>
                </path>
              );
            })}
            {graph.nodes.map((node) => {
              const position = positionMap.get(node.id);
              if (!position) return null;
              const shape = analysis.shapes.get(node.id);
              const invalid = analysis.issues.some(
                (issue) => issue.node === node.id && issue.severity === "error",
              );
              return (
                <g
                  key={node.id}
                  transform={`translate(${position.x}, ${position.y})`}
                  tabIndex={0}
                  role="button"
                  aria-label={`${node.name}, ${node.operation}, shape ${shape?.join(" by ") || "unknown"}`}
                  onClick={() => setSelected(node.id)}
                  onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (event.key === "Enter") setSelected(node.id);
                  }}
                >
                  <rect
                    width="132"
                    height="64"
                    rx="7"
                    fill={selected === node.id ? "#173252" : "#0c1c30"}
                    stroke={
                      invalid
                        ? "#fb7185"
                        : selected === node.id
                          ? "#60c6f2"
                          : "#294565"
                    }
                    strokeWidth={selected === node.id ? 1.8 : 1}
                  />
                  <rect
                    x="0"
                    y="10"
                    width="3"
                    height="44"
                    rx="2"
                    fill={OPERATION_COLORS[node.operation]}
                  />
                  <text x="12" y="19" fill="#d0e1f4" fontSize="10">
                    {node.name.slice(0, 19)}
                  </text>
                  <text
                    x="12"
                    y="36"
                    fill={OPERATION_COLORS[node.operation]}
                    fontSize="9"
                  >
                    {node.operation}
                  </text>
                  <text x="12" y="52" fill="#819bb9" fontSize="9">
                    {shape ? `[${shape.join(" × ")}]` : "Shape pending"}
                  </text>
                </g>
              );
            })}
          </svg>
        </div>
        <aside className="viz-architecture-properties">
          <h4>{chosen ? chosen.name : "Select an operation"}</h4>
          {chosen && (
            <>
              <dl>
                <div>
                  <dt>Operation</dt>
                  <dd>{chosen.operation}</dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>Depth</dt>
                  <dd>{analysis.depth.get(chosen.id) ?? "—"}</dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>Parameters</dt>
                  <dd>
                    {(analysis.parameters.get(chosen.id) || 0).toLocaleString()}
                  </dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>Output shape</dt>
                  <dd>[{analysis.shapes.get(chosen.id)?.join(", ") || "?"}]</dd>
                </div>
              </dl>
              {!readOnly && (
                <div className="viz-architecture-form">
                  <label>
                    Name
                    <input
                      value={chosen.name}
                      maxLength={200}
                      onChange={(event) => {
                        try {
                          save(
                            renameArchitectureNode(
                              graph,
                              chosen.id,
                              event.target.value,
                            ),
                          );
                        } catch {
                          /* Keep the last valid name during an empty edit. */
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                  </label>
                  {chosen.operation === "dense" && (
                    <label>
                      Units
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="1"
                        max="1000000"
                        value={chosen.units || 1}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          save({
                            ...graph,
                            nodes: graph.nodes.map((node) =>
                              node.id === chosen.id
                                ? { ...node, units: Number(event.target.value) }
                                : node,
                            ),
                          })
                        }
                      />
                    </label>
                  )}
                  {chosen.operation === "input" && (
                    <label>
                      Input dimensions
                      <input
                        value={(chosen.shape || []).join(", ")}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          save({
                            ...graph,
                            nodes: graph.nodes.map((node) =>
                              node.id === chosen.id
                                ? {
                                    ...node,
                                    shape: event.target.value
                                      .split(",")
                                      .map((value) => Number(value.trim())),
                                  }
                                : node,
                            ),
                          })
                        }
                      />
                    </label>
                  )}
                  {chosen.operation === "concat" && (
                    <label>
                      Axis
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        value={chosen.axis ?? 0}
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          save({
                            ...graph,
                            nodes: graph.nodes.map((node) =>
                              node.id === chosen.id
                                ? { ...node, axis: Number(event.target.value) }
                                : node,
                            ),
                          })
                        }
                      />
                    </label>
                  )}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      save(removeArchitectureNode(graph, chosen.id));
                      setSelected(null);
                    }}
                  >
                    Remove operation
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          <h4>Validation</h4>
          {analysis.issues.length ? (
            <ul className="viz-architecture-issues">
              {analysis.issues.map((issue, index) => (
                <li key={index} className={`is-${issue.severity}`}>
                  <strong>{issue.node || issue.severity}</strong>
                  {issue.message}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : (
            <p className="viz-valid">Acyclic graph · All shapes resolve</p>
          )}
        </aside>
      </div>
      {!readOnly && graph.edges.length > 0 && (
        <details className="viz-edge-list">
          <summary>Connections ({graph.edges.length})</summary>
          {graph.edges.map((edge, index) => (
            <div key={`${edge.source}-${edge.target}-${index}`}>
              <span>
                {graph.nodes.find((node) => node.id === edge.source)?.name} →{" "}
                {graph.nodes.find((node) => node.id === edge.target)?.name}
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={() =>
                  save({
                    ...graph,
                    edges: graph.edges.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
                  })
                }
              >
                Remove
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </details>
      )}
      <p className="viz-note">
        This editor validates and exports architecture specifications. It does
        not reconfigure a running experiment; use a compatible execution adapter
        to train a custom graph.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export default ArchitectureEditor;

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { attentionEntropy, clamp, finite, validateMatrix } from "./numerics";
import { TensorHeatmap } from "./TensorInspector";
import { exportTensorCSV } from "./exports";
import "./visualization.css";

export interface AttentionViewProps {
  matrix: number[][];
  labels?: string[];
  title?: string;
  causal?: boolean;
  maxTokens?: number;
}

export function AttentionView({
  matrix,
  labels = [],
  title = "Attention explorer",
  causal = false,
  maxTokens = 64,
}: AttentionViewProps) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0);
  const [topK, setTopK] = useState(8);
  const validation = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const shape = validateMatrix(matrix);
      if (
        matrix.some((row) =>
          row.some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0),
        )
      )
        throw new Error(
          "Attention matrices must contain finite, non-negative weights.",
        );
      return { ...shape, error: "" };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        rows: 0,
        columns: 0,
        error:
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Invalid attention matrix.",
      };
    }
  }, [matrix]);
  const query = clamp(selected, 0, Math.max(0, validation.rows - 1));
  const row = matrix[query] || [];
  const total = row.reduce((sum, value) => sum + finite(value), 0);
  const ranked = useMemo(
    () =>
      row
        .map((value, index) => ({ value, index }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
        .slice(0, topK),
    [row, topK],
  );
  const label = (index: number) => labels[index] || `Token ${index}`;
  const graphTokens = Math.min(validation.columns, clamp(maxTokens, 2, 96));
  const centerX = 240;
  const centerY = 190;
  const radius = 132;
  const positions = Array.from({ length: graphTokens }, (_, index) => ({
    x:
      centerX +
      Math.cos((index / graphTokens) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2) * radius,
    y:
      centerY +
      Math.sin((index / graphTokens) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2) * radius,
  }));
  const queryPosition = positions[query];
  if (validation.error)
    return (
      <div className="viz-error" role="alert">
        {validation.error}
      </div>
    );
  if (!validation.rows || !validation.columns)
    return (
      <div className="viz-empty">
        <h3>No attention capture</h3>
        <p>
          This experiment does not expose an attention matrix. Dense connections
          are available in Network geometry.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <section className="viz-attention" aria-label={title}>
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <h3>{title}</h3>
        <label>
          Query{" "}
          <select
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => setSelected(Number(event.target.value))}
          >
            {matrix.map((_, index) => (
              <option key={index} value={index}>
                {index} · {label(index)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          Top keys{" "}
          <input
            type="number"
            min="1"
            max="32"
            value={topK}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setTopK(clamp(Number(event.target.value), 1, 32))
            }
          />
        </label>
        <button onClick={() => exportTensorCSV(matrix, "attention.csv")}>
          Export matrix
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="viz-attention-grid">
        <div className="viz-attention-graph">
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 480 380"
            width="100%"
            role="img"
            aria-label={`Top attention connections for ${label(query)}`}
          >
            <defs>
              <radialGradient id="attention-node">
                <stop stopColor="#6ee7ff" />
                <stop offset="1" stopColor="#3b82f6" />
              </radialGradient>
            </defs>
            <circle
              cx={centerX}
              cy={centerY}
              r={radius}
              fill="none"
              stroke="#224264"
              strokeDasharray="3 5"
            />
            {queryPosition &&
              ranked
                .filter(
                  (item) => item.index < graphTokens && item.index !== query,
                )
                .map((item) => {
                  const target = positions[item.index];
                  const strength = total ? item.value / total : 0;
                  return (
                    <path
                      key={item.index}
                      d={`M${queryPosition.x},${queryPosition.y} Q${centerX},${centerY} ${target.x},${target.y}`}
                      fill="none"
                      stroke={strength > 0.25 ? "#ce80ff" : "#38bdf8"}
                      opacity={0.2 + strength * 0.8}
                      strokeWidth={1 + strength * 7}
                    >
                      <title>
                        {label(query)} → {label(item.index)}:{" "}
                        {(strength * 100).toFixed(2)}%
                      </title>
                    </path>
                  );
                })}
            {positions.map((position, index) => (
              <g
                key={index}
                role="button"
                tabIndex={0}
                aria-label={`Select query ${label(index)}`}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (index < validation.rows) setSelected(index);
                }}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (
                    (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") &&
                    index < validation.rows
                  ) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    setSelected(index);
                  }
                }}
              >
                {index === query && (
                  <circle
                    cx={position.x}
                    cy={position.y}
                    r="16"
                    fill="#a855f7"
                    opacity="0.2"
                  />
                )}
                <circle
                  cx={position.x}
                  cy={position.y}
                  r={index === query ? 8 : 5}
                  fill={index === query ? "#d8a9ff" : "url(#attention-node)"}
                  stroke="#addefe"
                  strokeWidth="0.6"
                />
                <text
                  x={position.x}
                  y={position.y + (position.y > centerY ? 20 : -14)}
                  textAnchor="middle"
                  fill={index === query ? "#e9d5ff" : "#94aec9"}
                  fontSize="10"
                >
                  {label(index).slice(0, 16)}
                </text>
              </g>
            ))}
          </svg>
          <div className="viz-chart-caption">
            <span>
              {causal
                ? "Causal mask expected from source capture"
                : "Connections from supplied attention weights"}
            </span>
            <span>
              {validation.columns > graphTokens
                ? `Showing first ${graphTokens} tokens`
                : `${validation.columns} keys`}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="viz-attention-rank">
          <h4>{label(query)}</h4>
          <dl>
            <div>
              <dt>Row sum</dt>
              <dd>{total.toFixed(5)}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Entropy</dt>
              <dd>{attentionEntropy(row).toFixed(3)} bits</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
          <h4>Most attended keys</h4>
          {ranked.map((item) => (
            <button
              key={item.index}
              onClick={() => {
                if (item.index < validation.rows) setSelected(item.index);
              }}
              title={`Key ${item.index}`}
            >
              <span>{label(item.index)}</span>
              <div>
                <i
                  style={{
                    width: `${total ? (item.value / total) * 100 : 0}%`,
                  }}
                />
              </div>
              <strong>
                {total ? (item.value / total).toFixed(4) : "0.0000"}
              </strong>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <TensorHeatmap
        matrix={matrix}
        title="Query × key attention"
        sequential
        domain={matrix.reduce(
          (max, current) =>
            current.reduce((peak, value) => Math.max(peak, value), max),
          1e-12,
        )}
        onSelect={(rowIndex) => setSelected(rowIndex)}
      />
      <p className="viz-note">
        Display uses the supplied attention capture. Rows are queries, columns
        are keys; ranking probabilities are normalized per row for inspection.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export default AttentionView;

BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/visualization/AttentionWorkbench.tsx

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { AttentionView } from "./AttentionView";
import { TensorHeatmap } from "./TensorInspector";
import {
  attentionHeadDivergence,
  attentionRollout,
  checkCausalMask,
  fuseAttentionHeads,
  headDivergenceMatrix,
  summarizeHeads,
  type LayerAttentionCapture,
  type RolloutOptions,
} from "./attention";
import { clamp } from "./numerics";
import "./visualization.css";

export interface AttentionWorkbenchProps {
  capture: LayerAttentionCapture;
  labels?: string[];
  layerNames?: string[];
  sourceDescription?: string;
}

export function AttentionWorkbench({
  capture,
  labels = [],
  layerNames = [],
  sourceDescription = "Supplied attention capture",
}: AttentionWorkbenchProps) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"heads" | "rollout" | "comparison">("heads");
  const [layerIndex, setLayerIndex] = useState(0);
  const [headIndex, setHeadIndex] = useState(0);
  const [compareHead, setCompareHead] = useState(1);
  const [fusion, setFusion] =
    useState<NonNullable<RolloutOptions["headFusion"]>>("mean");
  const [residual, setResidual] = useState(1);
  const [discard, setDiscard] = useState(0);
  const [startLayer, setStartLayer] = useState(0);
  const layer = clamp(layerIndex, 0, Math.max(0, capture.length - 1));
  const heads = capture[layer] || [];
  const head = clamp(headIndex, 0, Math.max(0, heads.length - 1));
  const other = clamp(compareHead, 0, Math.max(0, heads.length - 1));
  const result = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const summaries = summarizeHeads(heads);
      const matrix =
        tab === "rollout"
          ? attentionRollout(capture, {
              startLayer: Math.min(startLayer, layer),
              endLayer: layer,
              residualWeight: residual,
              discardFraction: discard,
              headFusion: fusion,
            })
          : heads[head] || [];
      const differences =
        tab === "comparison" && heads[other]
          ? matrix.map((row, query) =>
              row.map((value, key) => value - heads[other][query][key]),
            )
          : [];
      const divergence =
        tab === "comparison" && heads[other]
          ? attentionHeadDivergence(matrix, heads[other])
          : 0;
      const divergences =
        tab === "comparison" ? headDivergenceMatrix(heads) : [];
      const causal =
        matrix.length && matrix.length === matrix[0].length
          ? checkCausalMask(matrix)
          : null;
      return {
        matrix,
        differences,
        divergence,
        divergences,
        summaries,
        causal,
        error: "",
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        matrix: [],
        differences: [],
        divergence: 0,
        divergences: [],
        summaries: [],
        causal: null,
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Attention computation failed.",
      };
    }
  }, [
    capture,
    heads,
    head,
    other,
    tab,
    layer,
    startLayer,
    residual,
    discard,
    fusion,
  ]);
  if (!capture.length || !heads.length)
    return (
      <div className="viz-empty">
        <h3>No multi-head capture</h3>
        <p>
          This tool requires actual layer × head × query × key attention arrays.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <section className="viz-attention-workbench">
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <div className="viz-tab-list">
          {(["heads", "rollout", "comparison"] as const).map((value) => (
            <button
              key={value}
              aria-pressed={tab === value}
              onClick={() => setTab(value)}
            >
              {value}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <label>
          Layer{" "}
          <select
            value={layer}
            onChange={(event) => setLayerIndex(Number(event.target.value))}
          >
            {capture.map((_, index) => (
              <option key={index} value={index}>
                {layerNames[index] || `Layer ${index}`}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        {tab !== "rollout" && (
          <label>
            Head{" "}
            <select
              value={head}
              onChange={(event) => setHeadIndex(Number(event.target.value))}
            >
              {heads.map((_, index) => (
                <option key={index} value={index}>
                  Head {index}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        )}
        {tab === "comparison" && (
          <label>
            Compare{" "}
            <select
              value={other}
              onChange={(event) => setCompareHead(Number(event.target.value))}
            >
              {heads.map((_, index) => (
                <option key={index} value={index}>
                  Head {index}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        )}
      </div>
      {tab === "rollout" && (
        <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
          <label>
            From layer{" "}
            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              max={layer}
              value={Math.min(startLayer, layer)}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setStartLayer(clamp(Number(event.target.value), 0, layer))
              }
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Head fusion{" "}
            <select
              value={fusion}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setFusion(
                  event.target.value as NonNullable<
                    RolloutOptions["headFusion"]
                  >,
                )
              }
            >
              <option>mean</option>
              <option>max</option>
              <option>min</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            Residual weight{" "}
            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              max="100"
              step="0.1"
              value={residual}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setResidual(clamp(Number(event.target.value), 0, 100))
              }
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Discard weakest{" "}
            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              max="0.99"
              step="0.05"
              value={discard}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setDiscard(clamp(Number(event.target.value), 0, 0.99))
              }
            />
          </label>
        </div>
      )}
      {result.error ? (
        <p className="viz-error" role="alert">
          {result.error}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <AttentionView
            matrix={result.matrix}
            labels={labels}
            title={
              tab === "rollout" ? "Attention rollout" : `Attention head ${head}`
            }
            causal={result.causal?.valid}
          />
          {tab === "comparison" && (
            <>
              <div className="viz-comparison-metrics">
                <div>
                  <span>Head Jensen–Shannon divergence</span>
                  <strong>{result.divergence.toFixed(5)} bits</strong>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="viz-inspector-grid">
                <TensorHeatmap
                  matrix={result.differences}
                  title={`Head ${head} minus head ${other}`}
                />
                <TensorHeatmap
                  matrix={result.divergences}
                  sequential
                  domain={1}
                  title="Pairwise head divergence (bits)"
                />
              </div>
            </>
          )}
          <div className="viz-table-scroll">
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Head</th>
                  <th>Mean entropy</th>
                  <th>Mean self attention</th>
                  <th>Mean maximum</th>
                  <th>Nonzero weights</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {result.summaries.map((summary) => (
                  <tr key={summary.head}>
                    <td>{summary.head}</td>
                    <td>{summary.meanEntropy.toFixed(4)} bits</td>
                    <td>{(summary.meanSelfAttention * 100).toFixed(2)}%</td>
                    <td>{(summary.meanMaxAttention * 100).toFixed(2)}%</td>
                    <td>{(summary.nonzeroFraction * 100).toFixed(2)}%</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          {result.causal && (
            <p className="viz-note">
              Upper-triangle mask check:{" "}
              {result.causal.valid
                ? "no future-token leakage above 10⁻⁸"
                : `${result.causal.violations} violations, total leakage ${result.causal.leakage.toPrecision(4)}`}
              .
            </p>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      <p className="viz-note">
        {sourceDescription}.{" "}
        {tab === "rollout"
          ? "Rollout fuses measured heads, discards selected weak non-diagonal entries, adds an explicit identity residual and left-multiplies normalized transitions. This is an attention-path heuristic, not a causal attribution."
          : "Head summaries and comparisons are computed from normalized source rows; zero-mass rows remain zero."}
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export default AttentionWorkbench;

BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/visualization/EmbeddingView.tsx

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  clamp,
  projectPCA,
  rgbCss,
  divergingColor,
  type Projection,
} from "./numerics";
import { exportTensorCSV } from "./exports";
import "./visualization.css";

export interface EmbeddingViewProps {
  vectors: number[][];
  labels?: string[];
  groups?: string[];
  title?: string;
  onSelect?: (index: number) => void;
}
const GROUP_COLORS = [
  "#38bdf8",
  "#a78bfa",
  "#2dd4bf",
  "#fb7185",
  "#fbbf24",
  "#c084fc",
  "#f97316",
  "#93c5fd",
];

export function EmbeddingView({
  vectors,
  labels = [],
  groups = [],
  title = "Embedding projection",
  onSelect,
}: EmbeddingViewProps) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [axisX, setAxisX] = useState(0);
  const [axisY, setAxisY] = useState(1);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [showLabels, setShowLabels] = useState(false);
  const projection = useMemo<{
    value: Projection | null;
    error: string;
  }>(() => {
    try {
      return { value: projectPCA(vectors), error: "" };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        value: null,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Projection failed.",
      };
    }
  }, [vectors]);
  const points = projection.value?.points || [];
  const groupNames = Array.from(new Set(groups));
  const scale =
    Math.max(
      1e-9,
      ...points.flatMap((point) => [
        Math.abs(point[axisX]),
        Math.abs(point[axisY]),
      ]),
    ) / zoom;
  const location = (index: number) => ({
    x: 360 + (points[index][axisX] / scale) * 310,
    y: 220 - (points[index][axisY] / scale) * 175,
  });
  const choose = (index: number) => {
    setSelected(index);
    onSelect?.(index);
  };
  if (projection.error)
    return (
      <div className="viz-error" role="alert">
        {projection.error}
      </div>
    );
  if (!vectors.length)
    return (
      <div className="viz-empty">
        <h3>No embedding vectors captured</h3>
        <p>
          Supply captured representations to compute a centered PCA projection.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <section className="viz-embeddings" aria-label={title}>
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <h3>{title}</h3>
        <label>
          Horizontal{" "}
          <select
            value={axisX}
            onChange={(event) => setAxisX(Number(event.target.value))}
          >
            {[0, 1, 2].map((axis) => (
              <option key={axis} value={axis}>
                PC {axis + 1}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          Vertical{" "}
          <select
            value={axisY}
            onChange={(event) => setAxisY(Number(event.target.value))}
          >
            {[0, 1, 2].map((axis) => (
              <option key={axis} value={axis}>
                PC {axis + 1}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowLabels((value) => !value)}
          aria-pressed={showLabels}
        >
          Labels
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => exportTensorCSV(points, "pca-projection.csv")}>
          Export PCA
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="viz-embedding-layout">
        <div>
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 720 440"
            width="100%"
            role="img"
            aria-label={`Centered PCA projection of ${vectors.length} captured vectors`}
            onWheel={(event) =>
              setZoom((value) =>
                clamp(value * (event.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1), 0.2, 8),
              )
            }
          >
            <defs>
              <clipPath id="embedding-clip">
                <rect x="35" y="30" width="650" height="375" />
              </clipPath>
            </defs>
            <rect
              x="35"
              y="30"
              width="650"
              height="375"
              fill="#07101f"
              stroke="#1c3048"
            />
            {[-0.75, -0.5, -0.25, 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75].map((fraction) => (
              <g key={fraction}>
                <line
                  x1={360 + fraction * 310}
                  x2={360 + fraction * 310}
                  y1="30"
                  y2="405"
                  stroke={fraction ? "#15273d" : "#2d4e6f"}
                />
                <line
                  x1="35"
                  x2="685"
                  y1={220 + fraction * 175}
                  y2={220 + fraction * 175}
                  stroke={fraction ? "#15273d" : "#2d4e6f"}
                />
              </g>
            ))}
            <g clipPath="url(#embedding-clip)">
              {points.map((point, index) => {
                const position = location(index);
                const color = groups[index]
                  ? GROUP_COLORS[
                      groupNames.indexOf(groups[index]) % GROUP_COLORS.length
                    ]
                  : rgbCss(divergingColor(point[2], scale));
                return (
                  <g
                    key={index}
                    tabIndex={0}
                    role="button"
                    aria-label={`Select vector ${labels[index] || index}`}
                    onClick={() => choose(index)}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key === "Enter") choose(index);
                    }}
                  >
                    <circle
                      cx={position.x}
                      cy={position.y}
                      r={selected === index ? 6 : 3.5}
                      fill={color}
                      fillOpacity={selected === index ? 1 : 0.72}
                      stroke={selected === index ? "#ffffff" : "none"}
                    >
                      <title>
                        {labels[index] || `Vector ${index}`}: [
                        {point.map((value) => value.toPrecision(3)).join(", ")}]
                      </title>
                    </circle>
                    {showLabels && points.length <= 120 && (
                      <text
                        x={position.x + 7}
                        y={position.y - 5}
                        fontSize="9"
                        fill="#b5c7de"
                      >
                        {labels[index] || index}
                      </text>
                    )}
                  </g>
                );
              })}
            </g>
            <text
              x="360"
              y="429"
              textAnchor="middle"
              fill="#8aa2be"
              fontSize="11"
            >
              Principal component {axisX + 1}
            </text>
            <text
              x="12"
              y="220"
              transform="rotate(-90 12 220)"
              textAnchor="middle"
              fill="#8aa2be"
              fontSize="11"
            >
              Principal component {axisY + 1}
            </text>
          </svg>
          <div className="viz-chart-caption">
            <span>
              {vectors.length.toLocaleString()} vectors · {vectors[0].length}{" "}
              dimensions
            </span>
            <label>
              Zoom{" "}
              <input
                aria-label="Embedding zoom"
                type="range"
                min="0.2"
                max="8"
                step="0.1"
                value={zoom}
                onChange={(event) => setZoom(Number(event.target.value))}
              />
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside className="viz-embedding-summary">
          <h4>Explained variance</h4>
          {[0, 1, 2].map((index) => (
            <div className="viz-variance-row" key={index}>
              <span>PC {index + 1}</span>
              <strong>
                {(
                  (projection.value?.explainedVariance[index] || 0) * 100
                ).toFixed(2)}
                %
              </strong>
            </div>
          ))}
          <p>
            Centered PCA, computed from these vectors. Missing rank dimensions
            are zero.
          </p>
          {groupNames.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <h4>Source groups</h4>
              {groupNames.map((group, index) => (
                <div className="viz-variance-row" key={group}>
                  <span>
                    <i
                      style={{
                        background: GROUP_COLORS[index % GROUP_COLORS.length],
                      }}
                    />
                    {group}
                  </span>
                  <strong>
                    {groups.filter((value) => value === group).length}
                  </strong>
                </div>
              ))}
            </>
          )}
          {selected !== null && (
            <>
              <h4>Selected vector</h4>
              <strong>{labels[selected] || `Vector ${selected}`}</strong>
              <dl>
                {points[selected].map((value, axis) => (
                  <div key={axis}>
                    <dt>PC {axis + 1}</dt>
                    <dd>{value.toPrecision(5)}</dd>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </dl>
            </>
          )}
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p className="viz-note">
        PCA preserves directions of greatest variance; visual proximity is a
        projection and does not establish semantic equivalence.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export default EmbeddingView;

import {
  Component,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { Canvas, useThree, type ThreeEvent } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { Grid, Html, OrbitControls } from "@react-three/drei";
import * as THREE from "three";
import type { OrbitControls as OrbitControlsImpl } from "three-stdlib";
import type { LayerData, SceneProps } from "../types";
import {
  divergingColor,
  finite,
  layerValues,
  neuronPosition,
  sampledIndices,
  selectEdges,
  symmetricDomain,
  type EdgeRecord,
} from "./numerics";
import { exportCanvasImage } from "./exports";
import { SceneViewControls } from "./SceneViewControls";
import {
  loadViewSettings,
  saveViewSettings,
  type CameraBookmark,
} from "./viewState";
import "./visualization.css";

interface BoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallback: ReactNode;
}
class SceneBoundary extends Component<BoundaryProps, { failed: boolean }> {
  state = { failed: false };
  static getDerivedStateFromError() {
    return { failed: true };
  }
  render() {
    return this.state.failed ? this.props.fallback : this.props.children;
  }
}

function supportsWebGL(): boolean {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return false;
  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    const context = canvas.getContext("webgl2") || canvas.getContext("webgl");
    if (!context) return false;
    context.getExtension("WEBGL_lose_context")?.loseContext();
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

interface NeuronInstancesProps {
  layer: LayerData;
  layerIndex: number;
  layerCount: number;
  indices: number[];
  values: number[];
  domain: number;
  selected: SceneProps["selected"];
  onSelect: SceneProps["onSelect"];
}

function NeuronInstances({
  layer,
  layerIndex,
  layerCount,
  indices,
  values,
  domain,
  selected,
  onSelect,
}: NeuronInstancesProps) {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.InstancedMesh>(null);
  const dummy = useMemo(() => new THREE.Object3D(), []);
  const color = useMemo(() => new THREE.Color(), []);
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<number | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const mesh = ref.current;
    if (!mesh) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < indices.length; i++) {
      const neuron = indices[i];
      const value = finite(values[neuron]);
      const chosen =
        selected?.layer === layerIndex && selected.neuron === neuron;
      const radius = chosen
        ? 0.21
        : 0.11 + Math.min(0.065, (Math.abs(value) / domain) * 0.045);
      dummy.position.set(
        ...neuronPosition(layerIndex, neuron, layer.size, layerCount),
      );
      dummy.scale.setScalar(radius);
      dummy.updateMatrix();
      mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
      const rgb = chosen ? [1, 0.95, 0.7] : divergingColor(value, domain);
      color.setRGB(rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2]);
      mesh.setColorAt(i, color);
    }
    mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    if (mesh.instanceColor) mesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
    mesh.computeBoundingSphere();
  }, [
    indices,
    values,
    domain,
    selected,
    layerIndex,
    layerCount,
    layer.size,
    dummy,
    color,
  ]);
  const pick = (event: ThreeEvent<MouseEvent>) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (event.instanceId !== undefined)
      onSelect?.(layerIndex, indices[event.instanceId]);
  };
  return (
    <group>
      <instancedMesh
        ref={ref}
        args={[undefined, undefined, indices.length]}
        onClick={pick}
        onPointerOver={(event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          if (event.instanceId !== undefined)
            setHovered(indices[event.instanceId]);
        }}
        onPointerOut={() => setHovered(null)}
      >
        <sphereGeometry args={[1, 14, 10]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial
          roughness={0.3}
          metalness={0.35}
          emissive="#0a1e37"
          emissiveIntensity={0.65}
        />
      </instancedMesh>
      {hovered !== null && (
        <Html
          position={neuronPosition(layerIndex, hovered, layer.size, layerCount)}
          distanceFactor={13}
          center
          style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}
        >
          <div className="viz-node-tooltip">
            <strong>{layer.name}</strong>
            <span>
              Neuron {hovered} · {finite(values[hovered]).toPrecision(4)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </Html>
      )}
    </group>
  );
}

function Connections({
  layers,
  edges,
  opacity,
}: {
  layers: LayerData[];
  edges: EdgeRecord[];
  opacity: number;
}) {
  const geometry = useMemo(() => {
    const positions = new Float32Array(edges.length * 6);
    const colors = new Float32Array(edges.length * 6);
    const domain = symmetricDomain(edges.map((edge) => edge.weight));
    edges.forEach((edge, index) => {
      const source = neuronPosition(
        edge.sourceLayer,
        edge.source,
        layers[edge.sourceLayer].size,
        layers.length,
      );
      const target = neuronPosition(
        edge.targetLayer,
        edge.target,
        layers[edge.targetLayer].size,
        layers.length,
      );
      positions.set(source, index * 6);
      positions.set(target, index * 6 + 3);
      const color = divergingColor(edge.weight, domain);
      colors.set(color, index * 6);
      colors.set(color, index * 6 + 3);
    });
    const buffer = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    buffer.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
    buffer.setAttribute("color", new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    buffer.computeBoundingSphere();
    return buffer;
  }, [edges, layers]);
  useEffect(() => () => geometry.dispose(), [geometry]);
  return (
    <lineSegments geometry={geometry}>
      <lineBasicMaterial
        vertexColors
        transparent
        opacity={opacity}
        depthWrite={false}
      />
    </lineSegments>
  );
}

function LayerPlanes({ layers }: { layers: LayerData[] }) {
  return (
    <group>
      {layers.map((layer, index) => {
        const x = neuronPosition(index, 0, layer.size, layers.length)[0];
        return (
          <group key={`${layer.id}-${index}`} position={[x, 0, 0]}>
            <mesh rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
              <planeGeometry args={[6.2, 6.2]} />
              <meshBasicMaterial
                color={
                  index === 0
                    ? "#22d3ee"
                    : index === layers.length - 1
                      ? "#f472b6"
                      : "#8b5cf6"
                }
                transparent
                opacity={0.028}
                side={THREE.DoubleSide}
                depthWrite={false}
              />
            </mesh>
            <Html
              position={[0, -4, 0]}
              center
              distanceFactor={18}
              style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}
            >
              <div className="viz-layer-label">
                <span>
                  {index === 0
                    ? "INPUT"
                    : index === layers.length - 1
                      ? "OUTPUT"
                      : `LAYER ${index}`}
                </span>
                <strong>{layer.name}</strong>
                <small>{layer.size.toLocaleString()} units</small>
              </div>
            </Html>
          </group>
        );
      })}
    </group>
  );
}

type CameraLocation = Pick<CameraBookmark, "position" | "target" | "zoom">;
function SceneNavigation({
  command,
  onReady,
  maxDistance,
}: {
  command: CameraLocation | null;
  onReady: (capture: () => CameraLocation) => void;
  maxDistance: number;
}) {
  const { camera, invalidate } = useThree();
  const controls = useRef<OrbitControlsImpl>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    onReady(() => ({
      position: camera.position.toArray() as [number, number, number],
      target: (controls.current?.target.toArray() as [
        number,
        number,
        number,
      ]) || [0, 0, 0],
      zoom: camera.zoom,
    }));
  }, [camera, onReady]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!command) return;
    camera.position.set(...command.position);
    camera.zoom = command.zoom;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    if (controls.current) {
      controls.current.target.set(...command.target);
      controls.current.update();
    }
    camera.lookAt(...command.target);
    invalidate();
  }, [command, camera, invalidate]);
  return (
    <OrbitControls
      ref={controls}
      makeDefault
      enableDamping
      dampingFactor={0.08}
      minDistance={3}
      maxDistance={maxDistance}
    />
  );
}

function NetworkFallback({ layers, mode, onSelect }: SceneProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className="viz-fallback"
      role="region"
      aria-label="Neural network data"
    >
      <p>
        WebGL is unavailable. Explore the captured network through the
        accessible data view.
      </p>
      <div className="viz-fallback-layers">
        {layers.map((layer, layerIndex) => (
          <div key={`${layer.id}-${layerIndex}`}>
            <h4>{layer.name}</h4>
            <small>{layer.size} units</small>
            <div>
              {sampledIndices(layer.size, 24).map((neuron) => (
                <button
                  key={neuron}
                  onClick={() => onSelect?.(layerIndex, neuron)}
                  title={`Select ${layer.name}, neuron ${neuron}`}
                >
                  <span>{neuron}</span>
                  <strong>
                    {finite(
                      layerValues(layer, mode || "activations")[neuron],
                    ).toPrecision(3)}
                  </strong>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            {layer.size > 24 && <small>Showing 24 evenly sampled units.</small>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function NetworkScene({
  layers,
  mode = "activations",
  selected,
  onSelect,
  paused,
  height = 480,
  className = "",
}: SceneProps) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [webgl, setWebgl] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [reset, setReset] = useState(0);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(() =>
    loadViewSettings("neuralis.visualization.view"),
  );
  const { showEdges, edgeBudget, edgeOpacity: opacity } = settings;
  const [cameraCommand, setCameraCommand] = useState<CameraLocation | null>(
    null,
  );
  const captureCamera = useRef<(() => CameraLocation) | null>(null);
  const registerCapture = useCallback((capture: () => CameraLocation) => {
    captureCamera.current = capture;
  }, []);
  const [internalSelected, setInternalSelected] =
    useState<SceneProps["selected"]>(null);
  const activeSelected = selected !== undefined ? selected : internalSelected;
  const selectUnit = (layer: number, neuron: number) => {
    setInternalSelected({ layer, neuron });
    onSelect?.(layer, neuron);
  };
  const [exportError, setExportError] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    setWebgl(supportsWebGL());
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    saveViewSettings("neuralis.visualization.view", settings);
  }, [settings]);
  const networkId = useMemo(() => {
    const identity = layers
      .map((layer) => `${layer.id}:${layer.size}`)
      .join("|");
    let hash = 2166136261;
    for (let i = 0; i < identity.length; i++)
      hash = Math.imul(hash ^ identity.charCodeAt(i), 16777619);
    return (hash >>> 0).toString(16);
  }, [layers]);
  const indices = useMemo(
    () =>
      layers.map((layer) =>
        sampledIndices(
          layer.size,
          Math.min(
            512,
            Math.max(
              1,
              Math.floor(settings.nodeBudget / Math.max(layers.length, 1)),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    [layers, settings.nodeBudget],
  );
  const values = useMemo(
    () => layers.map((layer) => layerValues(layer, mode)),
    [layers, mode],
  );
  const domain = useMemo(() => symmetricDomain(values.flat()), [values]);
  const visible = useMemo(
    () => new Map(indices.map((neurons, index) => [index, new Set(neurons)])),
    [indices],
  );
  const edges = useMemo(
    () =>
      showEdges
        ? selectEdges(layers, edgeBudget, settings.weightThreshold, visible)
        : [],
    [layers, showEdges, edgeBudget, visible, settings.weightThreshold],
  );
  const unitCount = layers.reduce((sum, layer) => sum + layer.size, 0);
  const renderedCount = indices.reduce((sum, index) => sum + index.length, 0);
  const download = async () => {
    const canvas = root.current?.querySelector("canvas");
    if (!canvas) return;
    try {
      await exportCanvasImage(canvas, "neuralis-network.png");
      setExportError("");
    } catch (error) {
      setExportError(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Image export failed.",
      );
    }
  };
  const fallback = (
    <NetworkFallback layers={layers} mode={mode} onSelect={selectUnit} />
  );
  if (!layers.length)
    return (
      <div className={`viz-network viz-empty ${className}`} style={{ height }}>
        <div className="viz-empty-symbol">◇</div>
        <h3>No captured network yet</h3>
        <p>
          Start an experiment to inspect real activations, weights and
          gradients.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <div
      ref={root}
      className={`viz-network ${className}`}
      style={{ minHeight: height }}
    >
      <div className="viz-scene-toolbar">
        <div>
          <span className={`viz-status-dot ${paused ? "is-paused" : ""}`} />
          <strong>Network geometry</strong>
          <small>
            {renderedCount.toLocaleString()} / {unitCount.toLocaleString()}{" "}
            units
          </small>
        </div>
        <div>
          <button
            onClick={() =>
              setSettings((value) => ({
                ...value,
                showEdges: !value.showEdges,
              }))
            }
            aria-pressed={showEdges}
          >
            Connections
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setCameraCommand(null);
              setReset((value) => value + 1);
            }}
          >
            Reset view
          </button>
          <button onClick={download} disabled={!webgl}>
            Export PNG
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="viz-scene-canvas" style={{ height }}>
        {webgl === null ? (
          <div className="viz-empty">Preparing renderer…</div>
        ) : !webgl ? (
          fallback
        ) : (
          <SceneBoundary fallback={fallback}>
            <Canvas
              key={reset}
              camera={{
                position: [
                  Math.max(8, layers.length * 2.6),
                  5,
                  Math.max(13, layers.length * 3),
                ],
                fov: 42,
                near: 0.1,
                far: Math.max(200, layers.length * 20),
              }}
              gl={{
                antialias: true,
                alpha: true,
                preserveDrawingBuffer: true,
                powerPreference: "high-performance",
              }}
              dpr={[1, 1.75]}
              onPointerMissed={() => {
                /* Selection intentionally persists while navigating. */
              }}
            >
              <color attach="background" args={["#07101f"]} />
              <ambientLight intensity={1.1} />
              <directionalLight position={[5, 10, 12]} intensity={2.2} />
              <pointLight
                position={[-12, 2, 5]}
                color="#22d3ee"
                intensity={15}
                distance={30}
              />
              <pointLight
                position={[12, 2, 3]}
                color="#a855f7"
                intensity={18}
                distance={30}
              />
              <Grid
                position={[0, -3.7, 0]}
                args={[Math.max(40, layers.length * 6), 35]}
                cellSize={1}
                cellThickness={0.35}
                cellColor="#153345"
                sectionSize={5}
                sectionThickness={0.6}
                sectionColor="#1c5776"
                fadeDistance={60}
                infiniteGrid
              />
              <LayerPlanes layers={layers} />
              <Connections layers={layers} edges={edges} opacity={opacity} />
              {layers.map((layer, index) => (
                <NeuronInstances
                  key={`${layer.id}-${index}`}
                  layer={layer}
                  layerIndex={index}
                  layerCount={layers.length}
                  indices={indices[index]}
                  values={values[index]}
                  domain={domain}
                  selected={activeSelected}
                  onSelect={selectUnit}
                />
              ))}
              <SceneNavigation
                command={cameraCommand}
                onReady={registerCapture}
                maxDistance={Math.max(80, layers.length * 15)}
              />
            </Canvas>
          </SceneBoundary>
        )}
        <div className="viz-scene-corner">
          <span>● {mode.toUpperCase()}</span>
          <small>
            {mode === "weights"
              ? "Node color: mean incoming weight"
              : mode === "gradients"
                ? "Node color: captured unit gradient"
                : "Node color: captured activation"}
          </small>
          <small>
            Drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom · Click a unit to inspect
          </small>
        </div>
        <div className="viz-color-legend">
          <span>−{domain.toPrecision(2)}</span>
          <div />
          <span>+{domain.toPrecision(2)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="viz-scene-footer">
        <label>
          Top |weight| edges{" "}
          <input
            aria-label="Connection budget"
            type="range"
            min="0"
            max="4000"
            step="100"
            value={edgeBudget}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setSettings((value) => ({
                ...value,
                edgeBudget: Number(event.target.value),
              }))
            }
          />
          <output>{edges.length.toLocaleString()}</output>
        </label>
        <label>
          Opacity{" "}
          <input
            aria-label="Connection opacity"
            type="range"
            min="0.03"
            max="0.7"
            step="0.01"
            value={opacity}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setSettings((value) => ({
                ...value,
                edgeOpacity: Number(event.target.value),
              }))
            }
          />
        </label>
        <span>Bounded geometry · Actual captured tensors</span>
      </div>
      <SceneViewControls
        settings={settings}
        onChange={setSettings}
        onCapture={() => captureCamera.current?.() || null}
        onNavigate={setCameraCommand}
        selection={activeSelected}
        layerCount={layers.length}
        networkId={networkId}
      />
      {exportError && (
        <p className="viz-error" role="alert">
          {exportError}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { EmbeddingView } from "./EmbeddingView";
import { ResidualView } from "./ResearchViews";
import { Histogram, TensorHeatmap } from "./TensorInspector";
import {
  analyzeTrajectory,
  compareRepresentations,
  cosineSimilarityMatrix,
  representationDrift,
  trajectoryTurns,
} from "./representations";
import { exportTensorCSV } from "./exports";
import "./visualization.css";

export interface RepresentationInspectorProps {
  vectors: number[][];
  labels?: string[];
  groups?: string[];
  reference?: number[][];
  referenceLabel?: string;
  title?: string;
}

export function RepresentationInspector({
  vectors,
  labels,
  groups,
  reference,
  referenceLabel = "Reference capture",
  title = "Representation analysis",
}: RepresentationInspectorProps) {
  const result = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const matrix = vectors.length ? cosineSimilarityMatrix(vectors) : [];
      const comparison =
        reference?.length && vectors.length
          ? compareRepresentations(reference, vectors)
          : null;
      const drift =
        reference?.length &&
        vectors.length &&
        reference[0].length === vectors[0].length
          ? representationDrift(reference, vectors)
          : null;
      return { matrix, comparison, drift, error: "" };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        matrix: [],
        comparison: null,
        drift: null,
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Representation analysis failed.",
      };
    }
  }, [vectors, reference]);
  return (
    <section className="viz-representation-inspector">
      <EmbeddingView
        vectors={vectors}
        labels={labels}
        groups={groups}
        title={title}
      />
      {result.error && (
        <p className="viz-error" role="alert">
          {result.error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="viz-slice-reduction">
        <TensorHeatmap
          matrix={result.matrix}
          title="Original-space cosine similarity"
          domain={1}
          height={300}
        />
      </div>
      {result.comparison && (
        <>
          <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
            <h3>Aligned sample comparison</h3>
            <span className="viz-axis-description">
              {referenceLabel} · {result.comparison.samples} samples
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="viz-comparison-metrics">
            <div>
              <span>Linear CKA</span>
              <strong>{result.comparison.cka.toFixed(5)}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>Distance correlation</span>
              <strong>
                {result.comparison.pairwiseDistanceCorrelation.toFixed(5)}
              </strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>Reference dimensions</span>
              <strong>{result.comparison.leftDimensions}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>Current dimensions</span>
              <strong>{result.comparison.rightDimensions}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>Mean captured norm</span>
              <strong>{result.comparison.rightMeanNorm.toPrecision(5)}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {result.drift && (
        <>
          <Histogram
            values={result.drift.absolute}
            title="Elementwise representation drift"
          />
          <Histogram
            values={result.drift.cosine}
            title="Similarity to reference sample"
          />
        </>
      )}
      <p className="viz-note">
        Cosine and CKA operate on original representations. Comparison requires
        the same samples in the same order. Linear CKA uses centered Gram
        matrices and returns zero for a constant representation.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export interface TrajectoryInspectorProps {
  trajectories: number[][][];
  labels?: string[];
  layerLabels?: string[];
}
export function TrajectoryInspector({
  trajectories,
  labels = [],
  layerLabels = [],
}: TrajectoryInspectorProps) {
  const result = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      return {
        steps: trajectories.map((trajectory) => analyzeTrajectory(trajectory)),
        turns: trajectories.map((trajectory) => trajectoryTurns(trajectory)),
        error: "",
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        steps: [],
        turns: [],
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Trajectory analysis failed.",
      };
    }
  }, [trajectories]);
  return (
    <section className="viz-representation-inspector">
      <ResidualView
        trajectories={trajectories}
        labels={labels}
        layerLabels={layerLabels}
      />
      {result.error && (
        <p className="viz-error" role="alert">
          {result.error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <h3>Layer-wise representation movement</h3>
        <button
          onClick={() =>
            exportTensorCSV(
              result.steps.flatMap((steps, trajectory) =>
                steps.map((step) => [
                  trajectory,
                  step.layer,
                  step.norm,
                  step.displacement,
                  step.relativeDisplacement,
                  step.cosineToPrevious,
                  step.cosineToInitial,
                  step.accumulatedDistance,
                ]),
              ),
              "residual-trajectory-statistics.csv",
            )
          }
        >
          Export metrics
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="viz-table-scroll">
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Trajectory</th>
              <th>Layer</th>
              <th>Norm</th>
              <th>Step distance</th>
              <th>Relative step</th>
              <th>Previous cosine</th>
              <th>Initial cosine</th>
              <th>Path length</th>
              <th>Turn</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {result.steps.flatMap((steps, trajectory) =>
              steps.map((step) => (
                <tr key={`${trajectory}-${step.layer}`}>
                  <td>{labels[trajectory] || trajectory}</td>
                  <td>{layerLabels[step.layer] || step.layer}</td>
                  <td>{step.norm.toPrecision(4)}</td>
                  <td>{step.displacement.toPrecision(4)}</td>
                  <td>{step.relativeDisplacement.toPrecision(4)}</td>
                  <td>{step.cosineToPrevious.toFixed(4)}</td>
                  <td>{step.cosineToInitial.toFixed(4)}</td>
                  <td>{step.accumulatedDistance.toPrecision(4)}</td>
                  <td>
                    {step.layer >= 2
                      ? `${((result.turns[trajectory][step.layer - 2] * 180) / Math.PI).toFixed(1)}°`
                      : "—"}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )),
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <p className="viz-note">
        Movement and turn angles use original-dimensional captured vectors; all
        trajectories must retain a consistent representation dimension. Zero
        reference norms yield relative displacement zero.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}
