import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { LayerData, SceneProps } from "../types";
import NetworkScene from "./NetworkScene";
import {
  clamp,
  compareVectors,
  cosineSimilarity,
  projectPCA,
  selectEdges,
  summarize,
  type Projection,
  type Vector3Tuple,
} from "./numerics";
import { Histogram, TensorHeatmap } from "./TensorInspector";
import "./visualization.css";

export interface ResidualViewProps {
  trajectories: number[][][];
  labels?: string[];
  layerLabels?: string[];
  title?: string;
}

export function ResidualView({
  trajectories,
  labels = [],
  layerLabels = [],
  title = "Residual trajectories",
}: ResidualViewProps) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0);
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(true);
  const result = useMemo<{
    projection: Projection | null;
    points: Vector3Tuple[][];
    error: string;
  }>(() => {
    try {
      const projection = projectPCA(trajectories.flat());
      let offset = 0;
      const points = trajectories.map((trajectory) => {
        const slice = projection.points.slice(
          offset,
          offset + trajectory.length,
        );
        offset += trajectory.length;
        return slice;
      });
      return { projection, points, error: "" };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        projection: null,
        points: [],
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Projection failed.",
      };
    }
  }, [trajectories]);
  const index = clamp(selected, 0, Math.max(0, trajectories.length - 1));
  const magnitude = result.points
    .flat()
    .reduce(
      (max, point) => Math.max(max, Math.abs(point[0]), Math.abs(point[1])),
      1e-9,
    );
  const x = (point: Vector3Tuple) => 320 + (point[0] / magnitude) * 270;
  const y = (point: Vector3Tuple) => 185 - (point[1] / magnitude) * 145;
  const colors = [
    "#38bdf8",
    "#a78bfa",
    "#2dd4bf",
    "#fb7185",
    "#fbbf24",
    "#818cf8",
  ];
  const similarities = (trajectories[index] || []).map((vector) =>
    cosineSimilarity(vector, trajectories[index][0]),
  );
  if (result.error)
    return (
      <div className="viz-error" role="alert">
        {result.error}
      </div>
    );
  if (!trajectories.length)
    return (
      <div className="viz-empty">
        <h3>No residual capture</h3>
        <p>
          Capture equal-dimensional representations across layers to compare
          trajectories.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <section className="viz-residual">
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <h3>{title}</h3>
        <label>
          Trajectory{" "}
          <select
            value={index}
            onChange={(event) => setSelected(Number(event.target.value))}
          >
            {trajectories.map((_, i) => (
              <option value={i} key={i}>
                {labels[i] || `Vector ${i}`}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <button
          aria-pressed={showAll}
          onClick={() => setShowAll((value) => !value)}
        >
          All trajectories
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="viz-residual-grid">
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 640 370"
          width="100%"
          role="img"
          aria-label="Residual representations in a shared PCA basis"
        >
          <rect
            x="25"
            y="20"
            width="590"
            height="325"
            fill="#07101f"
            stroke="#1d304b"
          />
          {[-0.5, 0, 0.5].map((fraction) => (
            <g key={fraction}>
              <line
                x1={320 + fraction * 270}
                x2={320 + fraction * 270}
                y1="20"
                y2="345"
                stroke="#213249"
              />
              <line
                x1="25"
                x2="615"
                y1={185 + fraction * 145}
                y2={185 + fraction * 145}
                stroke="#213249"
              />
            </g>
          ))}
          {result.points.map(
            (points, trajectory) =>
              (showAll || index === trajectory) && (
                <g key={trajectory} opacity={trajectory === index ? 1 : 0.3}>
                  <polyline
                    points={points
                      .map((point) => `${x(point)},${y(point)}`)
                      .join(" ")}
                    fill="none"
                    stroke={colors[trajectory % colors.length]}
                    strokeWidth={trajectory === index ? 2.5 : 1}
                  />
                  {points.map((point, layer) => (
                    <g key={layer}>
                      <circle
                        cx={x(point)}
                        cy={y(point)}
                        r={trajectory === index ? 4 : 2.5}
                        fill={colors[trajectory % colors.length]}
                      >
                        <title>
                          {labels[trajectory] || `Vector ${trajectory}`} ·{" "}
                          {layerLabels[layer] || `Layer ${layer}`}
                        </title>
                      </circle>
                      {trajectory === index && (
                        <text
                          x={x(point) + 7}
                          y={y(point) - 7}
                          fill="#c3d4e9"
                          fontSize="10"
                        >
                          {layerLabels[layer] || layer}
                        </text>
                      )}
                    </g>
                  ))}
                </g>
              ),
          )}
          <text
            x="320"
            y="362"
            fill="#8aa2be"
            textAnchor="middle"
            fontSize="11"
          >
            Shared principal component 1
          </text>
        </svg>
        <div>
          <h4>Similarity to initial layer</h4>
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 290 220"
            width="100%"
            role="img"
            aria-label="Cosine similarity by layer"
          >
            {[-1, 0, 1].map((value) => (
              <g key={value}>
                <line
                  x1="30"
                  x2="275"
                  y1={110 - value * 85}
                  y2={110 - value * 85}
                  stroke="#213249"
                />
                <text
                  x="22"
                  y={114 - value * 85}
                  textAnchor="end"
                  fill="#8aa2be"
                  fontSize="10"
                >
                  {value}
                </text>
              </g>
            ))}
            <polyline
              points={similarities
                .map(
                  (similarity, layer) =>
                    `${30 + (layer / Math.max(1, similarities.length - 1)) * 245},${110 - similarity * 85}`,
                )
                .join(" ")}
              fill="none"
              stroke="#a78bfa"
              strokeWidth="2"
            />
            {similarities.map((similarity, layer) => (
              <circle
                key={layer}
                cx={30 + (layer / Math.max(1, similarities.length - 1)) * 245}
                cy={110 - similarity * 85}
                r="3"
                fill="#c4b5fd"
              >
                <title>
                  {layerLabels[layer] || `Layer ${layer}`}:{" "}
                  {similarity.toFixed(5)}
                </title>
              </circle>
            ))}
          </svg>
          <p className="viz-note">
            All trajectories share one centered PCA basis. Layer-wise cosine
            similarity uses the original representations.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export interface CircuitViewProps {
  layers: LayerData[];
  maxEdges?: number;
  onSelect?: SceneProps["onSelect"];
  title?: string;
}

export function CircuitView({
  layers,
  maxEdges = 240,
  onSelect,
  title = "Weight circuits",
}: CircuitViewProps) {
  const [threshold, setThreshold] = useState(0);
  const [budget, setBudget] = useState(maxEdges);
  const edges = useMemo(
    () => selectEdges(layers, budget, threshold),
    [layers, budget, threshold],
  );
  const nodeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<number, Set<number>>();
    for (const edge of edges) {
      if (!map.has(edge.sourceLayer)) map.set(edge.sourceLayer, new Set());
      if (!map.has(edge.targetLayer)) map.set(edge.targetLayer, new Set());
      map.get(edge.sourceLayer)!.add(edge.source);
      map.get(edge.targetLayer)!.add(edge.target);
    }
    return new Map(
      Array.from(map, ([layer, nodes]) => [
        layer,
        Array.from(nodes).sort((a, b) => a - b),
      ]),
    );
  }, [edges]);
  const location = (layer: number, neuron: number) => {
    const nodes = nodeMap.get(layer) || [];
    return {
      x: 60 + (layer / Math.max(1, layers.length - 1)) * 680,
      y: 45 + (nodes.indexOf(neuron) / Math.max(1, nodes.length - 1)) * 305,
    };
  };
  const highest = Math.max(1e-9, edges[0]?.score || 0);
  return (
    <section className="viz-circuit">
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <h3>{title}</h3>
        <label>
          Top edges{" "}
          <input
            type="number"
            value={budget}
            min="0"
            max="1200"
            step="20"
            onChange={(event) =>
              setBudget(clamp(Number(event.target.value), 0, 1200))
            }
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          Min |weight|{" "}
          <input
            type="number"
            value={threshold}
            min="0"
            step="0.01"
            onChange={(event) =>
              setThreshold(Math.max(0, Number(event.target.value)))
            }
          />
        </label>
      </div>
      {edges.length ? (
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 800 400"
          width="100%"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${edges.length} strongest parameter connections`}
        >
          {layers.map((layer, index) => (
            <g key={`${layer.id}-${index}`}>
              <line
                x1={60 + (index / Math.max(1, layers.length - 1)) * 680}
                x2={60 + (index / Math.max(1, layers.length - 1)) * 680}
                y1="35"
                y2="355"
                stroke="#132940"
              />
              <text
                x={60 + (index / Math.max(1, layers.length - 1)) * 680}
                y="380"
                textAnchor="middle"
                fill="#8ca9c8"
                fontSize="10"
              >
                {layer.name}
              </text>
            </g>
          ))}
          {edges.map((edge, index) => {
            const a = location(edge.sourceLayer, edge.source);
            const b = location(edge.targetLayer, edge.target);
            return (
              <path
                key={index}
                d={`M${a.x},${a.y} C${(a.x + b.x) / 2},${a.y} ${(a.x + b.x) / 2},${b.y} ${b.x},${b.y}`}
                fill="none"
                stroke={edge.weight >= 0 ? "#a78bfa" : "#22d3ee"}
                opacity={0.15 + (edge.score / highest) * 0.7}
                strokeWidth={0.4 + (edge.score / highest) * 2}
              >
                <title>
                  {layers[edge.sourceLayer].name}[{edge.source}] →{" "}
                  {layers[edge.targetLayer].name}[{edge.target}]:{" "}
                  {edge.weight.toPrecision(6)}
                </title>
              </path>
            );
          })}
          {Array.from(nodeMap, ([layer, neurons]) =>
            neurons.map((neuron) => {
              const point = location(layer, neuron);
              return (
                <g
                  key={`${layer}-${neuron}`}
                  role="button"
                  tabIndex={0}
                  aria-label={`${layers[layer].name} neuron ${neuron}`}
                  onClick={() => onSelect?.(layer, neuron)}
                  onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (event.key === "Enter") onSelect?.(layer, neuron);
                  }}
                >
                  <circle
                    cx={point.x}
                    cy={point.y}
                    r="3.5"
                    fill="#87d8ff"
                    stroke="#07101f"
                  />
                  <title>
                    {layers[layer].name} · Neuron {neuron}
                  </title>
                </g>
              );
            }),
          )}
        </svg>
      ) : (
        <div className="viz-empty">
          No parameter connections meet this threshold.
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="viz-chart-caption">
        <span>
          {nodeMap.size} layers ·{" "}
          {Array.from(nodeMap.values()).reduce(
            (sum, nodes) => sum + nodes.length,
            0,
          )}{" "}
          connected units · {edges.length} edges
        </span>
        <span>
          <i className="viz-legend-cyan" /> Negative weight{" "}
          <i className="viz-legend-purple" /> Positive weight
        </span>
      </div>
      <p className="viz-note">
        This is a parameter graph ranked by |weight|. Causal importance requires
        a measured intervention; weight magnitude alone does not establish a
        causal circuit.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export interface ComparisonViewProps {
  left: LayerData[];
  right: LayerData[];
  leftLabel?: string;
  rightLabel?: string;
}

export function ComparisonView({
  left,
  right,
  leftLabel = "Reference capture",
  rightLabel = "Comparison capture",
}: ComparisonViewProps) {
  const [mode, setMode] =
    useState<NonNullable<SceneProps["mode"]>>("activations");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<SceneProps["selected"]>(null);
  const [layer, setLayer] = useState(1);
  const [reset, setReset] = useState(0);
  const index = clamp(
    layer,
    0,
    Math.max(0, Math.min(left.length, right.length) - 1),
  );
  const comparison = useMemo(() => {
    const a = left[index];
    const b = right[index];
    if (!a || !b)
      return {
        result: null,
        differences: [] as number[],
        error: "Select two captures to compare.",
      };
    const valuesA =
      mode === "activations"
        ? a.activations
        : mode === "gradients"
          ? a.gradients
          : a.weights.flat();
    const valuesB =
      mode === "activations"
        ? b.activations
        : mode === "gradients"
          ? b.gradients
          : b.weights.flat();
    if (
      mode === "weights" &&
      (a.weights.length !== b.weights.length ||
        a.weights.some((row, i) => row.length !== b.weights[i]?.length))
    )
      return {
        result: null,
        differences: [],
        error:
          "Parameter matrix shapes differ. Compare captures with matching architectures.",
      };
    try {
      return {
        result: compareVectors(valuesA, valuesB),
        differences: valuesA.map((value, i) => value - valuesB[i]),
        error: "",
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        result: null,
        differences: [],
        error:
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Tensors are incompatible.",
      };
    }
  }, [left, right, index, mode]);
  return (
    <section className="viz-comparison">
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <h3>Capture comparison</h3>
        <label>
          Color{" "}
          <select
            value={mode}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setMode(event.target.value as NonNullable<SceneProps["mode"]>)
            }
          >
            <option value="activations">Activations</option>
            <option value="weights">Weights</option>
            <option value="gradients">Gradients</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          Layer{" "}
          <select
            value={index}
            onChange={(event) => setLayer(Number(event.target.value))}
          >
            {left.slice(0, right.length).map((item, i) => (
              <option key={`${item.id}-${i}`} value={i}>
                {item.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <button onClick={() => setReset((value) => value + 1)}>
          Reset both views
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="viz-comparison-scenes">
        <div>
          <h4>{leftLabel}</h4>
          <NetworkScene
            key={`left-${reset}`}
            layers={left}
            mode={mode}
            selected={selected}
            onSelect={(layer, neuron) => setSelected({ layer, neuron })}
            height={330}
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h4>{rightLabel}</h4>
          <NetworkScene
            key={`right-${reset}`}
            layers={right}
            mode={mode}
            selected={selected}
            onSelect={(layer, neuron) => setSelected({ layer, neuron })}
            height={330}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      {comparison.error ? (
        <p className="viz-note">{comparison.error}</p>
      ) : (
        comparison.result && (
          <>
            <div className="viz-comparison-metrics">
              {Object.entries(comparison.result).map(([key, value]) => (
                <div key={key}>
                  <span>{key.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1")}</span>
                  <strong>
                    {key === "compared"
                      ? value.toLocaleString()
                      : value.toPrecision(5)}
                  </strong>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <Histogram
              values={comparison.differences}
              title={`${left[index]?.name} · reference minus comparison`}
            />
            <TensorHeatmap
              matrix={[comparison.differences]}
              title="Element-wise difference"
              height={90}
            />
          </>
        )
      )}
      <p className="viz-note">
        Color mode, selected unit and view reset are linked. Each camera can be
        navigated independently. Numerical comparison uses all compatible tensor
        elements.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export function NeuronInspector({
  layers,
  selected,
}: {
  layers: LayerData[];
  selected: SceneProps["selected"];
}) {
  if (!selected)
    return (
      <aside className="viz-neuron-inspector">
        <h4>Unit inspection</h4>
        <p>
          Click a unit in the network to inspect its captured values and
          incoming parameters.
        </p>
      </aside>
    );
  const layer = layers[selected.layer];
  if (!layer || selected.neuron >= layer.size || selected.neuron < 0)
    return (
      <aside className="viz-neuron-inspector">
        <p>The selected unit is unavailable in this capture.</p>
      </aside>
    );
  const weights = layer.weights[selected.neuron] || [];
  const stats = summarize(weights);
  return (
    <aside className="viz-neuron-inspector">
      <h4>
        {layer.name} · unit {selected.neuron}
      </h4>
      <dl>
        <div>
          <dt>Activation</dt>
          <dd>
            {layer.activations[selected.neuron]?.toPrecision(6) ??
              "Not captured"}
          </dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Gradient</dt>
          <dd>
            {layer.gradients[selected.neuron]?.toPrecision(6) ?? "Not captured"}
          </dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Bias</dt>
          <dd>
            {layer.biases[selected.neuron]?.toPrecision(6) ?? "Not applicable"}
          </dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Incoming weights</dt>
          <dd>{weights.length}</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Weight L2</dt>
          <dd>{stats.l2.toPrecision(5)}</dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
      {weights.length > 0 && (
        <Histogram
          values={weights}
          title="Incoming weights"
          bins={24}
          height={145}
        />
      )}
    </aside>
  );
}

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  cameraPreset,
  defaultVisualizationSettings,
  parseViewSettings,
  type CameraBookmark,
  type CameraPreset,
  type VisualizationSettings,
} from "./viewState";
import { downloadBlob } from "./exports";
import type { SceneProps } from "../types";

export interface SceneViewControlsProps {
  settings: VisualizationSettings;
  onChange: (settings: VisualizationSettings) => void;
  onCapture: () => Pick<CameraBookmark, "position" | "target" | "zoom"> | null;
  onNavigate: (
    camera: Pick<CameraBookmark, "position" | "target" | "zoom">,
  ) => void;
  selection: SceneProps["selected"];
  layerCount: number;
  networkId: string;
}

export function SceneViewControls({
  settings,
  onChange,
  onCapture,
  onNavigate,
  selection,
  layerCount,
  networkId,
}: SceneViewControlsProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bookmarkName, setBookmarkName] = useState("");
  const [annotation, setAnnotation] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const sequence = useRef(0);
  const bookmarks = settings.bookmarks;
  const annotations = settings.annotations.filter((note) =>
    note.id.startsWith(`${networkId}:`),
  );
  const bookmark = () => {
    const camera = onCapture();
    if (!camera) {
      setError("The 3D camera is unavailable.");
      return;
    }
    if (bookmarks.length >= 32) {
      setError(
        "Delete a bookmark before adding another; this view supports 32.",
      );
      return;
    }
    const name = bookmarkName.trim() || `View ${bookmarks.length + 1}`;
    const value = {
      ...camera,
      id: `camera-${Date.now()}-${sequence.current++}`,
      name,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    onChange({ ...settings, bookmarks: [...bookmarks, value] });
    setBookmarkName("");
    setError("");
  };
  const annotate = () => {
    if (!selection || !annotation.trim()) return;
    if (settings.annotations.length >= 256) {
      setError("Annotation budget reached. Delete an existing annotation.");
      return;
    }
    const value = {
      id: `${networkId}:${Date.now()}-${sequence.current++}`,
      ...selection,
      text: annotation.trim(),
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    onChange({ ...settings, annotations: [...settings.annotations, value] });
    setAnnotation("");
    setError("");
  };
  return (
    <div className="viz-view-controls">
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <button onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)} aria-expanded={open}>
          View settings & bookmarks
        </button>
        <label>
          Camera{" "}
          <select
            defaultValue="perspective"
            onChange={(event) =>
              onNavigate(
                cameraPreset(event.target.value as CameraPreset, layerCount),
              )
            }
          >
            <option value="perspective">Perspective</option>
            <option value="front">Front</option>
            <option value="top">Top</option>
            <option value="side">Side</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <button
          onClick={() =>
            downloadBlob(
              new Blob([JSON.stringify(settings, null, 2)], {
                type: "application/json",
              }),
              "neuralis-view.json",
            )
          }
        >
          Export view
        </button>
      </div>
      {open && (
        <div className="viz-view-controls-body">
          <div className="viz-view-filter-grid">
            <label>
              Node budget
              <input
                type="number"
                value={settings.nodeBudget}
                min="32"
                max="10000"
                onChange={(event) =>
                  onChange({
                    ...settings,
                    nodeBudget: Math.min(
                      10000,
                      Math.max(32, Number(event.target.value)),
                    ),
                  })
                }
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              Weight threshold
              <input
                type="number"
                value={settings.weightThreshold}
                min="0"
                step="0.01"
                onChange={(event) =>
                  onChange({
                    ...settings,
                    weightThreshold: Math.max(0, Number(event.target.value)),
                  })
                }
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              Import view
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="application/json,.json"
                onChange={async (event) => {
                  const file = event.target.files?.[0];
                  if (!file) return;
                  try {
                    if (file.size > 500000)
                      throw new Error("View file is too large.");
                    onChange(parseViewSettings(await file.text()));
                    setError("");
                  } catch (caught) {
                    setError(
                      caught instanceof Error
                        ? caught.message
                        : "View import failed.",
                    );
                  }
                  event.target.value = "";
                }}
              />
            </label>
            <button onClick={() => onChange(defaultVisualizationSettings())}>
              Reset filters & saved views
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="viz-bookmark-editor">
            <input
              aria-label="Bookmark name"
              value={bookmarkName}
              maxLength={120}
              placeholder="Name this camera view"
              onChange={(event) => setBookmarkName(event.target.value)}
            />
            <button onClick={bookmark}>Save camera</button>
          </div>
          <div className="viz-bookmark-list">
            {bookmarks.map((item) => (
              <div key={item.id}>
                <button onClick={() => onNavigate(item)}>{item.name}</button>
                <button
                  onClick={() =>
                    onChange({
                      ...settings,
                      bookmarks: bookmarks.filter(
                        (value) => value.id !== item.id,
                      ),
                    })
                  }
                  aria-label={`Delete bookmark ${item.name}`}
                >
                  ×
                </button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="viz-annotation-editor">
            <textarea
              aria-label="Selected unit annotation"
              value={annotation}
              onChange={(event) => setAnnotation(event.target.value)}
              maxLength={2000}
              placeholder={
                selection
                  ? `Observation for layer ${selection.layer}, unit ${selection.neuron}`
                  : "Select a unit to attach an observation"
              }
              disabled={!selection}
            />
            <button
              onClick={annotate}
              disabled={!selection || !annotation.trim()}
            >
              Annotate unit
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="viz-annotation-list">
            {annotations.map((note) => (
              <article key={note.id}>
                <strong>
                  Layer {note.layer} · Unit {note.neuron}
                </strong>
                <p>{note.text}</p>
                <button
                  onClick={() =>
                    onChange({
                      ...settings,
                      annotations: settings.annotations.filter(
                        (value) => value.id !== note.id,
                      ),
                    })
                  }
                  aria-label="Delete annotation"
                >
                  Delete
                </button>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className="viz-note">
            View settings stay in this browser. Exports contain camera and
            observation data, without model weights or credentials.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p className="viz-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { LayerData } from "../types";
import {
  clamp,
  divergingColor,
  finite,
  histogram,
  rgbCss,
  summarize,
  symmetricDomain,
  validateMatrix,
  type NumericSummary,
} from "./numerics";
import {
  exportCanvasImage,
  exportLayersJSON,
  exportTensorCSV,
} from "./exports";
import "./visualization.css";

export interface TensorHeatmapProps {
  matrix: number[][];
  title?: string;
  domain?: number;
  height?: number;
  onSelect?: (row: number, column: number, value: number) => void;
  sequential?: boolean;
}
interface Cell {
  row: number;
  column: number;
  value: number;
}

/** Canvas previews are sampled by exact index; the source tensor remains untouched for CSV and statistics. */
export function TensorHeatmap({
  matrix,
  title = "Tensor heatmap",
  domain: suppliedDomain,
  height = 290,
  onSelect,
  sequential = false,
}: TensorHeatmapProps) {
  const canvas = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const container = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(500);
  const [cell, setCell] = useState<Cell | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const shape = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      return { ...validateMatrix(matrix), error: "" };
    } catch (caught) {
      return {
        rows: 0,
        columns: 0,
        error: caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Invalid tensor.",
      };
    }
  }, [matrix]);
  const values = useMemo(() => matrix.flat(), [matrix]);
  const domain =
    suppliedDomain && suppliedDomain > 0
      ? suppliedDomain
      : symmetricDomain(values);
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = container.current;
    if (!element) return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver((entries) =>
      setWidth(Math.max(1, entries[0].contentRect.width)),
    );
    observer.observe(element);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = canvas.current;
    if (!element || !shape.rows || !shape.columns) return;
    const context = element.getContext("2d");
    if (!context) return;
    const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    element.width = Math.ceil(width * ratio);
    element.height = Math.ceil(height * ratio);
    context.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
    context.fillStyle = "#07101f";
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    const columns = Math.min(
      shape.columns,
      192,
      Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / 2)),
    );
    const rows = Math.min(shape.rows, 192, Math.max(1, Math.floor(height / 2)));
    const cellWidth = width / columns;
    const cellHeight = height / rows;
    for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
      const sourceRow = Math.floor((row * shape.rows) / rows);
      for (let column = 0; column < columns; column++) {
        const sourceColumn = Math.floor((column * shape.columns) / columns);
        const value = matrix[sourceRow][sourceColumn];
        if (!Number.isFinite(value)) context.fillStyle = "#fbbf24";
        else if (sequential) {
          const intensity = clamp(value / domain, 0, 1);
          context.fillStyle = rgbCss([
            0.06 + intensity * 0.27,
            0.1 + intensity * 0.7,
            0.21 + intensity * 0.72,
          ]);
        } else context.fillStyle = rgbCss(divergingColor(value, domain));
        context.fillRect(
          column * cellWidth,
          row * cellHeight,
          Math.ceil(cellWidth + 0.1),
          Math.ceil(cellHeight + 0.1),
        );
      }
    }
    if (cell && cell.row < shape.rows && cell.column < shape.columns) {
      context.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
      context.lineWidth = 1.5;
      context.strokeRect(
        (cell.column / shape.columns) * width,
        (cell.row / shape.rows) * height,
        Math.max(cellWidth, width / shape.columns),
        Math.max(cellHeight, height / shape.rows),
      );
    }
  }, [matrix, shape, width, height, domain, cell, sequential]);
  const choose = (row: number, column: number, notify = false) => {
    const boundedRow = clamp(row, 0, shape.rows - 1);
    const boundedColumn = clamp(column, 0, shape.columns - 1);
    const value = matrix[boundedRow]?.[boundedColumn];
    if (value === undefined) return;
    setCell({ row: boundedRow, column: boundedColumn, value });
    if (notify) onSelect?.(boundedRow, boundedColumn, value);
  };
  const save = async () => {
    if (!canvas.current) return;
    try {
      await exportCanvasImage(canvas.current, "neuralis-tensor.png");
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Export failed.");
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="viz-heatmap-wrap" ref={container}>
      <div className="viz-chart-heading">
        <strong>{title}</strong>
        <span>
          {shape.rows} × {shape.columns}
        </span>
        <button onClick={save} disabled={!shape.rows}>
          PNG
        </button>
      </div>
      {shape.error ? (
        <p className="viz-error" role="alert">
          {shape.error}
        </p>
      ) : !shape.rows || !shape.columns ? (
        <div className="viz-empty" style={{ height }}>
          No tensor values captured.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <canvas
          ref={canvas}
          style={{ width: "100%", height }}
          tabIndex={0}
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${title}, ${shape.rows} rows and ${shape.columns} columns. Use arrow keys to inspect values.`}
          onMouseMove={(event) => {
            const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
            choose(
              Math.floor(
                ((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * shape.rows,
              ),
              Math.floor(
                ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * shape.columns,
              ),
            );
          }}
          onClick={() => {
            if (cell) onSelect?.(cell.row, cell.column, cell.value);
          }}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            const row = cell?.row || 0;
            const column = cell?.column || 0;
            if (event.key === "ArrowUp") {
              event.preventDefault();
              choose(row - 1, column);
            }
            if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
              event.preventDefault();
              choose(row + 1, column);
            }
            if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
              event.preventDefault();
              choose(row, column - 1);
            }
            if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
              event.preventDefault();
              choose(row, column + 1);
            }
            if (event.key === "Enter" && cell)
              onSelect?.(cell.row, cell.column, cell.value);
          }}
        />
      )}
      <div className="viz-chart-caption">
        <span aria-live="polite">
          {cell
            ? `[${cell.row}, ${cell.column}] = ${Number.isFinite(cell.value) ? cell.value.toPrecision(6) : "non-finite"}`
            : "Hover or use arrow keys to inspect a value"}
        </span>
        <span>
          {shape.rows > 192 || shape.columns > 192
            ? "Sampled preview · CSV preserves all values"
            : "Exact cells"}{" "}
          · {sequential ? "Sequential" : "Diverging"} scale
        </span>
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="viz-error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Histogram({
  values,
  title = "Value distribution",
  bins = 36,
  height = 180,
}: {
  values: number[];
  title?: string;
  bins?: number;
  height?: number;
}) {
  const distribution = useMemo(() => histogram(values, bins), [values, bins]);
  const max = Math.max(1, ...distribution.map((bin) => bin.count));
  const left = 38;
  const top = 12;
  const plotWidth = 562;
  const plotHeight = 125;
  return (
    <div className="viz-histogram">
      <div className="viz-chart-heading">
        <strong>{title}</strong>
        <span>
          {values.filter(Number.isFinite).length.toLocaleString()} values
        </span>
      </div>
      {distribution.length ? (
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 620 175"
          height={height}
          width="100%"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${title}: ${distribution.length} histogram bins`}
        >
          {[0, 0.5, 1].map((fraction) => (
            <g key={fraction}>
              <line
                x1={left}
                x2={left + plotWidth}
                y1={top + plotHeight * (1 - fraction)}
                y2={top + plotHeight * (1 - fraction)}
                stroke="#20334b"
                strokeDasharray="3 4"
              />
              <text
                x={left - 5}
                y={top + plotHeight * (1 - fraction) + 4}
                fill="#7f94ad"
                fontSize="10"
                textAnchor="end"
              >
                {Math.round(max * fraction)}
              </text>
            </g>
          ))}
          {distribution.map((bin, index) => {
            const barHeight = (bin.count / max) * plotHeight;
            const width = plotWidth / distribution.length;
            return (
              <rect
                key={index}
                x={left + width * index + 0.5}
                y={top + plotHeight - barHeight}
                width={Math.max(0.2, width - 1)}
                height={barHeight}
                rx="1"
                fill={index < distribution.length / 2 ? "#22b8dc" : "#9471ee"}
              >
                <title>
                  {bin.lower.toPrecision(4)} to {bin.upper.toPrecision(4)}:{" "}
                  {bin.count} values
                </title>
              </rect>
            );
          })}
          <text x={left} y="158" fill="#a1b1c6" fontSize="11">
            {distribution[0].lower.toPrecision(3)}
          </text>
          <text
            x={left + plotWidth}
            y="158"
            textAnchor="end"
            fill="#a1b1c6"
            fontSize="11"
          >
            {distribution[distribution.length - 1].upper.toPrecision(3)}
          </text>
        </svg>
      ) : (
        <div className="viz-empty" style={{ height }}>
          No finite values.
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function StatisticsTable({
  values,
  title = "Tensor statistics",
}: {
  values: number[];
  title?: string;
}) {
  const summary = useMemo(() => summarize(values), [values]);
  const entries: [string, keyof NumericSummary][] = [
    ["Count", "count"],
    ["Non-finite", "invalid"],
    ["Mean", "mean"],
    ["Median", "median"],
    ["Std. deviation", "standardDeviation"],
    ["Minimum", "min"],
    ["Maximum", "max"],
    ["L1 norm", "l1"],
    ["L2 norm", "l2"],
    ["Sparsity", "sparsity"],
  ];
  return (
    <div className="viz-statistics">
      <h4>{title}</h4>
      <dl>
        {entries.map(([label, key]) => (
          <div key={key}>
            <dt>{label}</dt>
            <dd>
              {key === "count" || key === "invalid"
                ? summary[key].toLocaleString()
                : key === "sparsity"
                  ? `${(summary[key] * 100).toFixed(2)}%`
                  : summary[key].toPrecision(5)}
            </dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
      <p>Sparsity: |value| ≤ 10⁻⁸. Statistics use all finite source values.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export interface TensorInspectorProps {
  layers: LayerData[];
  initialLayer?: number;
  initialMode?: "weights" | "activations" | "gradients" | "biases";
  onSelect?: (layer: number, neuron: number) => void;
}

export function TensorInspector({
  layers,
  initialLayer = 1,
  initialMode = "weights",
  onSelect,
}: TensorInspectorProps) {
  const [layerIndex, setLayerIndex] = useState(initialLayer);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(initialMode);
  const index = clamp(layerIndex, 0, Math.max(0, layers.length - 1));
  const layer = layers[index];
  const matrix = useMemo(
    () =>
      !layer
        ? []
        : mode === "weights"
          ? layer.weights
          : [
              mode === "activations"
                ? layer.activations
                : mode === "gradients"
                  ? layer.gradients
                  : layer.biases,
            ],
    [layer, mode],
  );
  const values = useMemo(() => matrix.flat(), [matrix]);
  return (
    <section className="viz-tensor-inspector" aria-label="Tensor inspector">
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <label>
          Layer{" "}
          <select
            value={index}
            onChange={(event) => setLayerIndex(Number(event.target.value))}
            disabled={!layers.length}
          >
            {layers.map((item, i) => (
              <option value={i} key={`${item.id}-${i}`}>
                {item.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <div className="viz-tab-list" aria-label="Tensor type">
          {(["weights", "activations", "gradients", "biases"] as const).map(
            (item) => (
              <button
                key={item}
                onClick={() => setMode(item)}
                aria-pressed={mode === item}
              >
                {item}
              </button>
            ),
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() =>
            exportTensorCSV(matrix, `${layer?.id || "tensor"}-${mode}.csv`)
          }
          disabled={!values.length}
        >
          Export CSV
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => exportLayersJSON(layers)}
          disabled={!layers.length}
        >
          Full capture
        </button>
      </div>
      {!layer ? (
        <div className="viz-empty">Start an experiment to capture tensors.</div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="viz-inspector-grid">
            <TensorHeatmap
              matrix={matrix}
              title={`${layer.name} · ${mode}`}
              onSelect={(row, column) =>
                onSelect?.(index, mode === "weights" ? row : column)
              }
            />
            <StatisticsTable values={values} />
          </div>
          <Histogram values={values} />
          <p className="viz-note">
            {mode === "weights"
              ? "Rows are output units; columns are input units. The full matrix is available in CSV."
              : mode === "gradients"
                ? "Captured gradient per unit. Consult the experiment metadata for parameter-level gradient coverage."
                : "This view displays actual values from the latest captured forward pass."}
          </p>
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export default TensorInspector;

====================================================================================================
BEGIN FILE: apps/web/src/visualization/TensorSliceInspector.tsx
====================================================================================================
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { TensorHeatmap, StatisticsTable, Histogram } from "./TensorInspector";
import {
  denseTensor,
  largestTensorElements,
  parseTensor,
  reduceTensor,
  serializeTensor,
  sliceTensor,
  tensorChannelStatistics,
  validateTensor,
  type DenseTensor,
  type TensorReduction,
} from "./tensors";
import { downloadBlob, exportTensorCSV } from "./exports";
import "./visualization.css";

export interface TensorSliceInspectorProps {
  tensor: DenseTensor;
  axisNames?: string[];
  title?: string;
}

export function TensorSliceInspector({
  tensor,
  axisNames = [],
  title = "Multidimensional tensor slices",
}: TensorSliceInspectorProps) {
  const [imported, setImported] = useState<DenseTensor | null>(null);
  const [rowAxis, setRowAxis] = useState(0);
  const [columnAxis, setColumnAxis] = useState(1);
  const [fixed, setFixed] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [channelAxis, setChannelAxis] = useState(0);
  const [reduction, setReduction] = useState<TensorReduction>("mean");
  const [showReduction, setShowReduction] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const source = imported || tensor;
  const activeRow = Math.min(rowAxis, Math.max(0, source.shape.length - 1));
  const activeColumn =
    columnAxis === activeRow || columnAxis >= source.shape.length
      ? (activeRow + 1) % Math.max(1, source.shape.length)
      : columnAxis;
  const activeChannel = Math.min(
    channelAxis,
    Math.max(0, source.shape.length - 1),
  );
  const result = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      validateTensor(source);
      const fixedIndices = source.shape.map((size, axis) =>
        Math.min(Math.max(0, fixed[axis] || 0), Math.max(0, size - 1)),
      );
      const matrix =
        source.shape.length < 2
          ? [Array.from(source.data)]
          : sliceTensor(source, activeRow, activeColumn, fixedIndices).matrix;
      const reduced = source.shape.length
        ? reduceTensor(source, activeChannel, reduction)
        : source;
      const reductionMatrix =
        reduced.shape.length < 2
          ? [Array.from(reduced.data)]
          : sliceTensor(reduced, 0, 1).matrix;
      const channels = source.shape.length
        ? tensorChannelStatistics(source, activeChannel)
        : [];
      const top = largestTensorElements(source, 10);
      return { matrix, reductionMatrix, reduced, channels, top, error: "" };
    } catch (caught) {
      return {
        matrix: [],
        reductionMatrix: [],
        reduced: denseTensor([], [0]),
        channels: [],
        top: [],
        error: caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Invalid tensor.",
      };
    }
  }, [source, activeRow, activeColumn, fixed, activeChannel, reduction]);
  const axisLabel = (axis: number) => axisNames[axis] || `Axis ${axis}`;
  const updateIndex = (axis: number, value: number) =>
    setFixed((previous) => {
      const next = [...previous];
      next[axis] = value;
      return next;
    });
  const save = () => {
    try {
      downloadBlob(
        new Blob([serializeTensor(source)], { type: "application/json" }),
        "neuralis-tensor.json",
      );
      setError("");
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Export failed.");
    }
  };
  return (
    <section className="viz-tensor-inspector" aria-label={title}>
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <h3>{title}</h3>
        <label>
          Load capture{" "}
          <input
            type="file"
            accept="application/json,.json"
            onChange={async (event) => {
              const file = event.target.files?.[0];
              if (!file) return;
              try {
                if (file.size > 64000000)
                  throw new Error("Capture file is too large.");
                setImported(parseTensor(await file.text()));
                setFixed([]);
                setError("");
              } catch (caught) {
                setError(
                  caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Import failed.",
                );
              }
              event.target.value = "";
            }}
          />
        </label>
        <button onClick={save}>Export capture</button>
        {imported && (
          <button onClick={() => setImported(null)}>
            Return to live capture
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <span className="viz-axis-description">
          {imported ? "Imported" : "Captured"} tensor · [
          {source.shape.join(" × ")}]
        </span>
        {source.shape.length > 1 && (
          <>
            <label>
              Rows{" "}
              <select
                value={activeRow}
                onChange={(event) => setRowAxis(Number(event.target.value))}
              >
                {source.shape.map((size, axis) => (
                  <option key={axis} value={axis}>
                    {axisLabel(axis)} · {size}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              Columns{" "}
              <select
                value={activeColumn}
                onChange={(event) => setColumnAxis(Number(event.target.value))}
              >
                {source.shape.map((size, axis) => (
                  <option key={axis} value={axis} disabled={axis === activeRow}>
                    {axisLabel(axis)} · {size}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
          </>
        )}
        {source.shape.map(
          (size, axis) =>
            axis !== activeRow &&
            axis !== activeColumn && (
              <label key={axis}>
                {axisLabel(axis)}{" "}
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  max={Math.max(0, size - 1)}
                  value={Math.min(fixed[axis] || 0, Math.max(0, size - 1))}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateIndex(axis, Number(event.target.value))
                  }
                />
              </label>
            ),
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => exportTensorCSV(result.matrix, "tensor-slice.csv")}
          disabled={!result.matrix.length}
        >
          Slice CSV
        </button>
      </div>
      {(error || result.error) && (
        <p className="viz-error" role="alert">
          {error || result.error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="viz-inspector-grid">
        <TensorHeatmap
          matrix={result.matrix}
          title={`${axisLabel(activeRow)} × ${axisLabel(activeColumn)} slice`}
        />
        <StatisticsTable
          values={Array.from(source.data)}
          title="Full tensor statistics"
        />
      </div>
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <label>
          Channel axis{" "}
          <select
            value={activeChannel}
            onChange={(event) => setChannelAxis(Number(event.target.value))}
          >
            {source.shape.map((size, axis) => (
              <option key={axis} value={axis}>
                {axisLabel(axis)} · {size}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          Reduction{" "}
          <select
            value={reduction}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setReduction(event.target.value as TensorReduction)
            }
          >
            {(["mean", "sum", "min", "max", "l2"] as const).map((operation) => (
              <option key={operation}>{operation}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowReduction((value) => !value)}
          aria-pressed={showReduction}
        >
          Reduced tensor
        </button>
      </div>
      {showReduction && (
        <div className="viz-slice-reduction">
          <TensorHeatmap
            matrix={result.reductionMatrix}
            title={`${reduction} over ${axisLabel(activeChannel)} · shape [${result.reduced.shape.join(", ")}]`}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="viz-tensor-details">
        <div>
          <h4>Channel statistics</h4>
          <div className="viz-table-scroll">
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Channel</th>
                  <th>Mean</th>
                  <th>Std. deviation</th>
                  <th>L2 norm</th>
                  <th>Sparsity</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {result.channels.slice(0, 128).map((stats, index) => (
                  <tr key={index}>
                    <td>{index}</td>
                    <td>{stats.mean.toPrecision(4)}</td>
                    <td>{stats.standardDeviation.toPrecision(4)}</td>
                    <td>{stats.l2.toPrecision(4)}</td>
                    <td>{(stats.sparsity * 100).toFixed(1)}%</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          {result.channels.length > 128 && (
            <p className="viz-note">Showing the first 128 channels.</p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div>
          <h4>Largest absolute elements</h4>
          <div className="viz-table-scroll">
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Coordinate</th>
                  <th>Value</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {result.top.map((element) => (
                  <tr key={element.offset}>
                    <td>[{element.index.join(", ")}]</td>
                    <td>{element.value.toPrecision(6)}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Histogram
        values={Array.from(source.data)}
        title="Full tensor distribution"
      />
      <p className="viz-note">
        Slices use exact row-major source coordinates. Reductions aggregate
        every element on the selected axis; displayed reduced axes are the first
        two remaining axes.
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

export default TensorSliceInspector;

import { useState } from "react";
import type { LayerData, SceneProps } from "../types";
import NetworkScene from "./NetworkScene";
import { TensorInspector } from "./TensorInspector";
import { CircuitView, NeuronInspector } from "./ResearchViews";
import "./visualization.css";

export function VisualizationWorkbench({ layers }: { layers: LayerData[] }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"network" | "tensors" | "circuits">("network");
  const [mode, setMode] =
    useState<NonNullable<SceneProps["mode"]>>("activations");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<SceneProps["selected"]>(null);
  const choose = (layer: number, neuron: number) =>
    setSelected({ layer, neuron });
  return (
    <div className="viz-workbench">
      <div className="viz-inspector-toolbar">
        <div className="viz-tab-list">
          {(["network", "tensors", "circuits"] as const).map((item) => (
            <button
              key={item}
              aria-pressed={tab === item}
              onClick={() => setTab(item)}
            >
              {item}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {tab === "network" && (
          <label>
            Color by{" "}
            <select
              value={mode}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setMode(event.target.value as NonNullable<SceneProps["mode"]>)
              }
            >
              <option value="activations">Activations</option>
              <option value="weights">Weights</option>
              <option value="gradients">Gradients</option>
            </select>
          </label>
        )}
      </div>
      {tab === "network" ? (
        <NetworkScene
          layers={layers}
          selected={selected}
          onSelect={choose}
          mode={mode}
        />
      ) : tab === "tensors" ? (
        <TensorInspector layers={layers} onSelect={choose} />
      ) : (
        <CircuitView layers={layers} onSelect={choose} />
      )}
      <NeuronInspector layers={layers} selected={selected} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  analyzeArchitecture,
  connectArchitecture,
  layoutArchitecture,
  parseArchitecture,
  removeArchitectureNode,
  sequentialArchitecture,
  topologicalOrder,
  type ArchitectureGraph,
} from "../architecture";
import {
  attentionHeadDivergence,
  attentionRollout,
  checkCausalMask,
  fuseAttentionHeads,
  headDivergenceMatrix,
  normalizeAttention,
} from "../attention";
import {
  contiguousStrides,
  denseTensor,
  flattenIndex,
  largestTensorElements,
  parseTensor,
  reduceTensor,
  reshapeTensor,
  serializeTensor,
  sliceTensor,
  tensorChannelStatistics,
  tensorDifference,
  transposeTensor,
  unravelIndex,
} from "../tensors";
import {
  cameraPreset,
  defaultVisualizationSettings,
  parseViewSettings,
} from "../viewState";

describe("exact multidimensional tensor transforms", () => {
  const tensor = denseTensor(
    Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => i),
    [2, 3, 4],
  );
  it("inverts row-major indices for every element", () => {
    expect(contiguousStrides([2, 3, 4])).toEqual([12, 4, 1]);
    for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++)
      expect(flattenIndex(unravelIndex(i, tensor.shape), tensor.shape)).toBe(i);
    expect(() => flattenIndex([2, 0, 0], tensor.shape)).toThrow();
    expect(() => unravelIndex(24, tensor.shape)).toThrow();
  });
  it("extracts arbitrary axis pairs with fixed coordinates", () => {
    expect(sliceTensor(tensor, 0, 2, [0, 1, 0]).matrix).toEqual([
      [4, 5, 6, 7],
      [16, 17, 18, 19],
    ]);
    expect(sliceTensor(tensor, 2, 0, [0, 2, 0]).matrix).toEqual([
      [8, 20],
      [9, 21],
      [10, 22],
      [11, 23],
    ]);
    expect(() => sliceTensor(tensor, 1, 1)).toThrow();
  });
  it("transposes values and recomputes contiguous strides", () => {
    const transpose = transposeTensor(tensor, [2, 0, 1]);
    expect(transpose.shape).toEqual([4, 2, 3]);
    expect(transpose.data[flattenIndex([3, 1, 2], transpose.shape)]).toBe(23);
    const roundTrip = transposeTensor(transpose, [1, 2, 0]);
    expect(Array.from(roundTrip.data)).toEqual(Array.from(tensor.data));
    expect(() => transposeTensor(tensor, [0, 0, 2])).toThrow();
  });
  it("preserves data buffer during reshape and rejects changes in size", () => {
    expect(reshapeTensor(tensor, [6, 4]).data).toBe(tensor.data);
    expect(() => reshapeTensor(tensor, [10, 4])).toThrow();
    expect(() => denseTensor([1, 2], [3])).toThrow();
  });
  it("reduces each axis against a hand-computed reference", () => {
    const small = denseTensor([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [2, 3]);
    expect(Array.from(reduceTensor(small, 0, "sum").data)).toEqual([5, 7, 9]);
    expect(Array.from(reduceTensor(small, 1, "mean").data)).toEqual([2, 5]);
    expect(Array.from(reduceTensor(small, 1, "max").data)).toEqual([3, 6]);
    expect(Array.from(reduceTensor(small, 0, "min").data)).toEqual([1, 2, 3]);
    expect(reduceTensor(small, 1, "l2").data[0]).toBeCloseTo(Math.sqrt(14));
  });
  it("computes channel statistics and reports original top-element coordinates", () => {
    expect(
      tensorChannelStatistics(tensor, 0).map((stats) => stats.mean),
    ).toEqual([5.5, 17.5]);
    const largest = largestTensorElements(tensor, 2);
    expect(largest.map((element) => element.index)).toEqual([
      [1, 2, 3],
      [1, 2, 2],
    ]);
    expect(largestTensorElements(tensor, 0)).toEqual([]);
  });
  it("round-trips validated imports and preserves exact elementwise differences", () => {
    const restored = parseTensor(serializeTensor(tensor));
    expect(Array.from(restored.data)).toEqual(Array.from(tensor.data));
    expect(
      Array.from(tensorDifference(tensor, restored).data).every(
        (value) => value === 0,
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(() =>
      parseTensor(
        '{"format":"neuralis.tensor","version":1,"shape":[3],"data":[1]}',
      ),
    ).toThrow();
    expect(() => serializeTensor(denseTensor([NaN], [1]))).toThrow();
  });
});

describe("architecture DAG validation and layout", () => {
  it("infers sequential dense parameters including biases", () => {
    const graph = sequentialArchitecture([3, 4, 2]);
    const result = analyzeArchitecture(graph);
    expect(result.issues).toEqual([]);
    expect(result.totalParameters).toBe(3 * 4 + 4 + 4 * 2 + 2);
    expect(result.shapes.get("output")).toEqual([2]);
    expect(result.depth.get("output")).toBe(3);
  });
  it("validates residual addition shapes and topological order", () => {
    const graph: ArchitectureGraph = {
      format: "neuralis.architecture",
      version: 1,
      nodes: [
        { id: "x", name: "x", operation: "input", shape: [5, 4] },
        { id: "p", name: "p", operation: "dense", units: 4 },
        { id: "add", name: "add", operation: "add" },
        { id: "out", name: "out", operation: "output" },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: "x", target: "p" },
        { source: "x", target: "add" },
        { source: "p", target: "add" },
        { source: "add", target: "out" },
      ],
    };
    const result = analyzeArchitecture(graph);
    expect(result.shapes.get("add")).toEqual([5, 4]);
    expect(result.totalParameters).toBe(20);
    expect(result.issues).toEqual([]);
    const mismatch = {
      ...graph,
      nodes: graph.nodes.map((node) =>
        node.id === "p" ? { ...node, units: 3 } : node,
      ),
    };
    expect(
      analyzeArchitecture(mismatch).issues.some((issue) =>
        issue.message.includes("identical shapes"),
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
  });
  it("rejects cycles, dangling endpoints and duplicate edges", () => {
    const graph = sequentialArchitecture([2, 3, 1]);
    expect(() => connectArchitecture(graph, "output", "dense-1")).toThrow(
      /cycle/,
    );
    expect(() => connectArchitecture(graph, "missing", "output")).toThrow();
    expect(() => connectArchitecture(graph, "input", "dense-1")).toThrow(
      /exists/,
    );
    const duplicate = { ...graph, edges: [...graph.edges, graph.edges[0]] };
    expect(
      analyzeArchitecture(duplicate).issues.some((issue) =>
        issue.message.includes("Duplicate"),
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
  });
  it("concatenates only compatible non-axis shapes", () => {
    const graph: ArchitectureGraph = {
      format: "neuralis.architecture",
      version: 1,
      nodes: [
        { id: "a", name: "a", operation: "input", shape: [8, 3] },
        { id: "b", name: "b", operation: "input", shape: [8, 5] },
        { id: "c", name: "c", operation: "concat", axis: 1 },
        { id: "o", name: "o", operation: "output" },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: "a", target: "c" },
        { source: "b", target: "c" },
        { source: "c", target: "o" },
      ],
    };
    expect(analyzeArchitecture(graph).shapes.get("c")).toEqual([8, 8]);
    expect(
      analyzeArchitecture({
        ...graph,
        nodes: graph.nodes.map((node) =>
          node.id === "c" ? { ...node, axis: 0 } : node,
        ),
      }).issues.some((issue) => issue.severity === "error"),
    ).toBe(true);
  });
  it("lays out all nodes deterministically and preserves upstream ordering", () => {
    const graph = sequentialArchitecture([2, 3, 1]);
    expect(layoutArchitecture(graph)).toEqual(layoutArchitecture(graph));
    const positions = layoutArchitecture(graph);
    expect(positions.map((position) => position.id)).toEqual(
      topologicalOrder(graph),
    );
    expect(positions[1].x).toBeGreaterThan(positions[0].x);
  });
  it("removes incident edges and round-trips architecture documents", () => {
    const graph = sequentialArchitecture([2, 3, 1]);
    expect(parseArchitecture(JSON.stringify(graph))).toEqual(graph);
    const removed = removeArchitectureNode(graph, "dense-1");
    expect(
      removed.edges.some(
        (edge) => edge.target === "dense-1" || edge.source === "dense-1",
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(() => parseArchitecture('{"format":"other"}')).toThrow();
  });
});

describe("attention propagation from measured heads", () => {
  const a = [
    [0.8, 0.2],
    [0.1, 0.9],
  ];
  const b = [
    [0.6, 0.4],
    [0.3, 0.7],
  ];
  it("fuses matching heads without altering source arrays", () => {
    expect(fuseAttentionHeads([a, b])).toEqual([
      [0.7, 0.30000000000000004],
      [0.2, 0.8],
    ]);
    expect(fuseAttentionHeads([a, b], "max")).toEqual([
      [0.8, 0.4],
      [0.3, 0.9],
    ]);
    expect(a[0]).toEqual([0.8, 0.2]);
    expect(() => fuseAttentionHeads([a, [[1]]])).toThrow();
  });
  it("multiplies rollout transitions in chronological order", () => {
    const result = attentionRollout([[a], [b]], { residualWeight: 0 });
    expect(result[0][0]).toBeCloseTo(0.52);
    expect(result[0][1]).toBeCloseTo(0.48);
    expect(result[1][0]).toBeCloseTo(0.31);
    expect(result[1][1]).toBeCloseTo(0.69);
    expect(
      result.every(
        (row) =>
          Math.abs(row.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) - 1) < 1e-12,
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
  });
  it("includes identity residuals and restricts selected layers", () => {
    const result = attentionRollout([[a], [b]], {
      startLayer: 1,
      endLayer: 1,
      residualWeight: 1,
    });
    expect(result[0][0]).toBeCloseTo(0.8);
    expect(result[0][1]).toBeCloseTo(0.2);
    expect(attentionRollout([])).toEqual([]);
    expect(() =>
      attentionRollout([
        [
          [
            [1, 0, 0],
            [0, 1, 0],
          ],
        ],
      ]),
    ).toThrow(/square/);
  });
  it("computes symmetric bounded head divergence", () => {
    expect(attentionHeadDivergence(a, a)).toBe(0);
    expect(attentionHeadDivergence([[1, 0]], [[0, 1]])).toBeCloseTo(1);
    expect(attentionHeadDivergence(a, b)).toBeCloseTo(
      attentionHeadDivergence(b, a),
    );
    const matrix = headDivergenceMatrix([a, b]);
    expect(matrix[0][1]).toEqual(matrix[1][0]);
    expect(matrix[0][0]).toBe(0);
    expect(normalizeAttention([[0, 0]])).toEqual([[0, 0]]);
  });
  it("detects future-token leakage", () => {
    expect(
      checkCausalMask([
        [1, 0],
        [0.2, 0.8],
      ]).valid,
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(checkCausalMask(a)).toMatchObject({
      valid: false,
      violations: 1,
      leakage: 0.2,
    });
  });
});

describe("portable camera and filter settings", () => {
  it("round-trips filters and safely bounds imported budgets", () => {
    const defaults = defaultVisualizationSettings();
    expect(parseViewSettings(JSON.stringify(defaults))).toEqual(defaults);
    expect(
      parseViewSettings(JSON.stringify({ ...defaults, edgeBudget: 1000000 }))
        .edgeBudget,
    ).toBe(20000);
    expect(() =>
      parseViewSettings(
        '{"format":"neuralis.view","version":1,"edgeOpacity":"bad"}',
      ),
    ).toThrow();
  });
  it("validates camera vectors and real unit annotations", () => {
    const settings = {
      ...defaultVisualizationSettings(),
      bookmarks: [
        {
          id: "1",
          name: "Front",
          ...cameraPreset("front", 4),
          createdAt: "2026-01-01",
        },
      ],
      annotations: [
        {
          id: "a",
          layer: 1,
          neuron: 2,
          text: "Measured activation changed.",
          createdAt: "2026-01-01",
        },
      ],
    };
    expect(parseViewSettings(JSON.stringify(settings))).toEqual(settings);
    expect(() =>
      parseViewSettings(
        JSON.stringify({
          ...settings,
          bookmarks: [{ ...settings.bookmarks[0], position: [0, 1] }],
        }),
      ),
    ).toThrow();
    expect(cameraPreset("top", 8).position[1]).toBe(24);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { LayerData } from "../../types";
import {
  attentionEntropy,
  compareVectors,
  cosineSimilarity,
  divergingColor,
  histogram,
  neuronPosition,
  pearsonCorrelation,
  projectPCA,
  sampledIndices,
  selectEdges,
  summarize,
  validateMatrix,
} from "../numerics";

function layer(id: string, size: number, weights: number[][] = []): LayerData {
  return {
    id,
    name: id,
    size,
    shape: [size],
    weights,
    activations: Array(size).fill(0),
    biases: Array(size).fill(0),
    gradients: Array(size).fill(0),
  };
}

describe("captured tensor statistics", () => {
  it("uses population variance and counts invalid data separately", () => {
    const stats = summarize([0, 1, 2, 3, NaN, Infinity]);
    expect(stats.count).toBe(4);
    expect(stats.invalid).toBe(2);
    expect(stats.mean).toBe(1.5);
    expect(stats.median).toBe(1.5);
    expect(stats.variance).toBe(1.25);
    expect(stats.l2).toBeCloseTo(Math.sqrt(14));
    expect(stats.sparsity).toBe(0.25);
  });
  it("has a finite empty state", () => {
    expect(summarize([]).count).toBe(0);
    expect(Object.values(summarize([NaN])).every(Number.isFinite)).toBe(true);
  });
  it("keeps the upper endpoint and conserves observation counts", () => {
    const bins = histogram([0, 1, 2, 3, 4], 4, [0, 4]);
    expect(bins.map((bin) => bin.count)).toEqual([1, 1, 1, 2]);
    expect(bins.reduce((sum, bin) => sum + bin.count, 0)).toBe(5);
    expect(
      bins.reduce((sum, bin) => sum + bin.density * (bin.upper - bin.lower), 0),
    ).toBeCloseTo(1);
  });
  it("supports constant and finite-range histograms", () => {
    expect(histogram([3, 3, 3]).reduce((sum, bin) => sum + bin.count, 0)).toBe(
      3,
    );
    expect(
      histogram([-2, 0, 2], 2, [-1, 1]).reduce(
        (sum, bin) => sum + bin.count,
        0,
      ),
    ).toBe(1);
    expect(() => histogram([0], 2, [1, -1])).toThrow();
  });
});

describe("bounded connection geometry", () => {
  it("ranks actual output-by-input weights and preserves indices", () => {
    const layers = [
      layer("input", 2),
      layer("hidden", 2, [
        [0.1, -0.9],
        [0.4, 0.2],
      ]),
      layer("output", 1, [[0.7, 0.3]]),
    ];
    const edges = selectEdges(layers, 3);
    expect(edges.map((edge) => edge.weight)).toEqual([-0.9, 0.7, 0.4]);
    expect(edges[0]).toMatchObject({
      sourceLayer: 0,
      source: 1,
      targetLayer: 1,
      target: 0,
    });
  });
  it("matches a full-sort reference across many candidate edges", () => {
    const weights = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) =>
      Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, j) => Math.sin((i * 18 + j + 1) * 0.37)),
    );
    const layers = [layer("a", 18), layer("b", 24, weights)];
    const actual = selectEdges(layers, 53).map((edge) => Math.abs(edge.weight));
    const expected = weights
      .flat()
      .map(Math.abs)
      .sort((a, b) => b - a)
      .slice(0, 53);
    expect(actual).toEqual(expected);
  });
  it("honors render visibility and excludes invalid or subthreshold weights", () => {
    const layers = [
      layer("input", 3),
      layer("output", 2, [
        [Infinity, -0.8, 0.7],
        [0.2, 0.1, NaN],
      ]),
    ];
    const visible = new Map([
      [0, new Set([1])],
      [1, new Set([0])],
    ]);
    expect(
      selectEdges(layers, 10, 0.5, visible).map((edge) => edge.weight),
    ).toEqual([-0.8]);
    expect(selectEdges(layers, 0)).toEqual([]);
  });
  it("samples deterministically without duplicate indices", () => {
    expect(sampledIndices(1000, 4)).toEqual([0, 333, 666, 999]);
    expect(sampledIndices(3, 8)).toEqual([0, 1, 2]);
    expect(sampledIndices(3, 0)).toEqual([]);
    expect(new Set(sampledIndices(57, 32)).size).toBe(32);
  });
  it("centers layers and places units at distinct positions", () => {
    expect(neuronPosition(0, 0, 1, 3)).toEqual([-4, 0, 0]);
    expect(neuronPosition(2, 0, 1, 3)).toEqual([4, 0, 0]);
    expect(neuronPosition(1, 0, 16, 3)).not.toEqual(
      neuronPosition(1, 1, 16, 3),
    );
    expect(
      divergingColor(-100, 1).every((value) => value >= 0 && value <= 1),
    ).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("matrix-free PCA", () => {
  it("recovers the principal axis of collinear data and retains centered distances", () => {
    const projection = projectPCA([
      [1, 2, 3],
      [2, 4, 6],
      [3, 6, 9],
      [4, 8, 12],
    ]);
    expect(projection.components.length).toBe(1);
    expect(projection.explainedVariance[0]).toBeCloseTo(1);
    expect(
      Math.abs(projection.points[1][0] - projection.points[0][0]),
    ).toBeCloseTo(Math.sqrt(14), 5);
    expect(
      projection.points.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point[0], 0),
    ).toBeCloseTo(0);
  });
  it("produces orthogonal components and the correct eigenvalue fractions", () => {
    const projection = projectPCA([
      [3, 0, 0],
      [-3, 0, 0],
      [0, 2, 0],
      [0, -2, 0],
      [0, 0, 1],
      [0, 0, -1],
    ]);
    expect(projection.explainedVariance[0]).toBeCloseTo(9 / 14, 4);
    expect(projection.explainedVariance[1]).toBeCloseTo(4 / 14, 4);
    expect(projection.explainedVariance[2]).toBeCloseTo(1 / 14, 4);
    expect(
      cosineSimilarity(projection.components[0], projection.components[1]),
    ).toBeCloseTo(0, 5);
    expect(
      cosineSimilarity(projection.components[0], projection.components[2]),
    ).toBeCloseTo(0, 5);
  });
  it("handles constants, one sample, invalid shapes and non-finite observations", () => {
    expect(
      projectPCA([
        [3, 3],
        [3, 3],
      ]).points,
    ).toEqual([
      [0, 0, 0],
      [0, 0, 0],
    ]);
    expect(projectPCA([[1, 2]]).components).toEqual([]);
    expect(() => projectPCA([[1], [1, 2]])).toThrow();
    expect(() => projectPCA([[NaN]])).toThrow();
  });
});

describe("attention and captured tensor comparison", () => {
  it("computes attention entropy in bits after row normalization", () => {
    expect(attentionEntropy([0.5, 0.5])).toBeCloseTo(1);
    expect(attentionEntropy([1, 1, 1, 1])).toBeCloseTo(2);
    expect(attentionEntropy([0, 0])).toBe(0);
    expect(() => attentionEntropy([-1, 2])).toThrow();
  });
  it("returns finite zero-norm comparisons and detects shape mismatch", () => {
    expect(cosineSimilarity([0, 0], [0, 0])).toBe(0);
    expect(compareVectors([1, 2], [1, 4]).rmse).toBeCloseTo(Math.sqrt(2));
    expect(pearsonCorrelation([1, 2, 3], [6, 4, 2])).toBeCloseTo(-1);
    expect(() => compareVectors([1], [1, 2])).toThrow();
    expect(() => validateMatrix([[1], [1, 2]])).toThrow();
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  analyzeTrajectory,
  compareRepresentations,
  cosineSimilarityMatrix,
  linearCKA,
  pairwiseSquaredDistances,
  representationDrift,
  sharedTrajectoryProjection,
  trajectoryTurns,
} from "../representations";

describe("original-space representation inspection", () => {
  it("makes linear CKA invariant to translation, isotropic scaling and orthogonal rotation", () => {
    const source = [
      [1, 3],
      [2, -1],
      [-4, 2],
      [0, 4],
    ];
    const transformed = source.map(([x, y]) => [-3 * y + 12, 3 * x - 7]);
    expect(linearCKA(source, transformed)).toBeCloseTo(1, 12);
    expect(
      compareRepresentations(source, transformed).pairwiseDistanceCorrelation,
    ).toBeCloseTo(1);
  });
  it("supports different dimensionalities with aligned sample identities", () => {
    const source = [
      [1, 0],
      [0, 1],
      [-1, 0],
      [0, -1],
    ];
    const extended = source.map(([x, y]) => [x, y, 0]);
    expect(linearCKA(source, extended)).toBeCloseTo(1);
    expect(compareRepresentations(source, extended)).toMatchObject({
      samples: 4,
      leftDimensions: 2,
      rightDimensions: 3,
    });
    expect(() => linearCKA(source, extended.slice(1))).toThrow(/aligned/);
  });
  it("returns a defined zero result for constant representations", () => {
    expect(
      linearCKA(
        [
          [1, 1],
          [1, 1],
        ],
        [
          [2, 2],
          [2, 2],
        ],
      ),
    ).toBe(0);
    expect(
      cosineSimilarityMatrix([
        [0, 0],
        [1, 0],
      ]),
    ).toEqual([
      [0, 0],
      [0, 1],
    ]);
  });
  it("computes original-space distance and exact drift", () => {
    expect(
      pairwiseSquaredDistances([
        [0, 0],
        [3, 4],
        [3, 0],
      ]),
    ).toEqual([25, 9, 16]);
    const drift = representationDrift(
      [
        [1, 0],
        [0, 1],
      ],
      [
        [2, 0],
        [1, 1],
      ],
    );
    expect(drift.absolute).toEqual([1, 1]);
    expect(drift.relative).toEqual([1, 1]);
    expect(drift.cosine[0]).toBe(1);
    expect(drift.cosine[1]).toBeCloseTo(Math.SQRT1_2);
    expect(() => representationDrift([[1]], [[1, 2]])).toThrow();
  });
});

describe("residual trajectory geometry", () => {
  it("distinguishes Euclidean movement, angular change and accumulated path length", () => {
    const trajectory = [
      [1, 0],
      [2, 0],
      [2, 2],
      [3, 2],
    ];
    const steps = analyzeTrajectory(trajectory);
    expect(steps.map((step) => step.displacement)).toEqual([0, 1, 2, 1]);
    expect(steps.map((step) => step.accumulatedDistance)).toEqual([0, 1, 3, 4]);
    expect(steps[2].relativeDisplacement).toBe(1);
    expect(trajectoryTurns(trajectory)).toEqual([Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2]);
  });
  it("uses one PCA basis across trajectories and preserves trajectory boundaries", () => {
    const trajectories = [
      [
        [0, 0],
        [1, 0],
      ],
      [
        [0, 1],
        [1, 1],
        [2, 1],
      ],
    ];
    const result = sharedTrajectoryProjection(trajectories);
    expect(result.points.map((points) => points.length)).toEqual([2, 3]);
    expect(result.projection.points).toEqual(result.points.flat());
    expect(() => analyzeTrajectory([[0], [0, 1]])).toThrow();
  });
});
