export type ArchitectureOperation =
  | "input"
  | "dense"
  | "relu"
  | "tanh"
  | "sigmoid"
  | "softmax"
  | "layernorm"
  | "add"
  | "concat"
  | "output";
export interface ArchitectureNode {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  operation: ArchitectureOperation;
  shape?: number[];
  units?: number;
  axis?: number;
  bias?: boolean;
}
export interface ArchitectureEdge {
  source: string;
  target: string;
}
export interface ArchitectureGraph {
  format: "neuralis.architecture";
  version: 1;
  nodes: ArchitectureNode[];
  edges: ArchitectureEdge[];
}
export interface ArchitectureIssue {
  severity: "error" | "warning";
  message: string;
  node?: string;
  edge?: number;
}
export interface ArchitectureAnalysis {
  issues: ArchitectureIssue[];
  order: string[];
  shapes: Map<string, number[]>;
  parameters: Map<string, number>;
  totalParameters: number;
  depth: Map<string, number>;
}
export interface ArchitecturePosition {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  depth: number;
}
const OPERATIONS: ArchitectureOperation[] = [
  "input",
  "dense",
  "relu",
  "tanh",
  "sigmoid",
  "softmax",
  "layernorm",
  "add",
  "concat",
  "output",
];

function equalShape(a: number[], b: number[]): boolean {
  return a.length === b.length && a.every((size, axis) => size === b[axis]);
}
function validShape(shape: number[]): boolean {
  return (
    shape.length > 0 &&
    shape.length <= 8 &&
    shape.every(
      (size) => Number.isInteger(size) && size > 0 && size <= 1000000,
    ) &&
    shape.reduce((size, value) => size * value, 1) <= 100000000
  );
}

export function graphAdjacency(graph: ArchitectureGraph): {
  incoming: Map<string, string[]>;
  outgoing: Map<string, string[]>;
} {
  const incoming = new Map(
    graph.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, [] as string[]]),
  );
  const outgoing = new Map(
    graph.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, [] as string[]]),
  );
  for (const edge of graph.edges) {
    if (!incoming.has(edge.target) || !outgoing.has(edge.source)) continue;
    incoming.get(edge.target)!.push(edge.source);
    outgoing.get(edge.source)!.push(edge.target);
  }
  return { incoming, outgoing };
}

export function topologicalOrder(graph: ArchitectureGraph): string[] {
  const { incoming, outgoing } = graphAdjacency(graph);
  const degrees = new Map(
    Array.from(incoming, ([id, nodes]) => [id, nodes.length]),
  );
  const queue = graph.nodes
    .filter((node) => degrees.get(node.id) === 0)
    .map((node) => node.id);
  const order: string[] = [];
  for (let cursor = 0; cursor < queue.length; cursor++) {
    const id = queue[cursor];
    order.push(id);
    for (const target of outgoing.get(id) || []) {
      const degree = degrees.get(target)! - 1;
      degrees.set(target, degree);
      if (!degree) queue.push(target);
    }
  }
  if (order.length !== graph.nodes.length)
    throw new Error(
      "Architecture contains a directed cycle or duplicate node IDs.",
    );
  return order;
}

export function analyzeArchitecture(
  graph: ArchitectureGraph,
): ArchitectureAnalysis {
  const issues: ArchitectureIssue[] = [];
  const shapes = new Map<string, number[]>();
  const parameters = new Map<string, number>();
  const depth = new Map<string, number>();
  const result: ArchitectureAnalysis = {
    issues,
    order: [],
    shapes,
    parameters,
    totalParameters: 0,
    depth,
  };
  if (graph.nodes.length > 256 || graph.edges.length > 2048) {
    issues.push({
      severity: "error",
      message:
        "Architecture exceeds the preview budget of 256 nodes and 2,048 edges.",
    });
    return result;
  }
  const nodes = new Map<string, ArchitectureNode>();
  for (const node of graph.nodes) {
    if (!node.id || node.id.length > 120)
      issues.push({
        severity: "error",
        message: "Node ID must have between 1 and 120 characters.",
        node: node.id,
      });
    if (nodes.has(node.id))
      issues.push({
        severity: "error",
        message: "Node IDs must be unique.",
        node: node.id,
      });
    if (!OPERATIONS.includes(node.operation))
      issues.push({
        severity: "error",
        message: "Unknown architecture operation.",
        node: node.id,
      });
    nodes.set(node.id, node);
  }
  const edges = new Set<string>();
  graph.edges.forEach((edge, index) => {
    if (!nodes.has(edge.source) || !nodes.has(edge.target))
      issues.push({
        severity: "error",
        message: "Edge refers to a missing node.",
        edge: index,
      });
    if (edge.source === edge.target)
      issues.push({
        severity: "error",
        message: "Self connections are not allowed in an acyclic architecture.",
        edge: index,
      });
    const key = JSON.stringify([edge.source, edge.target]);
    if (edges.has(key))
      issues.push({
        severity: "error",
        message: "Duplicate edges are not allowed.",
        edge: index,
      });
    edges.add(key);
  });
  if (issues.some((issue) => issue.severity === "error")) return result;
  try {
    result.order = topologicalOrder(graph);
  } catch (error) {
    issues.push({
      severity: "error",
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Invalid graph.",
    });
    return result;
  }
  const { incoming, outgoing } = graphAdjacency(graph);
  for (const id of result.order) {
    const node = nodes.get(id)!;
    const sources = incoming.get(id)!;
    const sourceShapes = sources.map((source) => shapes.get(source));
    const error = (message: string) =>
      issues.push({ severity: "error", message, node: id });
    const warning = (message: string) =>
      issues.push({ severity: "warning", message, node: id });
    depth.set(
      id,
      sources.reduce(
        (max, source) => Math.max(max, (depth.get(source) || 0) + 1),
        0,
      ),
    );
    parameters.set(id, 0);
    if (node.operation === "input") {
      if (sources.length) error("Input nodes cannot have incoming edges.");
      if (!node.shape || !validShape(node.shape))
        error(
          "Input shape must contain positive dimensions within the preview budget.",
        );
      else shapes.set(id, [...node.shape]);
      continue;
    }
    if (!sources.length) {
      error("Non-input operations require an incoming connection.");
      continue;
    }
    if (sourceShapes.some((shape) => !shape)) {
      error("An upstream shape is unavailable. Fix the preceding node first.");
      continue;
    }
    const inputs = sourceShapes as number[][];
    const first = inputs[0];
    if (
      node.operation !== "add" &&
      node.operation !== "concat" &&
      sources.length !== 1
    ) {
      error("This operation accepts exactly one input.");
      continue;
    }
    if (node.operation === "dense") {
      if (
        !Number.isInteger(node.units) ||
        !node.units ||
        node.units < 1 ||
        node.units > 1000000
      ) {
        error("Dense units must be a positive integer at most 1,000,000.");
        continue;
      }
      const output = [...first];
      output[output.length - 1] = node.units;
      shapes.set(id, output);
      const count =
        first[first.length - 1] * node.units +
        (node.bias === false ? 0 : node.units);
      parameters.set(id, count);
    } else if (node.operation === "add") {
      if (inputs.some((shape) => !equalShape(shape, first))) {
        error(
          "Add requires identical shapes; implicit broadcasting is not supported.",
        );
        continue;
      }
      if (inputs.length < 2) warning("Add currently receives only one branch.");
      shapes.set(id, [...first]);
    } else if (node.operation === "concat") {
      const axis = node.axis ?? first.length - 1;
      if (!Number.isInteger(axis) || axis < 0 || axis >= first.length) {
        error("Concatenation axis is outside the input rank.");
        continue;
      }
      if (
        inputs.some(
          (shape) =>
            shape.length !== first.length ||
            shape.some(
              (size, index) => index !== axis && size !== first[index],
            ),
        )
      ) {
        error("Concat inputs must match on every non-concatenated axis.");
        continue;
      }
      const output = [...first];
      output[axis] = inputs.reduce((sum, shape) => sum + shape[axis], 0);
      shapes.set(id, output);
    } else {
      shapes.set(id, [...first]);
      if (node.operation === "layernorm")
        parameters.set(id, first[first.length - 1] * 2);
    }
    if (!outgoing.get(id)?.length && node.operation !== "output")
      warning("This operation is a terminal node without an explicit output.");
  }
  if (!graph.nodes.some((node) => node.operation === "input"))
    issues.push({
      severity: "error",
      message: "Architecture requires at least one input node.",
    });
  if (!graph.nodes.some((node) => node.operation === "output"))
    issues.push({
      severity: "warning",
      message: "Architecture has no explicit output node.",
    });
  const inputs = graph.nodes
    .filter((node) => node.operation === "input")
    .map((node) => node.id);
  const reachable = new Set<string>(inputs);
  const queue = [...inputs];
  for (let i = 0; i < queue.length; i++)
    for (const target of outgoing.get(queue[i]) || [])
      if (!reachable.has(target)) {
        reachable.add(target);
        queue.push(target);
      }
  for (const node of graph.nodes)
    if (!reachable.has(node.id))
      issues.push({
        severity: "warning",
        message: "Node is unreachable from every input.",
        node: node.id,
      });
  result.totalParameters = Array.from(parameters.values()).reduce(
    (sum, count) => sum + count,
    0,
  );
  return result;
}

/** Layered DAG layout with barycentric sweeps to reduce crossings, deterministic for identical graph order. */
export function layoutArchitecture(
  graph: ArchitectureGraph,
  horizontalGap = 190,
  verticalGap = 94,
): ArchitecturePosition[] {
  const analysis = analyzeArchitecture(graph);
  if (!analysis.order.length)
    return graph.nodes.map((node, index) => ({
      id: node.id,
      x: 45 + (index % 4) * horizontalGap,
      y: 40 + Math.floor(index / 4) * verticalGap,
      depth: 0,
    }));
  const layers = new Map<number, string[]>();
  for (const id of analysis.order) {
    const depth = analysis.depth.get(id) || 0;
    if (!layers.has(depth)) layers.set(depth, []);
    layers.get(depth)!.push(id);
  }
  const { incoming, outgoing } = graphAdjacency(graph);
  const positions = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const nodes of layers.values())
    nodes.forEach((id, index) => positions.set(id, index));
  const sortLayer = (nodes: string[], adjacency: Map<string, string[]>) => {
    const average = (id: string) => {
      const neighbors = adjacency.get(id) || [];
      return neighbors.length
        ? neighbors.reduce(
            (sum, neighbor) => sum + (positions.get(neighbor) || 0),
            0,
          ) / neighbors.length
        : positions.get(id) || 0;
    };
    nodes.sort(
      (a, b) =>
        average(a) - average(b) ||
        graph.nodes.findIndex((node) => node.id === a) -
          graph.nodes.findIndex((node) => node.id === b),
    );
    nodes.forEach((id, index) => positions.set(id, index));
  };
  const depths = Array.from(layers.keys()).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 4; iteration++) {
    for (const depth of depths) sortLayer(layers.get(depth)!, incoming);
    for (const depth of depths.slice().reverse())
      sortLayer(layers.get(depth)!, outgoing);
  }
  const maxNodes = Math.max(
    1,
    ...Array.from(layers.values(), (nodes) => nodes.length),
  );
  return analysis.order.map((id) => {
    const depth = analysis.depth.get(id) || 0;
    const nodes = layers.get(depth)!;
    return {
      id,
      depth,
      x: 45 + depth * horizontalGap,
      y: 40 + ((maxNodes - nodes.length) / 2 + nodes.indexOf(id)) * verticalGap,
    };
  });
}

export function connectArchitecture(
  graph: ArchitectureGraph,
  source: string,
  target: string,
): ArchitectureGraph {
  if (
    !graph.nodes.some((node) => node.id === source) ||
    !graph.nodes.some((node) => node.id === target)
  )
    throw new Error("Both connection endpoints must exist.");
  if (
    graph.edges.some((edge) => edge.source === source && edge.target === target)
  )
    throw new Error("Connection already exists.");
  const next = { ...graph, edges: [...graph.edges, { source, target }] };
  topologicalOrder(next);
  return next;
}

export function removeArchitectureNode(
  graph: ArchitectureGraph,
  id: string,
): ArchitectureGraph {
  return {
    ...graph,
    nodes: graph.nodes.filter((node) => node.id !== id),
    edges: graph.edges.filter(
      (edge) => edge.source !== id && edge.target !== id,
    ),
  };
}

export function renameArchitectureNode(
  graph: ArchitectureGraph,
  id: string,
  name: string,
): ArchitectureGraph {
  if (!name.trim() || name.length > 200)
    throw new Error("Node name must have between 1 and 200 characters.");
  return {
    ...graph,
    nodes: graph.nodes.map((node) =>
      node.id === id ? { ...node, name: name.trim() } : node,
    ),
  };
}

export function parseArchitecture(text: string): ArchitectureGraph {
  if (text.length > 2000000)
    throw new Error("Architecture file exceeds the import budget.");
  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
  if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object")
    throw new Error("Expected an architecture document.");
  const record = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (
    record.format !== "neuralis.architecture" ||
    record.version !== 1 ||
    !Array.isArray(record.nodes) ||
    !Array.isArray(record.edges)
  )
    throw new Error("Expected neuralis.architecture version 1.");
  const nodes = record.nodes.map((value: unknown) => {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object")
      throw new Error("Invalid architecture node.");
    const node = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (
      typeof node.id !== "string" ||
      typeof node.name !== "string" ||
      typeof node.operation !== "string" ||
      !OPERATIONS.includes(node.operation as ArchitectureOperation)
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid node identity, name or operation.");
    if (
      node.shape !== undefined &&
      (!Array.isArray(node.shape) ||
        !node.shape.every((size) => typeof size === "number"))
    )
      throw new Error("Node shape must be a numeric array.");
    if (node.units !== undefined && typeof node.units !== "number")
      throw new Error("Dense units must be numeric.");
    if (node.axis !== undefined && typeof node.axis !== "number")
      throw new Error("Axis must be numeric.");
    if (node.bias !== undefined && typeof node.bias !== "boolean")
      throw new Error("Bias flag must be boolean.");
    return {
      id: node.id,
      name: node.name,
      operation: node.operation,
      ...(node.shape ? { shape: [...(node.shape as number[])] } : {}),
      ...(node.units !== undefined ? { units: node.units } : {}),
      ...(node.axis !== undefined ? { axis: node.axis } : {}),
      ...(node.bias !== undefined ? { bias: node.bias } : {}),
    } as ArchitectureNode;
  });
  const edges = record.edges.map((value: unknown) => {
    if (!value || typeof value !== "object")
      throw new Error("Invalid architecture edge.");
    const edge = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof edge.source !== "string" || typeof edge.target !== "string")
      throw new Error("Architecture endpoints must be node IDs.");
    return { source: edge.source, target: edge.target };
  });
  const graph: ArchitectureGraph = {
    format: "neuralis.architecture",
    version: 1,
    nodes,
    edges,
  };
  const analysis = analyzeArchitecture(graph);
  const structural = analysis.issues.filter(
    (issue) =>
      issue.severity === "error" &&
      (!issue.node || /IDs|Edge|cycle|Duplicate|Self/.test(issue.message)),
  );
  if (structural.length)
    throw new Error(structural.map((issue) => issue.message).join(" "));
  return graph;
}

export function sequentialArchitecture(
  sizes: readonly number[],
  names?: readonly string[],
): ArchitectureGraph {
  if (
    !sizes.length ||
    sizes.some((size) => !Number.isInteger(size) || size < 1)
  )
    throw new Error("Architecture sizes must be positive integers.");
  const nodes: ArchitectureNode[] = sizes.map((size, index) =>
    index === 0
      ? {
          id: "input",
          name: names?.[index] || "Input",
          operation: "input",
          shape: [size],
        }
      : {
          id: `dense-${index}`,
          name: names?.[index] || `Dense ${index}`,
          operation: "dense",
          units: size,
        },
  );
  nodes.push({ id: "output", name: "Output", operation: "output" });
  return {
    format: "neuralis.architecture",
    version: 1,
    nodes,
    edges: nodes
      .slice(1)
      .map((node, index) => ({ source: nodes[index].id, target: node.id })),
  };
}

import { attentionEntropy, clamp, validateMatrix } from "./numerics";

export type AttentionMatrix = number[][];
export type MultiHeadAttention = AttentionMatrix[];
export type LayerAttentionCapture = MultiHeadAttention[];
export interface RolloutOptions {
  headFusion?: "mean" | "max" | "min";
  residualWeight?: number;
  discardFraction?: number;
  startLayer?: number;
  endLayer?: number;
}
export interface HeadSummary {
  head: number;
  meanEntropy: number;
  meanSelfAttention: number;
  meanMaxAttention: number;
  nonzeroFraction: number;
}

export function validateAttention(
  matrix: AttentionMatrix,
  square = false,
): { rows: number; columns: number } {
  const shape = validateMatrix(matrix);
  if (shape.rows > 512 || shape.columns > 512)
    throw new Error(
      "Attention preview supports at most 512 query and key tokens.",
    );
  if (square && shape.rows !== shape.columns)
    throw new Error("Rollout requires square self-attention matrices.");
  if (
    matrix.some((row) =>
      row.some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0),
    )
  )
    throw new Error("Attention weights must be finite and non-negative.");
  return shape;
}

export function normalizeAttention(matrix: AttentionMatrix): AttentionMatrix {
  validateAttention(matrix);
  return matrix.map((row) => {
    const sum = row.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0);
    return row.map((value) => (sum > 0 ? value / sum : 0));
  });
}

export function fuseAttentionHeads(
  heads: MultiHeadAttention,
  mode: "mean" | "max" | "min" = "mean",
): AttentionMatrix {
  if (!heads.length) return [];
  if (heads.length > 128)
    throw new Error("Attention preview supports at most 128 heads per layer.");
  const shape = validateAttention(heads[0]);
  if (heads.length * shape.rows * shape.columns > 4000000)
    throw new Error(
      "Head fusion exceeds the four-million-value preview budget.",
    );
  for (const head of heads) {
    const current = validateAttention(head);
    if (current.rows !== shape.rows || current.columns !== shape.columns)
      throw new Error("All attention heads must have matching shapes.");
  }
  return Array.from({ length: shape.rows }, (_, row) =>
    Array.from({ length: shape.columns }, (_, column) => {
      let value = mode === "min" ? Infinity : 0;
      for (const head of heads)
        value =
          mode === "max"
            ? Math.max(value, head[row][column])
            : mode === "min"
              ? Math.min(value, head[row][column])
              : value + head[row][column];
      return mode === "mean" ? value / heads.length : value;
    }),
  );
}

function multiplyAttention(
  left: AttentionMatrix,
  right: AttentionMatrix,
): AttentionMatrix {
  const size = left.length;
  const result = Array.from({ length: size }, () =>
    Array<number>(size).fill(0),
  );
  for (let row = 0; row < size; row++) {
    for (let shared = 0; shared < size; shared++) {
      const multiplier = left[row][shared];
      if (!multiplier) continue;
      for (let column = 0; column < size; column++)
        result[row][column] += multiplier * right[shared][column];
    }
  }
  return result;
}

/** Left-multiply successive query-to-key transition matrices; identity residuals model an explicit skip path. */
export function attentionRollout(
  capture: LayerAttentionCapture,
  options: RolloutOptions = {},
): AttentionMatrix {
  if (!capture.length) return [];
  if (capture.length > 128)
    throw new Error("Attention rollout supports at most 128 layers.");
  const start = clamp(
    Math.floor(options.startLayer ?? 0),
    0,
    capture.length - 1,
  );
  const end = clamp(
    Math.floor(options.endLayer ?? capture.length - 1),
    start,
    capture.length - 1,
  );
  const residual = clamp(options.residualWeight ?? 1, 0, 100);
  const discard = clamp(options.discardFraction ?? 0, 0, 0.99);
  const first = fuseAttentionHeads(capture[start], options.headFusion);
  const shape = validateAttention(first, true);
  if (!shape.rows)
    throw new Error(
      "Attention rollout requires captured heads in each selected layer.",
    );
  if ((end - start + 1) * shape.rows ** 3 > 40000000)
    throw new Error(
      "Rollout exceeds the 40-million-operation preview budget. Reduce token count or layer range.",
    );
  let result: AttentionMatrix = Array.from({ length: shape.rows }, (_, row) =>
    Array.from({ length: shape.rows }, (_, column) => (row === column ? 1 : 0)),
  );
  for (let layer = start; layer <= end; layer++) {
    const fused = fuseAttentionHeads(capture[layer], options.headFusion);
    const current = validateAttention(fused, true);
    if (current.rows !== shape.rows)
      throw new Error(
        "Rollout layers must use the same self-attention token dimensions.",
      );
    const masked = fused.map((row, rowIndex) => {
      const output = [...row];
      if (discard > 0) {
        const ranked = row
          .map((value, index) => ({ value, index }))
          .filter((item) => item.index !== rowIndex)
          .sort((a, b) => a.value - b.value || a.index - b.index);
        const count = Math.floor(ranked.length * discard);
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) output[ranked[i].index] = 0;
      }
      output[rowIndex] += residual;
      return output;
    });
    result = multiplyAttention(normalizeAttention(masked), result);
  }
  return result;
}

export function summarizeHeads(heads: MultiHeadAttention): HeadSummary[] {
  return heads.map((head, index) => {
    const normalized = normalizeAttention(head);
    const rows = normalized.length;
    let entropy = 0;
    let self = 0;
    let maximum = 0;
    let nonzero = 0;
    let total = 0;
    for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
      entropy += attentionEntropy(normalized[row]);
      self += normalized[row][row] || 0;
      maximum += normalized[row].reduce(
        (max, value) => Math.max(max, value),
        0,
      );
      for (const value of normalized[row]) {
        if (value > 0) nonzero++;
        total++;
      }
    }
    return {
      head: index,
      meanEntropy: rows ? entropy / rows : 0,
      meanSelfAttention: rows ? self / rows : 0,
      meanMaxAttention: rows ? maximum / rows : 0,
      nonzeroFraction: total ? nonzero / total : 0,
    };
  });
}

/** Symmetric Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits, averaged over query rows. */
export function attentionHeadDivergence(
  left: AttentionMatrix,
  right: AttentionMatrix,
): number {
  const a = normalizeAttention(left);
  const b = normalizeAttention(right);
  if (
    a.length !== b.length ||
    a.some((row, index) => row.length !== b[index].length)
  )
    throw new Error(
      "Attention head comparison requires matching query and key dimensions.",
    );
  let divergence = 0;
  let included = 0;
  for (let row = 0; row < a.length; row++) {
    if (
      !a[row].some((value) => value > 0) ||
      !b[row].some((value) => value > 0)
    )
      continue;
    let rowDivergence = 0;
    for (let column = 0; column < a[row].length; column++) {
      const p = a[row][column];
      const q = b[row][column];
      const mean = (p + q) / 2;
      if (p) rowDivergence += (p * Math.log2(p / mean)) / 2;
      if (q) rowDivergence += (q * Math.log2(q / mean)) / 2;
    }
    divergence += rowDivergence;
    included++;
  }
  return included ? divergence / included : 0;
}

export function headDivergenceMatrix(
  heads: MultiHeadAttention,
): AttentionMatrix {
  if (heads.length > 32)
    throw new Error("Pairwise head comparison supports at most 32 heads.");
  const shape = heads.length
    ? validateAttention(heads[0])
    : { rows: 0, columns: 0 };
  if (heads.length ** 2 * shape.rows * shape.columns > 20000000)
    throw new Error(
      "Pairwise head comparison exceeds the preview operation budget. Reduce head or token count.",
    );
  const result = Array.from({ length: heads.length }, () =>
    Array<number>(heads.length).fill(0),
  );
  for (let i = 0; i < heads.length; i++)
    for (let j = i + 1; j < heads.length; j++) {
      const divergence = attentionHeadDivergence(heads[i], heads[j]);
      result[i][j] = divergence;
      result[j][i] = divergence;
    }
  return result;
}

export function checkCausalMask(
  matrix: AttentionMatrix,
  tolerance = 1e-8,
): { valid: boolean; leakage: number; violations: number } {
  validateAttention(matrix, true);
  let leakage = 0;
  let violations = 0;
  for (let row = 0; row < matrix.length; row++)
    for (let column = row + 1; column < matrix.length; column++) {
      leakage += matrix[row][column];
      if (matrix[row][column] > tolerance) violations++;
    }
  return { valid: violations === 0, leakage, violations };
}

export function attentionFlowToToken(
  matrix: AttentionMatrix,
  target: number,
): number[] {
  const { columns } = validateAttention(matrix);
  if (!Number.isInteger(target) || target < 0 || target >= columns)
    throw new Error("Target token is out of bounds.");
  return normalizeAttention(matrix).map((row) => row[target]);
}

import type { LayerData } from "../types";

export function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const anchor = document.createElement("a");
  anchor.href = url;
  anchor.download = filename.replace(/[\\/\u0000-\u001f]/g, "_");
  document.body.appendChild(anchor);
  anchor.click();
  anchor.remove();
  window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 30000);
}

export function exportCanvasImage(
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  filename = "neuralis-visualization.png",
): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!canvas.width || !canvas.height) {
      reject(new Error("Canvas has no pixels to export."));
      return;
    }
    try {
      canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
        if (!blob) {
          reject(new Error("The renderer could not encode this image."));
          return;
        }
        downloadBlob(blob, filename);
        resolve();
      }, "image/png");
    } catch {
      reject(new Error("Canvas image export was blocked by browser security."));
    }
  });
}

export function exportTensorCSV(
  matrix: readonly (readonly number[])[],
  filename = "tensor.csv",
): void {
  const csv = matrix
    .map((row) =>
      row
        .map((value) => (Number.isFinite(value) ? String(value) : ""))
        .join(","),
    )
    .join("\n");
  downloadBlob(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" }), filename);
}

export function exportLayersJSON(
  layers: LayerData[],
  filename = "neuralis-tensors.json",
): void {
  const body = JSON.stringify(
    {
      format: "neuralis.layers",
      version: 1,
      capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      layers,
    },
    null,
    2,
  );
  downloadBlob(new Blob([body], { type: "application/json" }), filename);
}

export function exportSVG(
  svg: SVGSVGElement,
  filename = "neuralis-chart.svg",
): void {
  const clone = svg.cloneNode(true) as SVGSVGElement;
  clone.setAttribute("xmlns", "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg");
  const body = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(clone);
  downloadBlob(
    new Blob([body], { type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8" }),
    filename,
  );
}

import type { LayerData } from "../types";

export type Vector3Tuple = [number, number, number];
export interface NumericSummary {
  count: number;
  invalid: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  mean: number;
  median: number;
  variance: number;
  standardDeviation: number;
  l1: number;
  l2: number;
  sparsity: number;
}
export interface HistogramBin {
  lower: number;
  upper: number;
  count: number;
  density: number;
}
export interface EdgeRecord {
  sourceLayer: number;
  source: number;
  targetLayer: number;
  target: number;
  weight: number;
  score: number;
}
export interface Projection {
  points: Vector3Tuple[];
  components: number[][];
  mean: number[];
  explainedVariance: number[];
  totalVariance: number;
}
export const finite = (value: unknown, fallback = 0): number =>
  typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
export const clamp = (value: number, lower: number, upper: number): number =>
  Math.max(lower, Math.min(upper, value));

/** Stable two-pass statistics. Non-finite values are counted, never silently presented as observations. */
export function summarize(
  values: readonly number[],
  zeroThreshold = 1e-8,
): NumericSummary {
  const valid = values.filter(Number.isFinite);
  const count = valid.length;
  if (!count)
    return {
      count: 0,
      invalid: values.length,
      min: 0,
      max: 0,
      mean: 0,
      median: 0,
      variance: 0,
      standardDeviation: 0,
      l1: 0,
      l2: 0,
      sparsity: 0,
    };
  let mean = 0;
  let m2 = 0;
  let l1 = 0;
  let squareSum = 0;
  let zeros = 0;
  let min = Infinity;
  let max = -Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const value = valid[i];
    const delta = value - mean;
    mean += delta / (i + 1);
    m2 += delta * (value - mean);
    min = Math.min(min, value);
    max = Math.max(max, value);
    l1 += Math.abs(value);
    squareSum += value * value;
    if (Math.abs(value) <= zeroThreshold) zeros++;
  }
  const ordered = valid.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const midpoint = Math.floor(count / 2);
  const median =
    count % 2
      ? ordered[midpoint]
      : (ordered[midpoint - 1] + ordered[midpoint]) / 2;
  const variance = Math.max(0, m2 / count);
  return {
    count,
    invalid: values.length - count,
    min,
    max,
    mean,
    median,
    variance,
    standardDeviation: Math.sqrt(variance),
    l1,
    l2: Math.sqrt(squareSum),
    sparsity: zeros / count,
  };
}

export function histogram(
  values: readonly number[],
  binCount = 32,
  range?: [number, number],
): HistogramBin[] {
  const valid = values.filter(Number.isFinite);
  const count = clamp(Math.floor(finite(binCount, 32)), 1, 512);
  if (!valid.length) return [];
  const stats = summarize(valid);
  let lower = range ? range[0] : stats.min;
  let upper = range ? range[1] : stats.max;
  if (!Number.isFinite(lower) || !Number.isFinite(upper) || lower > upper)
    throw new Error("Histogram range must be finite and ordered.");
  if (lower === upper) {
    const padding = Math.max(Math.abs(lower) * 0.01, 0.5);
    lower -= padding;
    upper += padding;
  }
  const width = (upper - lower) / count;
  const bins = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
    lower: lower + width * i,
    upper: lower + width * (i + 1),
    count: 0,
    density: 0,
  }));
  let included = 0;
  for (const value of valid) {
    if (value < lower || value > upper) continue;
    bins[Math.min(count - 1, Math.floor((value - lower) / width))].count++;
    included++;
  }
  for (const bin of bins)
    bin.density = included ? bin.count / (included * width) : 0;
  return bins;
}

export function quantile(values: readonly number[], fraction: number): number {
  const sorted = values
    .filter(Number.isFinite)
    .slice()
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  if (!sorted.length) return 0;
  const position = clamp(fraction, 0, 1) * (sorted.length - 1);
  const index = Math.floor(position);
  const remainder = position - index;
  return (
    sorted[index] * (1 - remainder) +
    sorted[Math.min(index + 1, sorted.length - 1)] * remainder
  );
}

export function symmetricDomain(
  values: readonly number[],
  percentile = 0.98,
): number {
  const magnitude = quantile(
    values.filter(Number.isFinite).map(Math.abs),
    percentile,
  );
  return magnitude > 1e-12 ? magnitude : 1;
}

const COLOR_STOPS: Vector3Tuple[] = [
  [0.11, 0.32, 0.72],
  [0.19, 0.82, 0.96],
  [0.11, 0.15, 0.25],
  [0.64, 0.31, 0.94],
  [1, 0.4, 0.55],
];
export function divergingColor(value: number, domain = 1): Vector3Tuple {
  const normalized = clamp(
    finite(value) / Math.max(Math.abs(domain), 1e-12),
    -1,
    1,
  );
  const position = (normalized + 1) * 2;
  const index = Math.min(3, Math.floor(position));
  const mix = position - index;
  return COLOR_STOPS[index].map(
    (channel, i) => channel + (COLOR_STOPS[index + 1][i] - channel) * mix,
  ) as Vector3Tuple;
}
export function rgbCss(rgb: Vector3Tuple, alpha = 1): string {
  return `rgba(${rgb.map((value) => Math.round(clamp(value, 0, 1) * 255)).join(",")},${clamp(alpha, 0, 1)})`;
}

export function neuronPosition(
  layer: number,
  neuron: number,
  size: number,
  layerCount: number,
): Vector3Tuple {
  const rows = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(Math.max(size, 1))));
  const columns = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(size / rows));
  const row = neuron % rows;
  const column = Math.floor(neuron / rows);
  const spacing = Math.min(0.72, 5.8 / rows);
  return [
    (layer - (layerCount - 1) / 2) * 4,
    (row - (rows - 1) / 2) * spacing,
    (column - (columns - 1) / 2) * spacing,
  ];
}

/** Uniform deterministic sampling preserves endpoint identities for very wide layers. */
export function sampledIndices(size: number, budget: number): number[] {
  const length = Math.max(0, Math.floor(finite(size)));
  const count = Math.min(length, Math.max(0, Math.floor(finite(budget))));
  if (!count) return [];
  if (count === 1) return [0];
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) =>
    Math.round((i * (length - 1)) / (count - 1)),
  );
}

export function layerValues(
  layer: LayerData,
  mode: "activations" | "weights" | "gradients",
): number[] {
  if (mode === "activations") return layer.activations;
  if (mode === "gradients") return layer.gradients;
  return Array.from({ length: layer.size }, (_, i) => {
    const row = layer.weights[i];
    if (!row?.length) return 0;
    return row.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + finite(weight), 0) / row.length;
  });
}

/** Top-k by absolute weight, using a bounded min-heap rather than allocating/sorting the complete graph. */
export function selectEdges(
  layers: LayerData[],
  budget = 1600,
  threshold = 0,
  visible?: Map<number, Set<number>>,
): EdgeRecord[] {
  const limit = clamp(Math.floor(finite(budget)), 0, 50000);
  if (!limit) return [];
  const heap: EdgeRecord[] = [];
  const swap = (a: number, b: number) => {
    const value = heap[a];
    heap[a] = heap[b];
    heap[b] = value;
  };
  const insert = (edge: EdgeRecord) => {
    if (heap.length < limit) {
      heap.push(edge);
      let i = heap.length - 1;
      while (i > 0) {
        const parent = (i - 1) >> 1;
        if (heap[parent].score <= heap[i].score) break;
        swap(i, parent);
        i = parent;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (edge.score <= heap[0].score) return;
    heap[0] = edge;
    let i = 0;
    while (true) {
      const left = i * 2 + 1;
      const right = left + 1;
      let smallest = i;
      if (left < heap.length && heap[left].score < heap[smallest].score)
        smallest = left;
      if (right < heap.length && heap[right].score < heap[smallest].score)
        smallest = right;
      if (smallest === i) break;
      swap(i, smallest);
      i = smallest;
    }
  };
  for (let targetLayer = 1; targetLayer < layers.length; targetLayer++) {
    const sourceSize = layers[targetLayer - 1].size;
    const target = layers[targetLayer];
    for (
      let neuron = 0;
      neuron < Math.min(target.size, target.weights.length);
      neuron++
    ) {
      if (visible && !visible.get(targetLayer)?.has(neuron)) continue;
      const row = target.weights[neuron];
      for (
        let source = 0;
        source < Math.min(sourceSize, row.length);
        source++
      ) {
        if (visible && !visible.get(targetLayer - 1)?.has(source)) continue;
        const weight = row[source];
        if (!Number.isFinite(weight) || Math.abs(weight) < threshold) continue;
        insert({
          sourceLayer: targetLayer - 1,
          source,
          targetLayer,
          target: neuron,
          weight,
          score: Math.abs(weight),
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return heap.sort(
    (a, b) =>
      b.score - a.score ||
      a.targetLayer - b.targetLayer ||
      a.target - b.target ||
      a.source - b.source,
  );
}

export function cosineSimilarity(
  a: readonly number[],
  b: readonly number[],
): number {
  if (a.length !== b.length)
    throw new Error("Cosine similarity requires vectors of equal dimensions.");
  let dot = 0;
  let normA = 0;
  let normB = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    const x = finite(a[i]);
    const y = finite(b[i]);
    dot += x * y;
    normA += x * x;
    normB += y * y;
  }
  return normA > 0 && normB > 0
    ? clamp(dot / Math.sqrt(normA * normB), -1, 1)
    : 0;
}

function dot(a: number[], b: number[]): number {
  return a.reduce((sum, value, i) => sum + value * b[i], 0);
}
function normalize(vector: number[]): number[] {
  const norm = Math.sqrt(dot(vector, vector));
  return norm > 1e-12
    ? vector.map((value) => value / norm)
    : vector.map(() => 0);
}

/** Centered PCA with matrix-free power iteration and orthogonal deflation. O(n*d*k), no d² covariance. */
export function projectPCA(
  vectors: readonly (readonly number[])[],
  iterations = 80,
): Projection {
  if (!vectors.length)
    return {
      points: [],
      components: [],
      mean: [],
      explainedVariance: [],
      totalVariance: 0,
    };
  const dimension = vectors[0].length;
  if (
    !dimension ||
    vectors.some(
      (vector) =>
        vector.length !== dimension ||
        vector.some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value)),
    )
  )
    throw new Error("PCA requires non-empty, equal-length finite vectors.");
  if (vectors.length > 10000 || dimension > 8192)
    throw new Error(
      "PCA preview budget exceeded. Sample at most 10,000 vectors with at most 8,192 dimensions.",
    );
  if (vectors.length * dimension > 2000000)
    throw new Error(
      "PCA preview supports at most two million captured values. Sample representations before projecting.",
    );
  const iterationBudget = Math.min(
    clamp(iterations, 1, 250),
    Math.max(
      8,
      Math.floor(48000000 / Math.max(1, vectors.length * dimension * 3)),
    ),
  );
  const mean = Array.from(
    { length: dimension },
    (_, j) =>
      vectors.reduce((sum, vector) => sum + vector[j], 0) / vectors.length,
  );
  const centered = vectors.map((vector) =>
    vector.map((value, j) => value - mean[j]),
  );
  const denominator = Math.max(1, vectors.length - 1);
  const totalVariance =
    centered.reduce((sum, vector) => sum + dot(vector, vector), 0) /
    denominator;
  const components: number[][] = [];
  const explainedVariance: number[] = [];
  for (
    let component = 0;
    component < Math.min(3, dimension, Math.max(0, vectors.length - 1));
    component++
  ) {
    let axis = normalize(
      Array.from(
        { length: dimension },
        (_, j) =>
          Math.sin((j + 1) * (component + 1) * 1.618) + Math.cos(j * 0.71),
      ),
    );
    for (let iteration = 0; iteration < iterationBudget; iteration++) {
      const next = Array<number>(dimension).fill(0);
      for (const vector of centered) {
        const projection = dot(vector, axis);
        for (let j = 0; j < dimension; j++) next[j] += vector[j] * projection;
      }
      for (const previous of components) {
        const projection = dot(next, previous);
        for (let j = 0; j < dimension; j++) next[j] -= previous[j] * projection;
      }
      const normalized = normalize(next);
      if (Math.abs(dot(axis, normalized)) > 1 - 1e-10) {
        axis = normalized;
        break;
      }
      axis = normalized;
    }
    const variance =
      centered.reduce((sum, vector) => {
        const projection = dot(vector, axis);
        return sum + projection * projection;
      }, 0) / denominator;
    if (variance <= 1e-12) break;
    components.push(axis);
    explainedVariance.push(totalVariance > 0 ? variance / totalVariance : 0);
  }
  const points = centered.map(
    (vector) =>
      [0, 1, 2].map((i) =>
        components[i] ? dot(vector, components[i]) : 0,
      ) as Vector3Tuple,
  );
  return { points, components, mean, explainedVariance, totalVariance };
}

export function pearsonCorrelation(
  a: readonly number[],
  b: readonly number[],
): number {
  if (a.length !== b.length)
    throw new Error("Correlation requires equal-length vectors.");
  const pairs = a
    .map((value, i) => [value, b[i]])
    .filter((pair) => pair.every(Number.isFinite));
  if (!pairs.length) return 0;
  const averageA = pairs.reduce((sum, pair) => sum + pair[0], 0) / pairs.length;
  const averageB = pairs.reduce((sum, pair) => sum + pair[1], 0) / pairs.length;
  let numerator = 0;
  let denominatorA = 0;
  let denominatorB = 0;
  for (const [x, y] of pairs) {
    numerator += (x - averageA) * (y - averageB);
    denominatorA += (x - averageA) ** 2;
    denominatorB += (y - averageB) ** 2;
  }
  return denominatorA > 0 && denominatorB > 0
    ? clamp(numerator / Math.sqrt(denominatorA * denominatorB), -1, 1)
    : 0;
}

export function compareVectors(
  left: readonly number[],
  right: readonly number[],
): {
  rmse: number;
  cosine: number;
  correlation: number;
  maxDifference: number;
  compared: number;
} {
  if (left.length !== right.length)
    throw new Error("Comparison requires tensors with equal sizes.");
  const differences = left.map((value, i) => value - right[i]);
  if (differences.some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value)))
    throw new Error("Comparison requires finite tensors.");
  const stats = summarize(differences);
  return {
    rmse: left.length ? stats.l2 / Math.sqrt(left.length) : 0,
    cosine: cosineSimilarity(left, right),
    correlation: pearsonCorrelation(left, right),
    maxDifference: Math.max(Math.abs(stats.min), Math.abs(stats.max)),
    compared: left.length,
  };
}

export function attentionEntropy(row: readonly number[]): number {
  if (row.some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0))
    throw new Error("Attention weights must be finite and non-negative.");
  const total = row.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
  if (!total) return 0;
  return -row.reduce((sum, value) => {
    const probability = value / total;
    return probability ? sum + probability * Math.log2(probability) : sum;
  }, 0);
}

export function validateMatrix(matrix: readonly (readonly number[])[]): {
  rows: number;
  columns: number;
} {
  if (!matrix.length) return { rows: 0, columns: 0 };
  const columns = matrix[0].length;
  if (matrix.some((row) => row.length !== columns))
    throw new Error("Tensor rows must have equal widths.");
  return { rows: matrix.length, columns };
}

import {
  cosineSimilarity,
  pearsonCorrelation,
  projectPCA,
  summarize,
  type Projection,
  type Vector3Tuple,
} from "./numerics";

export interface TrajectoryStep {
  layer: number;
  norm: number;
  displacement: number;
  relativeDisplacement: number;
  cosineToPrevious: number;
  cosineToInitial: number;
  accumulatedDistance: number;
}
export interface RepresentationSimilarity {
  cka: number;
  pairwiseDistanceCorrelation: number;
  samples: number;
  leftDimensions: number;
  rightDimensions: number;
  leftMeanNorm: number;
  rightMeanNorm: number;
}

function validateRepresentations(vectors: number[][]): {
  samples: number;
  dimensions: number;
} {
  if (!vectors.length || !vectors[0].length)
    throw new Error(
      "Representation analysis requires at least one non-empty vector.",
    );
  const dimension = vectors[0].length;
  if (
    vectors.some(
      (vector) =>
        vector.length !== dimension ||
        vector.some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value)),
    )
  )
    throw new Error(
      "Representation vectors must have matching finite dimensions.",
    );
  if (vectors.length * dimension > 2000000)
    throw new Error("Representation capture exceeds the preview budget.");
  return { samples: vectors.length, dimensions: dimension };
}

export function representationNorms(vectors: number[][]): number[] {
  validateRepresentations(vectors);
  return vectors.map((vector) =>
    Math.sqrt(vector.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value * value, 0)),
  );
}

export function analyzeTrajectory(trajectory: number[][]): TrajectoryStep[] {
  if (!trajectory.length) return [];
  validateRepresentations(trajectory);
  const norms = representationNorms(trajectory);
  let accumulatedDistance = 0;
  return trajectory.map((vector, layer) => {
    const previous = trajectory[Math.max(0, layer - 1)];
    const displacement = Math.sqrt(
      vector.reduce(
        (sum, value, axis) => sum + (value - previous[axis]) ** 2,
        0,
      ),
    );
    accumulatedDistance += displacement;
    return {
      layer,
      norm: norms[layer],
      displacement,
      relativeDisplacement:
        norms[Math.max(0, layer - 1)] > 0
          ? displacement / norms[Math.max(0, layer - 1)]
          : 0,
      cosineToPrevious: cosineSimilarity(vector, previous),
      cosineToInitial: cosineSimilarity(vector, trajectory[0]),
      accumulatedDistance,
    };
  });
}

export function sharedTrajectoryProjection(trajectories: number[][][]): {
  projection: Projection;
  points: Vector3Tuple[][];
} {
  const projection = projectPCA(trajectories.flat());
  let offset = 0;
  const points = trajectories.map((trajectory) => {
    const result = projection.points.slice(offset, offset + trajectory.length);
    offset += trajectory.length;
    return result;
  });
  return { projection, points };
}

export function cosineSimilarityMatrix(vectors: number[][]): number[][] {
  const shape = validateRepresentations(vectors);
  if (shape.samples ** 2 * shape.dimensions > 20000000)
    throw new Error(
      "Pairwise representation similarity exceeds the preview operation budget.",
    );
  const norms = representationNorms(vectors);
  const result = Array.from({ length: shape.samples }, () =>
    Array<number>(shape.samples).fill(0),
  );
  for (let i = 0; i < shape.samples; i++) {
    result[i][i] = norms[i] > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    for (let j = i + 1; j < shape.samples; j++) {
      const similarity = cosineSimilarity(vectors[i], vectors[j]);
      result[i][j] = similarity;
      result[j][i] = similarity;
    }
  }
  return result;
}

function centeredLinearGram(vectors: number[][]): number[][] {
  const { samples, dimensions } = validateRepresentations(vectors);
  if (samples ** 2 * dimensions > 20000000)
    throw new Error(
      "CKA exceeds the preview operation budget. Use fewer captured samples.",
    );
  const mean = Array.from(
    { length: dimensions },
    (_, axis) =>
      vectors.reduce((sum, vector) => sum + vector[axis], 0) / samples,
  );
  const centered = vectors.map((vector) =>
    vector.map((value, axis) => value - mean[axis]),
  );
  const gram = Array.from({ length: samples }, () =>
    Array<number>(samples).fill(0),
  );
  for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++)
    for (let j = i; j < samples; j++) {
      const product = centered[i].reduce(
        (sum, value, axis) => sum + value * centered[j][axis],
        0,
      );
      gram[i][j] = product;
      gram[j][i] = product;
    }
  return gram;
}

/** Biased linear centered-kernel alignment across aligned samples; invariant to translation and isotropic scale. */
export function linearCKA(left: number[][], right: number[][]): number {
  const leftShape = validateRepresentations(left);
  const rightShape = validateRepresentations(right);
  if (leftShape.samples !== rightShape.samples)
    throw new Error("CKA requires the same aligned samples in both captures.");
  const a = centeredLinearGram(left);
  const b = centeredLinearGram(right);
  let cross = 0;
  let normA = 0;
  let normB = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++)
    for (let j = 0; j < a.length; j++) {
      cross += a[i][j] * b[i][j];
      normA += a[i][j] ** 2;
      normB += b[i][j] ** 2;
    }
  return normA > 0 && normB > 0
    ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, cross / Math.sqrt(normA * normB)))
    : 0;
}

export function pairwiseSquaredDistances(vectors: number[][]): number[] {
  const { samples, dimensions } = validateRepresentations(vectors);
  if (samples ** 2 * dimensions > 20000000)
    throw new Error(
      "Pairwise distance computation exceeds the preview operation budget.",
    );
  const distances: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++)
    for (let j = i + 1; j < samples; j++)
      distances.push(
        vectors[i].reduce(
          (sum, value, axis) => sum + (value - vectors[j][axis]) ** 2,
          0,
        ),
      );
  return distances;
}

export function compareRepresentations(
  left: number[][],
  right: number[][],
): RepresentationSimilarity {
  const leftShape = validateRepresentations(left);
  const rightShape = validateRepresentations(right);
  if (leftShape.samples !== rightShape.samples)
    throw new Error(
      "Representation comparison requires aligned sample identities and counts.",
    );
  const cka = linearCKA(left, right);
  const pairwiseDistanceCorrelation = pearsonCorrelation(
    pairwiseSquaredDistances(left),
    pairwiseSquaredDistances(right),
  );
  return {
    cka,
    pairwiseDistanceCorrelation,
    samples: leftShape.samples,
    leftDimensions: leftShape.dimensions,
    rightDimensions: rightShape.dimensions,
    leftMeanNorm: summarize(representationNorms(left)).mean,
    rightMeanNorm: summarize(representationNorms(right)).mean,
  };
}

export function representationDrift(
  reference: number[][],
  current: number[][],
): {
  absolute: number[];
  relative: number[];
  cosine: number[];
  meanDisplacement: number;
  meanCosine: number;
} {
  const a = validateRepresentations(reference);
  const b = validateRepresentations(current);
  if (a.samples !== b.samples || a.dimensions !== b.dimensions)
    throw new Error(
      "Elementwise drift requires identical capture shapes and aligned samples.",
    );
  const norms = representationNorms(reference);
  const absolute = current.map((vector, i) =>
    Math.sqrt(
      vector.reduce(
        (sum, value, axis) => sum + (value - reference[i][axis]) ** 2,
        0,
      ),
    ),
  );
  const relative = absolute.map((value, i) =>
    norms[i] > 0 ? value / norms[i] : 0,
  );
  const cosine = reference.map((vector, i) =>
    cosineSimilarity(vector, current[i]),
  );
  return {
    absolute,
    relative,
    cosine,
    meanDisplacement: summarize(absolute).mean,
    meanCosine: summarize(cosine).mean,
  };
}

export function trajectoryTurns(trajectory: number[][]): number[] {
  if (trajectory.length < 3) return [];
  validateRepresentations(trajectory);
  const steps = trajectory
    .slice(1)
    .map((vector, layer) =>
      vector.map((value, axis) => value - trajectory[layer][axis]),
    );
  return steps.slice(1).map((step, index) => {
    const normA = summarize(steps[index]).l2;
    const normB = summarize(step).l2;
    return normA > 0 && normB > 0
      ? Math.acos(cosineSimilarity(steps[index], step))
      : 0;
  });
}

import { clamp, summarize, type NumericSummary } from "./numerics";

export interface DenseTensor {
  data: Float64Array;
  shape: number[];
  strides: number[];
}
export interface TensorSlice {
  matrix: number[][];
  rowAxis: number;
  columnAxis: number;
  fixedIndices: number[];
  sourceShape: number[];
}
export type TensorReduction = "mean" | "sum" | "min" | "max" | "l2";
export interface TensorCoordinate {
  index: number[];
  value: number;
  offset: number;
}

export function tensorSize(shape: readonly number[]): number {
  if (shape.length > 16)
    throw new Error("Tensor previews support at most 16 axes.");
  if (shape.some((size) => !Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size < 0))
    throw new Error("Tensor dimensions must be non-negative integers.");
  const size = shape.reduce((product, dimension) => product * dimension, 1);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size > 2000000)
    throw new Error(
      "Tensor preview exceeds the two-million-element capture budget.",
    );
  return size;
}

export function contiguousStrides(shape: readonly number[]): number[] {
  tensorSize(shape);
  let stride = 1;
  const strides = Array<number>(shape.length);
  for (let axis = shape.length - 1; axis >= 0; axis--) {
    strides[axis] = stride;
    stride *= shape[axis];
  }
  return strides;
}

export function denseTensor(
  values: readonly number[] | Float64Array,
  shape: readonly number[],
): DenseTensor {
  const expected = tensorSize(shape);
  if (values.length !== expected)
    throw new Error(
      `Tensor shape requires ${expected} values, received ${values.length}.`,
    );
  return {
    data: Float64Array.from(values),
    shape: [...shape],
    strides: contiguousStrides(shape),
  };
}

export function validateTensor(tensor: DenseTensor): void {
  if (tensor.data.length !== tensorSize(tensor.shape))
    throw new Error("Tensor buffer and shape disagree.");
  const expected = contiguousStrides(tensor.shape);
  if (
    tensor.strides.length !== expected.length ||
    tensor.strides.some((stride, axis) => stride !== expected[axis])
  )
    throw new Error("Tensor must use contiguous row-major strides.");
}

export function flattenIndex(
  index: readonly number[],
  shape: readonly number[],
  strides = contiguousStrides(shape),
): number {
  if (index.length !== shape.length || strides.length !== shape.length)
    throw new Error("Index rank does not match tensor rank.");
  let offset = 0;
  for (let axis = 0; axis < shape.length; axis++) {
    if (
      !Number.isInteger(index[axis]) ||
      index[axis] < 0 ||
      index[axis] >= shape[axis]
    )
      throw new Error(`Index on axis ${axis} is out of bounds.`);
    offset += index[axis] * strides[axis];
  }
  return offset;
}

export function unravelIndex(
  offset: number,
  shape: readonly number[],
): number[] {
  const size = tensorSize(shape);
  if (!Number.isInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || offset >= size)
    throw new Error("Flat tensor index is out of bounds.");
  const strides = contiguousStrides(shape);
  return shape.map(
    (dimension, axis) => Math.floor(offset / strides[axis]) % dimension,
  );
}

export function reshapeTensor(
  tensor: DenseTensor,
  shape: readonly number[],
): DenseTensor {
  validateTensor(tensor);
  if (tensorSize(shape) !== tensor.data.length)
    throw new Error("Reshape must preserve the number of tensor elements.");
  return {
    data: tensor.data,
    shape: [...shape],
    strides: contiguousStrides(shape),
  };
}

export function transposeTensor(
  tensor: DenseTensor,
  order: readonly number[],
): DenseTensor {
  validateTensor(tensor);
  if (
    order.length !== tensor.shape.length ||
    new Set(order).size !== order.length ||
    order.some(
      (axis) =>
        axis < 0 || axis >= tensor.shape.length || !Number.isInteger(axis),
    )
  )
    throw new Error("Transpose order must be a permutation of tensor axes.");
  const shape = order.map((axis) => tensor.shape[axis]);
  const data = new Float64Array(tensor.data.length);
  const outputStrides = contiguousStrides(shape);
  for (let offset = 0; offset < data.length; offset++) {
    let sourceOffset = 0;
    for (let axis = 0; axis < order.length; axis++) {
      const coordinate = Math.floor(offset / outputStrides[axis]) % shape[axis];
      sourceOffset += coordinate * tensor.strides[order[axis]];
    }
    data[offset] = tensor.data[sourceOffset];
  }
  return { data, shape, strides: outputStrides };
}

export function sliceTensor(
  tensor: DenseTensor,
  rowAxis: number,
  columnAxis: number,
  fixedIndices: readonly number[] = [],
): TensorSlice {
  validateTensor(tensor);
  const rank = tensor.shape.length;
  if (rank < 2)
    throw new Error(
      "A two-dimensional slice requires at least two tensor axes.",
    );
  if (
    rowAxis === columnAxis ||
    !Number.isInteger(rowAxis) ||
    !Number.isInteger(columnAxis) ||
    rowAxis < 0 ||
    columnAxis < 0 ||
    rowAxis >= rank ||
    columnAxis >= rank
  )
    throw new Error("Slice row and column axes must be distinct valid axes.");
  const fixed = tensor.shape.map((size, axis) => {
    if (axis === rowAxis || axis === columnAxis) return 0;
    const value = fixedIndices[axis] ?? 0;
    if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0 || value >= size)
      throw new Error(`Fixed index on axis ${axis} is out of bounds.`);
    return value;
  });
  const origin = fixed.reduce(
    (sum, index, axis) => sum + index * tensor.strides[axis],
    0,
  );
  const matrix = Array.from({ length: tensor.shape[rowAxis] }, (_, row) =>
    Array.from(
      { length: tensor.shape[columnAxis] },
      (_, column) =>
        tensor.data[
          origin +
            row * tensor.strides[rowAxis] +
            column * tensor.strides[columnAxis]
        ],
    ),
  );
  return {
    matrix,
    rowAxis,
    columnAxis,
    fixedIndices: fixed,
    sourceShape: [...tensor.shape],
  };
}

export function reduceTensor(
  tensor: DenseTensor,
  axis: number,
  operation: TensorReduction,
): DenseTensor {
  validateTensor(tensor);
  if (!Number.isInteger(axis) || axis < 0 || axis >= tensor.shape.length)
    throw new Error("Reduction axis is out of bounds.");
  const shape = tensor.shape.filter((_, index) => index !== axis);
  const data = new Float64Array(tensorSize(shape));
  const strides = contiguousStrides(shape);
  const axisSize = tensor.shape[axis];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < data.length; offset++) {
    let sourceOffset = 0;
    let outputAxis = 0;
    for (let sourceAxis = 0; sourceAxis < tensor.shape.length; sourceAxis++) {
      if (sourceAxis === axis) continue;
      const coordinate =
        Math.floor(offset / strides[outputAxis]) % shape[outputAxis];
      sourceOffset += coordinate * tensor.strides[sourceAxis];
      outputAxis++;
    }
    let accumulated =
      operation === "min" ? Infinity : operation === "max" ? -Infinity : 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < axisSize; index++) {
      const value = tensor.data[sourceOffset + index * tensor.strides[axis]];
      if (operation === "min") accumulated = Math.min(accumulated, value);
      else if (operation === "max") accumulated = Math.max(accumulated, value);
      else accumulated += operation === "l2" ? value * value : value;
    }
    if (operation === "mean")
      accumulated = axisSize ? accumulated / axisSize : NaN;
    if (operation === "l2") accumulated = Math.sqrt(accumulated);
    data[offset] = accumulated;
  }
  return { data, shape, strides };
}

export function tensorChannelStatistics(
  tensor: DenseTensor,
  axis: number,
): NumericSummary[] {
  validateTensor(tensor);
  if (!Number.isInteger(axis) || axis < 0 || axis >= tensor.shape.length)
    throw new Error("Channel axis is out of bounds.");
  const buckets: number[][] = Array.from(
    { length: tensor.shape[axis] },
    () => [],
  );
  for (let offset = 0; offset < tensor.data.length; offset++)
    buckets[
      Math.floor(offset / tensor.strides[axis]) % tensor.shape[axis]
    ].push(tensor.data[offset]);
  return buckets.map((bucket) => summarize(bucket));
}

export function largestTensorElements(
  tensor: DenseTensor,
  count = 20,
): TensorCoordinate[] {
  validateTensor(tensor);
  const budget = clamp(Math.floor(count), 0, 512);
  const ranked: { value: number; offset: number }[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0; offset < tensor.data.length; offset++) {
    const value = tensor.data[offset];
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) continue;
    if (
      ranked.length >= budget &&
      Math.abs(value) <= Math.abs(ranked[ranked.length - 1]?.value ?? 0)
    )
      continue;
    let insertion = 0;
    while (
      insertion < ranked.length &&
      Math.abs(ranked[insertion].value) >= Math.abs(value)
    )
      insertion++;
    ranked.splice(insertion, 0, { value, offset });
    if (ranked.length > budget) ranked.pop();
  }
  return ranked.map((element) => ({
    ...element,
    index: unravelIndex(element.offset, tensor.shape),
  }));
}

export function tensorDifference(
  left: DenseTensor,
  right: DenseTensor,
): DenseTensor {
  validateTensor(left);
  validateTensor(right);
  if (
    left.shape.length !== right.shape.length ||
    left.shape.some((size, axis) => size !== right.shape[axis])
  )
    throw new Error("Tensor difference requires identical shapes.");
  return {
    data: Float64Array.from(
      left.data,
      (value, offset) => value - right.data[offset],
    ),
    shape: [...left.shape],
    strides: [...left.strides],
  };
}

export function serializeTensor(tensor: DenseTensor): string {
  validateTensor(tensor);
  if (Array.from(tensor.data).some((value) => !Number.isFinite(value)))
    throw new Error(
      "JSON tensor export requires finite values. Use CSV to inspect invalid values.",
    );
  return JSON.stringify({
    format: "neuralis.tensor",
    version: 1,
    shape: tensor.shape,
    data: Array.from(tensor.data),
  });
}

export function parseTensor(text: string): DenseTensor {
  if (text.length > 64000000)
    throw new Error("Tensor document exceeds the import budget.");
  const value: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object")
    throw new Error("Expected a tensor document.");
  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (
    record.format !== "neuralis.tensor" ||
    record.version !== 1 ||
    !Array.isArray(record.shape) ||
    !record.shape.every((size) => typeof size === "number") ||
    !Array.isArray(record.data) ||
    !record.data.every(
      (item) => typeof item === "number" && Number.isFinite(item),
    )
  )
    throw new Error("Invalid neuralis.tensor version 1 document.");
  return denseTensor(record.data as number[], record.shape as number[]);
}

import { clamp, type Vector3Tuple } from "./numerics";

export interface CameraBookmark {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  position: Vector3Tuple;
  target: Vector3Tuple;
  zoom: number;
  createdAt: string;
}
export interface NeuronAnnotation {
  id: string;
  layer: number;
  neuron: number;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}
export interface VisualizationSettings {
  format: "neuralis.view";
  version: 1;
  showEdges: boolean;
  edgeBudget: number;
  edgeOpacity: number;
  nodeBudget: number;
  weightThreshold: number;
  bookmarks: CameraBookmark[];
  annotations: NeuronAnnotation[];
}
export type CameraPreset = "perspective" | "front" | "top" | "side";

export function defaultVisualizationSettings(): VisualizationSettings {
  return {
    format: "neuralis.view",
    version: 1,
    showEdges: true,
    edgeBudget: 1200,
    edgeOpacity: 0.16,
    nodeBudget: 1600,
    weightThreshold: 0,
    bookmarks: [],
    annotations: [],
  };
}
function finiteTuple(value: unknown): value is Vector3Tuple {
  return (
    Array.isArray(value) &&
    value.length === 3 &&
    value.every(
      (component) =>
        typeof component === "number" &&
        Number.isFinite(component) &&
        Math.abs(component) <= 1000000,
    )
  );
}

export function parseViewSettings(text: string): VisualizationSettings {
  if (text.length > 500000)
    throw new Error("View settings exceed the import budget.");
  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
  if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object")
    throw new Error("Expected a view settings document.");
  const value = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (value.format !== "neuralis.view" || value.version !== 1)
    throw new Error("Expected neuralis.view version 1.");
  const defaults = defaultVisualizationSettings();
  const number = (
    key: keyof VisualizationSettings,
    min: number,
    max: number,
  ): number => {
    const candidate = value[key];
    if (candidate === undefined) return defaults[key] as number;
    if (typeof candidate !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(candidate))
      throw new Error(`View setting ${key} must be finite.`);
    return clamp(candidate, min, max);
  };
  if (value.showEdges !== undefined && typeof value.showEdges !== "boolean")
    throw new Error("showEdges must be a boolean.");
  const bookmarks = value.bookmarks ?? [];
  const annotations = value.annotations ?? [];
  if (
    !Array.isArray(bookmarks) ||
    bookmarks.length > 32 ||
    !Array.isArray(annotations) ||
    annotations.length > 256
  )
    throw new Error("View supports at most 32 bookmarks and 256 annotations.");
  const safeBookmarks = bookmarks.map((bookmark: unknown) => {
    if (!bookmark || typeof bookmark !== "object")
      throw new Error("Invalid camera bookmark.");
    const item = bookmark as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (
      typeof item.id !== "string" ||
      item.id.length > 120 ||
      typeof item.name !== "string" ||
      item.name.length > 120 ||
      !finiteTuple(item.position) ||
      !finiteTuple(item.target) ||
      typeof item.zoom !== "number" ||
      !Number.isFinite(item.zoom) ||
      item.zoom <= 0 ||
      typeof item.createdAt !== "string"
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid camera bookmark fields.");
    return {
      id: item.id,
      name: item.name,
      position: [...item.position],
      target: [...item.target],
      zoom: clamp(item.zoom, 0.01, 100),
      createdAt: item.createdAt,
    } as CameraBookmark;
  });
  const safeAnnotations = annotations.map((annotation: unknown) => {
    if (!annotation || typeof annotation !== "object")
      throw new Error("Invalid unit annotation.");
    const item = annotation as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (
      typeof item.id !== "string" ||
      item.id.length > 120 ||
      !Number.isInteger(item.layer) ||
      !Number.isInteger(item.neuron) ||
      Number(item.layer) < 0 ||
      Number(item.neuron) < 0 ||
      typeof item.text !== "string" ||
      item.text.length > 2000 ||
      typeof item.createdAt !== "string"
    )
      throw new Error("Invalid unit annotation fields.");
    return {
      id: item.id,
      layer: Number(item.layer),
      neuron: Number(item.neuron),
      text: item.text,
      createdAt: item.createdAt,
    };
  });
  return {
    format: "neuralis.view",
    version: 1,
    showEdges: (value.showEdges as boolean) ?? defaults.showEdges,
    edgeBudget: Math.floor(number("edgeBudget", 0, 20000)),
    edgeOpacity: number("edgeOpacity", 0.01, 0.9),
    nodeBudget: Math.floor(number("nodeBudget", 32, 10000)),
    weightThreshold: number("weightThreshold", 0, 1000000),
    bookmarks: safeBookmarks,
    annotations: safeAnnotations,
  };
}

export function cameraPreset(
  preset: CameraPreset,
  layers: number,
): Pick<CameraBookmark, "position" | "target" | "zoom"> {
  const distance = Math.max(13, layers * 3);
  const target: Vector3Tuple = [0, 0, 0];
  if (preset === "front")
    return { position: [0, 0.1, distance], target, zoom: 1 };
  if (preset === "top")
    return { position: [0, distance, 0.1], target, zoom: 1 };
  if (preset === "side")
    return { position: [distance, 1, 0.1], target, zoom: 1 };
  return {
    position: [Math.max(8, layers * 2.6), 5, distance],
    target,
    zoom: 1,
  };
}

export function loadViewSettings(storageKey: string): VisualizationSettings {
  try {
    const text = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
    return text ? parseViewSettings(text) : defaultVisualizationSettings();
  } catch {
    return defaultVisualizationSettings();
  }
}

export function saveViewSettings(
  storageKey: string,
  settings: VisualizationSettings,
): boolean {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(settings));
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

BEGIN FILE: demos/anomaly-detection/README.md
====================================================================================================
# Sensor anomaly classifier

Labeled nominal and anomalous synthetic sensor observations.

## Run in Neuralis Studio

From the repository root, run `npm ci`, then `npm run dev`. Open the URL printed by Vite, choose **Sensor anomaly classifier** in the demo catalog, and start training. GitHub Pages runs this same numerical browser engine without a Python server.

`config.json` contains a reproducible CPU-first configuration. `example.ts` is an importable source example that runs synchronous single-step updates, reports real measurements, exports a resumable checkpoint, and disposes of the engine.

## Algorithm and measurements

Binary cross-entropy; held-out supervised anomaly accuracy.

This is supervised classification, not an unsupervised novelty score.

Implementation: [`dense-model.ts`](../../apps/web/src/engine/dense-model.ts). Shared numerical operations live in [engine](../../apps/web/src/engine). Dataset generation uses a seeded stream, with independent training/validation draws. Finite-case toy datasets can naturally repeat contexts across splits.

## Controls and reproducibility

Pause stops scheduled computation; single-step performs one optimizer or solver update. Resume continues the same parameters and random stream. Stop preserves the current model for inspection. Checkpoints retain parameters, optimizer moments, stochastic state, metrics, configuration, and progress. Imports validate into a fresh model before replacing the current run.

Five optimizer families are available for neural demos: SGD, momentum, Adam, AdamW, and RMSProp. Warmup/cosine schedules, global gradient clipping, weight decay and seeded inverted dropout are available where supported. Classical solvers expose their actual algorithm rather than pretending to use those neural options.

Captured tensors and metrics are measured values. Training and visualization budgets are bounded, and all demos use browser JavaScript CPU computation. Results from these synthetic problems do not establish performance on production datasets.

## Validation

Run `npm test -- --run src/engine` from the web workspace, or `npm run test --workspace=@neuralis/web -- src/engine` from the repository root. The suite checks exact numerical derivatives, real learning, state transitions, immutable captures, and checkpoint resumption.

  "batchSize": 32,
  "seed": 42,

  "schedule": "constant",
  "gradientClip": 5,
  "weightDecay": 0,
  "dropout": 0
}

END FILE: demos/anomaly-detection/config.json

====================================================================================================
BEGIN FILE: demos/anomaly-detection/example.ts
====================================================================================================
import { createEngine } from '../../apps/web/src/engine';
import type { RunConfig, RunSnapshot } from '../../apps/web/src/types';

export const configuration: RunConfig = {
  "demoId": "anomaly-detection",
  "learningRate": 0.01,
  "maxSteps": 1200,
  "batchSize": 32,
  "seed": 42,
  "captureEvery": 10,
  "optimizer": "adam",
  "schedule": "constant",
  "gradientClip": 5,
  "weightDecay": 0,
  "dropout": 0
};

/** Run genuine deterministic numerical updates without starting a timer. */
export function runAnomalyDetection(steps = 100): { snapshot: RunSnapshot; checkpoint: string } {
  if (!Number.isInteger(steps) || steps < 1 || steps > configuration.maxSteps) {
    throw new Error('Requested steps must lie within the configured training budget.');
  }
  const engine = createEngine(configuration, () => undefined);
  try {
    for (let step = 0; step < steps; step++) engine.step();
    const snapshot = engine.getSnapshot();
    if (snapshot.state === 'failed') throw new Error(snapshot.message ?? 'Numerical training failed.');
    return { snapshot, checkpoint: engine.exportCheckpoint() };
  } finally {
    engine.dispose();
  }
}

/** Import the full optimizer/random state and perform one reproducible update. */
export function resumeCheckpoint(serialized: string): RunSnapshot {
  const engine = createEngine(configuration, () => undefined);
  try {
    engine.importCheckpoint(serialized);
    if (engine.getSnapshot().state !== 'completed') engine.step();
    return engine.getSnapshot();
  } finally {
    engine.dispose();
  }
}
====================================================================================================
END FILE: demos/anomaly-detection/example.ts

# Attention pooling microscope

Four-token synthetic positive/negative phrases pooled by fixed scaled dot-product attention.

## Run in Neuralis Studio

From the repository root, run `npm ci`, then `npm run dev`. Open the URL printed by Vite, choose **Attention pooling microscope** in the demo catalog, and start training. GitHub Pages runs this same numerical browser engine without a Python server.

`config.json` contains a reproducible CPU-first configuration. `example.ts` is an importable source example that runs synchronous single-step updates, reports real measurements, exports a resumable checkpoint, and disposes of the engine.

## Algorithm and measurements

Binary cross-entropy; held-out sentiment accuracy.

Q/K/V embeddings are fixed; the dense readout alone is trained. Attention matrices are real computed probabilities.

Implementation: [`dense-model.ts`](../../apps/web/src/engine/dense-model.ts). Shared numerical operations live in [engine](../../apps/web/src/engine). Dataset generation uses a seeded stream, with independent training/validation draws. Finite-case toy datasets can naturally repeat contexts across splits.

## Controls and reproducibility

Pause stops scheduled computation; single-step performs one optimizer or solver update. Resume continues the same parameters and random stream. Stop preserves the current model for inspection. Checkpoints retain parameters, optimizer moments, stochastic state, metrics, configuration, and progress. Imports validate into a fresh model before replacing the current run.

Five optimizer families are available for neural demos: SGD, momentum, Adam, AdamW, and RMSProp. Warmup/cosine schedules, global gradient clipping, weight decay and seeded inverted dropout are available where supported. Classical solvers expose their actual algorithm rather than pretending to use those neural options.

Captured tensors and metrics are measured values. Training and visualization budgets are bounded, and all demos use browser JavaScript CPU computation. Results from these synthetic problems do not establish performance on production datasets.

## Validation

Run `npm test -- --run src/engine` from the web workspace, or `npm run test --workspace=@neuralis/web -- src/engine` from the repository root. The suite checks exact numerical derivatives, real learning, state transitions, immutable captures, and checkpoint resumption.

BEGIN FILE: demos/attention-sentiment/example.ts
====================================================================================================
import { createEngine } from '../../apps/web/src/engine';
import type { RunConfig, RunSnapshot } from '../../apps/web/src/types';

export const configuration: RunConfig = {
  "demoId": "attention-sentiment",
  "learningRate": 0.01,
  "maxSteps": 1200,
  "batchSize": 32,
  "seed": 42,
  "captureEvery": 10,
  "optimizer": "adam",
  "schedule": "constant",
  "gradientClip": 5,
  "weightDecay": 0,
  "dropout": 0
};

/** Run genuine deterministic numerical updates without starting a timer. */
export function runAttentionSentiment(steps = 100): { snapshot: RunSnapshot; checkpoint: string } {
  if (!Number.isInteger(steps) || steps < 1 || steps > configuration.maxSteps) {
    throw new Error('Requested steps must lie within the configured training budget.');
  }
  const engine = createEngine(configuration, () => undefined);
  try {
    for (let step = 0; step < steps; step++) engine.step();
    const snapshot = engine.getSnapshot();
    if (snapshot.state === 'failed') throw new Error(snapshot.message ?? 'Numerical training failed.');
    return { snapshot, checkpoint: engine.exportCheckpoint() };
  } finally {
    engine.dispose();
  }
}

/** Import the full optimizer/random state and perform one reproducible update. */
export function resumeCheckpoint(serialized: string): RunSnapshot {
  const engine = createEngine(configuration, () => undefined);
  try {
    engine.importCheckpoint(serialized);
    if (engine.getSnapshot().state !== 'completed') engine.step();
    return engine.getSnapshot();
  } finally {
    engine.dispose();
  }
}

END FILE: demos/attention-sentiment/example.ts

# Contextual bandit

Random three-dimensional contexts and three action-dependent linear reward means with Gaussian observation noise.

## Run in Neuralis Studio

From the repository root, run `npm ci`, then `npm run dev`. Open the URL printed by Vite, choose **Contextual bandit** in the demo catalog, and start training. GitHub Pages runs this same numerical browser engine without a Python server.

# Signal forecasting

Eight historical sinusoid values with randomized phase and frequency.

## Run in Neuralis Studio

From the repository root, run `npm ci`, then `npm run dev`. Open the URL printed by Vite, choose **Signal forecasting** in the demo catalog, and start training. GitHub Pages runs this same numerical browser engine without a Python server.

`config.json` contains a reproducible CPU-first configuration. `example.ts` is an importable source example that runs synchronous single-step updates, reports real measurements, exports a resumable checkpoint, and disposes of the engine.

## Algorithm and measurements

Mean squared one-step prediction error; clipped held-out R-squared.

Predict one future sample; no recurrent model is implied in this demo.

Implementation: [`dense-model.ts`](../../apps/web/src/engine/dense-model.ts). Shared numerical operations live in [engine](../../apps/web/src/engine). Dataset generation uses a seeded stream, with independent training/validation draws. Finite-case toy datasets can naturally repeat contexts across splits.

## Controls and reproducibility

Pause stops scheduled computation; single-step performs one optimizer or solver update. Resume continues the same parameters and random stream. Stop preserves the current model for inspection. Checkpoints retain parameters, optimizer moments, stochastic state, metrics, configuration, and progress. Imports validate into a fresh model before replacing the current run.

Five optimizer families are available for neural demos: SGD, momentum, Adam, AdamW, and RMSProp. Warmup/cosine schedules, global gradient clipping, weight decay and seeded inverted dropout are available where supported. Classical solvers expose their actual algorithm rather than pretending to use those neural options.

Captured tensors and metrics are measured values. Training and visualization budgets are bounded, and all demos use browser JavaScript CPU computation. Results from these synthetic problems do not establish performance on production datasets.

## Validation

Run `npm test -- --run src/engine` from the web workspace, or `npm run test --workspace=@neuralis/web -- src/engine` from the repository root. The suite checks exact numerical derivatives, real learning, state transitions, immutable captures, and checkpoint resumption.
