'use strict';

// Static, dependency-free report inspection. No fake or interpolated metrics.
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
let report = null;
let bundled = true;
let frameIndex = 0;
const number = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US');
const commands = {
  smoke: 'python doctor.py\npython train.py --config configs/smoke.json\npython -m pytest -q',
  train: 'python train.py --config configs/level-1-1.json\n# Resume without restarting the model:\npython train.py --resume runs/level-1-1/latest.pt --steps 20000000',
  evaluate: 'python evaluate.py runs/level-1-1/latest.pt \\\n  --episodes 30 --seed 100042 --video \\\n  --output runs/level-1-1/evaluation',
  export: 'python export.py runs/level-1-1 \\\n  --evaluation runs/level-1-1/evaluation/evaluation.json \\\n  --inspection runs/level-1-1/evaluation/inspection.json \\\n  --output runs/mario-export.json',
};

function notice(message, error = false) {
  $('notice').textContent = message;
  $('notice').classList.toggle('error', error);
}

function finite(value, fallback = 0) {
  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
}

function format(value, digits = 3) {
  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value.toFixed(digits) : '—';
}

function element(tag, className, content) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (content !== undefined) node.textContent = String(content);
  return node;
}

function detail(label, value) {
  const node = element('div', 'detail');
  node.append(element('span', '', label), element('b', '', value));
  return node;
}

function validate(data) {
  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || data.schema !== 'neuralis.mario.run/v1') {
    throw new Error('Choose a Neuralis Mario report exported by export.py. Expected schema neuralis.mario.run/v1.');
  }
  if (!data.run || !Array.isArray(data.metrics) || data.metrics.length > 100000) {
    throw new Error('Report is missing run metadata or exceeds the 100,000-update browser budget.');
  }
  if (!data.metrics.every((point) => point && typeof point === 'object' && !Array.isArray(point) && Number.isFinite(point.step) && point.step >= 0)) {
    throw new Error('Every optimization sample must be an object with a finite, nonnegative transition count.');
  }
  if (!data.architecture || !Array.isArray(data.architecture.layers) || data.architecture.layers.length > 128) {
    throw new Error('Report is missing its model architecture or exceeds the 128-layer viewer budget.');
  }
  return data;
}

function render(data, isBundled) {
  report = validate(data);
  bundled = isBundled;
  frameIndex = 0;
  $('transitions').textContent = number.format(finite(report.run.totalTransitions));
  $('updates').textContent = `${number.format(report.metrics.length)} measured updates · ${report.run.status || 'unknown status'}`;
  $('parameters').textContent = number.format(finite(report.architecture.parameters));
  const evaluation = report.evaluation;
  if (evaluation) {
    $('success').textContent = `${format(100 * finite(evaluation.successRate), 1)}%`;
    const interval = evaluation.successRate95CI;
    $('confidence').textContent = Array.isArray(interval) ? `95% CI ${format(interval[0] * 100, 1)}–${format(interval[1] * 100, 1)}%` : 'Confidence interval unavailable';
    $('max-x').textContent = number.format(finite(evaluation.maxX));
    $('evaluation-count').textContent = `${evaluation.episodes} evaluated episodes · seed ${evaluation.seed}`;
    $('evaluation-note').textContent = evaluation.note || 'Success is measured from flag_get, not predicted from reward.';
  } else {
    $('success').textContent = '—';
    $('max-x').textContent = '—';
    $('confidence').textContent = 'No evaluation loaded';
    $('evaluation-count').textContent = 'Export an evaluation to attach performance';
  }
  const slider = $('update-index');
  slider.max = String(Math.max(0, report.metrics.length - 1));
  slider.value = slider.max;
  slider.disabled = report.metrics.length === 0;
  renderUpdate();
  renderArchitecture();
  renderEpisodes();
  renderLayers();
  renderFrame();
  drawChart();
  notice(isBundled
    ? 'Captured smoke test: real NES rollouts and PPO optimization, followed by bounded evaluation. This policy has not solved Mario. Train longer on your hardware to measure progress.'
    : `Imported ${report.run.id || 'local run'}. All metrics are read directly from your exported experiment; frame images remain in your local evaluation directory.`);
}

function renderUpdate() {
  const index = Number($('update-index').value);
  const metric = report?.metrics[index];
  const container = $('update-details');
  container.replaceChildren();
  if (!metric) return;
  container.append(
    detail('Selected transition', number.format(finite(metric.step))),
    detail('Approximate KL', format(metric.approxKL, 5)),
    detail('Action entropy', format(metric.entropy)),
    detail('Learning rate', format(metric.learningRate, 6)),
  );
}

function renderArchitecture() {
  const container = $('architecture');
  container.replaceChildren();
  report.architecture.layers.forEach((layer) => {
    const node = element('div', 'layer-node');
    node.append(element('span', 'layer-icon'));
    node.append(element('strong', '', layer.type || 'Layer'));
    node.append(element('small', '', layer.name || ''));
    node.append(element('small', '', Array.isArray(layer.outputShape) ? layer.outputShape.join(' × ') : ''));
    node.append(element('small', '', `${number.format(finite(layer.parameters))} params`));
    container.append(node);
  });
}

function renderEpisodes() {
  const body = $('episodes');
  body.replaceChildren();
  const episodes = report.evaluation?.results || [];
  episodes.slice(0, 1000).forEach((episode, index) => {
    const row = element('tr');
    const outcome = episode.flagGet ? 'Flag reached' : episode.truncated ? 'Time limit' : 'Death / terminal';
    row.append(
      element('td', '', String(episode.episode ?? index + 1).padStart(2, '0')),
      element('td', '', format(episode.reward, 1)),
      element('td', '', number.format(finite(episode.xPos))),
      element('td', '', number.format(finite(episode.length))),
      element('td', episode.flagGet ? 'success' : 'timeout', outcome),
    );
    body.append(row);
  });
  if (episodes.length === 0) {
    const row = element('tr');
    const cell = element('td', '', 'No measured evaluation in this report.');
    cell.colSpan = 5;
    row.append(cell);
    body.append(row);
  }
}

function renderLayers() {
  const select = $('layer');
  select.replaceChildren();
  const layers = report.inspection?.layers || [];
  layers.forEach((layer, index) => {
    const option = element('option', '', layer.layer);
    option.value = String(index);
    select.append(option);
  });
  select.disabled = layers.length === 0;
  renderActivation();
}

function renderActivation() {
  const layer = report?.inspection?.layers?.[Number($('layer').value)];
  const grid = $('activation-grid');
  const details = $('activation-details');
  grid.replaceChildren();
  details.replaceChildren();
  if (!layer) {
    grid.append(element('p', 'muted', 'Attach inspection.json with export.py to inspect actual layer values.'));
    return;
  }
  const values = Array.isArray(layer.sample) ? layer.sample.slice(0, 128).map((value) => finite(value)) : [];
  const max = Math.max(1e-8, ...values.map(Math.abs));
  values.forEach((value, index) => {
    const cell = element('div', 'activation-cell');
    const normalized = value / max;
    cell.style.background = normalized >= 0
      ? `hsl(185 ${45 + 50 * normalized}% ${10 + 57 * normalized}%)`
      : `hsl(275 ${45 + 45 * -normalized}% ${10 + 55 * -normalized}%)`;
    cell.title = `Activation ${index}: ${value.toFixed(6)}`;
    grid.append(cell);
  });
  details.append(detail('Mean', format(layer.mean, 5)), detail('Std deviation', format(layer.std, 5)),
                 detail('Minimum', format(layer.min, 5)), detail('Maximum', format(layer.max, 5)));
}

function renderFrame() {
  const captures = report?.evaluation?.captures || [];
  const image = $('frame');
  if (!bundled || captures.length === 0) {
    image.hidden = true;
    image.removeAttribute('src');
    $('frame-label').textContent = bundled ? 'No captured frames available' : 'Open numbered PNGs from your evaluation output directory';
    $('frame-position').textContent = 'Local artifacts';
    $('previous-frame').disabled = true;
    $('next-frame').disabled = true;
    return;
  }
  frameIndex = (frameIndex + captures.length) % captures.length;
  const capture = captures[frameIndex];
  // Restrict bundled paths to local PNG filenames; imported reports cannot load URLs.
  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.png$/.test(capture.file)) return;
  image.hidden = false;
  image.src = `evidence/${capture.file}`;
  $('frame-label').textContent = `Episode ${capture.episode} · action step ${capture.step} · X ${capture.xPos}`;
  $('frame-position').textContent = `${String(frameIndex + 1).padStart(2, '0')} / ${String(captures.length).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  $('previous-frame').disabled = false;
  $('next-frame').disabled = false;
}

function drawChart() {
  if (!report) return;
  const canvas = $('chart');
  const ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const width = canvas.clientWidth;
  const height = canvas.clientHeight;
  if (width < 1 || height < 1) return;
  canvas.width = Math.round(width * ratio);
  canvas.height = Math.round(height * ratio);
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.scale(ratio, ratio);
  const padding = {left: 52, right: 14, top: 18, bottom: 24};
  const metric = $('metric').value;
  const points = report.metrics.filter((point) => typeof point[metric] === 'number' && Number.isFinite(point[metric]));
  const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
  const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
  if (points.length === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#889ab5';
    ctx.font = '12px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText('No metric samples are available.', padding.left, height / 2);
    return;
  }
  const values = points.map((point) => point[metric]);
  let low = Math.min(...values);
  let high = Math.max(...values);
  if (high === low) { high += 0.5; low -= 0.5; }
  const buffer = (high - low) * 0.1;
  low -= buffer;
  high += buffer;
  const first = finite(points[0].step);
  const last = finite(points[points.length - 1].step);
  const x = (point) => padding.left + (finite(point.step) - first) / Math.max(1, last - first) * chartWidth;
  const y = (point) => padding.top + chartHeight - (point[metric] - low) / (high - low) * chartHeight;
  ctx.font = '9px system-ui';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  for (let tick = 0; tick <= 4; tick++) {
    const coordinate = padding.top + chartHeight * tick / 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#1c2b43';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padding.left, coordinate); ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, coordinate); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7a8ca8';
    ctx.fillText((high - (high - low) * tick / 4).toPrecision(3), padding.left - 9, coordinate + 3);
  }
  ctx.beginPath();
  points.forEach((point, index) => index === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x(point), y(point)) : ctx.lineTo(x(point), y(point)));
  ctx.lineTo(x(points[points.length - 1]), padding.top + chartHeight);
  ctx.lineTo(x(points[0]), padding.top + chartHeight);
  ctx.closePath();
  const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, padding.top, 0, padding.top + chartHeight);
  gradient.addColorStop(0, '#45dce63a'); gradient.addColorStop(1, '#45dce602');
  ctx.fillStyle = gradient; ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  points.forEach((point, index) => index === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x(point), y(point)) : ctx.lineTo(x(point), y(point)));
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#45dce6'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
  const selected = report.metrics[Number($('update-index').value)];
  if (selected && Number.isFinite(selected[metric])) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dcfcff';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x(selected), y(selected), 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  $('chart-range').textContent = `${number.format(first)} → ${number.format(last)} transitions · ${points.length} actual samples`;
}

$('metric').addEventListener('change', drawChart);
$('layer').addEventListener('change', renderActivation);
$('update-index').addEventListener('input', () => { renderUpdate(); drawChart(); });
$('previous-frame').addEventListener('click', () => { frameIndex--; renderFrame(); });
$('next-frame').addEventListener('click', () => { frameIndex++; renderFrame(); });
$('report-file').addEventListener('change', async (event) => {
  const file = event.target.files[0];
  if (!file) return;
  if (file.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024) { notice('Report exceeds the 25 MiB browser import limit.', true); return; }
  try { render(JSON.parse(await file.text()), false); }
  catch (error) { notice(error.message, true); }
});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-command]').forEach((button) => {
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-command]').forEach((node) => node.classList.remove('selected'));
    button.classList.add('selected');
    $('command').textContent = commands[button.dataset.command];
  });
});
$('copy-command').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText($('command').textContent);
    $('copy-command').textContent = 'Copied';
    window.setTimeout(() => { $('copy-command').textContent = 'Copy command'; }, 1500);
  } catch { notice('Clipboard is unavailable. Select and copy the command text manually.', true); }
});
window.addEventListener('resize', drawChart);
$('command').textContent = commands.smoke;
fetch('evidence/sample-run.json').then((response) => {
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Sample report request failed (${response.status}). Serve this directory over HTTP.`);
  return response.json();
}).then((data) => render(data, true)).catch((error) => notice(error.message, true));

# Wave surface

Uniform two-dimensional inputs with sin(pi*x)*cos(pi*y).

## Run in Neuralis Studio

From the repository root, run `npm ci`, then `npm run dev`. Open the URL printed by Vite, choose **Wave surface** in the demo catalog, and start training. GitHub Pages runs this same numerical browser engine without a Python server.

`config.json` contains a reproducible CPU-first configuration. `example.ts` is an importable source example that runs synchronous single-step updates, reports real measurements, exports a resumable checkpoint, and disposes of the engine.

## Algorithm and measurements

Mean squared error; clipped held-out R-squared.

Compare how different hidden units respond to the two spatial directions.

Implementation: [`dense-model.ts`](../../apps/web/src/engine/dense-model.ts). Shared numerical operations live in [engine](../../apps/web/src/engine). Dataset generation uses a seeded stream, with independent training/validation draws. Finite-case toy datasets can naturally repeat contexts across splits.

## Controls and reproducibility

Pause stops scheduled computation; single-step performs one optimizer or solver update. Resume continues the same parameters and random stream. Stop preserves the current model for inspection. Checkpoints retain parameters, optimizer moments, stochastic state, metrics, configuration, and progress. Imports validate into a fresh model before replacing the current run.

Five optimizer families are available for neural demos: SGD, momentum, Adam, AdamW, and RMSProp. Warmup/cosine schedules, global gradient clipping, weight decay and seeded inverted dropout are available where supported. Classical solvers expose their actual algorithm rather than pretending to use those neural options.

Captured tensors and metrics are measured values. Training and visualization budgets are bounded, and all demos use browser JavaScript CPU computation. Results from these synthetic problems do not establish performance on production datasets.

## Validation

Run `npm test -- --run src/engine` from the web workspace, or `npm run test --workspace=@neuralis/web -- src/engine` from the repository root. The suite checks exact numerical derivatives, real learning, state transitions, immutable captures, and checkpoint resumption.

BEGIN FILE: demos/surface-regression/example.ts
====================================================================================================
import { createEngine } from '../../apps/web/src/engine';
import type { RunConfig, RunSnapshot } from '../../apps/web/src/types';

export const configuration: RunConfig = {
  "demoId": "surface-regression",
  "learningRate": 0.01,
  "maxSteps": 1200,
  "batchSize": 32,
  "seed": 42,
  "captureEvery": 10,
  "optimizer": "adam",
  "schedule": "constant",
  "gradientClip": 5,
  "weightDecay": 0,
  "dropout": 0
};

/** Run genuine deterministic numerical updates without starting a timer. */
export function runSurfaceRegression(steps = 100): { snapshot: RunSnapshot; checkpoint: string } {
  if (!Number.isInteger(steps) || steps < 1 || steps > configuration.maxSteps) {
    throw new Error('Requested steps must lie within the configured training budget.');
  }
  const engine = createEngine(configuration, () => undefined);
  try {
    for (let step = 0; step < steps; step++) engine.step();
    const snapshot = engine.getSnapshot();
    if (snapshot.state === 'failed') throw new Error(snapshot.message ?? 'Numerical training failed.');
    return { snapshot, checkpoint: engine.exportCheckpoint() };
  } finally {
    engine.dispose();
  }
}

/** Import the full optimizer/random state and perform one reproducible update. */
export function resumeCheckpoint(serialized: string): RunSnapshot {
  const engine = createEngine(configuration, () => undefined);
  try {
    engine.importCheckpoint(serialized);
    if (engine.getSnapshot().state !== 'completed') engine.step();
    return engine.getSnapshot();
  } finally {
    engine.dispose();
  }
}

# python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"

BEGIN FILE: deploy/Dockerfile.api
====================================================================================================
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm AS runtime
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1 \
    UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/neuralis/venv PATH=/opt/neuralis/venv/bin:$PATH \
    NEURALIS_HOST=0.0.0.0 NEURALIS_PORT=8000 NEURALIS_DATA=/data
WORKDIR /opt/neuralis/api
COPY services/api/pyproject.toml services/api/uv.lock ./
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=system_ca,required=false \
    if [ -f /run/secrets/system_ca ]; then export PIP_CERT=/run/secrets/system_ca SSL_CERT_FILE=/run/secrets/system_ca; fi; \
    pip install --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check uv==0.8.15 && \
    uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-install-project --extra lab
COPY services/api/src ./src
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=system_ca,required=false \
    if [ -f /run/secrets/system_ca ]; then export SSL_CERT_FILE=/run/secrets/system_ca; fi; \
    uv sync --frozen --no-dev --extra lab && \
    groupadd --gid 10001 neuralis && useradd --uid 10001 --gid neuralis --no-create-home neuralis && \
    mkdir -p /data && chown neuralis:neuralis /data
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --start-period=45s --retries=6 \
    CMD python -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health',timeout=2)"
CMD ["python", "-m", "neuralis"]
====================================================================================================
END FILE: deploy/Dockerfile.api

# Overlay for managed cloud builds: trust the mounted combined public CA bundle.
services:
  api:
    build:
      secrets: [system_ca]
    volumes:
      - ${NEURALIS_SYSTEM_CA:-/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt}:/run/neuralis-system-ca.pem:ro
    environment:
      SSL_CERT_FILE: /run/neuralis-system-ca.pem
      REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE: /run/neuralis-system-ca.pem
  worker:
    build:
      secrets: [system_ca]
    volumes:
      - ${NEURALIS_SYSTEM_CA:-/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt}:/run/neuralis-system-ca.pem:ro
    environment:
      SSL_CERT_FILE: /run/neuralis-system-ca.pem
secrets:
  system_ca:
    file: ${NEURALIS_SYSTEM_CA:-/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt}

BEGIN FILE: deploy/compose.yaml
====================================================================================================
name: neuralis
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.api
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${NEURALIS_PORT:-8000}:8000"
    environment:
      NEURALIS_TOKEN: ${NEURALIS_TOKEN:?Set NEURALIS_TOKEN to a random token of at least 32 bytes}
      NEURALIS_HOST: 0.0.0.0
      NEURALIS_DATA: /data
      NEURALIS_CORS_ORIGINS: ${NEURALIS_CORS_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:5173,http://127.0.0.1:5173}
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "2"
      OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"
    volumes:
      - api-data:/data
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=256m,mode=1777
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    init: true
    pids_limit: 256
    mem_limit: 4g
    cpus: 2.0
    restart: unless-stopped
  worker:
    profiles: [worker]
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.worker
    # Sharing the API network namespace enables verified loopback HTTP. Neither
    # worker nor API publishes a public plaintext listener on the host.
    network_mode: "service:api"
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      NEURALIS_COORDINATOR: http://127.0.0.1:8000
      NEURALIS_WORKER_TOKEN: ${NEURALIS_TOKEN:?Set NEURALIS_TOKEN}
      NEURALIS_WORKER_ID: ${NEURALIS_WORKER_ID:-compose-cpu-1}
      NEURALIS_WORKER_CPU_THREADS: "2"
      NEURALIS_WORKER_MEMORY_MB: "512"
      NEURALIS_WORKER_TIMEOUT: "300"
    volumes:
      - worker-data:/work
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=64m,mode=1777
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    init: true
    pids_limit: 64
    mem_limit: 768m
    cpus: 2.0
    restart: unless-stopped

  api-data:
  worker-data:

"""Exercise real containers, authenticated queues and durable API storage.

Run after building neuralis-api:validation and neuralis-worker:validation.
Only disposable validation containers/volumes created by this invocation are removed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
import argparse
import json
import os
import secrets
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time


class ValidationError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class DockerValidation:
    def __init__(self, *, api_image: str, worker_image: str):
        self.api_image = api_image
        self.worker_image = worker_image
        self.repository = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        self.project = "neuralis-validation-" + secrets.token_hex(4)
        self.environment = os.environ.copy()
        for name in ["DOCKER_HOST", "DOCKER_CONTEXT", "DOCKER_TLS", "DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY", "DOCKER_CERT_PATH"]:
            self.environment.pop(name, None)
        # Preserve Docker auth and proxy configuration. Only Buildx's writable
        # working-state path needs relocation in restricted cloud environments.
        self.environment.setdefault("BUILDX_CONFIG", str(self.repository.parent / "neuralis-buildx"))
        self.environment["NEURALIS_TOKEN"] = secrets.token_hex(32)
        with socket.socket() as reservation:
            reservation.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
            self.port = reservation.getsockname()[1]
        self.environment["NEURALIS_PORT"] = str(self.port)
        self.endpoint = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}"
        self.temporary = TemporaryDirectory(prefix="neuralis-container-validation-")
        self.overlay = Path(self.temporary.name) / "images.yaml"
        self.overlay.write_text(f"services:\n  api:\n    image: {api_image}\n  worker:\n    image: {worker_image}\n")

    def docker(self, *arguments: str, timeout: float = 180) -> str:
        command = ["docker", "--host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock", *arguments]
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=self.repository, env=self.environment,
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
        if result.returncode:
            # Commands never contain bearer values; redact just in case an upstream
            # diagnostic included an injected value.
            diagnostic = (result.stderr or result.stdout)[-4000:].replace(self.environment["NEURALIS_TOKEN"], "[redacted]")
            raise ValidationError(f"Docker command failed ({result.returncode}): {diagnostic}")
        return result.stdout

    def compose(self, *arguments: str, timeout: float = 180) -> str:
        return self.docker("compose", "-p", self.project, "-f", "deploy/compose.yaml", "-f", str(self.overlay), *arguments, timeout=timeout)

    def request(self, method: str, path: str, body: object = None, *, authenticated: bool = True):
        headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}
        if authenticated:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.environment['NEURALIS_TOKEN']}"
        data = None
        if body is not None:
            data = json.dumps(body, allow_nan=False).encode()
            headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        request = Request(self.endpoint + path, data=data, method=method, headers=headers)
        with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
            return json.load(response)

    def ready(self, seconds: float = 60) -> None:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                health = self.request("GET", "/health", authenticated=False)
                if health.get("status") == "ok":
                    self.request("GET", "/api/v1/capabilities")
                    return
            except (HTTPError, URLError, OSError, ValueError):
                pass
            time.sleep(.2)
        raise ValidationError("Container API did not become ready within its deadline")

    def run(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        self.compose("config", "--quiet")
        self.compose("up", "--no-build", "-d", "api")
        self.ready()
        try:
            self.request("GET", "/api/v1/capabilities", authenticated=False)
            raise ValidationError("Protected capabilities endpoint accepted an unauthenticated request")
        except HTTPError as error:
            if error.code != 401:
                raise
        queued = self.request("POST", "/api/v1/queue", {"task": "xor", "steps": 2500,
            "learning_rate": .08, "cpu_threads": 1, "memory_mb": 512})
        self.compose("run", "--rm", "--no-deps", "worker", "python", "-m", "neuralis_worker", "--once", timeout=120)
        jobs = self.request("GET", "/api/v1/queue")
        job = next((value for value in jobs if value["id"] == queued["id"]), None)
        if job is None or job["status"] != "completed":
            raise ValidationError(f"Actual queued training did not complete: {job and job.get('status')}")
        result = job["result"]["result"]
        if result.get("accuracy") != 1 or result.get("loss", 1) >= .03:
            raise ValidationError("Actual worker XOR result did not meet its smoke-test criterion")
        self.compose("restart", "api")
        self.ready()
        restored = self.request("GET", "/api/v1/queue")
        persisted = next(value for value in restored if value["id"] == queued["id"])
        if persisted["status"] != "completed" or persisted["result"]["result"]["checkpoint"] != result["checkpoint"]:
            raise ValidationError("Queue completion did not survive API restart")
        return {"api_health": "ok", "unauthenticated_api": "refused", "worker_job": "completed",
            "actual_accuracy": result["accuracy"], "actual_loss": result["loss"],
            "storage_after_restart": "verified", "container_uid": 10001}

    def close(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.compose("down", "--volumes", "--remove-orphans", timeout=60)
        finally:
            self.temporary.cleanup()
            self.environment.pop("NEURALIS_TOKEN", None)


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--api-image", default="neuralis-api:validation")
    parser.add_argument("--worker-image", default="neuralis-worker:validation")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    validation = DockerValidation(api_image=args.api_image, worker_image=args.worker_image)
    try:
        print(json.dumps(validation.run(), indent=2))
        return 0
    except (ValidationError, OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        print(f"Validation failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        validation.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
====================================================================================================
END FILE: deploy/validate.py
====================================================================================================

# Desktop application

Neuralis Studio uses a Tauri 2 native shell with the same React/WebGL application as the browser. Browser demos run without Python. Instrumented models require the optional Python API runtime, installed independently from the desktop bundle. No model weights, system Python installation or proprietary emulator ROM is bundled.

## Build prerequisites

Use a current stable Rust toolchain, Node 22 or newer, and the repository's locked npm dependencies. Linux requires GTK 3, WebKitGTK 4.1 and a C compiler. Debian and Ubuntu users can install:

```bash
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends \
  build-essential pkg-config libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
  librsvg2-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev patchelf
```

On macOS install Xcode command-line tools. On Windows install Microsoft C++ Build Tools and WebView2. Build packages on the target operating system; a Linux build does not produce verified macOS or Windows installers.

```bash
npm --prefix apps/web ci
npm --prefix apps/desktop install
npm --prefix apps/desktop run doctor
npm --prefix apps/desktop run dev
npm --prefix apps/desktop run build
```

The desktop configuration builds `apps/web/dist`; it does not fetch an external website. Development uses the existing Vite server on port 5173. The native shell is behind the `desktop` Cargo feature so the security and workspace library can be tested on machines without graphical libraries:

```bash
cargo test --locked --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features
cargo check --locked --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features desktop
```

The package metadata includes Debian/AppImage, DMG and NSIS targets. Release signatures, notarization and Windows Authenticode certificates are deployment requirements supplied by the release owner; they are not configured automatically.

## Python runtime

Install the API using its frozen uv lockfile, then choose its interpreter and the absolute Neuralis repository path in desktop settings. For a source checkout, a typical interpreter is `services/api/.venv/bin/python` on POSIX or `services/api/.venv/Scripts/python.exe` on Windows.

```bash
cd services/api
uv sync --frozen --extra dev
```

The native runtime launches `python -m neuralis` directly, with no shell. It selects an available loopback port, generates a 256-bit session bearer token, and checks `/health` followed by the protected `/api/v1/capabilities` endpoint. Only a successful authenticated readiness check exposes the backend to the interface. A bounded startup deadline and early process-exit check report missing packages and invalid interpreters. Closing the application stops its managed Python child and waits for exit. Remote servers remain independently managed.

The backend inherits the user's normal environment except explicit runtime overrides. User-provided interpreter paths execute local programs; select an interpreter you control. Startup does not download or execute a server-provided binary. The sidecar is a managed Python subprocess from the installed runtime, rather than an embedded PyInstaller executable.

## Local and remote connections

The default mode is `browser_only`. The `local` mode requires a selected interpreter and source repository. The `remote` mode requires an HTTPS endpoint, except loopback HTTP for local development. Embedded URL credentials, query parameters and fragments are refused. Enter a bearer token for the current session; it is retained only in native memory. Preferences save the selected endpoint and interpreter without token values.

Native HTTP requests stay on the selected origin. Redirects are disabled; relative path validation rejects encoded traversal and origin escapes. Responses and request bodies are bounded to 16 MiB. TLS certificate and hostname verification remain enabled. A private CA must be installed in the trust store supported by the deployed HTTP client; do not disable verification to connect.

Preferences use a versioned JSON schema, strict fields and atomic replacement. The native configuration directory follows Tauri's operating-system conventions. A failed preferences parse falls back to safe browser mode. Diagnostics retain at most 200 lines of 4 KiB each and redact the session token.

## File permissions and project workspaces

The renderer receives no unrestricted filesystem or shell plugin. Export folders and import files are selected with native dialogs, and grants last only for the running session. JSON checkpoint import reads at most 64 MiB. Export validates portable filenames and uses create-new semantics: existing files and symbolic links cannot be overwritten. File receipts include byte counts and SHA-256 checksums.

The native project workspace creates `neuralis-projects` inside a folder explicitly selected by the user. Every project has a versioned manifest and an `artifacts` directory. Supported artifact kinds are checkpoints, experiments, metrics, datasets and captures. Files remain JSON; no pickle or executable deserialization is used. Every indexed artifact has an integrity checksum, and reads verify it before returning data. Projects support tags and editable metadata, up to 500 artifacts per project and 10,000 projects per workspace.

The initial storage quota is 10 GiB. Individual artifacts and portable bundles are bounded to 64 MiB. Bundles include JSON artifacts and metadata and import into a fresh project identifier, preserving the source project. The importer validates every artifact before writing. Partial newly created imports are cleaned up on failure. Project directories, manifests and artifacts refuse symbolic links and traversal segments. These checks protect normal local workflows; a separate hostile process with write access to the selected folder can still race filesystem operations, so use a workspace owned by your user.

`apps/desktop/bridge.ts` is a browser-safe typed adapter. `isDesktop()` detects native IPC. Its methods cover runtime controls, preferences, file dialogs and project workspace CRUD/artifacts/bundles. Calling native operations in a browser gives a clear capability error.

## Validation boundaries

Core unit tests cover URL restrictions, token generation, redaction, configuration persistence, dialog grants, symlink refusal, artifact corruption, bundle import and project identity. Worker/backend validation is documented separately. Actual native GUI compilation depends on platform libraries. Packaging metadata alone does not establish a signed installer or successful runtime on every operating system.

# Laboratory deployment and workers

The runnable baseline uses a FastAPI CPU runtime, SQLite metadata and local safe-tensor/JSON artifacts. The laboratory coordinator adds project quotas, authenticated worker registration, queue acquisition, lease renewal and completion. Optional OIDC JWT validation uses issuer, audience and an HTTPS JWKS endpoint. These are operational building blocks; they do not establish a production-certified frontier laboratory system.

## Containers

The CPU API and standalone worker have separate Dockerfiles. The API installs the frozen `services/api/uv.lock`, including optional laboratory authentication dependencies. The worker has no third-party runtime dependencies for its registered XOR task. Neither image installs models, ROMs or a GPU toolkit.

```bash
cp deploy/.env.example deploy/.env
# Generate a random token and write it into deploy/.env without committing the file.
docker compose --env-file deploy/.env -f deploy/compose.yaml up --build -d api
docker compose --env-file deploy/.env -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile worker up --build -d
```

The API is published only on host loopback. The worker shares the API's container network namespace, making `http://127.0.0.1:8000` a local connection. Named volumes persist backend data and the worker's completion ledger. Both processes run as UID 10001, with dropped Linux capabilities, a read-only root filesystem, bounded temporary storage and process/memory/CPU limits. The basic profile reserves two CPUs and 4 GiB for the API and two CPUs and 768 MiB for the worker; adjust for the physical machine.

A remote deployment needs an HTTPS reverse proxy, an identity provider or securely issued service token, explicit CORS origins, backups and limits suited to the intended workload. Do not expose the basic API port to the public network using plaintext transport.

In a managed cloud environment, use its existing proxy configuration and trust bundle. The overlay mounts a combined public CA bundle into networked build steps and running containers:

```bash
docker compose --env-file deploy/.env \
  -f deploy/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.cloud.yaml build
```

The `system_ca` BuildKit secret mounts the CA only while dependencies are installed. It never copies the session certificate into an image layer. Configure `NEURALIS_SYSTEM_CA` if the combined bundle has another path. Registry credentials and existing Docker proxy settings remain platform-managed.

PostgreSQL and S3 are not part of the baseline persistence path. Installing optional driver libraries does not switch storage adapters. Do not create database/object-store services or set invented connection variables: use the capabilities endpoint and the backend documentation to determine whether a configured adapter is supported. OIDC configuration examples in `deploy/oidc.env.example` are examples rather than an included identity-provider service.

## Worker installation and self-test

```bash
python -m pip install -e services/worker
python -m neuralis_worker --doctor
python -m neuralis_worker --self-test
```

The self-test trains a real 2–8–1 tanh/sigmoid network on XOR using full-batch binary cross-entropy gradients. It reports achieved accuracy and loss. It does not fabricate GPU statistics. The worker token is read from `NEURALIS_WORKER_TOKEN`, falling back to `NEURALIS_TOKEN`; CLI arguments do not accept a token, preventing command-line exposure.

```bash
export NEURALIS_COORDINATOR=https://your-lab.example.org
# Supply NEURALIS_WORKER_TOKEN through a protected environment binding.
python -m neuralis_worker --worker-id cpu-01 --cpu-threads 2 \
  --memory-mb 2048 --timeout 300 --work-dir /your/data/worker
```

HTTPS is mandatory for remote coordinators. Loopback HTTP is permitted for development. The worker preserves certificate and hostname verification and refuses redirects to prevent bearer-token forwarding. Endpoint credentials, query strings and fragments are refused. Authentication failures stop the worker; transient coordinator failures use bounded retry intervals. Registration and completion retries are idempotent by worker/lease identifiers; acquisition is never blindly retried after an ambiguous request.

## Queue and lease protocol

Requests use the API's existing bearer authentication and `/api/v1` prefix:

| Operation | Endpoint | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Register | `POST /workers/register` | Worker identity and actual supported capabilities |
| Acquire | `POST /workers/{id}/lease` | Registered tasks and available CPU/memory budget |
| Renew | `POST /workers/{id}/heartbeat` | Lease ID, job ID, measured metrics and resource counters |
| Complete | `POST /workers/{id}/jobs/{job}/complete` | State, result, error and matching lease ID |
| Enqueue | `POST /queue` | Project, registered task and bounded task configuration |

The coordinator selects eligible queued jobs transactionally. The worker executes one job at a time. It accepts only locally registered task handlers: a queue message cannot choose a command, executable, module path or arbitrary script. Task options are strictly typed and bounded. Resource requests larger than the worker's declared budget fail before process startup.

A lease specifies its ID, job ID, expiration and duration. Renewals include real training metrics. A remote cancellation terminates the job process group. If authentication fails or a lease cannot be renewed within its duration, the worker stops execution. Expired jobs are marked lost by the coordinator and require an explicit new attempt; they are never silently replayed.

The worker's SQLite WAL ledger records each lease before execution. Completion enters a durable outbox before network delivery. Temporary delivery failures retain results and prevent acquisition of new work until delivery recovers. Restarted interrupted jobs become failed completions; execution is not repeated. A duplicate lease is refused, and a reused lease ID with different job/config data is an error. Completed history is pruned to a bounded count while undelivered results are preserved. The ledger has a 128 MiB storage quota and a 1 MiB result delivery budget.

Subprocesses do not inherit coordinator tokens. They run without shell invocation. POSIX workers enforce core-dump, CPU, file-size and descriptor limits. Pure-Python tasks also get a hard address-space limit. On Linux, aggregate RSS and CPU counters cover the job's descendant processes. DDP uses aggregate RSS monitoring instead of an address-space cap because PyTorch reserves large virtual mappings. Wall-clock deadlines apply on all supported platforms. Windows pure-Python execution is supported; DDP requires POSIX and is explicitly opt-in. On non-Linux systems, enforce aggregate process memory through your platform container/job limits.

## CPU distributed training

Install a compatible PyTorch CPU build from its verified official distribution, then opt into DDP:

```bash
python -m pip install -e 'services/worker[distributed]'
python -m neuralis_worker --allow-distributed --world-size 2 --cpu-threads 2 --doctor
```

The `ddp-xor` handler uses `torch.distributed.run --standalone`, a Gloo process group, a seeded tanh network and `DistributedDataParallel`. Ranks train evenly sized shards of a repeated XOR dataset. Gradients synchronize through DDP. Captured loss and accuracy synchronize through `all_reduce`; only rank zero emits the final JSON checkpoint. Each rank receives a bounded thread allocation. It is an actual single-machine CPU DDP demonstration, with no claim of tested multinode or GPU training.

## Tests and diagnostics

```bash
PYTHONPATH=services/worker python -m unittest discover -s services/worker/tests -v
```

Tests cover analytic training convergence, reproducibility, authenticated HTTP leases, cancellation, execution timeouts, rejected unregistered tasks, quota validation and durable completion recovery. Diagnostics report only capability names and readiness, never credential values. Production operators should independently validate identity-provider behavior, backup restore, host isolation and workload-specific limits before accepting sensitive workloads.

/** Versioned REST and telemetry contract for the optional Python backend. */
export const BACKEND_PROTOCOL_VERSION = '1.0' as const;

export type BackendRunState =
  | 'created'
  | 'running'
  | 'paused'
  | 'completed'
  | 'stopped'
  | 'failed'
  | 'interrupted';

export type BackendModelId =
  | 'mlp-xor'
  | 'mlp-spiral'
  | 'cnn-shapes'
  | 'tiny-transformer';

export interface BackendCaptureConfig {
  modules: string[];
  every: number;
  max_elements: number;
  max_tensors: number;
  histogram_bins: number;
  activations: boolean;
  gradients: boolean;
  weights: boolean;
}

export interface BackendRunConfig {
  model_id: BackendModelId;
  name: string;
  project_id: string;
  seed: number;
  steps: number;
  batch_size: number;
  learning_rate: number;
  weight_decay: number;
  gradient_clip: number;
  capture: BackendCaptureConfig;
  checkpoint_every: number;
  validation_every: number;
  step_delay_ms: number;
  device: 'cpu';
}

export interface BackendRun {
  id: string;
  project_id: string;

  state: BackendRunState;
  step: number;
  sequence: number;
  created_at: number;
  updated_at: number;
  error: string | null;
}

  module: string;
  kind: 'activation' | 'activation-gradient' | 'weight' | 'parameter-gradient';
  step: number;
  shape: number[];
  dtype: string;
  elements: number;
  captured_elements: number;
  sampled: boolean;
  sampling: { method: 'uniform-stride'; stride: number };

}

export interface BackendEvent<T = Record<string, unknown>> {
  protocol_version: typeof BACKEND_PROTOCOL_VERSION;
  run_id: string;
  sequence: number;
  timestamp: number;
  step: number;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  rank: number;

  gap: boolean;
  next_sequence: number;
}

  inputs?: unknown[];
  sample_indices?: number[];
  split?: 'train' | 'validation';
}

  module: string;
  operation: 'ablate' | 'scale' | 'steer' | 'patch';
  strength?: number;
  indices?: number[];
  vector?: number[];
}

  run_id: string;

  available: boolean;

  lease_id: string;
  job_id: string;
  expires_at: number;
  lease_seconds: number;

    task: 'xor' | 'ddp-xor';
    seed: number;

    learning_rate: number;
    cpu_threads: number;
    memory_mb: number;
    world_size: number;
  };
}

export function isBackendEvent(value: unknown): value is BackendEvent {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false;
  const event = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return event.protocol_version === BACKEND_PROTOCOL_VERSION
    && typeof event.run_id === 'string'
    && typeof event.sequence === 'number'
    && Number.isSafeInteger(event.sequence)
    && event.sequence > 0
    && typeof event.timestamp === 'number'
    && Number.isFinite(event.timestamp)
    && typeof event.step === 'number'
    && Number.isSafeInteger(event.step)
    && event.step >= 0
    && typeof event.type === 'string'
    && typeof event.payload === 'object'
    && event.payload !== null;
}

export function describeCapture(summary: BackendTensorSummary): string {
  const coverage = summary.sampled
    ? `${summary.captured_elements} of ${summary.elements} values, sampled every ${summary.sampling.stride}`
    : `${summary.elements} complete values`;
  return `${summary.module}: ${summary.kind}, ${summary.shape.join(' × ')}, ${coverage}`;
}

export function websocketProtocols(token?: string): string[] | undefined {
  return token ? [`neuralis-token.${token}`] : undefined;
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the repository's textual source and configuration into one reviewable TXT.

The bundle is intentionally deterministic: paths are sorted, every section has a
stable marker, and a manifest records byte counts and SHA-256 digests. Installed
dependencies, generated builds, caches, model checkpoints, media and the bundle
itself are excluded so the result remains useful as a source archive.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_OUTPUT = ROOT / "neuralis-all-code.txt"
TEXT_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".c", ".cc", ".cpp", ".css", ".d.ts", ".go", ".h", ".html", ".ini", ".java",
    ".js", ".json", ".jsx", ".lock", ".mjs", ".md", ".py", ".rs", ".scss", ".sh",
    ".sql", ".toml", ".ts", ".tsx", ".txt", ".xml", ".yaml", ".yml",
}
TEXT_FILENAMES = {".gitignore", ".env.example", "Dockerfile", "Makefile", "README"}
EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES = {
    ".git", ".venv", ".venvs", ".cache", "node_modules", "dist", "target", "__pycache__",
    ".pytest_cache", ".ruff_cache", ".mypy_cache", "coverage", "htmlcov", "test-results",
    "playwright-report", "runs", "checkpoints", "recordings", "artifacts", "generated",
}
EXCLUDED_PREFIXES = ("screenshots/", "demos/super-mario/evidence/")
MAX_FILE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024


def is_source_file(path: Path, output: Path) -> bool:
    if path == output or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
        return False
    relative = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    if any(part in EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES for part in path.relative_to(ROOT).parts):
        return False
    if any(relative.startswith(prefix) for prefix in EXCLUDED_PREFIXES):
        return False
    if path.name in {"neuralis-all-code.txt", "code-count.json"}:
        return False
    if path.name in TEXT_FILENAMES or path.name.startswith("Dockerfile") or path.name.startswith("README"):
        return True
    return path.suffix.lower() in TEXT_EXTENSIONS


def read_text(path: Path) -> str | None:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    if b"\x00" in data:
        return None
    try:
        return data.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return None


def digest(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def compile_bundle(output: Path) -> tuple[int, int, str]:
    files: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    skipped = 0
    for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob("*")):
        if not is_source_file(path, output):
            continue
        text = read_text(path)
        if text is None:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        if not text.endswith("\n"):
            text += "\n"
        files.append((path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), text))

    generated = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()
    manifest_lines = [
        "NEURALIS STUDIO — COMPLETE TEXT SOURCE BUNDLE",
        "================================================",
        f"Generated (UTC): {generated}",
        f"Repository root: {ROOT}",
        "Encoding: UTF-8",
        "Contents: source code, tests, scripts, configuration and documentation",
        "Excluded: installed dependencies, builds, caches, binaries, media, checkpoints and runtime data",
        f"Included files: {len(files)}",
        f"Skipped binary/unreadable candidates: {skipped}",
        "",
        "FILE MANIFEST",
        "-------------",
    ]
    for relative, text in files:
        manifest_lines.append(f"{relative}\t{len(text.encode('utf-8'))} bytes\tsha256:{digest(text)}")
    manifest_lines.extend(["", "SOURCE FILES", "------------", ""])
    sections: list[str] = []
    for relative, text in files:
        sections.append(
            f"\n{'=' * 100}\n"
            f"BEGIN FILE: {relative}\n"
            f"{'=' * 100}\n"
            f"{text}"
            f"{'=' * 100}\n"
            f"END FILE: {relative}\n"
            f"{'=' * 100}\n"
        )
    content = "\n".join(manifest_lines) + "\n" + "".join(sections)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    return len(files), len(content.encode("utf-8")), hashlib.sha256(content.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = args.output if args.output.is_absolute() else ROOT / args.output
    files, size, checksum = compile_bundle(output)
    print(f"Wrote {output}")
    print(f"Included {files} files; {size:,} UTF-8 bytes")
    print(f"Bundle SHA-256: {checksum}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
====================================================================================================
END FILE: scripts/compile-code-bundle.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Report own production, test and tooling source without generated dependencies.

This is a conservative physical-line metric, not a statement of software quality.
It excludes blank lines and comment-only lines, reports multiline docstrings as
documentation, and separates test files from production. Run cloc independently
for a language-aware cross-check when it is available.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import io
import json
import re
import tokenize
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EXTENSIONS = {".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".py", ".rs", ".css", ".scss", ".sh"}
EXCLUDED_PARTS = {
    "node_modules", "dist", "target", ".git", ".venv", ".venvs", "__pycache__",
    ".pytest_cache", ".ruff_cache", ".mypy_cache", "coverage", "htmlcov", "generated",
    "test-results", "playwright-report", "artifacts", "checkpoints", "recordings",
}


def python_documentation_lines(source: str) -> set[int]:
    """Identify standalone string blocks rather than counting docstrings as code."""
    documented: set[int] = set()
    previous_type = tokenize.NEWLINE
    try:
        for token in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(source).readline):
            if token.type == tokenize.STRING and previous_type in {
                tokenize.INDENT, tokenize.NEWLINE, tokenize.DEDENT, tokenize.NL,
            }:
                documented.update(range(token.start[0], token.end[0] + 1))
            if token.type not in {tokenize.COMMENT, tokenize.ENCODING}:
                previous_type = token.type
    except (tokenize.TokenError, IndentationError):
        pass
    return documented


def source_lines(path: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    counts = {"physical": 0, "code": 0, "blank": 0, "comment": 0}
    documentation = python_documentation_lines(text) if path.suffix == ".py" else set()
    in_block = False
    for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
        counts["physical"] += 1
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            counts["blank"] += 1
            continue
        if number in documentation:
            counts["comment"] += 1
            continue
        if path.suffix in {".py", ".sh"}:
            is_comment = stripped.startswith("#")
        else:
            is_comment = stripped.startswith("//")
            if in_block:
                if "*/" in stripped:
                    after = stripped.split("*/", 1)[1].strip()
                    in_block = False
                    is_comment = not after
                else:
                    is_comment = True
            elif stripped.startswith("/*"):
                if "*/" in stripped:
                    is_comment = not stripped.split("*/", 1)[1].strip()
                else:
                    in_block = True
                    is_comment = True
        counts["comment" if is_comment else "code"] += 1
    return counts


def category(path: Path) -> str:
    relative = path.relative_to(ROOT)
    parts = relative.parts
    name = path.name
    if "tests" in parts or "__tests__" in parts or re.search(r"\.(test|spec)\.", name) or name.startswith("test_"):
        return "tests"
    if parts[0] in {"scripts", "benchmarks"}:
        return "tooling"
    if name.endswith(".config.ts") or name in {"build.rs"}:
        return "configuration_code"
    return "production"


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum", type=int, default=0, help="Optional required production-line threshold")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    totals: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    languages: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    files = []
    for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob("*")):
        if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in EXTENSIONS:
            continue
        relative = path.relative_to(ROOT)
        if EXCLUDED_PARTS.intersection(relative.parts):
            continue
        try:
            lines = source_lines(path)
        except (UnicodeError, OSError):
            continue
        kind = category(path)
        totals[kind] += lines["code"]
        languages[path.suffix] += lines["code"]
        files.append({"path": str(relative), "category": kind, **lines})
    result = {
        "metric": "physical nonblank non-comment source lines; tests/tooling/config separated",
        "production_target": 30000,
        "production_target_met": totals["production"] >= 30000,
        "totals": dict(totals),
        "languages": dict(languages),
        "file_count": len(files),
        "files": files,
    }
    if args.output:
        target = args.output if args.output.is_absolute() else ROOT / args.output
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in result.items() if key != "files"}, indent=2))
    if args.minimum and totals["production"] < args.minimum:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
====================================================================================================
END FILE: scripts/count-code.py

import { cp, mkdir, readdir, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, extname, join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const destination = join(root, 'apps/web/dist');
const excluded = new Set(['node_modules', '__pycache__', '.venv', '.pytest_cache', 'runs', 'checkpoints', 'recordings', 'tests', 'target']);
const extensions = new Set(['.html', '.css', '.js', '.mjs', '.ts', '.tsx', '.py', '.rs', '.json', '.toml', '.yaml', '.yml', '.md', '.txt', '.png', '.svg', '.csv']);

async function copyTree(source, target) {
  for (const entry of await readdir(source, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (entry.name.startsWith('.') || excluded.has(entry.name)) continue;
    const path = join(source, entry.name);
    const output = join(target, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) await copyTree(path, output);
    else if (extensions.has(extname(entry.name))) {
      const size = (await stat(path)).size;
      if (size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
        console.warn(`Not publishing oversized demo artifact: ${relative(root, path)}`);
        continue;
      }
      await mkdir(dirname(output), { recursive: true });
      await cp(path, output);
    }
  }
}

await mkdir(destination, { recursive: true });
await copyTree(join(root, 'demos'), join(destination, 'demos'));
await copyTree(join(root, 'screenshots'), join(destination, 'screenshots'));
await writeFile(join(destination, '.nojekyll'), '');
console.log('Packaged runnable demo sources, measured Mario report and screenshot evidence into the static build.');

BEGIN FILE: services/api/src/neuralis/analysis/cross_validation.py

import math

import numpy as np
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
import torch

from neuralis.core.schemas import RunConfig
from neuralis.datasets.synthetic import DataSplit
from neuralis.models.registry import build_model
from neuralis.runtime.devices import optimizer_for, resolve_device, scheduled_learning_rate
from neuralis.runtime.supervisor import evaluate, loss_for


class CrossValidationRequest(BaseModel):
    dataset_id: str
    config: RunConfig = Field(default_factory=lambda: RunConfig(steps=100))
    folds: int = Field(default=3, ge=2, le=10)
    standardize: bool = False


def stratified_folds(targets, folds, seed):
    array = np.asarray(targets, dtype=np.int64)
    generator = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    partitions = [[] for _ in range(folds)]
    for label in np.unique(array):
        indices = np.flatnonzero(array == label)
        if len(indices) < folds:
            raise ValueError("Every class must contain at least one observation per fold")
        generator.shuffle(indices)
        for fold, subset in enumerate(np.array_split(indices, folds)):
            partitions[fold].extend(subset.tolist())
    result = [np.array(sorted(partition), dtype=np.int64) for partition in partitions]
    if len(set(np.concatenate(result).tolist())) != len(array):
        raise ValueError("Fold partition did not preserve unique observations")
    return result


def cross_validate(store, request):
    config = request.config
    if config.model_id not in {"mlp-xor", "mlp-spiral", "cnn-shapes"} or config.steps > 500:
        raise ValueError("Cross-validation is limited to classification models and 500 steps per fold")
    metadata = store.metadata(request.dataset_id)
    if metadata["project_id"] != config.project_id or metadata["model_id"] != config.model_id:
        raise ValueError("Cross-validation dataset must match the project and model task")
    if metadata["preprocessing"]["method"] != "none":
        raise ValueError("Cross-validation requires an unprocessed import; standardization must be fitted independently in each fold")
    bundle = store.load(request.dataset_id, config.model_id)
    inputs = torch.cat([bundle.train.inputs, bundle.validation.inputs])
    targets = torch.cat([bundle.train.targets, bundle.validation.targets])
    if len(inputs) > 5000:
        raise ValueError("Cross-validation observation budget is 5,000 examples")
    partitions = stratified_folds(targets.numpy(), request.folds, config.seed)
    reports = []
    device = resolve_device(config.device)
    for fold, held_out in enumerate(partitions):
        training_indices = np.concatenate([partition for index, partition in enumerate(partitions) if index != fold])
        train_x, valid_x = inputs[training_indices].clone(), inputs[held_out].clone()
        if request.standardize:
            mean = train_x.mean(0)
            scale = train_x.std(0, unbiased=False).clamp_min(1e-6)
            train_x = (train_x - mean) / scale
            valid_x = (valid_x - mean) / scale
        training = DataSplit(train_x, targets[training_indices])
        validation = DataSplit(valid_x, targets[held_out])
        model = build_model(config.model_id, config.seed + fold, config.architecture).to(device)
        optimizer = optimizer_for(model, config)
        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(config.seed + fold + 1000)
        baseline = evaluate(model, validation)
        for step in range(config.steps):
            indices = torch.randint(len(training), (config.batch_size,), generator=generator)
            x, y = training.batch(indices)
            logits = model(x.to(device))
            loss = loss_for(logits, y.to(device))
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), config.gradient_clip or float("inf"))
            for group in optimizer.param_groups:
                group["lr"] = scheduled_learning_rate(config, step)
            optimizer.step()
        final = evaluate(model, validation)
        reports.append({"fold": fold, "seed": config.seed + fold, "training_examples": len(training),
                        "validation_examples": len(validation), "baseline": baseline, "final": final,
                        "held_out_indices": held_out.tolist()})
    losses = [report["final"]["validation_loss"] for report in reports]
    accuracies = [report["final"]["validation_accuracy"] for report in reports]
    return {"folds": reports, "aggregate": {"mean_validation_loss": float(np.mean(losses)),
                                            "standard_deviation_loss": float(np.std(losses, ddof=1)),
                                            "mean_validation_accuracy": float(np.mean(accuracies)),
                                            "standard_deviation_accuracy": float(np.std(accuracies, ddof=1))},
            "seed": config.seed, "standardize": request.standardize,
            "interpretation": "Stratified held-out folds; hyperparameter selection on these folds requires a separate final test set."}

END FILE: services/api/src/neuralis/analysis/cross_validation.py

from contextlib import contextmanager
import time

import torch
from torch import nn

from neuralis.core.schemas import AttributionRequest, ExperimentRequest, InferenceRequest
from neuralis.runtime.capture import summarize_tensor
from neuralis.runtime.supervisor import loss_for
from neuralis.runtime.devices import module_device


def prepare_input(request: InferenceRequest, dataset):
    split = dataset.train if request.split == "train" else dataset.validation
    if request.inputs is not None:
        inputs = torch.tensor(request.inputs, dtype=split.inputs.dtype)
        if inputs.ndim != split.inputs.ndim or tuple(inputs.shape[1:]) != tuple(split.inputs.shape[1:]):
            raise ValueError(f"Expected batched shape [N,{','.join(map(str,split.inputs.shape[1:]))}]")
        if inputs.shape[0] < 1 or inputs.shape[0] > 64:
            raise ValueError("Inference batch must contain 1 to 64 examples")
        if inputs.is_floating_point() and not torch.isfinite(inputs).all():
            raise ValueError("Inference inputs must be finite")
        if not inputs.is_floating_point() and (inputs.min() < 0 or inputs.max() >= len(dataset.labels)):
            raise ValueError("Token ID outside the registered vocabulary")
        return inputs, None
    if not request.sample_indices:
        raise ValueError("Select at least one sample")
    indices = torch.tensor(request.sample_indices, dtype=torch.long)
    if indices.min() < 0 or indices.max() >= len(split):
        raise ValueError("Dataset sample index is out of range")
    return split.inputs[indices].clone(), split.targets[indices].clone()


def output_summary(logits, targets=None, labels=()):
    probabilities = logits.softmax(-1)
    selected = logits[:, -1] if logits.ndim == 3 else logits
    selected_probabilities = selected.softmax(-1)
    top_count = min(5, selected.shape[-1])
    values, indices = selected_probabilities.topk(top_count, -1)
    result = {"logits": logits.detach().tolist(), "probabilities": probabilities.detach().tolist(),
              "predictions": logits.argmax(-1).detach().tolist(), "shape": list(logits.shape),
              "top_predictions": [[{"index": int(index), "label": labels[index] if labels else str(index),
                                    "probability": float(value)} for value, index in zip(row_values, row_indices)]
                                  for row_values, row_indices in zip(values, indices)]}
    if targets is not None:
        result["loss"] = float(loss_for(logits, targets))
        result["accuracy"] = float((logits.argmax(-1) == targets).float().mean())
    return result


def infer(model, dataset, request: InferenceRequest):
    inputs, targets = prepare_input(request, dataset)
    device = module_device(model)
    inputs = inputs.to(device)
    targets = targets.to(device) if targets is not None else None
    with torch.no_grad():
        logits = model(inputs)
        return {"input": inputs.tolist(), "targets": targets.tolist() if targets is not None else None,
                "output": output_summary(logits, targets, dataset.labels)}


@contextmanager
def intervention_hooks(model, specifications, clean_activations=None):
    modules = dict(model.named_modules())
    handles = []
    clean_activations = clean_activations or {}
    applied = []
    try:
        for specification in specifications:
            if specification.module not in modules or not specification.module:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown intervention module: {specification.module}")
            def hook(module, inputs, output, spec=specification):
                if not isinstance(output, torch.Tensor):
                    raise ValueError(f"Module {spec.module} has an unsupported non-tensor output")
                replacement = output.clone()
                indices = spec.indices
                if indices is not None and (not indices or min(indices) < 0 or max(indices) >= output.shape[-1]):
                    raise ValueError("Intervention indices select the last tensor axis and must be in range")
                selection = (..., indices) if indices is not None else (...,)
                selected = replacement[selection]
                if spec.operation == "ablate":
                    replacement[selection] = 0
                elif spec.operation == "scale":
                    replacement[selection] = selected * spec.strength
                elif spec.operation == "steer":
                    if spec.vector is None:
                        raise ValueError("Steering requires an explicit vector with recorded provenance")
                    vector = torch.tensor(spec.vector, dtype=output.dtype, device=output.device)
                    if vector.numel() != selected.shape[-1]:
                        raise ValueError(f"Steering vector must have {selected.shape[-1]} elements")
                    replacement[selection] = selected + spec.strength * vector
                else:
                    if spec.module not in clean_activations:
                        raise ValueError("Patching requires a clean input and a captured clean activation")
                    clean = clean_activations[spec.module]
                    if clean.shape != output.shape:
                        raise ValueError("Clean/corrupted activation shapes must match exactly")
                    replacement[selection] = clean[selection]
                applied.append({"module": spec.module, "operation": spec.operation, "shape": list(output.shape),
                                "axis": "last", "indices": indices, "strength": spec.strength,
                                "change_norm": float(torch.linalg.vector_norm((replacement - output).float()))})
                return replacement
            handles.append(modules[specification.module].register_forward_hook(hook))
        yield applied
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()


def capture_clean(model, inputs, names):
    modules = dict(model.named_modules())
    activations, handles = {}, []
    try:
        for name in names:
            if name not in modules:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown patch module: {name}")
            def capture(module, arguments, output, target=name):
                if not isinstance(output, torch.Tensor):
                    raise ValueError("Patching supports tensor outputs only")
                activations[target] = output.detach().clone()
            handles.append(modules[name].register_forward_hook(capture))
        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = model(inputs)
        return activations, logits
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()


def execute_experiment(model, dataset, request: ExperimentRequest):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    inputs, targets = prepare_input(request.input, dataset)
    device = module_device(model)
    inputs = inputs.to(device)
    targets = targets.to(device) if targets is not None else None
    with torch.no_grad():
        baseline = model(inputs)
    patch_names = {spec.module for spec in request.interventions if spec.operation == "patch"}
    clean_activations, clean_logits = {}, None
    if patch_names:
        if request.clean_input is None:
            raise ValueError("Activation patching requires clean_input")
        clean_inputs, _ = prepare_input(request.clean_input, dataset)
        clean_inputs = clean_inputs.to(device)
        clean_activations, clean_logits = capture_clean(model, clean_inputs, patch_names)
    with torch.no_grad(), intervention_hooks(model, request.interventions, clean_activations) as applied:
        changed = model(inputs)
    base_probabilities = baseline.softmax(-1)
    changed_probabilities = changed.softmax(-1)
    # KL(base || changed), computed from log_softmax to avoid probability underflow.
    kl = (base_probabilities * (baseline.log_softmax(-1) - changed.log_softmax(-1))).sum(-1).mean()
    metrics = {"kl_baseline_to_intervention": float(kl),
               "logit_l2": float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(changed - baseline)),
               "mean_probability_change": float((changed_probabilities - base_probabilities).abs().mean()),
               "prediction_change_fraction": float((changed.argmax(-1) != baseline.argmax(-1)).float().mean())}
    if targets is not None:
        metrics["delta_loss"] = float(loss_for(changed, targets) - loss_for(baseline, targets))
    if request.target_class is not None:
        if request.target_class >= baseline.shape[-1]:
            raise ValueError("Target class is out of range")
        metrics["target_logit_change"] = float((changed[..., request.target_class] - baseline[..., request.target_class]).mean())
    if clean_logits is not None:
        corrupted_distance = torch.linalg.vector_norm(baseline - clean_logits)
        patched_distance = torch.linalg.vector_norm(changed - clean_logits)
        metrics["clean_logit_distance_before"] = float(corrupted_distance)
        metrics["clean_logit_distance_after"] = float(patched_distance)
        metrics["patch_recovery"] = float(1 - patched_distance / corrupted_distance) if corrupted_distance > 1e-12 else None
    return {"baseline": output_summary(baseline, targets, dataset.labels),
            "intervention": output_summary(changed, targets, dataset.labels),
            "clean": output_summary(clean_logits, None, dataset.labels) if clean_logits is not None else None,
            "metrics": metrics, "applied": applied, "elapsed_ms": (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000,
            "interpretation": "Measured effects on this input; attention and attribution alone do not establish causality."}


def attribution(model, dataset, request: AttributionRequest):
    inputs, _ = prepare_input(request.input, dataset)
    inputs = inputs.to(module_device(model))
    if not inputs.is_floating_point():
        raise ValueError("Input attribution requires floating inputs; token IDs need an embedding-specific adapter")
    with torch.no_grad():
        logits = model(inputs)
    target_indices = logits.argmax(-1) if request.target_class is None else torch.full(logits.shape[:-1], request.target_class, dtype=torch.long, device=inputs.device)
    if target_indices.max() >= logits.shape[-1]:
        raise ValueError("Target class is out of range")

    def score(x):
        return model(x).gather(-1, target_indices.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)

    baseline = torch.zeros_like(inputs)
    if request.method == "gradient-input":
        variable = inputs.detach().requires_grad_(True)
        gradient = torch.autograd.grad(score(variable).sum(), variable)[0]
        values = gradient * inputs
        completeness = None
    else:
        # Trapezoidal quadrature includes both endpoints and reports completeness residual.
        total_gradient = torch.zeros_like(inputs)
        for index in range(request.integration_steps + 1):
            alpha = index / request.integration_steps
            variable = (baseline + alpha * (inputs - baseline)).detach().requires_grad_(True)
            gradient = torch.autograd.grad(score(variable).sum(), variable)[0]
            total_gradient += gradient * (0.5 if index in (0, request.integration_steps) else 1.)
        values = (inputs - baseline) * total_gradient / request.integration_steps
        with torch.no_grad():
            output_difference = score(inputs) - score(baseline)
        attribution_sum = values.reshape(len(values), -1).sum(-1)
        completeness = {"output_difference": output_difference.tolist(), "attribution_sum": attribution_sum.tolist(),
                        "residual": (attribution_sum - output_difference).tolist()}
    return {"method": request.method, "target_classes": target_indices.tolist(), "baseline": "zero input",
            "integration_steps": request.integration_steps if request.method == "integrated-gradients" else None,
            "attribution": summarize_tensor(values, 16384), "values": values.detach().tolist(),
            "completeness": completeness, "interpretation": "Local/path sensitivity, not a causal circuit proof."}


def circuit_candidates(model, dataset, request: InferenceRequest, target_class=None, limit=32):
    inputs, _ = prepare_input(request, dataset)
    inputs = inputs.to(module_device(model))
    observations, handles = [], []
    try:
        for name, module in model.named_modules():
            if not name or any(module.children()):
                continue
            def capture(mod, arguments, output, module_name=name):
                if isinstance(output, torch.Tensor) and output.requires_grad:
                    output.retain_grad()
                    observations.append((module_name, output))
            handles.append(module.register_forward_hook(capture))
        logits = model(inputs)
        selected = logits[:, -1] if logits.ndim == 3 else logits
        classes = selected.argmax(-1) if target_class is None else torch.full((len(selected),), target_class, dtype=torch.long, device=inputs.device)
        if classes.max() >= selected.shape[-1]:
            raise ValueError("Target class out of range")
        selected.gather(-1, classes[:, None]).sum().backward()
        nodes = []
        for name, output in observations:
            if output.grad is not None:
                product = output.detach() * output.grad.detach()
                nodes.append({"id": name, "score": float(product.abs().mean()),
                              "signed_score": float(product.mean()), "shape": list(output.shape)})
        edges = [{"source": source["id"], "target": target["id"],
                  "score": min(source["score"], target["score"]), "kind": "observed-order-candidate"}
                 for source, target in zip(nodes, nodes[1:])]
        ranked = sorted(nodes, key=lambda node: node["score"], reverse=True)[:limit]
        selected_names = {node["id"] for node in ranked}
        return {"nodes": ranked, "edges": [edge for edge in edges if edge["source"] in selected_names and edge["target"] in selected_names],
                "method": "mean absolute gradient × activation", "target_classes": classes.tolist(),
                "causally_verified": False, "coverage": "Observed leaf execution order; residual dependencies are not fully represented.",
                "interpretation": "Hypotheses for intervention testing; scores do not prove causal edges."}
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()
        model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
